items.en: Journalistic tastes had changed long before his death, and postmodern readers have little use for the richly upholstered Vicwardian prose in which he specialized.
items.zh: 在他去世很久之前，新闻业的品味就已经发生了变化，后现代的读者对那种华丽繁复的维多利亚式散文几乎没什么兴趣。

items.en: Moreover, the amateur tradition in music criticism has been in headlong retreat.
items.zh: 此外，音乐评论中的业余传统正迅速衰退。

items.en: Over the past decade, thousands of patents have been granted for what are called business methods.
items.zh: 在过去十年中，数千项专利被授予了一些被称为商业方法的发明。

items.en: Amazon.com received one for its "one-click" online payment system.
items.zh: 亚马逊.com就因其"一键支付"在线支付系统获得了一项专利。

items.en: Merrill Lynch got legal protection for an asset allocation strategy.
items.zh: 美林证券则获得了对其资产配置策略的法律保护。

items.en: One inventor patented a technique for lifting a box.
items.zh: 有一位发明者甚至为一种提起箱子的技术申请了专利。

items.en: Now the nation's top patent court appears completely ready to scale back on business-method patents, which have been controversial ever since they were first authorized 10 years ago.
items.zh: 现在，这个国家最高级别的专利法院似乎已完全准备削减商业方法专利，这类专利自十年前首次被授权以来就一直存在争议。

items.en: In a move that has intellectual-property lawyers abuzz, the u.s. Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit said it would use a particular case to conduct a broad review of business-method patents.
items.zh: 这一举措让知识产权律师们议论纷纷，美国联邦巡回上诉法院表示，它将利用一个特定案例对商业方法专利进行广泛审查。

items.en: Of all the changes that have taken place in English-language newspapers during the past quarter-century, perhaps the most far-reaching has been the inexorable decline in the scope and seriousness of their arts coverage.
items.zh: 在过去的二十五年里，英语报纸发生了很多变化，其中最深远的变化可能是其艺术报道的范围和严肃性不可逆转地减少了。

items.en: It is difficult to the point of impossibility for the average reader under the age of forty to imagine a time when high-quality arts criticism could be found in most big-city newspapers.
items.zh: 对于四十岁以下的普通读者来说，很难想象曾经有一段时间，大多数大城市的报纸上都能找到高质量的艺术评论。

items.en: Yet a considerable number of the most significant collections of criticism published in the 20th century consisted in large part of newspaper reviews.
items.zh: 然而，20世纪出版的一些最重要的评论文集，很大程度上是由报纸上的评论文章组成的。

items.en: To read such books today is to marvel at the fact that their learned contents were once deemed suitable for publication in general-circulation dailies.
items.zh: 今天阅读这些书籍，人们会惊叹于这些深奥的内容曾经被认为适合发表在面向大众的日报上。

items.en: We are even farther removed from the unfocused newspaper reviews published in England between the turn of the 20th century and the eve of World War II, at a time when newsprint was dirt-cheap and stylish arts criticism was considered an ornament to the publications in which it appeared.
items.zh: 我们与20世纪初到第二次世界大战前夕英国报纸上发表的那些不那么聚焦的评论文章更是相去甚远，那时报纸纸张极其便宜，而风格高雅的艺术评论则被视为其出版物的装饰。

items.en: In those far-off days, it was taken for granted that the critics of major papers would write in detail and at length about the events they covered.
items.zh: 在那个遥远的年代，人们理所当然地认为，主要报纸的评论家会详细而深入地撰写他们所报道的事件。

items.en: Theirs was a serious business, and even those reviewers who wore their learning lightly, like George Bernard Shaw and Ernest Newman, could be trusted to know what they were about.
items.zh: 他们的工作是严肃的，即使是那些轻描淡写地展示学识的评论家，比如乔治·伯纳德·肖和欧内斯特·纽曼，也让人放心地相信他们知道自己在写什么。

items.en: These men believed in journalism as a calling, and were proud to be published in the daily press.
items.zh: 这些人相信新闻业是一种使命，并为自己的文章发表在日报上而感到自豪。

items.en: The Bilski case involves a claimed patent on a method for hedging risk in the energy market.
items.zh: Bilski案涉及一项声称的专利，该专利是关于在能源市场中对冲风险的方法。

items.en: The Federal Circuit issued an unusual order stating that the case would be heard by all 12 of the court's judges, rather than a typical panel of three, and that one issue it wants to evaluate is whether it should "reconsider" its State Street Bank ruling.
items.zh: 联邦巡回法院发布了一项不同寻常的命令，指出该案将由法院全部12名法官审理，而不是通常由三名法官组成的小组，并且法院希望评估的一个问题是，是否应该"重新考虑"其此前的State Street Bank裁决。

items.en: The Federal Circuit's action comes in the wake of a series of recent decisions by the Supreme Court that has narrowed the scope of protections for patent holders.
items.zh: 联邦巡回法院的这一行动是在最高法院一系列最近的裁决之后发生的，这些裁决已经缩小了对专利持有人的保护范围。

items.en: Last April, for example, the justices signaled that too many patents were being upheld for "inventions" that are obvious.
items.zh: 例如，去年四月，法官们表示，太多专利被维持有效，而这些专利所涉及的"发明"实际上是显而易见的。

items.en: The judges on the Federal Circuit are "reacting to the anti-patent trend at the Supreme Court," says Harold C.
items.zh: 联邦巡回法院的法官们表示，"他们正在回应最高法院的反专利趋势，"哈罗德·C说。

items.en: Wegner, a patent attorney and professor at George Washington University Law School.
items.zh: 韦格纳，一位专利律师兼乔治·华盛顿大学法学院教授。

items.en: In his book The Tipping Point, Malcolm Gladwell argues that "social epidemics" are driven in large part by the actions of a tiny minority of special individuals, often called influentials, who are unusually informed, persuasive, or well connected.
items.zh: 在他的著作《引爆点》中，马尔科姆·格拉德威尔认为，"社会流行"在很大程度上是由一小部分特殊个体的行为驱动的，这些人通常被称为有影响力者，他们往往信息特别灵通、极具说服力或人脉广泛。

items.en: The idea is intuitively compelling, but it doesn't explain how ideas actually spread.
items.zh: 这个想法在直觉上很有吸引力，但它并不能解释思想究竟是如何传播的。

items.en: The supposed importance of influentials derives from a plausible-sounding but largely untested theory called the "two-step flow of communication": Information flows from the media to the influentials and from them to everyone else.
items.zh: 所谓影响者的重要性源自一种听起来合理但大多未经验证的理论，称为"传播的两步流程"：信息从媒体流向影响者，再由他们流向其他人。

items.en: Marketers have embraced the two-step flow because it suggests that if they can just find and influence the influentials, those select people will do most of the work for them.
items.zh: 营销人员接受了这种两步流程理论，因为它表明，只要他们能找到并影响这些影响者，这些人就会为他们完成大部分工作。

items.en: The theory also seems to explain the sudden and unexpected popularity of certain looks, brands, or neighborhoods.
items.zh: 这一理论似乎也能解释某些风格、品牌或街区突然而意外的流行。

items.en: In many such cases, a cursory search for causes finds that some small group of people was wearing, promoting, or developing whatever it is before anyone else paid attention.
items.zh: 在许多这样的案例中，粗略地寻找原因会发现，总有一些小群体在其他人注意到之前就已经在穿、推广或发展这些东西了。

items.en: Anecdotal evidence of this kind fits nicely with the idea that only certain special people can drive trends.
items.zh: 这种轶事证据与这样一个观点非常吻合：只有某些特殊的人才能引领潮流。

items.en: In their recent work, however, some researchers have come up with the finding that influentials have far less impact on social epidemics than is generally supposed.
items.zh: 然而，最近一些研究人员的研究结果表明，影响者对社会流行现象的影响远没有人们普遍认为的那么大。

items.en: In fact, they don't seem to be required at all.
items.zh: 事实上，他们似乎根本就不是必需的。

items.en: The researchers' argument stems from a simple observation about social influence: With the exception of a few celebrities like Oprah Winfrey - whose outsize presence is primarily a function of media, not interpersonal, influence - even the most influential members of a population simply don't interact with that many others.
items.zh: 研究人员的论点源于对社会影响的一个简单观察：除了像奥普拉·温弗瑞这样少数几位其巨大影响力主要源于媒体而非人际影响的名人外，人群中最有影响力的人实际上并不与太多其他人互动。

items.en: These rules say they must value some assets at the price a third party would pay, not the price managers and regulators would like them to fetch.
items.zh: 这些规则规定，他们必须按照第三方愿意支付的价格来评估某些资产，而不是管理人员和监管者希望它们达到的价格。

items.en: Unfortunately, banks' lobbying now seems to be working.
items.zh: 不幸的是，银行的游说现在似乎正在奏效。

items.en: The details may be unknowable, but the independence of standard-setters, essential to the proper functioning of capital markets, is being compromised.
items.zh: 细节可能无法知晓，但标准制定者的独立性对于资本市场正常运作至关重要，而现在这种独立性正受到威胁。

items.en: And, unless banks carry toxic assets at prices that attract buyers, reviving the banking system will be difficult.
items.zh: 而且，除非银行以能吸引买家的价格持有有毒资产，否则恢复银行体系将十分困难。

items.en: After a bruising encounter with Congress, America's Financial Accounting Standards Board (FASB) rushed through rule changes.
items.zh: 在与国会激烈交锋之后，美国财务会计准则委员会（FASB）匆忙通过了规则修改。

items.en: These gave banks more freedom to use models to value illiquid assets and more flexibility in recognizing losses on long-term assets in their income statement.
items.zh: 这些修改使银行在使用模型评估非流动性资产时拥有更多自由，并在损益表中确认长期资产损失时拥有更大的灵活性。

items.en: Bob Herz, the FASB's chairman, cried out against those who "question our motives.
items.zh: FASB主席鲍勃·赫兹（Bob Herz）对那些质疑我们动机的人表示强烈反对。

items.en: Yet bank shares rose and the changes enhance what one lobby group politely calls "the use of judgment by management.
items.zh: 然而，银行股票上涨了，这些变化增强了一个游说团体礼貌地称之为"管理层判断运用"的内容。

items.en: Yet it is precisely these non-celebrity influentials who, according to the two-step-flow theory, are supposed to drive social epidemics, by influencing their friends and colleagues directly.
items.zh: 然而，正是这些非名人影响力者，根据两步传播理论，应该通过直接影响他们的朋友和同事来推动社会流行现象。

items.en: For a social epidemic to occur, however, each person so affected must then influence his or her own acquaintances, who must in turn influence theirs, and so on; and just how many others pay attention to each of these people has little to do with the initial influential.
items.zh: 然而，要使社会流行现象发生，每个受到影响的人随后都必须去影响他们自己的熟人，而这些熟人又必须进一步影响他们自己的熟人，依此类推；而究竟有多少其他人关注这些受影响的人，与最初的影响力者关系不大。

items.en: If people in the network just two degrees removed from the initial influential prove resistant, for example, the cascade of change won't propagate very far or affect many people.
items.zh: 例如，如果距离最初的影响力者仅隔两层关系的人表现出抵抗，那么这种变化的连锁反应就不会传播得很远，也不会影响到很多人。

items.en: Building on this basic truth about interpersonal influence, the researchers studied the dynamics of social influence by conducting thousands of computer simulations of populations, manipulating a number of variables relating to people's ability to influence others and their tendency to be influenced.
items.zh: 基于这一关于人际影响的基本事实，研究人员通过进行数千次计算机模拟，研究了社会影响的动态过程，并操控了与人们影响他人能力及其容易被影响倾向相关的一些变量。

items.en: They found that the principal requirement for what is called "global cascades" - the widespread propagation of influence through networks - is the presence not of a few influentials but, rather, of a critical mass of easily influenced people.
items.zh: 他们发现，所谓"全球连锁反应"——即通过网络广泛传播影响力——的主要条件并不是少数影响力者，而是存在一大批容易被影响的人，即所谓的临界质量。

items.en: Bankers have been blaming themselves for their troubles in public.
items.zh: 银行家们在公众场合一直将自己遭遇的困境归咎于自身。

items.en: Behind the scenes, they have been taking aim at someone else: the accounting standard-setters.
items.zh: 但在幕后，他们却把矛头指向了其他人：制定会计准则的机构。

items.en: Their rules, moan the banks, have forced them to report enormous losses, and it's just not fair.
items.zh: 他们抱怨说，这些机构制定的规则迫使他们报告巨额损失，这显然是不公平的。

items.en: In re Bilski, as the case is known, is "a very big deal," says Dennis D.
items.zh: 在该案被称为"In re Bilski"中，丹尼斯·D.表示，这"是一个非常重大的事件"。

items.en: Crouch of the University of Missouri School of Law.
items.zh: 密苏里大学法学院的克劳奇。

items.en: It "has the potential to eliminate an entire class of patents.
items.zh: 它有潜力消除整个一类专利。

items.en: Curbs on business-method claims would be a dramatic about-face, because it was the Federal Circuit itself that introduced such patents with its 1998 decision in the so-called State Street Bank case, approving a patent on a way of pooling mutual-fund assets.
items.zh: 对商业方法专利的限制将是一个戏剧性的转变，因为正是联邦巡回法院本身在1998年所谓的State Street Bank案中裁定引入此类专利，批准了一种将共同基金资产进行集合的方法的专利。

items.en: That ruling produced an explosion in business-method patent filings, initially by emerging Internet companies trying to stake out exclusive rights to specific types of online transactions.
items.zh: 该裁决导致了商业方法专利申请的激增，最初是由新兴的互联网公司申请的，这些公司试图为特定类型的在线交易确立排他性权利。

items.en: Later, more established companies raced to add such patents to their files, if only as a defensive move against rivals that might beat them to the punch.
items.zh: 后来，一些更为成熟的企业纷纷竞相将此类专利加入自己的文件中，即使只是为了防范竞争对手抢先一步。

items.en: In 2005, IBM noted in a court filing that it had been issued more than 300 business-method patents, despite the fact that it questioned the legal basis for granting them.
items.zh: 2005年，IBM在一份法庭文件中指出，尽管它质疑授予这些专利的法律依据，但该公司已获得了超过300项商业方法专利。

items.en: Similarly, some Wall Street investment firms armed themselves with patents for financial products, even as they took positions in court cases opposing the practice.
items.zh: 同样，一些华尔街投资公司通过拥有金融产品的专利来武装自己，即使他们在法庭上反对这种做法的案件中持有立场。

items.en: European ministers instantly demanded that the International Accounting Standards Board (IASB) do likewise.
items.zh: 欧洲部长们立刻要求国际会计准则委员会（IASB）采取同样的做法。

items.en: The IASB says it does not want to act without overall planning, but the pressure to fold when it completes its reconstruction of rules later this year is strong.
items.zh: IASB表示，它不希望在没有整体规划的情况下采取行动，但今年晚些时候在完成规则重建后屈服于压力的可能性很大。

items.en: Charlie McCreevy, a European commissioner, warned the IASB that it did "not live in a political vacuum" but "in the real world" and that Europe could yet develop different rules.
items.zh: 欧盟委员查理·麦克克里维警告IASB，它并非生活在政治真空之中，而是现实世界里，并指出欧洲仍可能制定出不同的规则。

items.en: It was banks that were on the wrong planet, with accounts that vastly overvalued assets.
items.zh: 当时，银行才是身处另一个星球的一方，它们的账面价值严重高估了资产。

items.en: Today they argue that market prices overstate losses, because they largely reflect the temporary illiquidity of markets, not the likely extent of bad debts.
items.zh: 如今它们则认为，市场价格夸大了损失，因为市场价格主要反映了市场的暂时性流动性不足，而非坏账可能的实际程度。

items.en: The truth will not be known for years.
items.zh: 真相要过数年才能揭晓。

items.en: But banks' shares trade below their book value, suggesting that investors are skeptical.
items.zh: 但银行的股票交易价格低于其账面价值，这表明投资者持怀疑态度。

items.en: And dead markets partly reflect the paralysis of banks which will not sell assets for fear of booking losses, yet are reluctant to buy all those supposed bargains.
items.zh: 而且，死气沉沉的市场部分反映了银行的瘫痪状态：它们不愿出售资产以避免确认损失，却又不愿意购买所有那些所谓的廉价资产。

items.en: So few authors have brains enough or literary gift enough to keep their own end up in journalism," Newman wrote, "that I am tempted to define 'journalism' as 'a term of contempt applied by writers who are not read to writers who are'.
items.zh: 纽曼写道："如此之少的作者拥有足够的头脑或文学天赋来在新闻业中维持自己的地位，以至于我忍不住想把‘新闻业’定义为‘由不被阅读的作家用来蔑视那些被阅读的作家的术语’。

items.en: Unfortunately, these critics are virtually forgotten.
items.zh: 不幸的是，这些批评者几乎已经被人们遗忘了。

items.en: Neville Cardus, who wrote for the Manchester Guardian from 1917 until shortly before his death in 1975, is now known solely as a writer of essays on the game of cricket.
items.zh: 奈维尔·卡德斯从1917年开始为《曼彻斯特卫报》撰稿，直到1975年去世前不久，如今他仅以撰写关于板球运动的散文而闻名。

items.en: During his lifetime, though, he was also one of England's foremost classical-music critics, and a stylist so widely admired that his Autobiography (1947) became a best-seller.
items.zh: 然而在他生前，他也曾是英国最著名的古典音乐评论家之一，其文风广受赞誉，以至于他的自传（1947年出版）成为畅销书。

items.en: He was knighted in 1967, the first music critic to be so honored.
items.zh: 他于1967年被封为爵士，成为首位获此殊荣的音乐评论家。

items.en: Yet only one of his books is now in print, and his vast body of writings on music is unknown save to specialists.
items.zh: 然而，他现在只有一本书在出版，他大量关于音乐的著作只有专家才知道。

items.en: Is there any chance that Cardus's criticism will enjoy a revival?
items.zh: 卡杜斯的批评有任何复兴的可能吗？

items.en: The prospect seems remote.
items.zh: 前景似乎很渺茫。

items.en: To get the system working again, losses must be recognized and dealt with.
items.zh: 要使系统重新运转起来，必须承认并处理损失。

items.en: America's new plan to buy up toxic assets will not work unless banks mark assets to levels which buyers find attractive.
items.zh: 除非银行将资产估值调整到买家认为有吸引力的水平，否则美国的新计划购买有毒资产将无法奏效。

items.en: Successful markets require independent and even combative standard-setters.
items.zh: 成功的市场需要独立甚至具有对抗性的标准制定者。

items.en: The FASB and IASB have been exactly that, cleaning up rules on stock options and pensions, for example, against hostility from special interests.
items.zh: FASB 和 IASB 正是这样的机构，例如他们曾不顾特殊利益集团的反对，清理了股票期权和养老金方面的规则。

items.en: But by giving in to critics now they are inviting pressure to make more concessions.
items.zh: 但如今如果屈服于批评者，他们将面临更大的压力，要求做出更多让步。

items.en: The longest bull run in a century of art-market history ended on a dramatic note with a sale of 56 works by Damien Hirst, Beautiful Inside My Head Forever, at Sotheby’s in London on September 15th 2008.
items.zh: 在艺术市场历史上一个世纪以来最长的牛市于 2008 年 9 月 15 日在伦敦苏富比以达明安·赫斯特的系列作品《Beautiful Inside My Head Forever》的拍卖画上句号。

items.en: All but two pieces sold, fetching more than £70m, a record for a sale by a single artist.
items.zh: 除两件作品外，其余全部售出，总成交额超过 7000 万英镑，创下单个艺术家作品拍卖的最高纪录。

items.en: It was a last victory.
items.zh: 这是最后一次胜利。

items.en: Within weeks the world’s two biggest auction houses, Sotheby’s and Christie’s, had to pay out nearly $200m in guarantees to clients who had placed works for sale with them.
items.zh: 几周之内，世界上最大的两家拍卖行苏富比和佳士得不得不向那些将作品委托给他们拍卖的客户支付近2亿美元的保证金。

items.en: The current downturn in the art market is the worst since the Japanese stopped buying Impressionists at the end of 1989.
items.zh: 目前艺术市场的低迷是自1989年底日本停止购买印象派作品以来最严重的一次。

items.en: This time experts reckon that prices are about 40% down on their peak on average, though some have been far more fluctuant.
items.zh: 但专家们认为，这一次价格平均比峰值下降了约40%，尽管有些作品的价格波动要大得多。

items.en: But Edward Dolman, Christie’s chief executive, says: “I’m pretty confident we’re at the bottom.
items.zh: 但佳士得首席执行官爱德华·多尔曼表示：‘我相当有信心，我们现在已经触底了。’

items.en: What makes this slump different from the last, he says, is that there are still buyers in the market.
items.zh: 他表示，这次市场低迷与上一次的不同之处在于，目前市场上仍然存在买家。

items.en: Almost everyone who was interviewed for this special report said that the biggest problem at the moment is not a lack of demand but a lack of good work to sell.
items.zh: 几乎所有接受采访的专家都表示，目前最大的问题不是需求不足，而是缺乏值得出售的好作品。

items.en: The three Ds – death, debt and divorce – still deliver works of art to the market.
items.zh: 死亡、债务和离婚这三大因素仍然将艺术品带入市场。

items.en: But anyone who does not have to sell is keeping away, waiting for confidence to return.
items.zh: 但那些没有被迫出售的人则选择观望，等待市场信心恢复。

items.en: As the auctioneer called out bids, in New York one of the oldest banks on Wall Street, Lehman Brothers, filed for bankruptcy.
items.zh: 当拍卖师喊出竞价时，位于华尔街的一家历史悠久的银行——雷曼兄弟，在纽约申请了破产。

items.en: The world art market had already been losing momentum for a while after rising bewilderingly since 2003.
items.zh: 在2003年以来艺术市场迅速上涨之后，世界艺术市场已经有一段时间失去了动力。

items.en: At its peak in 2007 it was worth some $65 billion, reckons Clare McAndrew, founder of Arts Economics, a research firm – double the figure five years earlier.
items.zh: 据研究公司Arts Economics的创始人克莱尔·麦克安德鲁估算，2007年该市场达到顶峰时价值约为650亿美元，是五年前数字的两倍。

items.en: Since then it may have come down to $50 billion.
items.zh: 但从那以后，其价值可能已降至500亿美元。

items.en: But the market generates interest far beyond its size because it brings together great wealth, enormous egos, greed, passion and controversy in a way matched by few other industries.
items.zh: 然而，这个市场因其聚集了巨额财富、巨大的自我、贪婪、激情和争议，而引起了远超其规模的关注，这种现象在其他行业中很少见。

items.en: In the weeks and months that followed mr. Hirst’s sale, spending of any sort became deeply unfashionable.
items.zh: 在赫斯特先生作品拍卖之后的几周和几个月里，任何形式的消费都变得极不时尚。

items.en: In the art world that meant collectors stayed away from galleries and salerooms.
items.zh: 在艺术界，这意味着收藏家们远离了画廊和拍卖行。

items.en: Sales of contemporary art fell by two-thirds, and in the most overheated sector, they were down by nearly 90% in the year to November 2008.
items.zh: 到2008年11月为止，当代艺术的销售额下降了三分之二，在最过热的领域，降幅甚至接近90%。

items.en: This episode crystallizes the irony that although American men tend to talk more than women in public situations, they often talk less at home.
items.zh: 这一事件凸显出一种讽刺：尽管美国男性在公共场合往往比女性更爱说话，但他们在家里的谈话却往往更少。

items.en: And this pattern is wreaking havoc with marriage.
items.zh: 这种模式正在对婚姻造成严重破坏。

items.en: The pattern was observed by political scientist Andrew Hacker in the late 1970s.
items.zh: 这种现象是由政治学家安德鲁·哈克尔在20世纪70年代末观察到的。

items.en: Sociologist Catherine Kohler Riessman reports in her new book Divorce Talk that most of the women she interviewed – but only a few of the men – gave lack of communication as the reason for their divorces.
items.zh: 社会学家凯瑟琳·科勒·里斯曼在其新书《离婚谈话》中报告称，她采访的大多数女性——但只有少数男性——都将缺乏沟通列为离婚的原因。

items.en: Given the current divorce rate of nearly 50 percent, that amounts to millions of cases in the United States every year – a virtual epidemic of failed conversation.
items.zh: 鉴于目前的离婚率接近50%，这意味着美国每年有数百万起离婚案例——一种沟通失败的近乎流行病式的危机。

items.en: In my own research, complaints from women about their husbands most often focused not on tangible inequities such as having given up the chance for a career to accompany a husband to his, or doing far more than their share of daily life-support work like cleaning, cooking and social arrangements.
items.zh: 在我的研究中，女性对丈夫的抱怨最常集中在沟通问题上，而不是诸如放弃职业机会去追随丈夫，或承担了大部分日常支持性工作（如打扫、做饭和安排社交活动）等具体不公。

items.en: Instead, they focused on communication: “He doesn’t listen to me.” “He doesn’t talk to me.” I found, as Hacker observed years before, that most wives want their husbands to be, first and foremost, conversational partners, but few husbands share this expectation of their wives.
items.zh: 相反，她们关注的是沟通：‘他不听我说话。’‘他从不和我说话。’正如哈克尔多年前观察到的一样，我发现大多数妻子希望丈夫首先且最重要的是成为她们的谈话伙伴，但很少有丈夫对妻子抱有同样的期待。

items.en: In short, the image that best represents the current crisis is the stereotypical cartoon scene of a man sitting at the breakfast table with a newspaper held up in front of his face, while a woman glares at the back of it, wanting to talk.
items.zh: 简而言之，最能代表当前危机的形象，就是那种典型的漫画场景：一个男人坐在早餐桌前，报纸挡在面前，而女人则愤怒地盯着报纸的背面，想要和他交谈。

items.en: Over the past decade, many companies had perfected the art of creating automatic behaviors – habits – among consumers.
items.zh: 在过去十年中，许多公司已经精通了在消费者中培养自动行为——习惯——的艺术。

items.en: These habits have helped companies earn billions of dollars when customers eat snacks or wipe counters almost without thinking, often in response to a carefully designed set of daily cues.
items.zh: 这些习惯帮助公司在顾客几乎不假思索地吃零食或擦拭台面时赚取了数十亿美元，而这些行为通常是对精心设计的一系列日常提示的反应。

items.en: There are fundamental public health problems, like dirty hands instead of a soap habit, that remain killers only because we can’t figure out how to change people’s habits,” said dr. Curtis, the director of the Hygiene Center at the London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine.
items.zh: 伦敦卫生与热带医学院卫生中心的主任 Curtis 博士说："存在一些根本性的公共卫生问题，比如不养成用肥皂洗手的习惯而只是脏手，这些问题仍然是杀手，仅仅因为我们无法找到改变人们习惯的方法。"

items.en: We wanted to learn from private industry how to create new behaviors that happen automatically.
items.zh: Curtis 博士想从私营企业那里学习如何创造自动发生的新行为。

items.en: The companies that dr. Curtis turned to – Procter & Gamble, Colgate- Palmolive and Unilever – had invested hundreds of millions of dollars finding the subtle cues in consumers’ lives that corporations could use to introduce new routines.
items.zh: Curtis 博士所求助的公司——宝洁公司、高露洁-棕榄公司和联合利华公司——已经投入了数亿资金，寻找消费者生活中细微的提示，企业可以利用这些提示来引入新的日常习惯。

items.en: If you look hard enough, you’ll find that many of the products we use every day
items.zh: 如果你仔细观察，你会发现我们每天使用的产品中有很多

items.en: – chewing gums, skin moisturizers, disinfecting wipes, air fresheners, water purifiers, health snacks, teeth whiteners, fabric softeners, vitamins – are results of manufactured habits.
items.zh: ——口香糖、皮肤保湿剂、消毒湿巾、空气清新剂、净水器、健康零食、牙齿美白产品、织物柔软剂、维生素——都是制造出来的习惯的产物。

items.en: A century ago, few people regularly brushed their teeth multiple times a day.
items.zh: 一个世纪前，很少有人每天多次定期刷牙。

items.en: Today, because of shrewd advertising and public health campaigns, many Americans habitually give their pearly whites a cavity-preventing scrub twice a day, often with Colgate, Crest or one of the other brands.
items.zh: 如今，由于精明的广告和公共卫生运动，许多美国人习惯于每天两次用牙膏（如佳洁士、高露洁或其他品牌）清洁牙齿，以预防龋齿。

items.en: A few decades ago, many people didn’t drink water outside of a meal.
items.zh: 几十年前，很多人除了吃饭时外，不会喝水。

items.en: Then beverage companies started bottling the production of far-off springs, and now office workers unthinkingly sip bottled water all day long.
items.zh: 后来饮料公司开始将远在异地的泉水装瓶销售，现在办公室工作人员整天无意识地喝着瓶装水。

items.en: Chewing gum, once bought primarily by adolescent boys, is now featured in commercials as a breath freshener and teeth cleanser for use after a meal.
items.zh: 口香糖曾经主要是青少年男孩购买，现在却在广告中被宣传为餐后清新口气和清洁牙齿的用品。

items.en: Skin moisturizers are advertised as part of morning beauty rituals, slipped in between hair brushing and putting on makeup.
items.zh: 皮肤保湿剂被宣传为早晨美容仪式的一部分，夹在梳头和化妆之间使用。

items.en: Our products succeed when they become part of daily or weekly patterns,” said Carol Berning, a consumer psychologist who recently retired from Procter & Gamble, the company that sold $76 billion of Tide, Crest and other products last year.
items.zh: 消费者心理学家卡罗尔·伯宁（Carol Berning）说，她最近从宝洁公司（Procter & Gamble）退休，该公司去年销售了760亿美元的汰渍（Tide）、高露洁（Crest）等产品，"我们的产品只有在成为日常或每周习惯的一部分时才能取得成功。"

items.en: Creating positive habits is a huge part of improving our consumers’ lives, and it’s essential to making new products commercially viable.
items.zh: 创造积极的习惯是改善消费者生活的重要部分，也是使新产品具有商业可行性的关键。

items.en: Through experiments and observation, social scientists like dr. Berning have learned that there is power in tying certain behaviors to habitual cues through ruthless advertising.
items.zh: 通过实验和观察，像伯宁博士这样的社会科学家了解到，通过无情的广告将某些行为与习惯性提示联系起来，具有强大的影响力。

items.en: As this new science of habit has emerged, controversies have erupted when the tactics have been used to sell questionable beauty creams or unhealthy foods.
items.zh: 随着习惯这一新科学的出现，当这些策略被用来推销有疑问的美容霜或不健康食品时，争议也随之爆发。

items.en: Many Americans regard the jury system as a concrete expression of crucial democratic values, including the principles that all citizens who meet minimal qualifications of age and literacy are equally competent to serve on juries; that jurors should be selected randomly from a representative cross section of the community; that no citizen should be denied the right to serve on a jury on account of race, religion, sex, or national origin; that defendants are entitled to trial by their peers; and that verdicts should represent the conscience of the community and not just the letter of the law.
items.zh: 许多美国人将陪审团制度视为关键民主价值观的具体体现，包括以下原则：所有符合年龄和读写能力最低要求的公民在担任陪审员方面都是同样胜任的；陪审员应从社区中具有代表性的各个群体中随机选出；不应因种族、宗教、性别或民族出身而剥夺任何公民担任陪审员的权利；被告有权接受同辈的审判；以及陪审团的裁决应体现社区的良知，而不仅仅是法律条文。

items.en: The jury is also said to be the best surviving example of direct rather than representative democracy.
items.zh: 陪审团制度也被认为是现存的最典型的直接民主而非代议制民主的例子。

items.en: In a direct democracy, citizens take turns governing themselves, rather than electing representatives to govern for them.
items.zh: 在直接民主中，公民轮流自己治理，而不是选举代表来代为治理。

items.en: But as recently as in 1968, jury selection procedures conflicted with these democratic ideals.
items.zh: 但早在1968年，陪审团的挑选程序就与这些民主理念相冲突。

items.en: In some states, for example, jury duty was limited to persons of supposedly superior intelligence, education, and moral character.
items.zh: 例如，在一些州，陪审团服务仅限于那些被认为智力、教育和道德品质较高的人。

items.en: Although the Supreme Court of the United States had prohibited intentional racial discrimination in jury selection as early as the 1880 case of Strauder v.
items.zh: 尽管早在1880年的斯特劳德诉西弗吉尼亚州案中，美国最高法院就已禁止在陪审团挑选中故意进行种族歧视。

items.en: West Virginia, the practice of selecting so-called elite or blue-ribbon juries provided a convenient way around this and other antidiscrimination laws.
items.zh: 但挑选所谓精英或蓝丝带陪审团的做法，却为绕过这一及其他反歧视法律提供了便利。

items.en: The system also failed to regularly include women on juries until the mid-20th century.
items.zh: 该制度直到20世纪中期才开始定期将女性纳入陪审团。

items.en: Although women first served on state juries in Utah in 1898, it was not until the 1940s that a majority of states made women eligible for jury duty.
items.zh: 尽管女性早在1898年就在犹他州的州陪审团中任职，但直到1940年代，大多数州才使女性有资格担任陪审员。

items.en: Even then several states automatically exempted women from jury duty unless they personally asked to have their names included on the jury list.
items.zh: 即使如此，一些州除非女性本人主动要求将名字列入陪审团名单，否则自动免除女性的陪审义务。

items.en: This practice was justified by the claim that women were needed at home, and it kept juries unrepresentative of women through the 1960s.
items.zh: 这种做法以女性在家需要照顾为由进行辩护，并且直到1960年代，陪审团仍然无法代表女性群体。

items.en: In 1968, the Congress of the United States passed the Jury Selection and Service Act, ushering in a new era of democratic reforms for the jury.
items.zh: 1968年，美国国会通过了《陪审团选拔和服务法》，开启了陪审团民主改革的新时代。

items.en: This law abolished special educational requirements for federal jurors and required them to be selected at random from a cross section of the entire community.
items.zh: 该法律废除了联邦陪审员的特殊教育要求，并规定必须从整个社区的各个层面随机选拔陪审员。

items.en: In the landmark 1975 decision Taylor v.
items.zh: 在具有里程碑意义的1975年泰勒诉路易斯安那州案中，最高法院将陪审团必须代表社区各个部分的要求扩展到了州一级。

items.en: Louisiana, the Supreme Court extended the requirement that juries be representative of all parts of the community to the state level.
items.zh: 路易斯安那州，最高法院将陪审团必须代表社区各个部分的要求扩展到了州一级。

items.en: The Taylor decision also declared sex discrimination in jury selection to be unconstitutional and ordered states to use the same procedures for selecting male and female jurors.
items.zh: 泰勒案的裁决还宣布，在陪审团选拔中存在性别歧视是违宪的，并命令各州在选拔男性和女性陪审员时使用相同的程序。

items.en: The decision of the New York Philharmonic to hire Alan Gilbert as its next music director has been the talk of the classical-music world ever since the sudden announcement of his appointment in 2009.
items.zh: 纽约爱乐乐团决定聘请艾伦·吉尔伯特担任下一任音乐总监，自从2009年突然宣布这一任命以来，这一决定一直是古典音乐界议论的焦点。

items.en: For the most part, the response has been favorable, to say the least.
items.zh: 至少可以说，大多数人的反应是积极的。

items.en: At last!" wrote Anthony Tommasini, a sober-sided classical-music critic.
items.zh: ‘终于！’安东尼·托马西尼写道，他是一位冷静务实的古典音乐评论家。

items.en: One of the reasons why the appointment came as such a surprise, however, is that Gilbert is comparatively little known.
items.zh: 然而，任命之所以如此出人意料，其中一个原因就是吉尔伯特相对来说并不为人所知。

items.en: Even Tommasini, who had advocated Gilbert's appointment in the Times, calls him "an unpretentious musician with no air of the formidable conductor about him.
items.zh: 就连在《纽约时报》上曾支持吉尔伯特任命的托马西尼，也称他为‘一位不张扬的音乐家，身上完全没有那种令人敬畏的指挥家的气质’。

items.en: As a description of the next music director of an orchestra that has hitherto been led by musicians like Gustav Mahler and Pierre Boulez, that seems likely to have struck at least some Times readers as faint praise.
items.zh: 作为对一个此前由古斯塔夫·马勒和皮埃尔·布列兹这样著名音乐家领导的乐团下一任音乐总监的描述，这似乎至少会让一些《纽约时报》的读者觉得评价有些轻描淡写。

items.en: For my part, I have no idea whether Gilbert is a great conductor or even a good one.
items.zh: 就我而言，我不知道吉尔伯特是否是一位伟大的指挥家，甚至是否是一位出色的指挥家。

items.en: I was addressing a small gathering in a suburban Virginia living room – a women’s group that had invited men to join them.
items.zh: 我正在弗吉尼亚州郊区的一间客厅里对一个小群体讲话——这是一个邀请男性加入的女性小组。

items.en: Throughout the evening, one man had been particularly talkative, frequently offering ideas and anecdotes, while his wife sat silently beside him on the couch.
items.zh: 整个晚上，有一个人特别健谈，经常提出想法和讲述趣事，而他的妻子则默默地坐在他旁边沙发上。

items.en: Toward the end of the evening, I commented that women frequently complain that their husbands don’t talk to them.
items.zh: 在晚上快结束的时候，我评论说，女性经常抱怨她们的丈夫不跟她们说话。

items.en: This man quickly nodded in agreement.
items.zh: 这位男士迅速点头表示同意。

items.en: He gestured toward his wife and said, “She’s the talker in our family.” The room burst into laughter; the man looked puzzled and hurt.
items.zh: 他朝妻子比划了一下，说："她是家里最爱说话的人。" 房间里顿时爆发出一阵笑声；那个男人看起来困惑又受伤。

items.en: It’s true,” he explained.
items.zh: “这是真的，”他解释道。

items.en: When I come home from work I have nothing to say.
items.zh: 我下班回家后，什么也不想说。

items.en: If she didn’t keep the conversation going, we’d spend the whole evening in silence.
items.zh: 如果她不继续交谈，我们整个晚上都会沉默不语。

items.en: It also sent a clear message to the outside world about his aspirations.
items.zh: 这也向外界传递了一个明确的信息，表明了他的抱负。

items.en: And McGee isn't alone.
items.zh: 麦吉并不是唯一一个。

items.en: In recent weeks the no. 2 executives at Avon and American Express quit with the explanation that they were looking for a CEO post.
items.zh: 最近几周，雅芳和美国运通的第二号高管都辞职了，他们解释说是在寻找首席执行官的职位。

items.en: As boards scrutinize succession plans in response to shareholder pressure, executives who don't get the nod also may wish to move on.
items.zh: 随着董事会在股东压力下审视继任计划，那些没有获得晋升的高管也可能希望另谋高就。

items.en: A turbulent business environment also has senior managers cautious of letting vague pronouncements cloud their reputations.
items.zh: 动荡的商业环境也使高级管理人员谨慎对待模糊的声明，以免损害自己的声誉。

items.en: As the first signs of recovery begin to take hold, deputy chiefs may be more willing to make the jump without a net.
items.zh: 随着复苏的最初迹象开始显现，副手级别的高管可能更愿意在没有安全保障的情况下跳槽。

items.en: In the third quarter, CEO turnover was down 23% from a year ago as nervous boards stuck with the leaders they had, according to Liberum Research.
items.zh: 据Liberum Research数据显示，第三季度首席执行官的更换率比去年同期下降了23%，紧张的董事会选择继续留任现有的领导者。

items.en: As the economy picks up, opportunities will abound for aspiring leaders.
items.zh: 随着经济逐渐复苏，对于有抱负的领导者来说，机会将层出不穷。

items.en: But what will be the nature of that difference?
items.zh: 但这种差异的性质会是什么？

items.en: Merely expanding the orchestra's repertoire will not be enough.
items.zh: 仅仅扩大乐团的曲目范围是不够的。

items.en: If Gilbert and the Philharmonic are to succeed, they must first change the relationship between America's oldest orchestra and the new audience it hopes to attract.
items.zh: 如果吉尔伯特和爱乐乐团想要成功，他们首先必须改变美国最古老乐团与它希望吸引的新观众之间的关系。

items.en: When Liam McGee departed as president of Bank of America in August, his explanation was surprisingly straight up.
items.zh: 当利亚姆·麦吉于8月辞去美国银行总裁一职时，他的解释出人意料地直截了当。

items.en: Rather than cloaking his exit in the usual vague excuses, he came right out and said he was leaving "to pursue my goal of running a company.
items.zh: 他没有像通常那样用含糊的借口来掩饰自己的离职，而是直接表示他离开是为了"追求自己经营公司的目标"。

items.en: Broadcasting his ambition was "very much my decision," McGee says.
items.zh: 麦吉表示，公开自己的抱负是"我自己的决定"。

items.en: Within two weeks, he was talking for the first time with the board of Hartford Financial Services Group, which named him CEO and chairman on September 29.
items.zh: 两周之内，他就首次与哈特福德金融服务集团的董事会进行了会谈，并于9月29日被任命为该集团的首席执行官和董事长。

items.en: McGee says leaving without a position lined up gave him time to reflect on what kind of company he wanted to run.
items.zh: 麦吉表示，没有事先安排好职位就离职，让他有时间反思自己想要经营什么样的公司。

items.en: To be sure, he performs an impressive variety of interesting compositions, but it is not necessary for me to visit Avery Fisher Hall, or anywhere else, to hear interesting orchestral music.
items.zh: 可以肯定的是，他演奏了各种令人印象深刻的有趣作品，但我不需要去艾弗里·费舍音乐厅，或任何其他地方，就能听到有趣的管弦乐作品。

items.en: All I have to do is to go to my CD shelf, or boot up my computer and download still more recorded music from iTunes.
items.zh: 我只需要走到我的CD架前，或者打开电脑从iTunes下载更多的录音音乐。

items.en: Devoted concertgoers who reply that recordings are no substitute for live performance are missing the point.
items.zh: 那些坚持认为录音无法替代现场演出的忠实音乐会观众，没有抓住重点。

items.en: For the time, attention, and money of the art-loving public, classical instrumentalists must compete not only with opera houses, dance troupes, theater companies, and museums, but also with the recorded performances of the great classical musicians of the 20th century.
items.zh: 在艺术爱好者的时间、注意力和金钱面前，古典乐器演奏家不仅要与歌剧院、舞蹈团、剧院公司和博物馆竞争，还要与20世纪伟大古典音乐家的录音表演竞争。

items.en: These recordings are cheap, available everywhere, and very often much higher in artistic quality than today's live performances; moreover, they can be "consumed" at a time and place of the listener's choosing.
items.zh: 这些录音价格低廉，随处可见，而且艺术质量往往比当今的现场演出更高；此外，听众可以自由选择时间和地点来欣赏它们。

items.en: The widespread availability of such recordings has thus brought about a crisis in the institution of the traditional classical concert.
items.zh: 这类录音的广泛可得性因此引发了传统古典音乐会制度的危机。

items.en: One possible response is for classical performers to program attractive new music that is not yet available on record.
items.zh: 一种可能的应对方式是，古典音乐表演者演奏一些尚未被录制的具有吸引力的新音乐作品。

items.en: Gilbert's own interest in new music has been widely noted: Alex Ross, a classical-music critic, has described him as a man who is capable of turning the Philharmonic into "a markedly different, more vibrant organization.
items.zh: 吉尔伯特对新音乐的兴趣广为人知：一位古典音乐评论家亚历克斯·罗斯曾形容他为一个有能力将爱乐乐团转变为"一个明显不同、更加充满活力的组织"的人。

items.en: The decision to quit a senior position to look for a better one is unconventional.
items.zh: 辞去高级职位去寻找更好的职位的决定是不寻常的。

items.en: For years executives and headhunters have adhered to the rule that the most attractive CEO candidates are the ones who must be poached.
items.zh: 多年来，高管和猎头一直遵循这样一个规则：最具吸引力的CEO候选人往往是那些必须被挖角的人。

items.en: Says Korn/Ferry senior partner Dennis Carey: "I can't think of a single search I've done where a board has not instructed me to look at sitting CEOs first.
items.zh: 科恩/费里高级合伙人丹尼斯·凯里表示："我想不到我做过的任何一次搜寻，董事会没有指示我要首先考虑现任CEO。"

items.en: Those who jumped without a job haven't always landed in top positions quickly.
items.zh: 那些没有工作就跳槽的人并不总能迅速进入高层职位。

items.en: Ellen Marram quit as chief of Tropicana a decade ago, saying she wanted to be a CEO.
items.zh: 艾伦·马拉姆十年前辞去了Tropicana的首席职位，表示她想成为一名CEO。

items.en: It was a year before she became head of a tiny Internet-based commodities exchange.
items.zh: 一年后，她才成为一家小型基于互联网的商品交易所的负责人。

items.en: Robert Willumstad left Citigroup in 2005 with ambitions to be a CEO.
items.zh: 罗伯特·威卢姆斯塔德于2005年离开花旗集团，雄心勃勃地想成为一名CEO。

items.en: He finally took that post at a major financial institution three years later.
items.zh: 三年后，他终于在一家主要的金融机构担任了这一职位。

items.en: Many recruiters say the old disgrace is fading for top performers.
items.zh: 许多招聘人员表示，对于顶尖人才来说，失业的旧耻辱正在逐渐消失。

items.en: The financial crisis has made it more acceptable to be between jobs or to leave a bad one.
items.zh: 金融危机使得在工作之间空档或离开一份糟糕的工作变得更容易被接受。

items.en: The traditional rule was it's safer to stay where you are, but that's been fundamentally inverted," says one headhunter.
items.zh: 一位猎头公司负责人说：'传统的规则是留在原地更安全，但这一规则已经被彻底颠覆了。'

items.en: The people who've been hurt the worst are those who've stayed too long.
items.zh: 那些受到打击最严重的人，往往是待在原岗位时间太长的人。

items.en: The rough guide to marketing success used to be that you got what you paid for.
items.zh: 过去衡量营销成功与否的粗略标准是，你付出多少就能得到多少。

items.en: While traditional "paid" media - such as television commercials and print advertisements - still play a major role, companies today can exploit many alternative forms of media.
items.zh: 虽然传统的'付费'媒体，如电视广告和印刷广告，仍然发挥着重要作用，但如今企业可以利用许多替代形式的媒体。

items.en: Consumers passionate about a product may create "earned" media by willingly promoting it to friends, and a company may leverage "owned" media by sending e-mail alerts about products and sales to customers registered with its Web site.
items.zh: 对产品充满热情的消费者可能会通过主动向朋友推荐产品来创造'赢得的'媒体，而企业则可以通过向在其网站上注册的客户发送电子邮件，告知产品和促销信息，来利用'自有'媒体。

items.en: The way consumers now approach the process of making purchase decisions means that marketing's impact stems from a broad range of factors beyond conventional paid media.
items.zh: 消费者现在在做出购买决策时所采取的方式意味着，营销的影响来源于许多超出传统付费媒体范畴的因素。

items.en: Paid and owned media are controlled by marketers promoting their own products.
items.zh: 付费媒体和自有媒体由推广自己产品的营销人员所控制。

items.en: For earned media, such marketers act as the initiator for users' responses.
items.zh: 对于 earned media（ earned media 指通过用户自发产生的内容或口碑传播的媒体），这些营销人员则充当用户回应的发起者。

items.en: But in some cases, one marketer's owned media become another marketer's paid media - for instance, when an e-commerce retailer sells ad space on its Web site.
items.zh: 但在某些情况下，一个营销人员的自有媒体会变成另一个营销人员的付费媒体——例如，当一家电子商务零售商在其网站上出售广告位时。

items.en: We define such sold media as owned media whose traffic is so strong that other organizations place their content or e-commerce engines within that environment.
items.zh: 我们将这种被出售的媒体定义为自有媒体，其流量如此强大，以至于其他组织会在该环境中放置自己的内容或电子商务引擎。

items.en: This trend, which we believe is still in its infancy, effectively began with retailers and travel providers such as airlines and hotels and will no doubt go further.
items.zh: 我们认为这一趋势仍处于初期阶段，它实际上最早开始于零售商和旅行服务提供商，如航空公司和酒店，无疑还会进一步发展。

items.en: Johnson & Johnson, for example, has created BabyCenter, a stand-alone media property that promotes complementary and even competitive products.
items.zh: 例如，强生公司创建了 BabyCenter，这是一个独立的媒体平台，用于推广互补性甚至竞争性的产品。

items.en: Besides generating income, the presence of other marketers makes the site seem objective, gives companies opportunities to learn valuable information about the appeal of other companies' marketing, and may help expand user traffic for all companies concerned.
items.zh: 除了产生收入外，其他营销人员的存在还使网站显得更加客观，为企业提供了了解其他公司营销吸引力的宝贵机会，还可能帮助所有相关公司扩大用户流量。

items.en: The same dramatic technological changes that have provided marketers with more (and more diverse) communications choices have also increased the risk that passionate consumers will voice their opinions in quicker, more visible, and much more damaging ways.
items.zh: 为营销人员提供更多（且更多样化）传播选择的戏剧性技术变革，同时也增加了热情消费者以更快、更明显、更具破坏性的方式表达意见的风险。

items.en: Such hijacked media are the opposite of earned media: an asset or campaign becomes hostage to consumers, other stakeholders, or activists who make negative allegations about a brand or product.
items.zh: 此类被劫持的媒体与 earned media 相反：一项资产或活动成为消费者、其他利益相关者或活动人士的“人质”，他们会对品牌或产品提出负面指控。

items.en: Members of social networks, for instance, are learning that they can hijack media to apply pressure on the businesses that originally created them.
items.zh: 例如，社交网络的成员正在认识到，他们可以劫持媒体，对最初创建这些媒体的企业施加压力。

items.en: If that happens, passionate consumers would try to persuade others to boycott products, putting the reputation of the target company at risk.
items.zh: 如果这种情况发生，热情的消费者会试图说服他人抵制产品，从而危及目标公司的声誉。

items.en: In such a case, the company's response may not be sufficiently quick or thoughtful, and the learning curve has been steep.
items.zh: 在这种情况下，公司的回应可能不够迅速或深思熟虑，而学习曲线也相当陡峭。

items.en: Toyota Motor, for example, alleviated some of the damage from its recall crisis earlier this year with a relatively quick and well-orchestrated social-media response campaign, which included efforts to engage with consumers directly on sites such as Twitter and the social-news site Digg.
items.zh: 例如，丰田汽车公司今年早些时候通过相对迅速且组织良好的社交媒体回应活动，缓解了部分召回危机带来的损害，其中包括在 Twitter 和社交新闻网站 Digg 等平台上直接与消费者互动的努力。

items.en: It's no surprise that Jennifer Senior's insightful, provocative magazine cover story, "I Love My Children, I Hate My Life," is arousing much chatter - nothing gets people talking like the suggestion that child rearing is anything less than a completely fulfilling, life-enriching experience.
items.zh: Jennifer Senior 深刻且富有争议的杂志封面故事《I Love My Children, I Hate My Life》引起广泛讨论并不令人意外——没有什么比暗示育儿体验并非完全充实、丰富人生更能引发人们讨论的了。

items.en: Rather than concluding that children make parents either happy or miserable, Senior suggests we need to redefine happiness: instead of thinking of it as something that can be measured by moment-to-moment joy, we should consider being happy as a past-tense condition.
items.zh: 与其得出结论说孩子让父母变得幸福或痛苦，Senior 建议我们重新定义幸福：与其将其视为可以由瞬间快乐来衡量的东西，不如将其视为一种过去时的状态。

items.en: Even though the day-to-day experience of raising kids can be soul-crushingly hard, Senior writes that "the very things that in the moment dampen our moods can later be sources of intense gratification and delight.
items.zh: 尽管养育孩子的日常体验可能令人精神崩溃地艰难，Senior 写道："那些在当下让我们情绪低落的事情，日后可能会成为带来强烈满足感和愉悦感的源泉。"

items.en: The magazine cover showing an attractive mother holding a cute baby is hardly the only Madonna-and-child image on newsstands this week.
items.zh: 这本周杂志封面上展示的迷人的母亲抱着可爱婴儿的图像，几乎不是新闻架上唯一的一幅圣母与孩子的画面。

items.en: There are also stories about newly adoptive - and newly single - mom Sandra Bullock, as well as the usual "Jennifer Aniston is pregnant" news.
items.zh: 这周新闻架上还有关于刚刚领养孩子并刚刚单身的桑德拉·布洛克的故事，以及一贯的‘詹妮弗·安妮斯顿怀孕了’的新闻。

items.en: Practically every week features at least one celebrity mom, or mom-to-be, smiling on the newsstands.
items.zh: 几乎每一周都会在新闻架上出现至少一位明星妈妈或即将成为妈妈的明星微笑着的形象。

items.en: In a society that so persistently celebrates procreation, is it any wonder that admitting you regret having children is equivalent to admitting you support kitten-killing?
items.zh: 在一个如此持续推崇生育的社会里，承认自己后悔生孩子，等同于承认自己支持虐杀小猫，这难道令人感到意外吗？

items.en: It doesn't seem quite fair, then, to compare the regrets of parents to the regrets of the childless.
items.zh: 因此，将有孩子的父母的遗憾与没有孩子的人的遗憾相比较似乎并不公平。

items.en: Unhappy parents rarely are provoked to wonder if they shouldn't have had kids, but unhappy childless folks are bothered with the message that children are the single most important thing in the world: obviously their misery must be a direct result of the gaping baby-size holes in their lives.
items.zh: 不快乐的父母很少会去想自己是否不该生孩子，而不快乐的无子女者却总是被灌输‘孩子是世界上最重要的东西’这一信息：显然，他们的痛苦必定是直接源于生活中那些空缺的、本应有孩子的巨大缺口。

items.en: Of course, the image of parenthood that celebrity magazines like Us Weekly and People present is hugely unrealistic, especially when the parents are single mothers like Bullock.
items.zh: 当然，像《Us Weekly》和《People》这样的明星杂志所呈现的父母形象是极其不现实的，尤其是在父母是像布洛克这样的单身母亲时更是如此。

items.en: According to several studies concluding that parents are less happy than childless couples, single parents are the least happy of all.
items.zh: 根据几项研究得出的结论，有孩子的父母比没有孩子的夫妇更不快乐，而单身父母则是其中最不快乐的。

items.en: The effect tended to be larger for larger firms.
items.zh: 这种效应在大公司中往往更为明显。

items.en: Although a correlation between them leaving and subsequent bad performance at the firm is suggestive, it does not mean that such directors are always jumping off a sinking ship.
items.zh: 尽管它们离职与公司随后出现的不良表现之间存在相关性，但这并不意味着这些董事总是急于逃离即将沉没的船只。

items.en: Often they “trade up,” leaving riskier, smaller firms for larger and more stable firms.
items.zh: 他们常常是“向上跳槽”，从风险更大、规模更小的公司转去更大的、更稳定的公司。

items.en: But the researchers believe that outside directors have an easier time of avoiding a blow to their reputations if they leave a firm before bad news breaks, even if a review of history shows they were on the board at the time any wrongdoing occurred.
items.zh: 但研究人员认为，如果外部董事在坏消息公布之前就离开公司，即使历史记录显示他们在任何不当行为发生时曾担任董事会成员，他们也更容易避免对其声誉的打击。

items.en: Firms who want to keep their outside directors through tough times may have to create incentives.
items.zh: 想要在困难时期留住外部董事的公司可能不得不创造一些激励措施。

items.en: Otherwise outside directors will follow the example of ms. Simmons, once again very popular on campus.
items.zh: 否则，外部董事将再次效仿西蒙斯女士，重新成为校园里非常受欢迎的人物。

items.en: Whatever happened to the death of newspapers?
items.zh: 报纸的消亡又去哪儿了？

items.en: A year ago the end seemed near.
items.zh: 一年前，它们的终结似乎已经迫在眉睫。

items.en: The recession threatened to remove the advertising and readers that had not already fled to the internet.
items.zh: 经济衰退威胁要带走那些尚未转向互联网的广告和读者。

items.en: Newspapers like the San Francisco Chronicle were chronicling their own doom.
items.zh: 像《旧金山纪事报》这样的报纸正在记录着自身的衰亡。

items.en: America’s Federal Trade Commission launched a round of talks about how to save newspapers.
items.zh: 美国联邦贸易委员会发起了一系列关于如何拯救报纸的讨论。

items.en: Should they become charitable corporations?
items.zh: 它们应该成为慈善性公司吗？

items.en: Should the state subsidize them?
items.zh: 政府应该补贴它们吗？

items.en: It will hold another meeting soon.
items.zh: 它不久将再次召开会议。

items.en: But the discussions now seem out of date.
items.zh: 但现在这些讨论似乎已经过时了。

items.en: In much of the world there is little sign of crisis.
items.zh: 在世界大部分地区，危机的迹象微乎其微。

items.en: Outside directors are supposed to serve as helpful, yet less biased, advisers on a firm’s board.
items.zh: 外部董事应当作为公司董事会中有帮助、但偏见更少的顾问提供帮助。

items.en: Having made their wealth and their reputations elsewhere, they presumably have enough independence to disagree with the chief executive’s proposals.
items.zh: 由于他们的财富和声誉是在其他地方建立的，因此他们 presumably 具备足够的独立性来反对首席执行官的提案。

items.en: If the sky, and the share price is falling, outside directors should be able to give advice based on having weathered their own crises.
items.zh: 如果天空和股价都在下跌，外部董事应该能够基于他们自己经历过危机的经验给出建议。

items.en: The researchers from Ohio University used a database that covered more than 10,000 firms and more than 64,000 different directors between 1989 and 2004.
items.zh: 来自俄亥俄大学的研究人员使用了一个涵盖 1989 年至 2004 年间超过 10,000 家公司和超过 64,000 名不同董事的数据库。

items.en: Then they simply checked which directors stayed from one proxy statement to the next.
items.zh: 然后他们 simply 检查了哪些董事从一份代理声明到下一份代理声明一直留任。

items.en: The most likely reason for departing a board was age, so the researchers concentrated on those “surprise” disappearances by directors under the age of 70.
items.zh: 董事离开董事会的最可能原因是因为年龄，因此研究人员集中关注了那些 70 岁以下董事的“意外”消失情况。

items.en: They found that after a surprise departure, the probability that the company will subsequently have to restate earnings increases by nearly 20%.
items.zh: 他们发现，在发生意外离职后，公司随后需要重新陈述收益的概率 nearly 增加了 20%。

items.en: The likelihood of being named in a federal class-action lawsuit also increases, and the stock is likely to perform worse.
items.zh: 被列为联邦集体诉讼的 likelihood 也增加了，而且股票的表现 likely 会更差。

items.en: No shock there, considering how much work it is to raise a kid without a partner to lean on; yet to hear Sandra and Britney tell it, raising a kid on their "own" (read: with round-the-clock help) is a piece of cake.
items.zh: 考虑到独自抚养孩子需要付出这么多努力，这并不令人意外；但据桑德拉和布兰妮所说，她们‘独自’抚养孩子（实际上是有全天候的帮忙）却是一件轻而易举的事。

items.en: It's hard to imagine that many people are dumb enough to want children just because Reese and Angelina make it look so glamorous: most adults understand that a baby is not a haircut.
items.zh: 很难想象有很多人傻到仅仅因为丽丝和安吉丽娜让养育孩子看起来如此光鲜亮丽，就想要孩子；大多数成年人都明白，婴儿可不是一次理发。

items.en: But it's interesting to wonder if the images we see every week of stress-free, happiness-enhancing parenthood aren't in some small, subconscious way contributing to our own dissatisfactions with the actual experience, in the same way that a small part of us hoped getting "the Rachel" might make us look just a little bit like Jennifer Aniston.
items.zh: 但有趣的是，我们每周看到的那些无忧无虑、充满幸福感的父母形象，是否在某种程度上、潜移默化地加剧了我们对实际育儿体验的不满？就像我们内心深处曾希望剪个‘瑞秋头’就能稍微像詹妮弗·安妮斯顿一点那样。

items.en: Ruth Simmons joined Goldman Sachs’s board as an outside director in January 2000; a year later she became president of Brown University.
items.zh: 露丝·西蒙斯于2000年1月以独立董事的身份加入高盛董事会；一年后，她成为布朗大学的校长。

items.en: For the rest of the decade she apparently managed both roles without attracting much criticism.
items.zh: 在接下来的十年里，她似乎成功地兼顾了这两个角色，而没有引起太多批评。

items.en: But by the end of 2009 ms. Simmons was under fire for having sat on Goldman’s compensation committee; how could she have let those enormous bonus payouts pass unremarked?
items.zh: 但到2009年底，西蒙斯女士因曾担任高盛薪酬委员会成员而遭到抨击；她怎么能眼睁睁看着那些巨额奖金的发放而毫无异议？

items.en: By February the next year ms. Simmons had left the board.
items.zh: 到次年2月，西蒙斯女士已经离开了董事会。

items.en: The position was just taking up too much time, she said.
items.zh: 她说，这个职位只是占用的时间太多。

items.en: German and Brazilian papers have shrugged off the recession.
items.zh: 德国和巴西的报纸已经对经济衰退表示了漠然态度。

items.en: Even American newspapers, which inhabit the most troubled corner of the global industry, have not only survived but often returned to profit.
items.zh: 就连身处全球报业最困难领域的美国报纸，不仅生存了下来，而且常常重新实现了盈利。

items.en: Not the 20% profit margins that were routine a few years ago, but profit all the same.
items.zh: 虽然不再是几年前习以为常的20%利润率，但至少还是盈利了。

items.en: It has not been much fun.
items.zh: 这过程并不怎么愉快。

items.en: Many papers stayed afloat by pushing journalists overboard.
items.zh: 许多报纸通过裁员记者才得以维持运营。

items.en: The American Society of News Editors reckons that 13,500 newsroom jobs have gone since 2007.
items.zh: 美国新闻编辑协会估计，自2007年以来，新闻编辑室的岗位减少了13,500个。

items.en: Readers are paying more for slimmer products.
items.zh: 读者为内容更少的报纸支付了更高的费用。

items.en: Some papers even had the nerve to refuse delivery to distant suburbs.
items.zh: 有些报纸甚至胆敢拒绝向远郊地区配送报纸。

items.en: Yet these desperate measures have proved the right ones and, sadly for many journalists, they can be pushed further.
items.zh: 然而，这些绝望的措施已被证明是正确的，对许多记者来说，令人遗憾的是，这些措施还可以进一步推进。

items.en: Newspapers are becoming more balanced businesses, with a healthier mix of revenues from readers and advertisers.
items.zh: 报纸正逐渐成为更加平衡的业务，收入来源更加健康地分布在读者和广告商之间。

items.en: American papers have long been highly unusual in their reliance on ads.
items.zh: 美国报纸长期以来在依赖广告方面都极为不寻常。

items.en: Fully 87% of their revenues came from advertising in 2008, according to the Organization for Economic Cooperation & Development (OECD).
items.zh: 根据经济合作与发展组织（OECD）的数据，2008年它们的收入中有整整87%来自广告。

items.en: In Japan the proportion is 35%.
items.zh: 在日本，这一比例为35%。

items.en: Not surprisingly, Japanese newspapers are much more stable.
items.zh: 不出所料，日本的报纸要稳定得多。

items.en: The whirlwind that swept through newsrooms harmed everybody, but much of the damage has been concentrated in areas where newspapers are least distinctive.
items.zh: 席卷新闻编辑室的风暴伤害了所有人，但大部分损害集中在报纸最不具特色的地方。

items.en: Car and film reviewers have gone.
items.zh: 汽车和电影评论员已经离职。

items.en: Economic condition was only a stimulus for the trend toward efficient living.
items.zh: 经济状况只是推动高效生活方式趋势的一个刺激因素。

items.en: The phrase “less is more” was actually first popularized by a German, the architect Ludwig Mies van der Rohe, who like other people associated with the Bauhaus, a school of design, emigrated to the United States before World War II and took up posts at American architecture schools.
items.zh: “少即是多”这一说法实际上最早是由一位德国人、建筑师路德维希·密斯·凡德罗（Ludwig Mies van der Rohe）推广开来的，他像其他与包豪斯设计学院有关的人一样，在第二次世界大战前移居美国，并在美国的建筑学院担任教职。

items.en: These designers came to exert enormous influence on the course of American architecture, but none more so than Mies.
items.zh: 这些设计师对美国建筑的发展产生了巨大影响，但其中没有人比密斯的影响更为深远。

items.en: Mies’s signature phrase means that less decoration, properly organized, has more impact than a lot.
items.zh: 密斯的标志性短语意味着，经过合理组织的简洁装饰，其效果比大量装饰更显著。

items.en: Elegance, he believed, did not derive from abundance.
items.zh: 他认为，优雅并非源于繁复。

items.en: Like other modern architects, he employed metal, glass and laminated wood – materials that we take for granted today but that in the 1940s symbolized the future.
items.zh: 和其它现代建筑师一样，他使用金属、玻璃和层压木板——这些材料如今我们习以为常，但在20世纪40年代却象征着未来。

items.en: Mies’s sophisticated presentation masked the fact that the spaces he designed were small and efficient, rather than big and often empty.
items.zh: 密斯高雅的展示方式掩盖了一个事实，即他设计的空间是小巧而高效的，而不是宏大而常常空荡的。

items.en: The apartments in the elegant towers Mies built on Chicago’s Lake Shore Drive, for example, were smaller – two-bedroom units under 1,000 square feet – than those in their older neighbors along the city’s Gold Coast.
items.zh: 例如，密斯在芝加哥湖岸大道（Lake Shore Drive）上建造的那些优雅的高层建筑中的公寓，面积不到1000平方英尺的两居室单位，比沿城市黄金海岸（Gold Coast）的老邻居们的公寓还要小。

items.en: But they were popular because of their airy glass walls, the views they afforded and the elegance of the buildings’ details and proportions, the architectural equivalent of the abstract art so popular at the time.
items.zh: 但它们之所以受欢迎，是因为其轻盈的玻璃墙、提供的视野以及建筑细节和比例的优雅，这相当于当时非常流行的抽象艺术。

items.en: The trend toward “less” was not entirely foreign.
items.zh: 对“少即是多”的趋势并非完全陌生。

items.en: In the 1930s Frank Lloyd Wright started building more modest and efficient houses – usually around 1,200 square feet – than the spreading two-story ones he had designed in the 1890s and the early 20th century.
items.zh: 20世纪30年代，弗兰克·洛伊·莱特开始建造更为谦逊和高效的住宅——通常约为1200平方英尺——这比他在19世纪90年代和20世纪初设计的那些宽敞的两层住宅要小得多。

items.en: The “Case Study Houses” commissioned from talented modern architects by California Arts & Architecture magazine between 1945 and 1962 were yet another homegrown influence on the “less is more” trend.
items.zh: 1945年至1962年间，《加利福尼亚艺术与建筑》杂志委托才华横溢的现代建筑师设计的“案例研究住宅”是又一个本土影响“少即是多”趋势的因素。

items.en: Aesthetic effect came from the landscape, new materials and forthright detailing.
items.zh: 美学效果来自于景观、新材料和坦率的细节处理。

items.en: In his Case Study House, Ralph Rapson may have mispredicted just how the mechanical revolution would impact everyday life – few American families acquired helicopters, though most eventually got clothes dryers – but his belief that self-sufficiency was both desirable and inevitable was widely shared.
items.zh: 在他的案例研究住宅中，拉尔夫·拉普森可能错误地预测了机械革命将如何影响日常生活——很少有美国家庭拥有直升机，尽管大多数最终都拥有了干衣机——但他认为自给自足既是可取的也是不可避免的，这一信念在当时被广泛认同。

items.en: Will the European Union make it?
items.zh: 欧盟能挺过去吗？

items.en: The question would have sounded strange not long ago.
items.zh: 这个问题在不久前听起来还会很奇怪。

items.en: Now even the project’s greatest cheerleaders talk of a continent facing a “Bermuda triangle” of debt, population decline and lower growth.
items.zh: 如今，即使是该项目最坚定的支持者，也谈到一个大陆正面临债务、人口减少和增长放缓的'百慕大三角'。

items.en: As well as those chronic problems, the EU faces an acute crisis in its economic core, the 16 countries that use the single currency.
items.zh: 除了这些长期存在的问题，欧盟还面临着其经济核心地区——使用单一货币的16个国家——的严重危机。

items.en: Markets have lost faith that the euro zone’s economies, weaker or stronger, will one day converge thanks to the discipline of sharing a single currency, which denies uncompetitive members the quick fix of devaluation.
items.zh: 市场已失去信心，认为欧元区的经济体，无论强弱，终有一天会因共享单一货币的纪律而趋于一致，而这种纪律使得缺乏竞争力的成员国无法通过贬值来迅速解决问题。

items.en: Yet the debate about how to save Europe’s single currency from disintegration is stuck.
items.zh: 然而，关于如何拯救欧洲单一货币以避免解体的辩论却陷入僵局。

items.en: It is stuck because the euro zone’s dominant powers, France and Germany, agree on the need for greater harmonisation within the euro zone, but disagree about what to harmonise.
items.zh: 这是因为欧元区的主要强国——法国和德国——虽然都同意需要在欧元区内部实现更大的协调一致，但对应该协调什么存在分歧。

items.en: Germany thinks the euro must be saved by stricter rules on borrowing, spending and competitiveness, backed by quasi-automatic sanctions for governments that do not obey.
items.zh: 德国认为，必须通过更严格的借贷、支出和竞争力规则来拯救欧元，并对不遵守规则的政府实施准自动化的制裁。

items.en: These might include threats to freeze EU funds for poorer regions and EU mega-projects, and even the suspension of a country’s voting rights in EU ministerial councils.
items.zh: 这些制裁可能包括冻结对较贫穷地区的欧盟资金和大型欧盟项目的拨款，甚至暂停一个国家在欧盟部长理事会中的投票权。

items.en: It insists that economic co-ordination should involve all 27 members of the EU club, among whom there is a small majority for free-market liberalism and economic rigour; in the inner core alone, Germany fears, a small majority favour French interference.
items.zh: 它坚持认为经济协调应包括欧盟俱乐部的全部27个成员国，在这些国家中，自由市场经济和经济严谨性的支持者占少数；而在核心地区，德国担心，支持法国干预的少数派却占了多数。

items.en: A “southern” camp headed by France wants something different: “European economic government” within an inner core of euro-zone members.
items.zh: 由法国领导的所谓“南方”阵营则希望实现不同的目标：在欧元区核心成员国内部建立一个“欧洲经济政府”。”

items.en: Translated, that means politicians intervening in monetary policy and a system of redistribution from richer to poorer members, via cheaper borrowing for governments through common Eurobonds or complete fiscal transfers.
items.zh: 换言之，这意味着政治家们将干预货币政策，并建立一种从富裕成员国向贫穷成员国进行财富再分配的体系，例如通过共同的欧元债券或完全的财政转移，使政府能够以更低的成本借款。

items.en: Finally, figures close to the Franch government have murmured, euro-zone members should agree to some fiscal and social harmonisation: e.g. , curbing competition in corporate-tax rates or labour costs.
items.zh: 最后，有法国政府人士低声表示，欧元区成员国应同意在财政和社会政策上实现一定程度的协调，例如限制企业税率和劳动力成本方面的竞争。

items.en: It is too soon to write off the EU.
items.zh: 现在下结论认为欧盟已经失败还为时过早。

items.en: It remains the world’s largest trading block.
items.zh: 它仍然是世界上最大的贸易集团。

items.en: At its best, the European project is remarkably liberal: built around a single market of 27 rich and poor countries, its internal borders are far more open to goods, capital and labour than any comparable trading area.
items.zh: 在最好的情况下，欧洲项目表现出显著的自由主义特征：它围绕着一个由27个富国和穷国组成的单一市场，其内部边界对商品、资本和劳动力的开放程度远高于任何其他类似的贸易区域。

items.en: It is an ambitious attempt to blunt the sharpest edges of globalisation, and make capitalism benign.
items.zh: 这是一个雄心勃勃的尝试，旨在削弱全球化的最尖锐部分，使资本主义变得温和。”

items.en: Come on - Everybody's doing it.
items.zh: 来吧——大家都在这么做。

items.en: Rosenberg argues convincingly that public-health advocates ought to take a page from advertisers, so skilled at applying peer pressure.
items.zh: 罗斯伯格有力地论证了公共卫生倡导者应该借鉴广告商的做法，因为广告商在运用同辈压力方面非常擅长。

items.en: But on the general effectiveness of the social cure, Rosenberg is less persuasive.
items.zh: 但在社会疗法总体效果方面，罗斯伯格的说服力就较弱了。

items.en: Join the Club is filled with too much irrelevant detail and not enough exploration of the social and biological factors that make peer pressure so powerful.
items.zh: 《加入俱乐部》一书充满了太多无关紧要的细节，而对使同辈压力如此强大的社会和生物因素探讨不足。

items.en: The most glaring flaw of the social cure as it's presented here is that it doesn't work very well for very long.
items.zh: 这里所呈现的社会疗法最明显的缺陷是，它并不能长期有效地发挥作用。

items.en: Rage Against the Haze failed once state funding was cut.
items.zh: 一旦州政府的资金被削减，《对抗雾霾的愤怒》项目就失败了。

items.en: Evidence that the loveLife program produces lasting changes is limited and mixed.
items.zh: 有关loveLife项目能产生持久改变的证据是有限且不一致的。

items.en: There's no doubt that our peer groups exert enormous influence on our behavior.
items.zh: 毫无疑问，我们的同辈群体对我们的行为有着巨大的影响。

items.en: An emerging body of research shows that positive health habits - as well as negative ones - spread through networks of friends via social communication.
items.zh: 一项新兴的研究表明，积极的健康习惯——以及消极的习惯——都会通过朋友之间的社交沟通在社交网络中传播。

items.en: That whispered message, half invitation and half forcing, is what most of us think of when we hear the words peer pressure.
items.zh: 那种低声细语的信息，一半是邀请，一半是强迫，就是我们大多数人听到‘同伴压力’这个词时所想到的内容。

items.en: It usually leads to no good - drinking, drugs and casual sex.
items.zh: 它通常不会带来什么好处——比如饮酒、吸毒和随意性行为。

items.en: But in her new book Join the Club, Tina Rosenberg contends that peer pressure can also be a positive force through what she calls the social cure, in which organizations and officials use the power of group dynamics to help individuals improve their lives and possibly the world.
items.zh: 但在她新书《加入俱乐部》中，蒂娜·罗斯伯格认为，同伴压力也可以通过她称之为‘社会疗法’的方式成为一种积极的力量，即组织和官员利用群体动力的力量，帮助个人改善生活，甚至可能改变世界。

items.en: Rosenberg, the recipient of a Pulitzer Prize, offers a host of examples of the social cure in action: In South Carolina, a state-sponsored antismoking program called Rage Against the Haze sets out to make cigarettes uncool.
items.zh: 罗斯伯格是普利策奖的获得者，她提供了大量‘社会疗法’实际运作的例子：在南卡罗来纳州，一个由州政府支持的反吸烟计划名为‘怒对烟雾’，旨在让吸烟变得不再酷。

items.en: In South Africa, an HIV-prevention initiative known as loveLife recruits young people to promote safe sex among their peers.
items.zh: 在南非，一个名为loveLife的艾滋病预防计划招募年轻人在同龄人中推广安全性行为。

items.en: The idea seems promising, and Rosenberg is a perceptive observer.
items.zh: 这个想法看起来很有前景，而罗斯伯格也是一位敏锐的观察者。

items.en: Her critique of the lameness of many public-health campaigns is spot-on: they fail to mobilize peer pressure for healthy habits, and they demonstrate a seriously flawed understanding of psychology.
items.zh: 她对许多公共卫生运动缺乏力度的批评非常准确：它们未能利用同伴压力来促进健康习惯，而且显示出对心理学存在严重错误的理解。

items.en: Dare to be different, please don't smoke!" pleads one billboard campaign aimed at reducing smoking among teenagers - teenagers, who desire nothing more than fitting in.
items.zh: ‘勇敢地与众不同，请不要吸烟！’是针对青少年减少吸烟的一个广告牌活动所发出的恳求——而青少年最渴望的就是融入群体。

items.en: So have science and general business reporters.
items.zh: 科学记者和一般商业记者也是如此。

items.en: Foreign bureaus have been savagely cut off.
items.zh: 外国事务部门已被大幅削减。

items.en: Newspapers are less complete as a result.
items.zh: 因此，报纸的内容变得不那么完整了。

items.en: But completeness is no longer a virtue in the newspaper business.
items.zh: 但在报纸行业，全面性已不再是一种美德。

items.en: We tend to think of the decades immediately following World War II as a time of prosperity and growth, with soldiers returning home by the millions, going off to college on the G.
items.zh: 我们往往将第二次世界大战结束后的几十年视为繁荣与增长的时期，数以百万计的士兵返回家园，凭借G.I.法案进入大学深造。

items.en: Bill and lining up at the marriage bureaus.
items.zh: 比尔和排队去婚姻登记处。

items.en: But when it came to their houses, it was a time of common sense and a belief that less could truly be more.
items.zh: 但当谈到他们的房屋时，那是一个讲求常识和相信少即是多的时期。

items.en: During the Depression and the war, Americans had learned to live with less, and that restraint, in combination with the postwar confidence in the future, made small, efficient housing positively stylish.
items.zh: 在经济大萧条和战争时期，美国人学会了用更少的东西生活，而这种克制与战后对未来的信心相结合，使得小型而高效的住房变得非常时尚。

items.en: This is a subtle form of peer pressure: we unconsciously imitate the behavior we see every day.
items.zh: 这是一种微妙的同辈压力：我们无意识地模仿每天看到的行为。

items.en: Far less certain, however, is how successfully experts and bureaucrats can select our peer groups and steer their activities in virtuous directions.
items.zh: 然而，专家和官僚们能否成功地为我们选择同辈群体，并引导他们的活动朝着积极的方向发展，这一点远不那么确定。

items.en: It's like the teacher who breaks up the troublemakers in the back row by pairing them with better-behaved classmates.
items.zh: 这就像老师把后排的捣蛋学生和表现更好的同学配对，以分散他们的注意力。

items.en: The tactic never really works.
items.zh: 这种策略从未真正奏效过。

items.en: And that's the problem with a social cure engineered from the outside: in the real world, as in school, we insist on choosing our own friends.
items.zh: 而这就是从外部设计的社会疗法的问题：在现实世界中，就像在学校一样，我们坚持要自己选择朋友。

items.en: A deal is a deal - except, apparently, when Entergy is involved.
items.zh: 协议就是协议——除非，显然，涉及的是Entergy公司。

items.en: The company, a major energy supplier in New England, provoked justified outrage in Vermont last week when it announced it was reneging on a longstanding commitment to abide by the state's strict nuclear regulations.
items.zh: 这家新英格兰地区的主要能源供应商上周在佛蒙特州宣布，将撤销其长期以来承诺遵守该州严格核能法规的决定，此举引发了合理的愤怒。

items.en: Instead, the company has done precisely what it had long promised it would not: challenge the constitutionality of Vermont's rules in the federal court, as part of a desperate effort to keep its Vermont Yankee nuclear power plant running.
items.zh: 相反，该公司做了它曾长期承诺不会做的事：在联邦法院挑战佛蒙特州法规的合宪性，作为一项绝望努力，以继续运营其佛蒙特扬基核电站。

items.en: It's a stunning move.
items.zh: 这是一项令人震惊的举措。

items.en: The conflict has been surfacing since 2002, when the corporation bought Vermont's only nuclear power plant, an aging reactor in Vernon.
items.zh: 自2002年起，这场冲突就逐渐显现，当时这家企业收购了佛蒙特州唯一的核电站——位于弗农市的一座老旧反应堆。

items.en: As a condition of receiving state approval for the sale, the company agreed to seek permission from state regulators to operate past 2012.
items.zh: 作为获得州政府批准这项交易的条件，该公司同意向州监管机构申请许可，以继续在2012年后运营。

items.en: In 2006, the state went a step further, requiring that any extension of the plant's license be subject to the Vermont legislature's approval.
items.zh: 2006年，州政府更进一步，要求任何延长该核电站执照的申请都必须经过佛蒙特州立法机构的批准。

items.en: Then, too, the company went along.
items.zh: 当时，该公司也同意了这一要求。

items.en: Either Entergy never really intended to live by those commitments, or it simply didn't foresee what would happen next.
items.zh: 要么是Entergy公司从未真正打算遵守这些承诺，要么是它根本没有预见到接下来会发生的事情。

items.en: A string of accidents, including the partial collapse of a cooling tower in 2007 and the discovery of an underground pipe system leakage, raised serious questions about both Vermont Yankee's safety and Entergy's management - especially after the company made misleading statements about the pipe.
items.zh: 一系列事故，包括2007年冷却塔部分坍塌以及发现地下管道系统泄漏，引发了对佛蒙特扬基核电站安全性和Entergy公司管理能力的严重质疑——尤其是在公司对管道问题发表了误导性声明之后。

items.en: Enraged by Entergy's behavior, the Vermont Senate voted 26 to 4 last year against allowing an extension.
items.zh: 由于对Entergy公司的行为感到愤怒，佛蒙特州参议院去年以26票对4票的投票结果，拒绝允许延长其运营许可。

items.en: Now the company is suddenly claiming that the 2002 agreement is invalid because of the 2006 legislation, and that only the federal government has regulatory power over nuclear issues.
items.zh: 现在，该公司突然声称，由于2006年的立法，2002年的协议无效，并且只有联邦政府对核能问题拥有监管权力。

items.en: The legal issues in the case are obscure: whereas the Supreme Court has ruled that states do have some regulatory authority over nuclear power, legal scholars say that Vermont case will offer a precedent-setting test of how far those powers extend.
items.zh: 本案中的法律问题尚不明确：虽然最高法院裁定各州确实对核能拥有一些监管权，但法律学者表示，佛蒙特州的案件将提供一个具有开创意义的测试，以确定这些权力能延伸到何种程度。

items.en: Certainly, there are valid concerns about the patchwork regulations that could result if every state sets its own rules.
items.zh: 当然，如果每个州都自行制定规则，可能会导致监管碎片化，这确实存在合理的担忧。

items.en: But had Entergy kept its word, that debate would be beside the point.
items.zh: 但若恩特格里公司信守承诺，这场争论就无关紧要了。

items.en: The company seems to have concluded that its reputation in Vermont is already so damaged that it has nothing left to lose by going to war with the state.
items.zh: 该公司似乎得出结论，认为其在佛蒙特州的声誉已经严重受损，与该州对抗已无所损失。

items.en: But there should be consequences.
items.zh: 但这样做应当承担后果。

items.en: Permission to run a nuclear plant is a public trust.
items.zh: 获得运行核电厂的许可是一种公共信托。

items.en: Entergy runs 11 other reactors in the United States, including Pilgrim Nuclear station in Plymouth.
items.zh: 恩特格里公司在美国内其他地区还运营着11座反应堆，包括普利茅斯的皮尔格林核电站。

items.en: Pledging to run Pilgrim safely, the company has applied for federal permission to keep it open for another 20 years.
items.zh: 承诺安全运行普利茅斯核电站，该公司已申请联邦政府许可，再运营20年。

items.en: But as the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) reviews the company's application, it should keep in mind what promises from Entergy are worth.
items.zh: 但随着核管理委员会（NRC）审查该公司的申请，它应记住Entergy公司的哪些承诺是值得信赖的。

items.en: In the idealized version of how science is done, facts about the world are waiting to be observed and collected by objective researchers who use the scientific method to carry out their work.
items.zh: 在理想化的科学运作方式中，关于世界的事实正等待着客观的研究者通过科学方法去观察和收集。

items.en: But in the everyday practice of science, discovery frequently follows an ambiguous and complicated route.
items.zh: 但在科学的日常实践中，发现过程往往遵循一条模糊而复杂的路径。

items.en: We aim to be objective, but we cannot escape the context of our unique life experiences.
items.zh: 我们力求客观，但无法摆脱我们独特人生经历所构成的背景。

items.en: Prior knowledge and interests influence what we experience, what we think our experiences mean, and the subsequent actions we take.
items.zh: 先前的知识和兴趣会影响我们的体验、我们对体验的理解，以及我们随后采取的行动。

items.en: Opportunities for misinterpretation, error, and self-deception abound.
items.zh: 误解、错误和自我欺骗的机会比比皆是。

items.en: Consequently, discovery claims should be thought of as protoscience.
items.zh: 因此，发现性主张应被视为前科学。

items.en: Similar to newly staked mining claims, they are full of potential.
items.zh: 类似于新设立的采矿权，它们充满潜力。

items.en: But it takes collective scrutiny and acceptance to transform a discovery claim into a mature discovery.
items.zh: 但要将一个发现声明转化为成熟的发现，需要整个共同体的审查和认可。

items.en: This is the credibility process, through which the individual researcher's me, here, now becomes the community's anyone, anywhere, anytime.
items.zh: 这就是可信度过程，通过这个过程，个体研究者的‘我’、‘这里’、‘此刻’变成了共同体的‘任何人’、‘任何地方’、‘任何时间’。

items.en: Objective knowledge is the goal, not the starting point.
items.zh: 客观知识是目标，而不是起点。

items.en: Once a discovery claim becomes public, the discoverer receives intellectual credit.
items.zh: 一旦一个发现声明公开，发现者就会获得智力上的认可。

items.en: But, unlike with mining claims, the community takes control of what happens next.
items.zh: 但与采矿权不同的是，共同体将掌控接下来的发展。

items.en: Within the complex social structure of the scientific community, researchers make discoveries; editors and reviewers act as gatekeepers by controlling the publication process; other scientists use the new finding to suit their own purposes; and finally, the public (including other scientists) receives the new discovery and possibly accompanying technology.
items.zh: 在科学共同体复杂的社交结构中，研究人员做出发现；编辑和审稿人通过控制出版过程充当守门人；其他科学家则可能利用这一新发现来实现他们自己的目的；最后，公众（包括其他科学家）接受这一新发现，以及可能伴随的新技术。

items.en: As a discovery claim works its way through the community, the interaction and confrontation between shared and competing beliefs about the science and the technology involved transforms an individual's discovery claim into the community's credible discovery.
items.zh: 当一个发现声明在共同体中传播时，关于相关科学和技术的共享信念与竞争性信念之间的互动和冲突，将个体的发现声明转化为共同体认可的可信发现。

items.en: Two paradoxes exist throughout this credibility process.
items.zh: 在整个可信度评估过程中，存在两个悖论。

items.en: First, scientific work tends to focus on some aspect of prevailing knowledge that is viewed as incomplete or incorrect.
items.zh: 首先，科学工作往往关注现有知识中被认为不完整或错误的某个方面。

items.en: Little reward accompanies duplication and confirmation of what is already known and believed.
items.zh: 重复和确认已知和已被接受的内容几乎得不到任何回报。

items.en: The goal is new-search, not re-search.
items.zh: 目标是探索新知，而非重复研究。

items.en: Not surprisingly, newly published discovery claims and credible discoveries that appear to be important and convincing will always be open to challenge and potential modification or refutation by future researchers.
items.zh: 不出所料，新发表的发现性主张以及看似重要且有说服力的可信发现，总会受到未来研究者的质疑，并可能被修正或推翻。

items.en: Second, novelty itself frequently provokes disbelief.
items.zh: 其次，新颖性本身常常引发怀疑。

items.en: Nobel Laureate and physiologist Albert Szent-Gyorgyi once described discovery as "seeing what everybody has seen and thinking what nobody has thought.
items.zh: 诺贝尔奖得主、生理学家阿尔伯特·森特-哲尔吉曾将发现描述为“看到别人看到的东西，却思考别人未曾思考的问题”。

items.en: But thinking what nobody else has thought and telling others what they have missed may not change their views.
items.zh: 但思考别人未曾思考的问题，并告诉他人他们忽略了什么，可能并不会改变他们的看法。

items.en: First, they can shut things down without suffering much in the way of consequences.
items.zh: 首先，他们可以关闭某些事物而不会承受太多后果。

items.en: Second, they are mostly bright and well-educated.
items.zh: 其次，他们大多聪明且受过良好教育。

items.en: A quarter of America's public-sector workers have a university degree.
items.zh: 美国四分之一的公共部门工作人员拥有大学学位。

items.en: Third, they now dominate left-of-centre politics.
items.zh: 第三，他们现在主导了左翼政治。

items.en: Some of their ties go back a long way.
items.zh: 他们的一些关系可以追溯到很久以前。

items.en: Britain's Labor Party, as its name implies, has long been associated with trade unionism.
items.zh: 英国工党，正如其名称所暗示的，长期以来与工会主义有着密切关联。

items.en: Its current leader, Ed Miliband, owes his position to votes from public-sector unions.
items.zh: 其现任领袖埃德·米利班德的职位得益于公共部门工会的投票支持。

items.en: At the state level their influence can be even more fearsome.
items.zh: 在州一级，他们的影响力可能更加令人畏惧。

items.en: Sometimes years are required for truly novel discovery claims to be accepted and appreciated.
items.zh: 有时需要数年时间，真正新颖的发现性主张才能被接受和认可。

items.en: In the end, credibility "happens" to a discovery claim - a process that corresponds to what philosopher Annette Baier has described as the commons of the mind.
items.zh: 最终，一个发现性主张会"获得"可信度——这一过程对应哲学家安妮特·拜尔所描述的"心灵的公共领域"。

items.en: We reason together, challenge, revise, and complete each other's reasoning and each other's conceptions of reason.
items.zh: 我们共同推理，挑战、修正并完善彼此的推理和对理性的理解。

items.en: If the trade unionist Jimmy Hoffa were alive today, he would probably represent civil servants.
items.zh: 如果劳工领袖吉米·霍法今天还活着，他很可能代表公务员。

items.en: When Hoffa's Teamsters were in their prime in 1960, only one in ten American government workers belonged to a union; now 36% do.
items.zh: 当霍法的国际卡车司机工会在1960年达到鼎盛时期时，只有十分之一的美国政府工作人员加入了工会；如今，这一比例已达到36%。

items.en: In 2009 the number of unionists in America's public sector passed that of their fellow members in the private sector.
items.zh: 2009年，美国公共部门的工会成员人数超过了私人部门的工会成员人数。

items.en: In Britain, more than half of public-sector workers but only about 15% of private-sector ones are unionized.
items.zh: 在英国，超过一半的公共部门工作人员加入了工会，而私人部门中只有大约15%的人加入了工会。

items.en: There are three reasons for the public-sector unions' thriving.
items.zh: 公共部门工会之所以蓬勃发展，有三个原因。

items.en: Mark Baldassare of the Public Policy Institute of California points out that much of the state's budget is patrolled by unions.
items.zh: 加利福尼亚公共政策研究所的马克·巴尔达萨雷指出，该州的大部分预算都受到工会的监督。

items.en: The teachers' unions keep an eye on schools, the CCPOA on prisons and a variety of labor groups on health care.
items.zh: 教师工会关注学校，CCPOA关注监狱，各种劳工组织则关注医疗保健。

items.en: In many rich countries average wages in the state sector are higher than in the private one.
items.zh: 在许多富裕国家，公共部门的平均工资高于私营部门。

items.en: But the real gains come in benefits and work practices.
items.zh: 但真正的收益体现在福利和工作制度上。

items.en: Politicians have repeatedly "backloaded" public-sector pay deals, keeping the pay increases modest but adding to holidays and especially pensions that are already generous.
items.zh: 政客们多次对公共部门的薪酬协议进行"后置加码"，保持薪资增长适度，但增加了假期和尤其是已经相当优厚的养老金。

items.en: Reform has been vigorously opposed, perhaps most notoriously in education, where charter schools, academies and merit pay all faced drawn-out battles.
items.zh: 改革一直遭到强烈反对，尤其是在教育领域最为明显，特许学校、学院和绩效工资都曾面临旷日持久的斗争。

items.en: Even though there is plenty of evidence that the quality of the teachers is the most important variable, teachers' unions have fought against getting rid of bad ones and promoting good ones.
items.zh: 尽管有大量证据表明教师素质是最重要的变量，但教师工会却反对淘汰不合格的教师和提升优秀教师。

items.en: As the cost to everyone else has become clearer, politicians have begun to clamp down.
items.zh: 随着对其他人成本的了解逐渐清晰，政客们开始采取严厉措施。

items.en: It is quite possible that the homework helped.
items.zh: 作业可能确实起到了帮助作用。

items.en: Yet rather than empowering teachers to find what works best for their students, the policy imposes a flat, across-the-board rule.
items.zh: 然而，这项政策并没有赋予教师根据学生情况找到最佳方法的权力，而是强加了一项一刀切的统一规则。

items.en: At the same time, the policy addresses none of the truly thorny questions about homework.
items.zh: 同时，这项政策并未触及关于作业的真正棘手的问题。

items.en: If the district finds homework to be unimportant to its students’ academic achievement, it should move to reduce or eliminate the assignments, not make them count for almost nothing.
items.zh: 如果该地区认为作业对其学生的学业成绩不重要，它就应该采取措施减少或取消作业，而不是让作业几乎不计成绩。

items.en: Conversely, if homework matters, it should account for a significant portion of the grade.
items.zh: 相反，如果作业确实重要，它就应该占成绩的很大一部分。

items.en: Meanwhile, this policy does nothing to ensure that the homework students receive is meaningful or appropriate to their age and the subject, or that teachers are not assigning more than they are willing to review and correct.
items.zh: 与此同时，这项政策并未确保学生所接受的作业是有意义的，或者适合他们的年龄和学科，也未确保教师不会布置超出他们愿意批改和纠正的作业量。

items.en: The homework rules should be put on hold while the school board, which is responsible for setting educational policy, looks into the matter and conducts public hearings.
items.zh: 在负责制定教育政策的校董事会调查此事并举行公开听证会之前，应暂时搁置这项作业规则。

items.en: It is not too late for L.A.
items.zh: 洛杉矶现在还来得及。

items.en: In Wisconsin the unions have rallied thousands of supporters against Scott Walker, the hardline Republican governor.
items.zh: 在威斯康星州，工会已经动员了数千名支持者反对强硬派共和党州长斯科特·沃克。

items.en: But many within the public sector suffer under the current system, too.
items.zh: 但许多公共部门的员工在现行体系下也承受着痛苦。

items.en: John Donahue at Harvard's Kennedy School points out that the norms of culture in Western civil services suit those who want to stay put but is bad for high achievers.
items.zh: 哈佛大学肯尼迪学院的约翰·多纳胡指出，西方文官体系中的文化规范适合那些只想安稳待在岗位上的人，但对于高成就者来说却是个问题。

items.en: The only American public-sector workers who earn well above $250,000 a year are university sports coaches and the president of the United States.
items.zh: 唯一年薪超过25万美元的美国公共部门员工是大学体育教练和美国总统。

items.en: Bankers' fat pay packets have attracted much criticism, but a public-sector system that does not reward high achievers may be a much bigger problem for America.
items.zh: 银行家们丰厚的薪酬包已经引起了大量批评，但一个不奖励高成就者的公共部门体系可能对美国来说是一个更大的问题。

items.en: Homework has never been terribly popular with students and even many parents, but in recent years it has been particularly scorned.
items.zh: 家庭作业从未受到学生和许多家长的热烈欢迎，但近年来更是遭到了特别的蔑视。

items.en: School districts across the country, most recently Los Angeles Unified, are revising their thinking on this educational ritual.
items.zh: 全国各地的学区，最近的是洛杉矶联合学区，正在重新思考这一教育传统。

items.en: Unfortunately, L.A.
items.zh: 不幸的是，洛杉矶

items.en: Unified has produced an inflexible policy which mandates that with the exception of some advanced courses, homework may no longer count for more than 10% of a student’s academic grade.
items.zh: 统一政策制定了一项僵化的规定，要求除了一些高级课程外，家庭作业在学生的学业成绩中所占比例不得超过10%。

items.en: This rule is meant to address the difficulty that students from impoverished or chaotic homes might have in completing their homework.
items.zh: 这项规定旨在解决来自贫困或混乱家庭的学生可能在完成家庭作业方面遇到的困难。

items.en: But the policy is unclear and contradictory.
items.zh: 但这项政策本身含糊不清且自相矛盾。

items.en: Certainly, no homework should be assigned that students cannot complete on their own or that they cannot do without expensive equipment.
items.zh: 当然，不应布置学生无法独立完成或没有昂贵设备就无法完成的家庭作业。
