items.en: But if the district is essentially giving a pass to students who do not do their homework because of complicated family lives, it is going riskily close to the implication that standards need to be lowered for poor children.
items.zh: 但如果该地区基本上对因家庭生活复杂而未能完成家庭作业的学生网开一面，那就意味着要冒着对贫困儿童降低标准的暗示风险。

items.en: District administrators say that homework will still be a part of schooling; teachers are allowed to assign as much of it as they want.
items.zh: 地区教育管理者表示，家庭作业仍然是学校教育的一部分；教师可以随意布置他们想要的作业量。

items.en: But with homework counting for no more than 10% of their grades, students can easily skip half their homework and see very little difference on their report cards.
items.zh: 但由于家庭作业在成绩中所占比例不超过10%，学生完全可以跳过一半的作业，而成绩单上的变化却微乎其微。

items.en: Some students might do well on state tests without completing their homework, but what about the students who performed well on the tests and did their homework?
items.zh: 一些学生可能在不完成家庭作业的情况下在州考试中表现良好，但那些既在考试中表现优异又完成了家庭作业的学生又该怎么办呢？

items.en: Unified to do homework right.
items.zh: 统一去做作业是对的。

items.en: Pretty in pink: adult women do not remember being so obsessed with the colour, yet it is pervasive in our young girls’ lives.
items.zh: 粉红色：成年女性似乎不记得自己曾经如此痴迷于这种颜色，然而它却充斥在我们年轻女孩的生活中。

items.en: It is not that pink is intrinsically bad, but it is such a tiny slice of the rainbow and, though it may celebrate girlhood in one way, it also repeatedly and firmly fuses girls’ identity to appearance.
items.zh: 并不是粉红色本身不好，而是它在彩虹中只占极小的一部分，尽管它以某种方式庆祝女孩的童年，但同时也反复而坚定地将女孩的身份与外貌联系在一起。

items.en: Then it presents that connection, even among two-year-olds, between girls as not only innocent but as evidence of innocence.
items.zh: 然后，它在女孩身上呈现了这种联系，即使在两岁的孩子中，也把女孩视为不仅是天真无邪的，更是天真无邪的象征。

items.en: Looking around, I despaired at the singular lack of imagination about girls’ lives and interests.
items.zh: 环顾四周，我绝望于对女孩生活和兴趣的想象力的极度匮乏。

items.en: Girls’ attraction to pink may seem unavoidable, somehow encoded in their DNA, but according to Jo Paoletti, an associate professor of American Studies, it is not.
items.zh: 女孩对粉红色的迷恋似乎难以避免，仿佛被编码在她们的DNA中，但根据美国研究教授乔·帕奥莱蒂的说法，事实并非如此。

items.en: Children were not colour-coded at all until the early 20th century: in the era before domestic washing machines all babies wore white as a practical matter, since the only way of getting clothes clean was to boil them.
items.zh: 直到20世纪初，儿童才开始被按颜色进行区分：在家用洗衣机出现之前的时代，所有婴儿都穿白色衣服，这在实际中是合理的，因为当时唯一清洁衣物的方法就是煮沸。

items.en: What’s more, both boys and girls wore what were thought of as gender-neutral dresses.
items.zh: 更重要的是，男孩和女孩都穿着被认为是中性性别风格的连衣裙。

items.en: It was only after “toddler” became a common shoppers’ term that it evolved into a broadly accepted developmental stage.
items.zh: 直到“幼儿”一词成为常见购物者术语之后，它才演变为一个被广泛接受的发展阶段。

items.en: Splitting kids, or adults, into ever-tinier categories has proved a sure-fire way to boost profits.
items.zh: 将儿童或成人划分为越来越细的类别已被证明是提高利润的稳妥方法。

items.en: And one of the easiest ways to segment a market is to magnify gender differences – or invent them where they did not previously exist.
items.zh: 而细分市场最简单的方法之一，就是放大性别差异——或者在原本不存在差异的地方人为制造差异。

items.en: In 2010, a federal judge shook America’s biotech industry to its core.
items.zh: 2010年，一名联邦法官震动了美国的生物技术行业。

items.en: Companies had won patents for isolated DNA for decades – by 2005 some 20% of human genes were patented.
items.zh: 几十年来，公司已经获得了分离DNA的专利——到2005年，约有20%的人类基因已被专利保护。

items.en: But in March 2010 a judge ruled that genes were unpatentable.
items.zh: 但在2010年3月，法官裁定基因无法被授予专利。

items.en: Executives were violently agitated.
items.zh: 企业高管们感到极度不安。

items.en: The Biotechnology Industry Organisation (BIO), a trade group, assured members that this was just a “preliminary step” in a longer battle.
items.zh: 生物技术产业组织（BIO）作为一个行业协会，向成员保证，这只是更长期斗争中的一个‘初步步骤’。

items.en: On July 29th they were relieved, at least temporarily.
items.zh: 7月29日，他们终于松了一口气，至少是暂时的。

items.en: A federal appeals court overturned the prior decision, ruling that Myriad Genetics could indeed hold patents to two genes that help forecast a woman’s risk of breast cancer.
items.zh: 一家联邦上诉法院推翻了之前的决定，裁定Myriad Genetics公司确实可以对两种有助于预测女性患乳腺癌风险的基因持有专利。

items.en: The chief executive of Myriad, a company in Utah, said the ruling was a blessing to firms and patients alike.
items.zh: 这家位于犹他州的Myriad公司首席执行官表示，这一裁决对公司和患者来说都是福音。

items.en: But as companies continue their attempts at personalised medicine, the courts will remain rather busy.
items.zh: 但随着企业继续尝试个性化医疗，法院的工作仍将相当繁忙。

items.en: The Myriad case itself is probably not over.
items.zh: Myriad案本身可能还没有结束。

items.en: Critics make three main arguments against gene patents: a gene is a product of nature, so it may not be patented; gene patents suppress innovation rather than reward it; and patents’ monopolies restrict access to genetic tests such as Myriad’s.
items.zh: 批评者对基因专利提出了三个主要论点：基因是自然产物，因此可能无法申请专利；基因专利抑制了创新，而非奖励创新；专利的垄断限制了像Myriad这样的基因检测的获取途径。

items.en: A growing number seem to agree.
items.zh: 越来越多的人似乎对此表示赞同。

items.en: Last year a federal task-force urged reform for patents related to genetic tests.
items.zh: 去年，一个联邦特别工作组敦促对与基因检测相关的专利进行改革。

items.en: When nursery colours were introduced, pink was actually considered the more masculine colour, a pastel version of red, which was associated with strength.
items.zh: 当婴儿服颜色开始流行时，粉色实际上被认为是更具男子气概的颜色，它是红色的一种柔和版本，而红色则与力量相关。

items.en: Blue, with its intimations of the Virgin Mary, constancy and faithfulness, symbolised femininity.
items.zh: 蓝色则因其与圣母玛利亚、忠诚和忠实的暗示，象征着女性气质。

items.en: It was not until the mid-1980s, when amplifying age and sex differences became a dominant children’s marketing strategy, that pink fully came into its own, when it began to seem inherently attractive to girls, part of what defined them as female, at least for the first few critical years.
items.zh: 直到20世纪80年代中期，当放大年龄和性别差异成为儿童市场营销的主要策略时，粉色才真正大放异彩，开始被视为女孩与生俱来的吸引力，成为定义她们为女性的一部分，至少在最初几年的关键时期是如此。

items.en: I had not realised how profoundly marketing trends dictated our perception of what is natural to kids, including our core beliefs about their psychological development.
items.zh: 我之前没有意识到市场营销趋势在多大程度上决定了我们对儿童自然天性的认知，包括我们对她们心理发展的核心信念。

items.en: Take the toddler.
items.zh: 以幼儿为例。

items.en: I assumed that phase was something experts developed after years of research into children’s behaviour: wrong.
items.zh: 我曾以为这个阶段是专家们经过多年对儿童行为的研究后才得出的结论：错了。

items.en: Turns out, according to Daniel Cook, a historian of childhood consumerism, it was popularised as a marketing trick by clothing manufacturers in the 1930s.
items.zh: 据儿童消费史学家丹尼尔·库克所说，事实证明，这种做法是服装制造商在20世纪30年代为了促销而推广的一种营销手段。

items.en: Trade publications counselled department stores that, in order to increase sales, they should create a “third stepping stone” between infant wear and older kids’ clothes.
items.zh: 行业出版物建议百货商店，为了增加销量，他们应该在婴儿服装和较大儿童服装之间创造一个‘第三阶段’的产品。

items.en: In October the Department of Justice filed a brief in the Myriad case, arguing that an isolated DNA molecule “is no less a product of nature…than are cotton fibres that have been separated from cotton seeds.
items.zh: 10月份，司法部在Myriad案件中提交了一份简要文件，主张一个孤立的DNA分子“与从棉花种子中分离出来的棉花纤维一样，都是自然产物……”。

items.en: Despite the appeals court’s decision, big questions remain unanswered.
items.zh: 尽管上诉法院做出了裁决，但仍有许多重大问题悬而未决。

items.en: For example, it is unclear whether the sequencing of a whole genome violates the patents of individual genes within it.
items.zh: 例如，尚不清楚对整个基因组进行测序是否会侵犯其中单个基因的专利。

items.en: The case may yet reach the Supreme Court.
items.zh: 此案仍有可能最终提交至最高法院。

items.en: As the industry advances, however, other suits may have an even greater impact.
items.zh: 然而，随着行业的发展，其他诉讼可能会产生更大的影响。

items.en: Companies are unlikely to file many more patents for human DNA molecules – most are already patented or in the public domain.
items.zh: 公司不太可能再为人类DNA分子申请大量专利——大多数已经获得专利或属于公共领域。

items.en: Firms are now studying how genes interact, looking for correlations that might be used to determine the causes of disease or predict a drug’s efficacy.
items.zh: 目前，企业正在研究基因之间的相互作用，寻找可用于确定疾病原因或预测药物效果的相关性。

items.en: Companies are eager to win patents for “connecting the dots,” explains Hans Sauer, a lawyer for the BIO.
items.zh: “连接这些点”（即发现基因之间的关联）的专利申请，企业非常渴望获得，BIO的律师汉斯·索尔解释道。

items.en: Their success may be determined by a suit related to this issue, brought by the Mayo Clinic, which the Supreme Court will hear in its next term.
items.zh: 他们的成功可能取决于梅奥诊所就这一问题提起的诉讼，该诉讼将在最高法院下一次审理中进行听证。

items.en: The BIO recently held a convention which included sessions to coach lawyers on the shifting landscape for patents.
items.zh: 生物技术产业组织（BIO）最近举办了一次大会，其中包括指导律师应对专利领域不断变化的形势的专题会议。

items.en: Each meeting was packed.
items.zh: 每场会议都座无虚席。

items.en: The great recession may be over, but this era of high joblessness is probably beginning.
items.zh: 尽管大萧条可能已经结束，但高失业率的时代很可能才刚刚开始。

items.en: Before it ends, it will likely change the life course and character of a generation of young adults.
items.zh: 在这一时代结束之前，它很可能会改变一代年轻人的人生轨迹和性格特征。

items.en: And ultimately, it is likely to reshape our politics, our culture, and the character of our society for years.
items.zh: 最终，它很可能在多年内重塑我们的政治、文化以及社会的性质。

items.en: No one tries harder than the jobless to find silver linings in this national economic disaster.
items.zh: 在失业者中，没有人比他们更努力地试图在这场国家经济灾难中找到积极的一面。

items.en: Many said that unemployment, while extremely painful, had improved them in some ways: they had become less materialistic and more financially prudent; they were more aware of the struggles of others.
items.zh: 许多人表示，虽然失业非常痛苦，但也在某些方面让他们有所提升：他们变得更加不重物质、更加注重财务审慎；他们对他人所面临的困境也更加敏感。

items.en: In limited respects, perhaps the recession will leave society better off.
items.zh: 在有限的范围内，也许经济衰退会让社会变得更好。

items.en: At the very least, it has awoken us from our national fever dream of easy riches and bigger houses, and put a necessary end to an era of reckless personal spending.
items.zh: 至少，它让我们从全国性的、追求轻松致富和更大住房的狂热梦中醒来，并结束了不负责任的个人消费时代，这是必要的。

items.en: But for the most part, these benefits seem thin, uncertain, and far off.
items.zh: 但总的来说，这些好处似乎微不足道、不确定且遥不可及。

items.en: In The Moral Consequences of Economic Growth, the economic historian Benjamin Friedman argues that both inside and outside the u.s. , lengthy periods of economic stagnation or decline have almost always left society more mean-spirited and less inclusive, and have usually stopped or reversed the advance of rights and freedoms.
items.zh: 在《经济增长的道德后果》一书中，经济史学家本杰明·弗里德曼认为，无论是美国国内还是国外，长期的经济停滞或衰退几乎总是使社会变得更加吝啬狭隘、更加排外，并且通常会阻碍或逆转权利与自由的进步。

items.en: Anti-immigrant sentiment typically increases, as does conflict between races and classes.
items.zh: 反移民情绪通常会上升，种族和阶级之间的冲突也会加剧。

items.en: Income inequality usually falls during a recession, but it has not shrunk in this one.
items.zh: 事实上，收入不平等通常会在经济衰退期间缩小，但在此次衰退中却并未缩小。

items.en: Indeed, this period of economic weakness may reinforce class divides, and decrease opportunities to cross them – especially for young people.
items.zh: 确实，这段经济疲软时期可能会加剧阶级分化，并减少跨越阶级的机会——尤其是对年轻人而言。

items.en: The research of Till Von Wachter, the economist at Columbia University, suggests that not all people graduating into a recession see their life chances dimmed: those with degrees from elite universities catch up fairly quickly to where they otherwise would have been if they had graduated in better times; it is the masses beneath them that are left behind.
items.zh: 哥伦比亚大学的经济学家蒂尔·冯·瓦赫特的研究表明，并非所有在经济衰退期间毕业的人都会看到自己人生机会的减少：那些毕业于顶尖大学的人很快就能赶上原本在经济状况更好的时期毕业所应达到的水平；而他们之下的人群则被远远甩在后面。

items.en: In the Internet age, it is particularly easy to see the resentment that has always been hidden within American society.
items.zh: 在互联网时代，人们尤其容易看到美国社会中一直隐藏的怨恨情绪。

items.en: More difficult, in the moment, is discerning precisely how these lean times are affecting society’s character.
items.zh: 然而，当下更困难的是准确判断这些艰难时期如何影响社会的性格。

items.en: In many respects, the u.s. was more socially tolerant entering this recession than at any time in its history, and a variety of national polls on social conflict since then have shown mixed results.
items.zh: 在很多方面，美国在进入这次经济衰退时比历史上任何时期都更加社会包容，此后关于社会冲突的各种全国性民意调查结果也呈现出混杂的局面。

items.en: We will have to wait and see exactly how these hard times will reshape our social fabric.
items.zh: 我们必须拭目以待，这些艰难时期究竟会如何重塑我们的社会结构。

items.en: But they certainly will reshape it, and all the more so the longer they extend.
items.zh: 但可以肯定的是，它们一定会重塑社会结构，而且持续时间越长，这种重塑就越明显。

items.en: In the 2006 film version of The Devil Wears Prada, Miranda Priestly, played by Meryl Streep, scolds her unattractive assistant for imagining that high fashion doesn't affect her.
items.zh: 在2006年电影版《穿普拉达的女王》中，由梅丽尔·斯特里普饰演的米兰达·普里斯特利斥责她貌不出众的助理，认为她想象高时尚不会影响自己是错误的。

items.en: Priestly explains how the deep blue color of the assistant's sweater descended over the years from fashion shows to department stores and to the bargain bin in which the poor girl doubtless found her garment.
items.zh: 普里斯特利解释了助理毛衣的深蓝色颜色是如何多年来从时装秀场传到百货商店，最后落入折扣区，而这个可怜的女孩很可能就是在那儿找到这件衣服的。

items.en: This top-down conception of the fashion business couldn't be more out of date or at odds with the feverish world described in Overdressed, Elizabeth Cline's three-year indictment of "fast fashion".
items.zh: 这种自上而下的时尚产业观念已经过时，与伊丽莎白·克莱恩在《过度着装》中描述的狂热世界大相径庭，该书是对"快时尚"长达三年的批判。

items.en: Americans, she finds, buy roughly 20 billion garments a year - about 64 items per person - and no matter how much they give away, this excess leads to waste.
items.zh: 她发现，美国人每年购买大约200亿件服装——每人约64件——无论他们捐赠多少，这种过度消费都会导致浪费。

items.en: Towards the end of Overdressed, Cline introduced her ideal, a Brooklyn woman named Sarah Kate Beaumont, who since 2008 has made all of her own clothes - and beautifully.
items.zh: 在《过度着装》一书的结尾，克莱恩介绍了她的理想人物：一位名叫莎拉·凯特·比蒙特的布鲁克林女性，自2008年以来，她一直自己制作所有衣物，而且制作得非常精美。

items.en: But as Cline is the first to note, it took Beaumont decades to perfect her craft; her example can't be knocked off.
items.zh: 但正如克莱恩首先指出的那样，比蒙特花了数十年时间才精通她的手艺；她的例子无法被轻易复制。

items.en: Though several fast-fashion companies have made efforts to curb their impact on labor and the environment - including H&M, with its green Conscious Collection line - Cline believes lasting change can only be effected by the customer.
items.zh: 尽管几家快时尚公司已经努力减少对劳动力和环境的影响——包括H&M推出的环保意识系列——但克莱恩认为，只有消费者才能带来持久的改变。

items.en: She exhibits the idealism common to many advocates of sustainability, be it in food or in energy.
items.zh: 她展现出许多可持续发展倡导者所共有的理想主义，无论是食品还是能源领域都是如此。

items.en: Vanity is a constant; people will only start shopping more sustainably when they can't afford not to.
items.zh: 虚荣心是永恒的；人们只有在无法不这样做时，才会开始更加可持续地购物。

items.en: An old saying has it that half of all advertising budgets are wasted - the trouble is, no one knows which half.
items.zh: 有一句老话说，所有广告预算的一半都是浪费的——问题是，没人知道到底是哪一半。

items.en: In the internet age, at least in theory, this fraction can be much reduced.
items.zh: 在互联网时代，至少在理论上，这一比例可以大大减少。

items.en: In the last decade or so, advances in technology have allowed mass-market labels such as Zara, H&M, and Uniqlo to react to trends more quickly and anticipate demand more precisely.
items.zh: 在过去的十年左右，技术的进步使得像Zara、H&M和Uniqlo这样的大众市场品牌能够更快地响应潮流，并更精确地预测需求。

items.en: Quicker turnarounds mean less wasted inventory, more frequent releases, and more profit.
items.zh: 更快的周转意味着更少的库存浪费、更频繁的产品发布以及更多的利润。

items.en: These labels encourage style-conscious consumers to see clothes as disposable - meant to last only a wash or two, although they don't advertise that - and to renew their wardrobe every few weeks.
items.zh: 这些品牌鼓励注重时尚的消费者将衣物视为一次性用品——只穿一两次就该丢弃，尽管它们并未公开宣传这一点——并每隔几周就更新一次衣橱。

items.en: By offering on-trend items at dirt-cheap prices, Cline argues, these brands have hijacked fashion cycles, shaking an industry long accustomed to a seasonal pace.
items.zh: 克莱恩认为，通过以极低的价格提供符合潮流的商品，这些品牌已经操控了时尚周期，颠覆了一个长期习惯于按季节节奏运作的行业。

items.en: The victims of this revolution, of course, are not limited to designers.
items.zh: 当然，这场革命的受害者并不仅限于设计师。

items.en: For H&M to offer a $5.95 knit miniskirt in all its 2,300-plus stores around the world, it must rely on low-wage overseas labor, order in volumes that strain natural resources, and use massive amounts of harmful chemicals.
items.zh: 为了在全球2300多家门店中提供5.95美元的针织迷你裙，H&M必须依赖海外低工资劳动力，以大规模订单压榨自然资源，并使用大量有害化学品。

items.en: Overdressed is the fashion world's answer to consumer-activist bestsellers like Michael Pollan's The Omnivore's Dilemma.
items.zh: 《Overdressed》是时尚界对像迈克尔·波伦的《The Omnivore's Dilemma》这样的消费者活动主义畅销书的回应。

items.en: Mass-produced clothing, like fast food, fills a hunger and need, yet is non-durable and wasteful," Cline argues.
items.zh: 克莱恩认为，大规模生产的服装，就像快餐一样，满足了人们的饥饿感和需求，但却不耐用且浪费。

items.en: Advertisers are horrified.
items.zh: 广告商感到震惊。

items.en: Human nature being what it is, most people stick with default settings.
items.zh: 人性使然，大多数人会坚持使用默认设置。

items.en: Few switch DNT on now, but if tracking is off it will stay off.
items.zh: 现在很少有人开启DNT（禁止跟踪）选项，但如果关闭了跟踪功能，它就会一直保持关闭状态。

items.en: Bob Liodice, the chief executive of the Association of National Advertisers, says consumers will be worse off if the industry cannot collect information about their preferences.
items.zh: 美国全国广告协会的首席执行官鲍勃·利奥迪斯表示，如果行业无法收集消费者偏好的信息，消费者将处于更不利的地位。

items.en: People will not get fewer ads, he says.
items.zh: 他表示，人们不会看到更少的广告。

items.en: They'll get less meaningful, less targeted ads.
items.zh: 他们会看到更不相关、更不精准的广告。

items.en: It is not yet clear how advertisers will respond.
items.zh: 目前尚不清楚广告商将如何应对。

items.en: Getting a DNT signal does not oblige anyone to stop tracking, although some companies have promised to do so.
items.zh: 收到DNT信号并不会迫使任何人停止跟踪，尽管一些公司已承诺会这么做。

items.en: By watching what people search for, click on and say online, companies can aim "behavioural" ads at those most likely to buy.
items.zh: 通过观察人们在线搜索的内容、点击的对象以及所说的话，公司可以向最有可能购买产品的用户投放"行为"广告。

items.en: In the past couple of weeks a quarrel has illustrated the value to advertisers of such fine-grained information: Should advertisers assume that people are happy to be tracked and sent behavioural ads?
items.zh: 在过去几周里，一场争论说明了此类精细信息对广告商的价值：广告商是否应该假定人们愿意被追踪并接收行为广告？

items.en: Or should they have explicit permission?
items.zh: 还是应该获得明确的许可？

items.en: In December 2010 America's Federal Trade Commission (FTC) proposed adding a "do not track" (DNT) option to internet browsers, so that users could tell advertisers that they did not want to be followed.
items.zh: 2010年12月，美国联邦贸易委员会（FTC）提议在互联网浏览器中增加一个"请勿追踪"（DNT）选项，以便用户可以告诉广告商他们不希望被追踪。

items.en: Microsoft's Internet Explorer and Apple's Safari both offer DNT; Google's Chrome is due to do so this year.
items.zh: 微软的Internet Explorer和苹果的Safari浏览器都已提供DNT功能；谷歌的Chrome浏览器今年也将推出该功能。

items.en: In February the FTC and the Digital Advertising Alliance (DAA) agreed that the industry would get cracking on responding to DNT requests.
items.zh: 2月，FTC与数字广告联盟（DAA）达成一致，认为行业应立即着手回应DNT请求。

items.en: On May 31st Microsoft set off the row.
items.zh: 5月31日，微软引发了这场争论。

items.en: It said that Internet Explorer 10, the version due to appear with Windows 8, would have DNT as a default.
items.zh: 它表示，即将随Windows 8一同发布的Internet Explorer 10将默认启用DNT功能。

items.en: Unable to tell whether someone really objects to behavioural ads or whether they are sticking with Microsoft's default, some may ignore a DNT signal and press on anyway.
items.zh: 无法判断某人是否真的反对行为广告，还是只是沿用微软的默认设置，有些人可能会忽略DNT信号并继续进行广告投放。

items.en: Also unclear is why Microsoft has gone it alone.
items.zh: 同样不清楚的是，为什么微软要独自行动。

items.en: After all, it has an ad business too, which it says will comply with DNT requests, though it is still working out how.
items.zh: 毕竟，微软也有自己的广告业务，它表示将遵守DNT请求，尽管目前仍在摸索具体实施方式。

items.en: If it is trying to upset Google, which relies almost wholly on advertising, it has chosen an indirect method: there is no guarantee that DNT by default will become the norm.
items.zh: 如果微软试图通过这种方式来挑战谷歌，而谷歌几乎完全依赖广告收入，那么它选择了一种间接的方法：默认启用DNT并不能保证会成为行业标准。

items.en: DNT does not seem an obviously huge selling point for Windows 8 - though the firm has compared some of its other products favourably with Google's on that count before.
items.zh: DNT似乎并不是Windows 8的一个明显的大卖点——尽管该公司之前在某些产品上曾与谷歌的产品做过有利比较。

items.en: Brendon Lynch, Microsoft's chief privacy officer, blogged: "We believe consumers should have more control.
items.zh: 微软的首席隐私官布伦登·林奇在博客中写道："我们认为消费者应该拥有更多的控制权。"

items.en: Could it really be that simple?
items.zh: 这真的能如此简单吗？

items.en: Up until a few decades ago, our visions of the future were largely - though by no means uniformly - glowingly positive.
items.zh: 直到几十年前，我们对未来的愿景大多是——尽管并非完全一致——充满乐观和积极的。

items.en: Science and technology would cure all the ills of humanity, leading to lives of fulfilment and opportunity for all.
items.zh: 科技将治愈人类的所有弊病，为所有人带来充满满足感和机遇的生活。

items.en: Now utopia has grown unfashionable, as we have gained a deeper appreciation of the range of threats facing us, from asteroid strike to epidemic flu and to climate change.
items.zh: 如今，乌托邦已不再流行，因为我们对所面临的各种威胁有了更深刻的认识，从小行星撞击到流感疫情，再到气候变化。

items.en: You might even be tempted to assume that humanity has little future to look forward to.
items.zh: 你甚至可能被诱惑去认为，人类几乎没有值得期待的未来。

items.en: But such gloominess is misplaced.
items.zh: 但这种悲观情绪是不恰当的。

items.en: The fossil record shows that many species have endured for millions of years - so why shouldn't we?
items.zh: 化石记录表明，许多物种已经延续了数百万年——那么我们为什么不能呢？

items.en: Take a broader look at our species' place in the universe, and it becomes clear that we have an excellent chance of surviving for tens, if not hundreds, of thousands of years.
items.zh: 从更广阔的视角来看我们这个物种在宇宙中的位置，就会清楚地认识到，我们有很好的机会生存数万年，甚至可能长达数十万年。

items.en: Look up Homo sapiens in the "Red List" of threatened species of the International Union for the Conservation of Nature (IUCN) and you will read: "Listed as Least Concern as the species is very widely distributed, adaptable, currently increasing, and there are no major threats resulting in an overall population decline.
items.zh: 在国际自然保护联盟（IUCN）的《濒危物种红色名录》中查找智人（Homo sapiens），你会看到这样的描述："列为最不关心等级，因为该物种分布非常广泛，适应性强，目前数量正在增长，且没有重大威胁导致总体种群数量下降。"

items.en: So what does our deep future hold?
items.zh: 那么，我们的深远未来将带来什么呢？

items.en: A growing number of researchers and organisations are now thinking seriously about that question.
items.zh: 越来越多的研究人员和机构现在正认真思考这个问题。

items.en: For example, the Long Now Foundation has as its flagship project a mechanical clock that is designed to still be marking time thousands of years hence.
items.zh: 例如，Long Now 基金会将其旗舰项目定为一座机械钟，它被设计为在数千年后仍能继续计时。

items.en: Perhaps willfully, it may be easier to think about such lengthy timescales than about the more immediate future.
items.zh: 也许是有意为之，思考如此长远的时间尺度可能比思考更近的未来更容易一些。

items.en: The potential evolution of today's technology, and its social consequences, is dazzlingly complicated, and it's perhaps best left to science fiction writers and futurologists to explore the many possibilities we can envisage.
items.zh: 当今技术的潜在发展及其社会后果复杂得令人眼花缭乱，或许最好还是让科幻作家和未来学家去探索我们所能设想的众多可能性。

items.en: That's one reason why we have launched Arc, a new publication dedicated to the near future.
items.zh: 这就是我们推出《Arc》这一新出版物的原因之一，它专注于近未来。

items.en: But take a longer view and there is a surprising amount that we can say with considerable assurance.
items.zh: 但如果我们从更长远的角度来看，我们可以相当有把握地做出许多令人惊讶的陈述。

items.en: As so often, the past holds the key to the future: we have now identified enough of the long-term patterns shaping the history of the planet, and our species, to make evidence-based forecasts about the situations in which our descendants will find themselves.
items.zh: 正如往常一样，过去是未来的钥匙：我们现在已经识别出足够多的长期模式，这些模式塑造了地球以及我们这个物种的历史，因此可以基于证据对未来我们的后代所处的情境做出预测。

items.en: This long perspective makes the pessimistic view of our prospects seem more likely to be a passing fad.
items.zh: 这种长远视角使得我们对未来前景的悲观看法似乎更可能只是短暂的时尚。

items.en: To be sure, the future is not all rosy.
items.zh: 可以肯定的是，未来并非一片光明。

items.en: But we are now knowledgeable enough to reduce many of the risks that threatened the existence of earlier humans, and to improve the lot of those to come.
items.zh: 但我们现在拥有足够的知识，可以减少许多曾威胁早期人类生存的风险，并改善后代人的生活状况。

items.en: On a five to three vote, the Supreme Court knocked out much of Arizona's immigration law Monday - a modest policy victory for the Obama Administration.
items.zh: 在五比三的投票中，最高法院于周一否决了亚利桑那州移民法的大部分内容——这是奥巴马政府的一项适度的政策胜利。

items.en: But on the more important matter of the Constitution, the decision was an 8-0 defeat for the Administration's effort to upset the balance of power between the federal government and the states.
items.zh: 但在更为重要的宪法问题上，该裁决以八比零的结果成为政府试图打破联邦政府与各州之间权力平衡的努力的失败。

items.en: United States, the majority overturned three of the four contested provisions of Arizona's controversial plan to have state and local police enforce federal immigration law.
items.zh: 美国最高法院多数意见推翻了亚利桑那州颇具争议的计划中四个有争议条款中的三个，该计划试图让州和地方警察执行联邦移民法。

items.en: The Constitutional principles that Washington alone has the power to "establish a uniform Rule of Naturalization" and that federal laws precede state laws are noncontroversial.
items.zh: 华盛顿拥有权力来"制定统一的归化规则"以及联邦法律优先于州法律的宪法原则本身并无争议。

items.en: Arizona had attempted to fashion state policies that ran parallel to the existing federal ones.
items.zh: 亚利桑那州曾试图制定与现有联邦政策并行的州政策。

items.en: Justice Anthony Kennedy, joined by Chief Justice John Roberts and the Court's liberals, ruled that the state flew too close to the federal sun.
items.zh: 安东尼·肯尼迪大法官，连同首席大法官约翰·罗伯茨和最高法院的自由派法官，裁定该州过于接近联邦政府的权力范围。

items.en: In the past, workers with average skills, doing an average job, could earn an average lifestyle.
items.zh: 过去，拥有普通技能的工人，做着普通的工作，可以获得普通的生活方式。

items.en: But, today, average is officially over.
items.zh: 但如今，普通已正式成为过去式。

items.en: Being average just won’t earn you what it used to.
items.zh: 做个普通的人已经无法赚到以前那样的收入了。

items.en: It can’t when so many more employers have so much more access to so much more above average cheap foreign labor, cheap robotics, cheap software, cheap automation and cheap genius.
items.zh: 当越来越多的雇主能够更便捷地获取大量廉价的外国劳动力、廉价的机器人、廉价的软件、廉价的自动化和廉价的天才时，这就更不可能了。

items.en: Therefore, everyone needs to find their extra – their unique value contribution that makes them stand out in whatever is their field of employment.
items.zh: 因此，每个人都需要找到自己的额外价值——在各自的工作领域中让自己脱颖而出的独特贡献。

items.en: Yes, new technology has been eating jobs forever, and always will.
items.zh: 是的，新技术一直在吞噬工作岗位，而且永远都会如此。

items.en: But there’s been an acceleration.
items.zh: 但这种趋势正在加速。

items.en: As Davidson notes, “In the 10 years ending in 2009, [u.s. ] factories shed workers so fast that they erased almost all the gains of the previous 70 years; roughly one out of every three manufacturing jobs – about 6 million in total – disappeared.
items.zh: 正如戴维森所指出的："在2009年结束的10年间，[美国]工厂裁员速度之快，几乎抹去了前70年所有的就业增长；大约每三个制造业岗位中就有一个消失，总计约600万个岗位。"

items.en: Some powers do belong exclusively to the federal government, and control of citizenship and the borders is among them.
items.zh: 一些权力是联邦政府独有的，对公民身份和边境的控制就是其中之一。

items.en: But if Congress wanted to prevent states from using their own resources to check immigration status, it could.
items.zh: 但如果国会想阻止各州使用自己的资源来核查移民身份，它本来是可以做到的。

items.en: It never did so.
items.zh: 但它从未这样做过。

items.en: The Administration was in essence asserting that because it didn't want to carry out Congress's immigration wishes, no state should be allowed to do so either.
items.zh: 政府实际上是在声称，由于它不想执行国会的移民政策，因此也不应允许任何州这样做。

items.en: Every Justice rightly rejected this remarkable claim.
items.zh: 每一位法官都正确地拒绝了这一惊人的主张。

items.en: In an essay entitled “Making It in America,” the author Adam Davidson relates a joke from cotton country about just how much a modern textile mill has been automated: The average mill has only two employees today, “a man and a dog.
items.zh: 在一篇题为《在美国立足》的文章中，作者亚当·戴维森讲述了一个来自棉花产区的笑话，说明现代纺织厂的自动化程度有多高：如今一家平均的纺织厂只有两名员工，‘一个人和一条狗’。

items.en: The man is there to feed the dog, and the dog is there to keep the man away from the machines.
items.zh: 这个人在那里是为了喂狗，而狗在那里则是为了阻止人靠近机器。

items.en: Davidson’s article is one of a number of pieces that have recently appeared making the point that the reason we have such stubbornly high unemployment and declining middle-class incomes today is largely because of the big drop in demand because of the Great Recession, but it is also because of the advances in both globalization and the information technology revolution, which are more rapidly than ever replacing labor with machines or foreign workers.
items.zh: 戴维森的文章是最近几篇论述的一个例子，这些文章指出，我们如今之所以面临顽固的高失业率和中产阶级收入下降，主要原因是由于大萧条导致的需求大幅下降，但同时也是由于全球化和信息技术革命的进展，这两者正以前所未有的速度用机器或外国工人取代劳动力。

items.en: On the overturned provisions the majority held Congress had deliberately "occupied the field" and Arizona had thus intruded on the federal's privileged powers.
items.zh: 在被推翻的条款上，多数意见认为国会已经明确地"占据了领域"，因此亚利桑那州侵犯了联邦的特权权力。

items.en: However, the Justices said that Arizona police would be allowed to verify the legal status of people who come in contact with law enforcement.
items.zh: 然而，法官们表示，亚利桑那州的警察将被允许核实与执法部门接触人员的法律地位。

items.en: That's because Congress has always envisioned joint federal-state immigration enforcement and explicitly encourages state officers to share information and cooperate with federal colleagues.
items.zh: 这是因为国会一直设想的是联邦与州联合的移民执法，并明确鼓励州官员分享信息并与联邦同事合作。

items.en: Two of the three objecting Justices - Samuel Alito and Clarence Thomas - agreed with this Constitutional logic but disagreed about which Arizona rules conflicted with the federal statute.
items.zh: 三位持反对意见的法官中，有两位 - 萨缪尔·阿利托和克拉伦斯·托马斯 - 赞同这一宪法逻辑，但对哪些亚利桑那州的法规与联邦法律相冲突存在分歧。

items.en: The only major objection came from Justice Antonin Scalia, who offered an even more robust defense of state privileges going back to the Alien and Sedition Acts.
items.zh: 唯一的主要反对意见来自安东尼·斯卡利亚法官，他在反对意见中提出了更为有力的州权辩护，这一辩护可以追溯到《外国人与煽动叛乱法》。

items.en: The 8-0 objection to President Obama turns on what Justice Samuel Alito describes in his objection as "a shocking assertion of federal executive power".
items.zh: 对奥巴马总统的8-0反对意见，基于萨缪尔·阿利托法官在其反对意见中所描述的"令人震惊的联邦行政权力主张"。

items.en: The White House argued that Arizona's laws conflicted with its enforcement priorities, even if state laws complied with federal statutes to the letter.
items.zh: 白宫方面认为，即使亚利桑那州的法律在字面上完全符合联邦法律，但这些法律与联邦的执法优先事项相冲突。

items.en: In effect, the White House claimed that it could invalidate any otherwise legitimate state law that it disagrees with.
items.zh: 实际上，白宫声称它可以使任何它不同意的、否则合法的州法律失效。

items.en: About a quarter of all Italian immigrants, for example, eventually returned to Italy for good.
items.zh: 例如，大约四分之一的意大利移民最终永久返回了意大利。

items.en: They even had an affectionate nickname, “uccelli di passaggio,” birds of passage.
items.zh: 他们甚至有一个亲切的绰号，“uccelli di passaggio”，意为“过境鸟”。

items.en: Today, we are much more rigid about immigrants.
items.zh: 如今，我们对移民的态度要严格得多。

items.en: We divide newcomers into two categories: legal or illegal, good or bad.
items.zh: 我们将新来的人分为两类：合法或非法，好人或坏人。

items.en: We hail them as Americans in the making, or brand them as aliens to be kicked out.
items.zh: 我们一方面将他们誉为正在成为美国人的群体，另一方面则将他们视为需要驱逐的外国人。

items.en: That framework has contributed mightily to our broken immigration system and the long political paralysis over how to fix it.
items.zh: 这种框架极大地加剧了我们移民体系的崩溃，以及在如何修复它方面长期的政治僵局。

items.en: We don’t need more categories, but we need to change the way we think about categories.
items.zh: 我们并不需要更多的分类，但需要改变我们对分类的看法。

items.en: We need to look beyond strict definitions of legal and illegal.
items.zh: 我们需要超越对合法与非法的严格定义。

items.en: To start, we can recognize the new birds of passage, those living and thriving in the gray areas.
items.zh: 首先，我们可以认识到这些新的候鸟式人群，他们生活在并活跃于灰色地带。

items.en: We might then begin to solve our immigration challenges.
items.zh: 接着，我们或许可以开始解决我们的移民挑战。

items.en: Crop pickers, violinists, construction workers, entrepreneurs, engineers, home health-care aides and physicists are among today’s birds of passage.
items.zh: 今天的候鸟式人群包括摘水果工人、小提琴手、建筑工人、企业家、工程师、家庭健康护理员和物理学家。

items.en: They are energetic participants in a global economy driven by the flow of work, money and ideas.
items.zh: 他们是全球经济发展中工作、金钱和思想流动的积极参与者。

items.en: They prefer to come and go as opportunity calls them.
items.zh: 他们更倾向于根据机遇的召唤来去自如。

items.en: They can manage to have a job in one place and a family in another.
items.zh: 他们能够在一个地方工作，在另一个地方拥有家庭。

items.en: With or without permission, they straddle laws, jurisdictions and identities with ease.
items.zh: 无论有没有许可，他们都能轻松地跨越法律、司法管辖区和身份界限。

items.en: We need them to imagine the United States as a place where they can be productive for a while without committing themselves to staying forever.
items.zh: 我们需要他们将美国想象成一个可以暂时发挥生产力，而无需永久定居的地方。

items.en: We need them to feel that home can be both here and there and that they can belong to two nations honorably.
items.zh: 我们需要让他们感受到，家既可以在这里也可以在那里，并且他们可以体面地属于两个国家。

items.en: Accommodating this new world of people in motion will require new attitudes on both sides of the immigration battle.
items.zh: 适应这个充满流动人口的新世界，将需要移民问题双方都采取新的态度。

items.en: Looking beyond the culture war logic of right or wrong means opening up the middle ground and understanding that managing immigration today requires multiple paths and multiple outcomes, including some that are not easy to accomplish legally in the existing system.
items.zh: 超越文化战争中非黑即白的逻辑，意味着开辟中间地带，并理解如今管理移民需要多种途径和多种结果，其中一些在现行制度下很难通过法律手段实现。

items.en: Scientists have found that although we are prone to snap overreactions, if we take a moment and think about how we are likely to react, we can reduce or even eliminate the negative effects of our quick, hard-wired responses.
items.zh: 科学家发现，尽管我们容易产生迅速的过度反应，但如果花点时间思考我们可能会如何反应，就能减少甚至消除我们快速、本能反应带来的负面影响。

items.en: Snap decisions can be important defense mechanisms; if we are judging whether someone is dangerous, our brains and bodies are hard-wired to react very quickly, within milliseconds.
items.zh: 即时决策可以是重要的防御机制；当我们判断某人是否危险时，我们的大脑和身体天生就会在毫秒之内迅速反应。

items.en: But we need more time to assess other factors.
items.zh: 但我们需要更多的时间来评估其他因素。

items.en: To accurately tell whether someone is sociable, studies show, we need at least a minute, preferably five.
items.zh: 研究表明，要准确判断一个人是否善于社交，我们至少需要一分钟，最好是五分钟。

items.en: It takes a while to judge complex aspects of personality, like neuroticism or open
items.zh: 判断性格的复杂方面，比如神经质或开放性，需要一些时间。

items.en: Our ability to mute our hard-wired reactions by pausing is what differentiates us from animals: dogs can think about the future only intermittently or for a few minutes.
items.zh: 我们通过暂停来抑制与生俱来的反应的能力，使我们与动物区分开来：狗只能间歇性地或在几分钟内思考未来。

items.en: But historically we have spent about 12 percent of our days contemplating the longer term.
items.zh: 但从历史上看，我们每天大约有12%的时间用于思考更长远的问题。

items.en: Although technology might change the way we react, it hasn’t changed our nature.
items.zh: 尽管科技可能改变我们的反应方式，但它并未改变我们的本质。

items.en: We still have the imaginative capacity to rise above temptation and reverse the high-speed trend.
items.zh: 我们仍然具备想象力，能够超越诱惑，逆转高速发展的趋势。

items.en: Europe is not a gender-equality heaven.
items.zh: 欧洲并不是性别平等的天堂。

items.en: In particular, the corporate workplace will never be completely family-friendly until women are part of senior management decisions, and Europe’s top corporate-governance positions remain overwhelmingly male.
items.zh: 特别是，除非女性参与高级管理层的决策，否则企业工作场所永远不会完全适合家庭需求，而欧洲企业治理的高层职位仍几乎全部由男性担任。

items.en: Indeed, women hold only 14 per cent of positions on European corporate boards.
items.zh: 事实上，女性仅占欧洲企业董事会职位的14%。

items.en: The European Union is now considering legislation to compel corporate boards to maintain a certain proportion of women – up to 60 per cent.
items.zh: 现在，欧盟正在考虑立法，强制要求企业董事会保持一定比例的女性成员——最高可达60%。

items.en: But snap decisions in reaction to rapid stimuli aren’t exclusive to the interpersonal realm.
items.zh: 但对快速刺激的即时决策并不局限于人际交往领域。

items.en: Psychologists at the University of Toronto found that viewing a fast-food logo for just a few milliseconds primes us to read 20 percent faster, even though reading has little to do with eating.
items.zh: 多伦多大学的心理学家发现，仅仅在几毫秒内看到快餐标志，就会让我们阅读速度提高20%，尽管阅读与进食几乎无关。

items.en: We unconsciously associate fast food with speed and impatience and carry those impulses into whatever else we’re doing, Subjects exposed to fast-food flashes also tend to think a musical piece lasts too long.
items.zh: 我们无意识地将快餐与速度和不耐烦联系在一起，并将这些冲动带入我们正在做的其他事情中。接受快餐标志短暂刺激的受试者也倾向于认为一段音乐持续时间太长。

items.en: Yet we can reverse such influences.
items.zh: 然而，我们可以逆转这些影响。

items.en: If we know we will overreact to consumer products or housing options when we see a happy face (one reason good sales representatives and real estate agents are always smiling), we can take a moment before buying.
items.zh: 如果我们知道在看到一张笑脸时，会对消费品或住房选择产生过度反应（这也是为什么优秀的销售人员和房地产经纪人总是面带微笑的原因之一），那么在购买之前我们可以稍作停顿。

items.en: If we know female job screeners are more likely to reject attractive female applicants, we can help screeners understand their biases – or hire outside screeners.
items.zh: 如果我们知道女性招聘者更可能拒绝有吸引力的女性求职者，我们就可以帮助招聘者认识到他们的偏见——或者聘请外部人员来进行筛选。

items.en: John Gottman, the marriage expert, explains that we quickly “thin slice” information reliably only after we ground such snap reactions in “thick sliced” long-term study.
items.zh: 婚姻专家约翰·戈特曼解释说，只有当我们把这种即时反应建立在长期深入研究的基础上，我们才能可靠地快速‘薄切’信息。

items.en: When dr. Gottman really wants to assess whether a couple will stay together, he invites them to his island retreat for a much longer evaluation: two days, not two seconds.
items.zh: 当戈特曼博士真正想评估一对夫妻是否会维持关系时，他会邀请他们到他的岛上度假地进行更长时间的评估：两天，而不是两秒钟。

items.en: This proposed mandate was born of frustration.
items.zh: 这项提议的强制规定源于挫败感。

items.en: Last year, European Commission Vice President Viviane Reding issued a call to voluntary action.
items.zh: 去年，欧盟委员会副主席薇薇安·雷丁发起了一项自愿行动的呼吁。

items.en: Reding invited corporations to sign up for gender balance goals of 40 per cent female board membership.
items.zh: 雷丁邀请企业报名参与实现董事会女性成员比例达到40%的目标。

items.en: But her appeal was considered a failure: only 24 companies took it up.
items.zh: 但她的呼吁被认为是一次失败：只有24家公司响应了这一倡议。

items.en: Do we need quotas to ensure that women can continue to climb the corporate ladder fairly as they balance work and family?
items.zh: 我们需要配额来确保女性在平衡工作与家庭的同时，能够公平地继续攀登企业阶梯吗？

items.en: Personally, I don’t like quotas,” Reding said recently.
items.zh: 雷丁最近表示："我个人不喜欢配额。"

items.en: But I like what the quotas do.” Quotas get action: they “open the way to equality and they break through the glass ceiling,” according to Reding, a result seen in France and other countries with legally binding provisions on placing women in top business positions.
items.zh: 但她喜欢配额所产生的效果。"配额能促使行动：它们"为平等开辟道路，并打破玻璃天花板"，雷丁如是说，这一效果在法国及其他对女性担任高层职位有法律约束力规定的国家已经显现。

items.en: I understand Reding’s reluctance – and her frustration.
items.zh: 我理解雷丁的犹豫——以及她的挫败感。

items.en: More apparent reasonableness followed.
items.zh: 更加明显的合理性随之而来。

items.en: There will now be a seven-day wait for the jobseeker's allowance.
items.zh: 现在，求职者津贴的申请将需要等待七天。

items.en: Those first few days should be spent looking for work, not looking to sign on," he claimed.
items.zh: 他声称，最初的几天应该用来找工作，而不是去申请津贴。

items.en: We're doing these things because we know they help people stay off benefits and help those on benefits get into work faster.
items.zh: 我们之所以这么做，是因为我们知道这些措施有助于人们不领取福利金，同时帮助正在领取福利金的人更快地找到工作。

items.en: On first hearing, this was the socially concerned chancellor, trying to change lives for the better, complete with "reforms" to an obviously indulgent system that demands too little effort from the newly unemployed to find work, and subsidises laziness.
items.zh: 乍一听，这似乎是一位关心社会的财政大臣，试图通过改革明显过于宽容的制度来改善人们的生活，这个制度对新失业者要求的努力太少，而且补贴了懒惰的行为。

items.en: What motivated him, we were to understand, was his zeal for "fundamental fairness" - protecting the taxpayer, controlling spending and ensuring that only the most deserving claimants received their benefits.
items.zh: 我们被告知，促使他这样做的是他对“根本公平”的热忱——保护纳税人，控制开支，并确保只有最值得获得的人才能领取他们的福利金。

items.en: Losing a job is hurting: you don't skip down to the jobcentre with a song in your heart, delighted at the prospect of doubling your income from the generous state.
items.zh: 失去工作是一件痛苦的事：你不会哼着歌兴高采烈地跑到就业中心，期待着从慷慨的国家福利中获得双倍收入。

items.en: It is financially terrifying, psychologically embarrassing and you know that support is minimal and extraordinarily hard to get.
items.zh: 这在经济上令人恐惧，在心理上令人尴尬，而且你知道得到的支持是极其有限的，而且非常难以获得。

items.en: I don’t like quotas either; they run counter to my belief in meritocracy, governance by the capable.
items.zh: 我也不喜欢配额制度；它们与我信奉的才能至上的理念背道而驰。

items.en: But, when one considers the obstacles to achieving the meritocratic ideal, it does look as if a fairer world must be temporarily ordered.
items.zh: 然而，当我们考虑到实现才能至上的理想所面临的障碍时，似乎一个更公平的世界必须暂时进行某种秩序安排。

items.en: After all, four decades of evidence has now shown that corporations in Europe as well as the US are evading the meritocratic hiring and promotion of women to top positions – no matter how much “soft pressure” is put upon them.
items.zh: 毕竟，四十年来的证据表明，欧洲和美国的企业都在逃避按才能招聘和晋升女性到高层职位的做法——无论对它们施加了多少“软性压力”。

items.en: When women do break through to the summit of corporate power – as, for example, Sheryl Sandberg recently did at Facebook – they attract massive attention precisely because they remain the exception to the rule.
items.zh: 当女性最终突破到企业权力的顶峰——比如，谢丽尔·桑德伯格最近在Facebook所做的那样——她们会吸引大量关注，正是因为她们仍然是这一规则的例外。

items.en: If appropriate public policies were in place to help all women – whether CEOs or their children’s caregivers – and all families, Sandberg would be no more newsworthy than any other highly capable person living in a more just society.
items.zh: 如果适当的社会政策能够帮助所有女性——无论是首席执行官还是她们孩子的照看者——以及所有家庭，那么桑德伯格就不会比其他任何在更加公正社会中具备高度能力的人更有新闻价值。

items.en: In order to "change lives for the better" and reduce "dependency", George Osborne, Chancellor of the Exchequer, introduced the "upfront work search" scheme.
items.zh: 为了实现“改善人们的生活”并减少“依赖性”，英国财政大臣乔治·奥斯本推出了“提前求职”计划。

items.en: Only if the jobless arrive at the jobcentre with a CV, register for online job search, and start looking for work will they be eligible for benefit - and then they should report weekly rather than fortnightly.
items.zh: 只有失业者带着简历来到就业中心，注册在线求职，并开始找工作，他们才有资格领取福利——而且之后他们应该每周而不是每两周进行一次报到。

items.en: What could be more reasonable?
items.zh: 还有什么比这更合理呢？

items.en: There will always be change – new jobs, new products, new services.
items.zh: 变化将始终存在——新的工作、新的产品、新的服务。

items.en: But the one thing we know for sure is that with each advance in globalization and the I.
items.zh: 但有一件事我们是确定的，那就是随着全球化的每一次进步以及I的每一次发展，

items.en: T. revolution, the best jobs will require workers to have more and better education to make themselves above average.
items.zh: 在技术革命中，最好的工作将要求工人接受更多更好的教育，使自己高于平均水平。

items.en: In a world where average is officially over, there are many things we need to do to support employment, but nothing would be more important than passing some kind of G.
items.zh: 在一个平均值已正式终结的世界里，我们需要做很多事情来支持就业，但没有什么比通过某种形式的G更为重要的了。

items.en: Bill for the 21st century that ensures that every American has access to post-high school education.
items.zh: 一项确保每个美国人都能接受高中后教育的21世纪法案。

items.en: A century ago, the immigrants from across the Atlantic included settlers and sojourners.
items.zh: 一个世纪前，来自大西洋彼岸的移民包括定居者和暂住者。

items.en: Along with the many folks looking to make a permanent home in the United States came those who had no intention to stay, and who would make some money and then go home.
items.zh: 除了许多希望在美国安家落户的人之外，还有一些人根本没有打算留下，他们只想赚些钱然后就回国。

items.en: Between 1908 and 1915, about 7 million people arrived while about 2 million departed.
items.zh: 1908年至1915年间，约有700万人抵达，同时约有200万人离开。

items.en: You are now not wanted; you are now excluded from the work environment that offers purpose and structure in your life.
items.zh: 你现在不再被需要了；你已被排除在能为你生活提供意义和结构的工作环境之外。

items.en: Worse, the crucial income to feed yourself and your family and pay the bills has disappeared.
items.zh: 更糟糕的是，维持你和家人生活以及支付账单的关键收入已经消失。

items.en: Ask anyone newly unemployed what they want and the answer is always: a job.
items.zh: 问问任何刚刚失业的人他们想要什么，答案总是：一份工作。

items.en: But in Osborneland, your first instinct is to fall into dependency - permanent dependency if you can get it - supported by a state only too ready to indulge your falsehood.
items.zh: 但在奥斯本的政策下，你的第一反应是陷入依赖——如果可能的话，是永久的依赖——而国家也乐于支持你这种虚假的依赖。

items.en: It is as though 20 years of ever-tougher reforms of the job search and benefit administration system never happened.
items.zh: 就好像过去20年里，针对求职和福利管理系统的越来越严格的改革从未发生过一样。

items.en: The principle of British welfare is no longer that you can insure yourself against the risk of unemployment and receive unconditional payments if the disaster happens.
items.zh: 英国福利的原则已不再是你可以通过缴纳国民保险费来保障自己免受失业风险，并在灾难发生时无条件获得支付。

items.en: Even the very phrase "jobseeker's allowance" is about redefining the unemployed as a "jobseeker" who had no fundamental right to a benefit he or she has earned through making national insurance contributions.
items.zh: 甚至‘求职者津贴’这个说法本身，也是在重新定义失业者为‘求职者’，而他们并没有基于通过缴纳国民保险费所获得的任何基本权利。

items.en: Instead, the claimant receives a time-limited "allowance," conditional on actively seeking a job; no entitlement and no insurance, at £71.70 a week, one of the least generous in the EU.
items.zh: 相反，申请人只能获得一个有时间限制的‘津贴’，前提是他们积极寻找工作；这既不是任何权利，也不是任何保险，每周仅71.70英镑，是欧盟国家中最不慷慨的之一。

items.en: All around the world, lawyers generate more hostility than the members of any other profession - with the possible exception of journalism.
items.zh: 在全球范围内，律师这个职业比其他任何职业都更容易引发敌意——也许除了新闻业之外。

items.en: But there are few places where clients have more grounds for complaint than America.
items.zh: 但很少有地方比美国更能引起客户投诉的。

items.en: During the decade before the economic crisis, spending on legal services in America grew twice as fast as inflation.
items.zh: 在经济危机前的十年里，美国在法律服务上的支出增长速度是通货膨胀的两倍。

items.en: The best lawyers made skyscrapers-full of money, tempting ever more students to pile into law schools.
items.zh: 最优秀的律师赚取了足以填满摩天大楼的钱，这诱惑着越来越多的学生涌向法学院。

items.en: But most law graduates never get a big-firm job.
items.zh: 但大多数法学院毕业生从未获得大型律师事务所的工作。

items.en: Many of them instead become the kind of nuisance-lawsuit filer that makes the tort system a costly nightmare.
items.zh: 他们中许多人反而成为了那种制造麻烦诉讼的原告，使侵权法体系变成了昂贵的噩梦。

items.en: There are many reasons for this.
items.zh: 造成这种现象的原因有很多。

items.en: One is the excessive costs of a legal education.
items.zh: 其中一个原因是法律教育的过高成本。

items.en: There is just one path for a lawyer in most American states: a four-year undergraduate degree in some unrelated subject, then a three-year law degree at one of 200 law schools authorized by the American Bar Association and an expensive preparation for the bar exam.
items.zh: 在大多数美国州，律师的职业路径只有一条：先攻读四年制的与法律无关的本科专业，然后在获得美国律师协会授权的200所法学院之一攻读三年制的法律学位，接着还要花费高昂的费用准备律师资格考试。

items.en: This leaves today's average law-school graduate with $100,000 of debt on top of undergraduate debts.
items.zh: 这使得如今的普通法学院毕业生在本科债务的基础上，又背上了10万美元的债务。

items.en: Law-school debt means that they have to work fearsomely hard.
items.zh: 法学院的债务意味着他们必须非常努力地工作。

items.en: Reforming the system would help both lawyers and their customers.
items.zh: 改革这个体系将对律师及其客户都有好处。

items.en: Sensible ideas have been around for a long time, but the state-level bodies that govern the profession have been too conservative to implement them.
items.zh: 一些合理的改革想法已经存在了很长时间，但管理这一职业的州级机构却过于保守，未能实施这些想法。

items.en: One idea is to allow people to study law as an undergraduate degree.
items.zh: 其中一个想法是允许人们将法律作为本科专业来学习。

items.en: Another is to let students sit for the bar after only two years of law school.
items.zh: 另一个想法是让学生在法学院学习两年后就可以参加律师资格考试。

items.en: If the bar exam is truly a stern enough test for a would-be lawyer, those who can sit it earlier should be allowed to do so.
items.zh: 如果律师资格考试确实是对一个未来律师足够严格的测试，那么那些可以更早参加考试的人就应该被允许这样做。

items.en: Students who do not need the extra training could cut their debt mountain by a third.
items.zh: 不需要额外培训的学生可以将他们的债务山减少三分之一。

items.en: The other reason why costs are so high is the restrictive guild-like ownership structure of the business.
items.zh: 成本之所以如此高昂的另一个原因是该行业的限制性类似行会的所有权结构。

items.en: Except in the District of Columbia, non-lawyers may not own any share of a law firm.
items.zh: 除了哥伦比亚特区外，非律师不得拥有律师事务所的任何股份。

items.en: This keeps fees high and innovation slow.
items.zh: 这使得费用居高不下，创新进展缓慢。

items.en: There is pressure for change from within the profession, but opponents of change among the regulators insist that keeping outsiders out of a law firm isolates lawyers from the pressure to make money rather than serve clients ethically.
items.zh: 事实上，法律界内部存在改革的压力，但监管机构中反对改革的人坚持认为，阻止外部人员进入律师事务所，可以使律师免受赚钱而非以符合道德的方式服务客户的压力。

items.en: In fact, allowing non-lawyers to own shares in law firms would reduce costs and improve services to customers, by encouraging law firms to use technology and to employ professional managers to focus on improving firms' efficiency.
items.zh: 实际上，允许非律师拥有律师事务所的股份，将通过鼓励律师事务所采用技术并聘请专业经理来提高效率，从而降低成本并改善对客户的服务。

items.en: After all, other countries, such as Australia and Britain, have started liberalizing their legal professions.
items.zh: 毕竟，像澳大利亚和英国这样的其他国家已经开始放松其法律行业的管制。

items.en: America should follow.
items.zh: 美国也应该跟进。

items.en: The new awards are an exercise in self-promotion for those behind them, say scientists.
items.zh: 科学家们表示，这些新奖项对于其背后的支持者来说，只是一次自我宣传的尝试。

items.en: They could distort the achievement-based system of peer-review-led research.
items.zh: 它们可能会扭曲基于成就、以同行评审为主导的研究体系。

items.en: They could cement the status quo of peer-reviewed research.
items.zh: 它们可能会巩固以同行评审为主导的研究现状。

items.en: They do not fund peer-reviewed research.
items.zh: 它们并不资助经过同行评审的研究。

items.en: They perpetuate the myth of the lone genius.
items.zh: 它们延续了独行天才的神话。

items.en: The goals of the prize-givers seem as scattered as the criticism.
items.zh: 颁奖机构的目标似乎和批评一样分散。

items.en: Some want to shock, others to draw people into science, or to better reward those who have made their careers in research.
items.zh: 一些人希望引起轰动，另一些人则希望吸引更多人投身科学，或者更好地奖励那些以科研为职业的人。

items.en: As Nature has pointed out before, there are some legitimate concerns about how science prizes - both new and old - are distributed.
items.zh: 正如《自然》之前所指出的，人们对新旧科学奖项的分配方式存在一些合理的担忧。

items.en: The US$3-million Fundamental Physics Prize is indeed an interesting experiment, as Alexander Polyakov said when he accepted this year's award in March.
items.zh: 300万美元的基础物理学奖确实是一个有趣的实验，正如亚历山大·波利亚科夫在3月份接受今年奖项时所说。

items.en: And it is far from the only one of its type.
items.zh: 而且它远不是唯一一个此类奖项。

items.en: As a News Feature article in Nature discusses, a string of lucrative awards for researchers have joined the Nobel Prizes in recent years.
items.zh: 正如《自然》杂志的一篇新闻特写文章所讨论的，近年来一系列丰厚的科研奖项已经加入了诺贝尔奖的行列。

items.en: Many, like the Fundamental Physics Prize, are funded from the telephone-number-sized bank accounts of Internet entrepreneurs.
items.zh: 许多奖项，比如基础物理学奖，都是由互联网企业家们从他们电话号码般庞大的银行账户中资助的。

items.en: These benefactors have succeeded in their chosen fields, they say, and they want to use their wealth to draw attention to those who have succeeded in science.
items.zh: 这些资助者表示，他们在自己选择的领域取得了成功，现在想用自己的财富来引起人们对科学领域成功者的关注。

items.en: What's not to like?
items.zh: 有什么不喜欢的呢？

items.en: Quite a lot, according to a handful of scientists quoted in the News Feature.
items.zh: 据《新闻特写》中引用的几位科学家的说法，其实有很多不喜欢的地方。

items.en: You cannot buy class, as the old saying goes, and these upstart entrepreneurs cannot buy their prizes the prestige of the Nobels.
items.zh: 俗话说，你买不到品格，而这些新晋企业家也无法用金钱买到诺贝尔奖所拥有的声望。

items.en: The Breakthrough Prize in Life Sciences, launched this year, takes an unrepresentative view of what the life sciences include.
items.zh: 今年设立的生命科学突破奖对生命科学所包含的内容采取了一种不具代表性的看法。

items.en: But the Nobel Foundation's limit of three recipients per prize, each of whom must still be living, has long been outgrown by the collaborative nature of modern research - as will be demonstrated by the inevitable row over who is ignored when it comes to acknowledging the discovery of the Higgs boson.
items.zh: 但诺贝尔基金会规定每个奖项最多只能有三位获奖者，且每位获奖者都必须仍然在世，这一限制早已无法适应现代研究的协作性质——这一点在承认希格斯玻色子发现时不可避免地引发争议时将得到证明。

items.en: The Nobels were, of course, themselves set up by a very rich individual who had decided what he wanted to do with his own money.
items.zh: 当然，诺贝尔奖最初也是由一位非常富有的个人设立的，他决定如何使用自己的资金。

items.en: Time, rather than intention, has given them legitimacy.
items.zh: 时间，而非初衷，赋予了它们合法性。

items.en: As much as some scientists may complain about the new awards, two things seem clear.
items.zh: 尽管一些科学家可能会对这些新奖项抱怨，但有两件事似乎很清楚。

items.en: First, most researchers would accept such a prize if they were offered one.
items.zh: 首先，如果大多数研究人员被提供这样的奖项，他们大概会接受。

items.en: Second, it is surely a good thing that the money and attention come to science rather than go elsewhere.
items.zh: 其次，这笔资金和关注投入到科学领域，而不是其他地方，显然是件好事。

items.en: It is fair to criticize and question the mechanism - that is the culture of research, after all - but it is the prize-givers' money to do with as they please.
items.zh: 批评和质疑这一机制是合理的——毕竟这本身就是科研文化的一部分——但这是颁奖机构决定如何使用他们自己的资金。

items.en: It is wise to take such gifts with gratitude and grace.
items.zh: 以感恩和优雅的态度接受这样的礼物是明智的。

items.en: The Heart of the Matter," the just-released report by the American Academy of Arts and Sciences (AAAS), deserves praise for affirming the importance of the humanities and social sciences to the prosperity and security of liberal democracy in America.
items.zh: 《问题的核心》这份由美国艺术与科学学院（AAAS）刚刚发布的报告，值得赞扬，因为它肯定了人文学科和社会科学对美国自由民主制度繁荣与安全的重要性。

items.en: Regrettably, however, the report's failure to address the true nature of the crisis facing liberal education may cause more harm than good.
items.zh: 然而令人遗憾的是，该报告未能正视自由教育所面临的真正危机，这可能会弊大于利。

items.en: In 2010, leading congressional Democrats and Republicans sent letters to the AAAS asking that it identify actions that could be taken by "federal, state and local governments, universities, foundations, educators, individual benefactors and others" to "maintain national excellence in humanities and social scientific scholarship and education.
items.zh: 2010年，美国国会的民主党与共和党领袖分别致信AAAS，要求其确定联邦、州和地方政府、大学、基金会、教育者、个人捐助者及其他各方可以采取的行动，以保持美国在人文学科和社会科学领域学术与教育的全国领先地位。

items.en: In response, the American Academy formed the Commission on the Humanities and Social Sciences.
items.zh: 作为回应，美国艺术与科学学院成立了人文学科与社会科学委员会。

items.en: Among the commission's 51 members are top-tier-university presidents, scholars, lawyers, judges, and business executives, as well as prominent figures from diplomacy, filmmaking, music and journalism.
items.zh: 该委员会的51名成员包括顶尖大学的校长、学者、律师、法官和企业高管，以及来自外交、电影制作、音乐和新闻领域的知名人士。

items.en: The goals identified in the report are generally admirable.
items.zh: 报告中提出的目标总体上是值得称赞的。

items.en: Because representative government presupposes an informed citizenry, the report supports full literacy; stresses the study of history and government, particularly American history and American government; and encourages the use of new digital technologies.
items.zh: 由于代议制政府预设了一个受过良好教育的公民群体，报告支持全面的读写能力；强调历史和政府课程的学习，特别是美国历史和美国政府；并鼓励使用新的数字技术。

items.en: What would you do with $590m?
items.zh: 你拿到5.9亿美元会做什么？

items.en: This is now a question for Gloria MacKenzie, an 84-year-old widow who recently emerged from her small, tin-roofed house in Florida to collect the biggest undivided lottery jackpot in history.
items.zh: 现在这个问题摆在格洛丽亚·麦克肯齐面前，她是一位84岁的寡妇，最近才从佛罗里达州她那间小而铁皮屋顶的房子中走出来，领取了历史上最大的未分割彩票头奖。

items.en: If she hopes her new-found fortune will yield lasting feelings of fulfilment, she could do worse than read Happy Money by Elizabeth Dunn and Michael Norton.
items.zh: 如果她希望这笔意外之财能带来持久的满足感，那么她不如读一读伊丽莎白·邓恩和迈克尔·诺顿所著的《快乐金钱》。

items.en: These two academics use an array of behavioral research to show that the most rewarding ways to spend money can be counterintuitive.
items.zh: 这两位学者运用大量行为研究证明，最能带来满足感的花钱方式往往出人意料。

items.en: Fantasies of great wealth often involve visions of fancy cars and extravagant homes.
items.zh: 人们对巨额财富的幻想通常包括豪华汽车和奢侈住宅的画面。

items.en: Yet satisfaction with these material purchases wears off fairly quickly.
items.zh: 然而，对这些物质性购买的满足感很快就会消退。

items.en: What was once exciting and new becomes old-hat; regret creeps in.
items.zh: 曾经令人兴奋的新鲜感会变得乏味；后悔的情绪开始滋生。

items.en: It is far better to spend money on experiences, say Ms Dunn and Mr Norton, like interesting trips, unique meals or even going to the cinema.
items.zh: 邓恩女士和诺顿先生认为，与其购买这些物质性的东西，不如把钱花在体验上，比如有趣的旅行、独特的美食，甚至去看一场电影。

items.en: To encourage innovation and competition, the report calls for increased investment in research, the crafting of coherent curricula that improve students' ability to solve problems and communicate effectively in the 21st century, increased funding for teachers and the encouragement of scholars to bring their learning to bear on the great challenges of the day.
items.zh: 为了鼓励创新和竞争，报告呼吁增加对研究的投资，制定连贯的课程体系以提升学生在21世纪解决问题和有效沟通的能力，增加对教师的资金支持，并鼓励学者将所学知识应用于当今的重大挑战。

items.en: The report also advocates greater study of foreign languages, international affairs and the expansion of study abroad programs.
items.zh: 报告还提倡加强对外语、国际事务的学习，并扩大出国学习项目。

items.en: Unfortunately, despite 2½ years in the making, "The Heart of the Matter" never gets to the heart of the matter: the illiberal nature of liberal education at our leading colleges and universities.
items.zh: 不幸的是，尽管这份报告耗时2½年完成，但《核心问题》（"The Heart of the Matter"）从未触及问题的核心：我们顶尖大学和学院中自由教育的非自由本质。

items.en: The commission ignores that for several decades America's colleges and universities have produced graduates who don't know the content and character of liberal education and are thus deprived of its benefits.
items.zh: 该委员会忽视了一个事实，即几十年来，美国的大学和学院培养出来的毕业生并不了解自由教育的内容和本质，因此无法享受其带来的益处。

items.en: Sadly, the spirit of inquiry once at home on campus has been replaced by the use of the humanities and social sciences as vehicles for publicizing "progressive," or left-liberal propaganda.
items.zh: 令人遗憾的是，曾经在校园中盛行的探究精神已被人文和社会科学作为宣传"进步"（即左翼自由主义）宣传的工具所取代。

items.en: Today, professors routinely treat the progressive interpretation of history and progressive public policy as the proper subject of study while portraying conservative or classical liberal ideas - such as free markets and self-reliance - as falling outside the boundaries of routine, and sometimes legitimate, intellectual investigation.
items.zh: 如今，教授们通常将进步的历史解读和进步的公共政策视为研究的正当主题，而将保守或古典自由主义的观点——例如自由市场和自立——描绘为超出常规、有时甚至是合法的学术研究范围之外的内容。

items.en: The AAAS displays great enthusiasm for liberal education.
items.zh: 美国科学促进协会（AAAS）对自由教育表现出极大的热情。

items.en: Yet its report may well set back reform by obscuring the depth and breadth of the challenge that Congress asked it to illuminate.
items.zh: 然而，它的报告可能会阻碍改革进程，因为它模糊了国会要求其阐明的这一挑战的深度和广度。

items.en: These purchases often become more valuable with time
items.zh: 这些购买往往随着时间的推移而变得更加有价值

items.en: – as stories or memories – particularly if they involve feeling more connected to others.
items.zh: ——作为故事或回忆——尤其是当它们让人感觉与他人更加联系紧密时。

items.en: This slim volume is packed with tips to help wage slaves as well as lottery winners get the most “happiness bang for your buck.” It seems most people would be better off if they could shorten their commutes to work, spend more time with friends and family and less of it watching television (something the average American spends a whopping two months a year doing, and is hardly jollier for it).
items.zh: 这本薄薄的小书充满了建议，帮助工薪族以及彩票中奖者获得最大的‘幸福感与金钱的比值’。似乎大多数人如果能缩短通勤时间，多花时间与朋友和家人在一起，少花时间看电视（美国人平均每年花整整两个月的时间看电视，但这并未让他们变得更快乐），将会更好。

items.en: Buying gifts or giving to charity is often more pleasurable than purchasing things for oneself, and luxuries are most enjoyable when they are consumed sparingly.
items.zh: 购买礼物或进行慈善捐赠通常比为自己买东西更令人愉快，而奢侈品在适度消费时最为享受。

items.en: This is apparently the reason McDonald’s restricts the availability of its popular McRib – a marketing trick that has turned the pork sandwich into an object of obsession.
items.zh: 显然这就是麦当劳限制其受欢迎的麦里芝猪排三明治供应量的原因——这是一种营销策略，使这款猪肉三明治变成了人们痴迷的对象。

items.en: Readers of Happy Money are clearly a privileged lot, anxious about fulfilment, not hunger.
items.zh: 《快乐金钱》的读者显然是一群生活优渥的人，他们更焦虑的是追求满足感，而不是饥饿。

items.en: Money may not quite buy happiness, but people in wealthier countries are generally happier than those in poor ones.
items.zh: 金钱或许并不能完全买到幸福，但富裕国家的人通常比贫穷国家的人更幸福。

items.en: Yet the link between feeling good and spending money on others can be seen among rich and poor people around the world, and scarcity enhances the pleasure of most things for most people.
items.zh: 然而，在全世界的富人和穷人中，都能看到将钱花在他人身上与感觉良好的联系，而且稀缺性增强了大多数人对大多数事物的愉悦感。

items.en: Psychologist and behavioural scientist Nicholas Epley oversaw a key study into self-enhancement and attractiveness.
items.zh: 心理学家和行为科学家尼古拉斯·埃普利主持了一项关于自我提升和吸引力的关键研究。

items.en: Rather than have people simply rate their beauty compared with others, he asked them to identify an original photograph of themselves from a lineup including versions that had been altered to appear more and less attractive.
items.zh: 与其让参与者简单地将自己与他人相比评定美貌，他要求他们从一组包含被修改得更吸引人和不那么吸引人的照片中，辨认出自己原始的照片。

items.en: Visual recognition, reads the study, is “an automatic psychological process, occurring rapidly and intuitively with little or no apparent conscious deliberation”.
items.zh: 这项研究指出，视觉识别是一种‘自动的心理过程，快速且直觉地发生，几乎不需要或明显不需要有意识的深思熟虑’。

items.en: If the subjects quickly chose a falsely flattering image – which most did – they genuinely believed it was really how they looked.
items.zh: 如果受试者迅速选择了被错误地美化了的照片——大多数人都是如此——他们真的相信那张照片就是他们真实的模样。

items.en: Epley found no significant gender difference in responses.
items.zh: 埃普利发现，男女在回应上没有显著差异。

items.en: Nor was there any evidence that those who self-enhanced the most (that is, the participants who thought the most positively doctored pictures were real) were doing so to make up for profound insecurities.
items.zh: 也没有证据表明那些自我提升最多的人（即认为经过最多积极修改的照片是真实的参与者）是出于深刻的不安全感而这样做。

items.en: In fact, those who thought that the images higher up the attractiveness scale were real directly corresponded with those who showed other markers for having higher self-esteem.
items.zh: 事实上，认为吸引力等级更高的照片是真实的人，直接对应于那些表现出更高自尊心的其他标志的人。

items.en: I don’t think the findings that we have are any evidence of personal delusion,” says Epley.
items.zh: 埃普利表示：‘我认为我们目前的发现并不能作为个人妄想的任何证据。’

items.en: It’s a reflection simply of people generally thinking well of themselves.” If you are depressed, you won’t be self-enhancing.
items.zh: 这仅仅反映了人们通常对自己评价很高。”如果你抑郁了，你就不会自我提升。

items.en: Knowing the results of Epley’s study, it makes sense that many people hate photographs of themselves viscerally – on one level, they don’t even recognise the person in the picture as themselves.
items.zh: 了解了Epley研究的结果，很多人从直觉上就讨厌自己的照片也就合情合理了——在某种程度上，他们甚至无法在照片中认出那个人就是自己。

items.en: Facebook, therefore, is a self-enhancer’s paradise, where people can share only the most flattering photos, the cream of their wit, style, beauty, intellect and lifestyles.
items.zh: 因此，Facebook对于那些喜欢自我提升的人来说简直就是天堂，人们可以只分享最能凸显自己魅力的照片，展现自己最出色的一面：机智、风格、美貌、智慧和生活方式。

items.en: It’s not that people’s profiles are dishonest, says Catalina Toma of Wisconsin-Madison University, “but they portray an idealised version of themselves.
items.zh: 威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校的Catalina Toma表示：“人们的个人资料并非不诚实，但它们展现的是一个理想化的自我形象。

items.en: The concept of man versus machine is at least as old as the industrial revolution, but this phenomenon tends to be most acutely felt during economic downturns and fragile recoveries.
items.zh: 人与机器之间的概念至少可以追溯到工业革命时期，但这种现象往往在经济衰退和脆弱复苏时期最为明显。

items.en: And yet, it would be a mistake to think we are right now simply experiencing the painful side of a boom and bust cycle.
items.zh: 然而，认为我们现在仅仅是经历经济繁荣与萧条周期中痛苦的一面，那就错了。

items.en: Certain jobs have gone away for good, outmoded by machines.
items.zh: 某些工作已经一去不复返了，被机器淘汰了。

items.en: Since technology has such an insatiable appetite for eating up human jobs, this phenomenon will continue to restructure our economy in ways we cannot immediately foresee.
items.zh: 由于技术对吞噬人类工作有着无法满足的胃口，这种现象将继续以我们无法立即预见的方式重塑我们的经济。

items.en: Not everyone will agree with the authors’ policy ideas, which range from mandating more holiday time to reducing tax incentives for American homebuyers.
items.zh: 并非所有人都会同意作者的政策主张，这些主张从强制增加假期时间到减少对美国购房者的税收优惠不等。

items.en: But most people will come away from this book believing it was money well spent.
items.zh: 但大多数读完这本书的人会认为，花在上面的钱是值得的。

items.en: An article in Scientific American has pointed out that empirical research says that, actually, you think you’re more beautiful than you are.
items.zh: 《科学美国人》的一篇文章指出，实证研究表明，实际上，你认为自己比实际更漂亮。

items.en: We have a deep-seated need to feel good about ourselves and we naturally employ a number of self-enhancing strategies to achieve this.
items.zh: 我们内心深处有一种迫切的需求，那就是对自己有良好的感觉，因此我们会自然地采用多种自我提升的策略来实现这一点。

items.en: Social psychologists have amassed oceans of research into what they call the “above average effect”, or “illusory superiority”, and shown that, for example, 70% of us rate ourselves as above average in leadership, 93% in driving and 85% at getting on well with others – all obviously statistical impossibilities.
items.zh: 社会心理学家已经积累了大量关于他们称之为“高于平均水平效应”或“虚假优越感”的研究，并证明例如，70%的人认为自己在领导力方面高于平均水平，93%的人认为自己在驾驶方面高于平均水平，85%的人认为自己在与他人相处方面高于平均水平——显然这些都是统计上的不可能现象。

items.en: We rose-tint our memories and put ourselves into self-affirming situations.
items.zh: 我们会美化自己的记忆，并让自己置身于能够肯定自我的情境中。

items.en: We become defensive when criticised, and apply negative stereotypes to others to boost our own esteem.
items.zh: 当我们受到批评时，会变得防御性很强，并对他人的负面刻板印象进行应用，以提升自己的自尊。

items.en: We stalk around thinking we’re hot stuff.
items.zh: 我们四处走动时，总觉得自己很了不起。

items.en: Housing is seldom mentioned.
items.zh: 住房问题很少被提及。

items.en: To some extent the housing sector must shoulder the blame.
items.zh: 在某种程度上，住房部门必须承担部分责任。

items.en: We have not been good at communicating the real value that housing can contribute to economic growth.
items.zh: 我们并没有很好地传达住房对经济增长所能做出的真实价值。

items.en: Then there is the scale of the typical housing project.
items.zh: 然后还有典型住房项目的规模问题。

items.en: to shove for attention among multibillion-pound infrastructure projects, so it is
items.zh: 要在数亿英镑的基础设施项目中争夺关注，因此它

items.en: inevitable that the attention is focused elsewhere.
items.zh: 不可避免地受到其他方面的关注。

items.en: But perhaps the most significant reason is that the issue has always been so politically charged.
items.zh: 但也许最重要的原因是，这一问题一直具有高度的政治敏感性。

items.en: Nevertheless, the affordable housing situation is desperate.
items.zh: 然而，可负担住房的状况却十分严峻。

items.en: In our rapidly changing economy, we more than ever need people in the workplace who can take initiative and exercise their imagination “to respond to unexpected events”.
items.zh: 在我们快速变化的经济中，我们比以往任何时候都更需要那些能够在工作中主动行动并发挥想象力以应对意外事件的人。

items.en: That is not something machines are good at.
items.zh: 这并不是机器擅长的事情。

items.en: They are designed to perform very predictable activities.
items.zh: 它们被设计用来执行非常可预测的活动。

items.en: As Hagel notes, Brynjolfsson and McAfee indeed touched on this point in their book.
items.zh: 正如哈格尔指出的，布林约尔松和麦卡菲确实在他们的书中触及了这一点。

items.en: We need to reframe race against the machine as race with the machine.
items.zh: 我们需要将与机器的竞赛重新定义为与机器的合作。

items.en: In other words, we need to look at the ways in which machines can augment human labor rather than replace it.
items.zh: 换句话说，我们需要关注机器如何增强人类劳动，而不是取代它。

items.en: So then the problem is not really about technology, but rather, “how do we innovate our institutions and our work practices?
items.zh: 因此，问题并不真正在于技术本身，而在于“我们如何创新我们的制度和工作方式？”，

items.en: When the government talks about infrastructure contributing to the economy the focus is usually on roads, railways, broadband and energy.
items.zh: 当政府谈到基础设施对经济的贡献时，通常关注的是道路、铁路、宽带和能源。

items.en: Waiting lists increase all the time and we are simply not building enough new homes.
items.zh: 等待名单一直在增加，而我们 simply 没有建造足够的新房。

items.en: The comprehensive spending review offers an opportunity for the government to help rectify this.
items.zh: 全面的支出审查为政府提供了一个机会，可以帮助纠正这一问题。

items.en: It needs to put historical prejudices to one side and take some steps to address our urgent housing need.
items.zh: 它需要摒弃历史上的偏见，并采取一些措施来应对我们迫切的住房需求。

items.en: There are some indications that it is preparing to do just that.
items.zh: 有一些迹象表明，它正准备这样做。

items.en: The communities minister, Don Foster, has hinted that George Osborne, Chancellor of the Exchequer, may introduce more flexibility to the current cap on the amount that local authorities can borrow against their housing stock debt.
items.zh: 社区部长唐·福斯特暗示，财政大臣乔治·奥斯本可能会对地方政府以住房存量债务为抵押所能借款的现行上限引入更多灵活性。

items.en: Evidence shows that 60,000 extra new homes could be built over the next five years if the cap were lifted, increasing GDP by 0.6%.
items.zh: 证据表明，如果取消这一上限，未来五年内可以多建造6万套新房，从而使国内生产总值增长0.6%。

items.en: Ministers should also look at creating greater certainty in the rental environment, which would have a significant impact on the ability of registered providers to fund new developments from revenues.
items.zh: 部长们还应该考虑在租赁环境中创造更大的确定性，这将对注册供应商通过收入资助新开发项目的能力产生重大影响。

items.en: But it is not just down to the government.
items.zh: 但这不仅仅取决于政府。

items.en: When there is rapid improvement in the price and performance of technology, jobs that were once thought to be immune from automation suddenly become threatened.
items.zh: 当技术的价格和性能迅速提升时，那些曾经被认为不会受到自动化影响的工作突然变得岌岌可危。

items.en: This argument has attracted a lot of attention, via the success of the book Race Against the Machine, by Erik Brynjolfsson and Andrew McAfee, who both hail from MIT’s Center for Digital Business.
items.zh: 这一论点因埃里克·布里尼奥尔森和安德鲁·麦卡菲合著的《与机器赛跑》一书的成功而受到广泛关注，这两位作者均来自麻省理工学院数字商业中心。

items.en: This is a powerful argument, and a scary one.
items.zh: 这是一个有力且令人不安的论点。

items.en: And yet, John Hagel, author of The Power of Pull and other books, says Brynjolfsson and McAfee miss the reason why these jobs are so vulnerable to technology in the first place.
items.zh: 然而，约翰·哈格尔——《拉力的力量》等书的作者——表示，布里尼奥尔森和麦卡菲忽略了这些工作之所以最初就如此容易受到技术冲击的原因。

items.en: Hagel says we have designed jobs in the u.s. that tend to be “tightly scripted” and “highly standardized” ones that leave no room for “individual initiative or creativity”.
items.zh: 哈格尔说，我们在美国设计的工作往往都是'高度脚本化'和'高度标准化'的，完全没有给'个人主动性或创造力'留下空间。

items.en: In short, these are the types of jobs that machines can perform much better at than human beings.
items.zh: 简而言之，这些是机器比人类做得更好的工作类型。

items.en: That is how we have put a giant target sign on the backs of American workers, Hagel says.
items.zh: 哈格尔说，这就是我们为何在美国家工的背上挂上了巨大的'目标牌'。

items.en: It’s time to reinvent the formula for how work is conducted, since we are still relying on a very 20th century notion of work, Hagel says.
items.zh: 哈格尔表示，现在是时候重新设计工作开展的公式了，因为我们仍在依赖一种非常20世纪的工作观念。

items.en: While these measures would be welcome in the short term, we must face up to the fact that the existing £ 4.5bn programme of grants to fund new affordable housing, set to expire in 2015, is unlikely to be extended beyond then.
items.zh: 尽管这些措施在短期内值得欢迎，但我们必须正视这样一个事实：现有的45亿英镑的拨款计划用于资助新建可负担住房，该计划将于2015年到期，很可能不会延长。

items.en: The Labour party has recently announced that it will retain a large part of the coalition’s spending plans if it returns to power.
items.zh: 工党最近宣布，如果它重新执政，将保留联盟政府大部分的开支计划。

items.en: The housing sector needs to accept that we are very unlikely to ever return to the era of large-scale public grants.
items.zh: 住房行业需要接受这样一个现实：我们几乎不可能再回到大规模公共拨款的时代。

items.en: We need to adjust to this changing climate.
items.zh: 我们需要适应这种变化的环境。

items.en: While the government’s commitment to long-term funding may have changed, the very pressing need for more affordable housing is real and is not going away.
items.zh: 尽管政府对长期资金的承诺可能已经改变，但对更多可负担住房的迫切需求是真实存在的，并不会消失。

items.en: King Juan Carlos of Spain once insisted "kings don't abdicate, they die in their sleep.
items.zh: 西班牙国王胡安·卡洛斯曾坚持说："国王不会退位，他们会在睡梦中去世。"

items.en: But embarrassing scandals and the popularity of the republican left in the recent Euro-elections have forced him to eat his words and stand down.
items.zh: 但令人尴尬的丑闻以及近年来欧洲选举中共和左派的高人气迫使他收回了这番话并辞职下台。

items.en: So, does the Spanish crisis suggest that monarchy is seeing its last days?
items.zh: 那么，西班牙的危机是否意味着君主制正在走向终结？

items.en: At a time when Thomas Piketty and other economists are warning of rising inequality and the increasing power of inherited wealth, it is bizarre that wealthy aristocratic families should still be the symbolic heart of modern democratic states.
items.zh: 在托马斯·皮凯蒂和其他经济学家警告收入不平等加剧以及继承财富力量日益增强的时刻，富有的贵族家庭仍然是现代民主国家象征性核心的事实显得非常奇怪。

items.en: The most successful monarchies strive to abandon or hide their old aristocratic ways.
items.zh: 最成功的君主制努力放弃或隐藏其旧有的贵族传统。

items.en: Princes and princesses have day-jobs and ride bicycles, not horses (or helicopters).
items.zh: 王子和公主们现在都有正经的工作，骑自行车而不是骑马（或直升机）。

items.en: Even so, these are wealthy families who party with the international 1%, and media intrusiveness makes it increasingly difficult to maintain the right image.
items.zh: 即便如此，这些家族仍然是与国际1%群体一起聚会的富裕家庭，而媒体的过度关注使得维持正确的形象变得越来越困难。

items.en: While Europe's monarchies will no doubt be smart enough to survive for some time to come, it is the British royals who have most to fear from the Spanish example.
items.zh: 虽然欧洲的君主制无疑会聪明地生存一段时间，但英国王室从西班牙的例子中受到的威胁最大。

items.en: It is only the Queen who has preserved the monarchy's reputation with her rather ordinary (if well-heeled) granny style.
items.zh: 只有女王以她相对普通的（尽管衣着考究的）祖母风格，成功地维护了王室的声誉。

items.en: The danger will come with Charles, who has both an expensive taste of lifestyle and a pretty hierarchical view of the world.
items.zh: 危险将来自查尔斯，他既有着昂贵的生活方式品味，又有着相当等级森严的世界观。

items.en: He has failed to understand that monarchies have largely survived because they provide a service - as non-controversial and non-political heads of state.
items.zh: 他未能理解君主制之所以大多得以存续，是因为它们提供了一种服务——作为非争议性和非政治性的国家元首。

items.en: Does that mean the writing is on the wall for all European royals, with their magnificent uniforms and majestic lifestyles?
items.zh: 这是否意味着所有欧洲王室，连同他们华丽的制服和宏伟的生活方式，都将面临末日？

items.en: The Spanish case provides arguments both for and against monarchy.
items.zh: 西班牙的情况为君主制提供了正反两方面的论据。

items.en: When public opinion is particularly polarised, as it was following the end of the Franco regime, monarchs can rise above "mere" politics and "embody" a spirit of national unity.
items.zh: 当公众舆论特别两极分化时，比如在佛朗哥政权结束后，君主们可以超越"纯粹"的政治，"体现"国家统一的精神。

items.en: It is this apparent transcendence of politics that explains monarchs' continuing popularity as heads of state.
items.zh: 正是这种看似超越政治的特质，解释了君主们作为国家元首仍持续受欢迎的原因。

items.en: And so, the Middle East excepted, Europe is the most monarch-infested region in the world, with 10 kingdoms (not counting Vatican city and Andorra).
items.zh: 因此，除了中东地区，欧洲是世界上君主制最盛行的地区，拥有10个王国（不包括梵蒂冈城和安道尔）。

items.en: But unlike their absolutist counterparts in the Gulf and Asia, most royal families have survived because they allow voters to avoid the difficult search for a non-controversial but respected public figure.
items.zh: 但与海湾和亚洲那些专制君主不同，大多数王室家族之所以能够幸存下来，是因为他们允许选民避免寻找一位既无争议又受人尊敬的公众人物的困难过程。

items.en: Even so, kings and queens undoubtedly have a downside.
items.zh: 即便如此，国王和王后无疑也有其不利之处。

items.en: Symbolic of national unity as they claim to be, their very history - and sometimes the way they behave today - embodies outdated and indefensible privileges and inequalities.
items.zh: 正如他们所声称的那样，象征着国家统一，但他们的历史——有时甚至是今天的行为——却体现了过时且无法辩护的特权和不平等。

items.en: The court has ruled that police don't violate the Fourth Amendment when they go through the wallet or pocketbook of an arrestee without a warrant.
items.zh: 法院裁定，警察在没有搜查令的情况下检查被捕者的钱包或手提包时，并不违反第四修正案。

items.en: But exploring one's smartphone is more like entering his or her home.
items.zh: 但检查一个人的智能手机则更类似于进入他的家。

items.en: A smartphone may contain an arrestee's reading history, financial history, medical history and comprehensive records of recent correspondence.
items.zh: 智能手机可能包含被捕者的阅读记录、财务记录、医疗记录以及近期通信的综合记录。

items.en: The development of "cloud computing", meanwhile, has made that exploration so much the easier.
items.zh: 与此同时，"云计算"的发展使得这种检查变得更加容易。

items.en: Americans should take steps to protect their digital privacy.
items.zh: 美国人应该采取措施保护自己的数字隐私。

items.en: But keeping sensitive information on these devices is increasingly a requirement of normal life.
items.zh: 但将敏感信息保存在这些设备上，正日益成为正常生活中的一个必要条件。

items.en: Citizens still have a right to expect private documents to remain private and protected by the Constitution's prohibition on unreasonable searches.
items.zh: 公民仍然有权期望私人文件保持私密，并受到宪法禁止不合理搜查条款的保护。

items.en: As so often is the case, stating that principle doesn't ease the challenge of line-drawing.
items.zh: 正如经常发生的情况一样，阐明这一原则并不会减轻划清界限这一挑战的难度。

items.en: Charles ought to know that as English history shows, it is kings, not republicans, who are the monarchy's worst enemies.
items.zh: 查尔斯应该知道，正如英国历史所显示的，是国王们，而不是共和党人，才是君主制的最坏敌人。

items.en: Just how much does the Constitution protect your digital data?
items.zh: 宪法究竟在多大程度上保护你的数字数据？

items.en: The Supreme Court will now consider whether police can search the contents of a mobile phone without a warrant if the phone is on or around a person during an arrest.
items.zh: 最高法院现在将考虑，如果在逮捕过程中，手机在被捕者身上或附近，警方是否可以在没有搜查令的情况下搜索手机内容。

items.en: California has asked the justices to refrain from a sweeping ruling, particularly one that upsets the old assumption that authorities may search through the possessions of suspects at the time of their arrest.
items.zh: 加利福尼亚州已要求法官们避免做出广泛的裁决，尤其是那些颠覆了旧有假设的裁决，即警方在逮捕嫌疑人时可以搜查其随身物品。

items.en: It is hard, the state argues, for judges to assess the implications of new and rapidly changing technologies.
items.zh: 该州认为，法官们很难评估新兴且迅速变化的技术所带来的影响。

items.en: The court would be recklessly modest if it followed California's advice.
items.zh: 如果最高法院采纳加利福尼亚州的建议，那将是极其轻率和谦逊的。

items.en: Enough of the implications are discernable, even obvious, so that the justices can and should provide updated guidelines to police, lawyers and defendants.
items.zh: 即使有足够多的影响是显而易见的，法官们也应当并能够为警方、律师和被告提供更新的指导方针。

items.en: They should start by discarding California's lame argument that exploring the contents of a smartphone - a vast storehouse of digital information - is similar to, say, going through a suspect's purse.
items.zh: 他们应该从摒弃加利福尼亚州提出的拙劣论点开始，即探索智能手机的内容——一个巨大的数字信息存储库——类似于翻查嫌疑人的手提包。

items.en: In many cases, it would not be overly burdensome for authorities to obtain a warrant to search through phone contents.
items.zh: 在许多情况下，执法机关获取搜查手机内容的搜查令并不会带来过重的负担。

items.en: They could still invalidate Fourth Amendment protections when facing severe, urgent circumstances, and they could take reasonable measures to ensure that phone data are not erased or altered while waiting for a warrant.
items.zh: 在面对严重而紧急的情况时，他们仍然可以推翻第四修正案的保护措施，并且在等待搜查令期间，他们可以采取合理措施确保手机数据不会被删除或篡改。

items.en: The court, though, may want to allow room for police to cite situations where they are entitled to more freedom.
items.zh: 然而，法院可能希望为警方留出空间，让他们能够引用那些他们有权享有更多自由的情形。

items.en: But the justices should not swallow California's argument whole.
items.zh: 但法官们不应全盘接受加利福尼亚州的论点。

items.en: New, disruptive technology sometimes demands novel applications of the Constitution's protections.
items.zh: 新的、具有颠覆性的技术有时需要对宪法保护进行新颖的应用。

items.en: Orin Kerr, a law professor, compares the explosion and accessibility of digital information in the 21st century with the establishment of automobile use as a virtual necessity of life in the 20th: The justices had to specify novel rules for the new personal domain of the passenger car then; they must sort out how the Fourth Amendment applies to digital information now.
items.zh: 法律教授奥林·凯尔将21世纪数字信息的爆炸式增长和易于获取性，与20世纪汽车使用成为生活必需品的情况进行了类比：当时法官们不得不为私家车这一新的个人领域制定新的规则；如今，他们也必须厘清第四修正案如何适用于数字信息。

items.en: The journal Science is adding an extra round of statistical checks to its peer-review process, editor-in-chief Marcia McNutt announced today.
items.zh: 《科学》杂志主编玛尔西娅·麦克努特今天宣布，该杂志将在同行评审流程中增加一轮额外的统计检查。
