items.en: The policy follows similar efforts from other journals, after widespread concern that basic mistakes in data analysis are contributing to the irreproducibility of many published research findings.
items.zh: 这一政策是在其他期刊采取类似措施之后推出的，因为人们普遍担忧数据分析中的基本错误正在导致许多已发表的研究成果无法被重复验证。

items.en: Readers must have confidence in the conclusions published in our journal," writes McNutt in an editorial.
items.zh: 读者必须对我们期刊上发表的结论有信心，”麦克纳特在一篇社论中写道。

items.en: Working with the American Statistical Association, the journal has appointed seven experts to a statistics board of reviewing editors (SBoRE).
items.zh: 该期刊与美国统计协会合作，已任命七位专家组成统计审稿编辑委员会（SBoRE）。

items.en: Manuscripts will be flagged up for additional scrutiny by the journal's internal editors, or by its existing Board of Reviewing Editors or by outside peer reviewers.
items.zh: 期刊的内部编辑，或现有的审稿编辑委员会，或外部同行评审人员，将对这些稿件进行额外的审查。

items.en: The SBoRE panel will then find external statisticians to review these manuscripts.
items.zh: SBoRE小组随后将寻找外部统计学家来评审这些稿件。

items.en: Asked whether any particular papers had impelled the change, McNutt said: "The creation of the 'statistics board' was motivated by concerns broadly with the application of statistics and data analysis in scientific research and is part of Science's overall drive to increase reproducibility in the research we publish.
items.zh: 当被问及是否有特定的论文促使了这一变化时，麦克纳特表示："建立‘统计审稿委员会’的动机是广泛地关注统计学和数据分析在科学研究中的应用，并且是《科学》杂志推动我们发表的研究提高可重复性的整体努力的一部分。

items.en: Giovanni Parmigiani, a biostatistician at the Harvard School of Public Health, a member of the SBoRE group, says he expects the board to "play primarily an advisory role.
items.zh: 哈佛大学公共卫生学院的生物统计学家、SBoRE小组成员乔瓦尼·帕尔米吉亚尼表示，他预计该委员会将‘主要发挥顾问作用’。

items.en: He agreed to join because he "found the foresight behind the establishment of the SBoRE to be novel, unique and likely to have a lasting impact.
items.zh: 他同意加入是因为他‘认为SBoRE的建立背后有远见，这种远见是新颖、独特且可能产生持久影响的’。

items.en: This impact will not only be through the publications in Science itself, but hopefully through a larger group of publishing places that may want to model their approach after Science.
items.zh: 这种影响不仅将通过《科学》杂志本身的出版物体现出来，也希望能在更多出版机构中产生影响，这些机构可能会以《科学》为榜样来改进自己的做法。

items.en: But "it's us, human beings, we the people who create the society we want, not profit.
items.zh: 但‘是我们人类，是人民，我们要创造我们想要的社会，而不是为了利润。’

items.en: Driving her point home, she continued: "It's increasingly apparent that the absence of purpose, of a moral language within government, media or business could become one of the most dangerous goals for capitalism and freedom.
items.zh: 为了强调她的观点，她继续说道：‘越来越明显的是，政府、媒体或商业中缺乏目标感和道德语言，可能会成为资本主义和自由最危险的目标之一。’

items.en: This same absence of moral purpose was wounding companies such as News International, she thought, making it more likely that it would lose its way as it had with widespread illegal telephone hacking.
items.zh: 她认为，这种同样缺乏道德目标的情况正在损害像新闻国际这样的公司，使其更容易迷失方向，就像之前因大规模非法电话窃听而发生的那样。

items.en: As the hacking trial concludes - finding guilty one ex-editor of the News of the World, Andy Coulson, for conspiring to hack phones, and finding his predecessor, Rebekah Brooks, innocent of the same charge - the wider issue of dearth of integrity still stands.
items.zh: 随着窃听案审判结束——认定《世界新闻》前编辑安迪·库尔森因密谋窃听电话而有罪，而他的前任蕾贝卡·布鲁克斯则被判定无罪——更广泛的问题，即诚信的缺失，依然存在。

items.en: Journalists are known to have hacked the phones of up to 5,500 people.
items.zh: 记者们被证实曾窃听了多达5500人的电话。

items.en: This is hacking on an industrial scale, as was acknowledged by Glenn Mulcaire, the man hired by the News of the World in 2001 to be the point person for phone hacking.
items.zh: 这属于工业规模的窃听，正如《世界新闻》于2001年聘请的电话窃听负责人格伦·穆尔凯尔所承认的那样。

items.en: Others await trial.
items.zh: 其他人仍在等待审判。

items.en: This long story still unfolds.
items.zh: 这个漫长的事件仍在继续发展。

items.en: John Ioannidis, a physician who studies research methodology, says that the policy is "a most welcome step forward" and "long overdue".
items.zh: 研究方法学家约翰·伊奥尼迪斯（John Ioannidis）表示，这一政策是"一个非常受欢迎的进步"，并且"早就应该实施了"。

items.en: Most journals are weak in statistical review, and this damages the quality of what they publish.
items.zh: 大多数期刊在统计审查方面都很薄弱，这损害了它们所发表内容的质量。

items.en: I think that, for the majority of scientific papers nowadays, statistical review is more essential than expert review," he says, but he noted that biomedical journals such as Annals of Internal Medicine, the Journal of the American Medical Association and The Lancet pay strong attention to statistical review.
items.zh: 他说："我认为，如今大多数科学论文中，统计审查比专家审查更为重要。" 但他指出，像《内科年鉴》（Annals of Internal Medicine）、《美国医学会杂志》（Journal of the American Medical Association）和《柳叶刀》（The Lancet）这样的生物医学期刊非常重视统计审查。

items.en: Professional scientists are expected to know how to analyse data, but statistical errors are alarmingly common in published research, according to David Vaux, a cell biologist.
items.zh: 细胞生物学家大卫·沃克斯（David Vaux）表示，专业科学家应该知道如何分析数据，但根据他的说法，已发表的研究中统计错误却令人震惊地普遍。

items.en: Researchers should improve their standards, he wrote in 2012, but journals should also take a tougher line, "engaging reviewers who are statistically literate and editors who can verify the process".
items.zh: 他在2012年写道，研究人员应该提高他们的标准，但期刊也应该采取更严格的态度，"聘请具有统计学素养的审稿人和能够验证这一过程的编辑"。

items.en: Vaux says that Science's idea to pass some papers to statisticians "has some merit, but a weakness is that it relies on the board of reviewing editors to identify 'the papers that need scrutiny' in the first place".
items.zh: 沃克斯表示，《科学》杂志将一些论文交给统计学家审查的设想"有一定道理，但其弱点在于它依赖于审稿编辑委员会首先识别出"需要审查的论文"。

items.en: Two years ago, Rupert Murdoch's daughter, Elisabeth, spoke of the "unsettling dearth of integrity across so many of our institutions".
items.zh: 两年前，鲁珀特·默多克的女儿伊丽莎白（Elisabeth）谈到"我们许多机构中令人不安的诚信缺失"。

items.en: Integrity had collapsed, she argued, because of a collective acceptance that the only "sorting mechanism" in society should be profit and the market.
items.zh: 她认为，诚信已经崩溃，因为社会普遍接受的唯一"筛选机制"应该是利润和市场。

items.en: In many respects, the dearth of moral purpose frames not only the fact of such widespread phone hacking but the terms on which the trial took place.
items.zh: 在许多方面，道德目标的缺失不仅解释了为何手机窃听现象如此普遍，也决定了此次审判所依据的条件。

items.en: One of the astonishing revelations was how little Rebekah Brooks knew of what went on in her newsroom, how little she thought to ask and the fact that she never inquired how the stories arrived.
items.zh: 令人震惊的披露之一是，丽贝卡·布鲁克斯对她在新闻编辑室发生的事情了解甚少，她几乎没有想过去询问，更没有查问过这些新闻故事是如何获得的。

items.en: The core of her successful defence was that she knew nothing.
items.zh: 她成功辩护的核心在于，她声称对此一无所知。

items.en: In today's world, it has become normal that well-paid executives should not be accountable for what happens in the organisations that they run.
items.zh: 在当今世界，高薪高管对其所管理的组织中发生的事情无需负责，已经成为一种常态。

items.en: Perhaps we should not be so surprised.
items.zh: 也许我们不应该感到如此惊讶。

items.en: For a generation, the collective doctrine has been that the sorting mechanism of society should be profit.
items.zh: 在一代人的时间里，社会的主流观念一直是，社会的筛选机制应当是利润。

items.en: The words that have mattered are efficiency, flexibility, shareholder value, business-friendly, wealth generation, sales, impact and, in newspapers, circulation.
items.zh: 真正重要的词汇是效率、灵活性、股东价值、亲商、财富创造、销售、影响力，以及在报纸行业中，发行量。

items.en: Words degraded to the margin have been justice, fairness, tolerance, proportionality and accountability.
items.zh: 被边缘化的词语则是正义、公平、宽容、适当性和问责制。

items.en: This is why people who work outside the home have better health.
items.zh: 这就是为什么在家外工作的人拥有更好的健康状况的原因。

items.en: What the study doesn’t measure is whether people are still doing work when they’re at home, whether it is household work or work brought home from the office.
items.zh: 这项研究没有测量的是，人们在家中是否仍在工作，无论是家务劳动还是从办公室带回来的工作。

items.en: For many men, the end of the workday is a time to kick back.
items.zh: 对许多男性来说，工作日结束是他们放松休息的时间。

items.en: For women who stay home, they never get to leave the office.
items.zh: 对于那些待在家里的女性来说，她们从未真正离开过办公室。

items.en: And for women who work outside the home, they often are playing catch-up-with-household tasks.
items.zh: 而对于那些在外工作的女性来说，她们常常要追赶家务任务。

items.en: With the blurring of roles, and the fact that the home front lags well behind the workplace in making adjustments for working women, it’s not surprising that women are more stressed at home.
items.zh: 随着角色界限的模糊，以及家庭方面在为职业女性做出调整时远远落后于职场，女性在家中的压力更大也就不足为奇了。

items.en: But it’s not just a gender thing.
items.zh: 但这不仅仅是一个性别问题。

items.en: At work, people pretty much know what they’re supposed to be doing: working, making money, doing the tasks they have to do in order to draw an income.
items.zh: 在工作中，人们基本上知道自己应该做什么：工作、赚钱、完成那些为了获得收入而必须完成的任务。

items.en: The purpose of editing the News of the World was not to promote reader understanding, to be fair in what was written or to betray any common humanity.
items.zh: 编辑《世界新闻》的目的并不是为了促进读者理解、保证所写内容的公正性或违背任何普遍的人性。

items.en: It was to ruin lives in the quest for circulation and impact.
items.zh: 其目的是为了在追求发行量和影响力的过程中毁掉人们的生活。

items.en: Ms Brooks may or may not have had suspicions about how her journalists got their stories, but she asked no questions, gave no instructions - nor received traceable, recorded answers.
items.zh: 布罗克斯女士可能怀疑她的记者是如何获得这些新闻线索的，但她没有提出任何问题，也没有下达任何指示——也没有得到可追溯、可记录的回答。

items.en: A new study suggests that contrary to most surveys, people are actually more stressed at home than at work.
items.zh: 一项新研究指出，与大多数调查结果相反，人们实际上在家中的压力比在工作时更大。

items.en: Researchers measured people’s cortisol, which is a stress marker, while they were at work and while they were at home and found it higher at what is supposed to be a place of refuge.
items.zh: 研究人员在人们工作和在家时测量了他们的皮质醇水平，这是一种压力指标，结果发现在家中的皮质醇水平比在所谓的避风港——工作场所更高。

items.en: Further contradicting conventional wisdom, we found that women as well as men have lower levels of stress at work than at home,” writes one of the researchers, Sarah Damaske.
items.zh: 进一步与传统观念相悖，研究人员写道：‘我们发现，无论是女性还是男性，在工作中的压力水平都比在家中的压力水平低。’研究人员之一莎拉·达马斯基说道。

items.en: In fact women even say they feel better at work, she notes.
items.zh: 事实上，女性甚至表示她们在工作中感觉更好，她指出。

items.en: It is men, not women, who report being happier at home than at work.” Another surprise is that the findings hold true for both those with children and without, but more so for nonparents.
items.zh: 她说，是男性，而非女性，报告称在家中的幸福感比在工作中更高。’另一个令人惊讶的发现是，无论有无孩子，这一研究结果都成立，但对没有孩子的父母来说更为明显。

items.en: The bargain is very pure: Employee puts in hours of physical or mental labor and employee draws out life-sustaining moola.
items.zh: 这个交易非常纯粹：员工付出大量的体力或脑力劳动，员工则从中获取维持生活的金钱。

items.en: On the home front, however, people have no such clarity.
items.zh: 然而，在家庭内部，人们却没有这样的清晰度。

items.en: Rare is the household in which the division of labor is so clinically and methodically laid out.
items.zh: 很少有家庭会如此临床且有条不紊地安排劳动分工。

items.en: There are a lot of tasks to be done, there are inadequate rewards for most of them.
items.zh: 有很多任务需要完成，但其中大部分任务的回报却很有限。

items.en: Your home colleagues – your family – have no clear rewards for their labor; they need to be talked into it, or if they’re teenagers, threatened with complete removal of all electronic devices.
items.zh: 你的家庭成员——你的家人——对他们所付出的劳动并没有明确的回报；你需要说服他们去做，如果他们是青少年，可能还需要以完全没收所有电子设备来威胁他们。

items.en: Plus, they’re your family.
items.zh: 此外，他们是你家人。

items.en: You cannot fire your family.
items.zh: 你不能解雇你的家人。

items.en: You never really get to go home from home.
items.zh: 你永远无法真正从家这个环境中‘下班’回家。

items.en: She started spinning off examples.
items.zh: 她开始不断举出例子。

items.en: If you and I parachuted back to Fortune 500 companies in 1990, we would see much less frequent use of terms like journey, mission, passion.
items.zh: 如果我们和现在一样，回到1990年的财富500强企业，我们会看到像‘旅程’、‘使命’、‘热情’这样的词汇使用频率要低得多。

items.en: There were goals, there were strategies, there were objectives, but we didn’t talk about energy; we didn’t talk about passion.
items.zh: 那时有目标，有战略，有具体任务，但我们不会谈论能量；我们也不会谈论热情。

items.en: Koehn pointed out that this new era of corporate vocabulary is very “team”-oriented – and not by coincidence.
items.zh: 科恩指出，这种新的企业用语时代非常强调‘团队’——这并非偶然。

items.en: Let’s not forget sports – in male-dominated corporate America, it’s still a big deal.
items.zh: 我们不要忘记体育——在男性主导的企业界，它仍然是个大事情。

items.en: It’s not explicitly conscious; it’s the idea that I’m a coach, and you’re my team, and we’re in this together.
items.zh: 这并不是一种明确的自觉意识；这是一种‘我是教练，你是我的团队，我们共同面对这一切’的想法。

items.en: There are lots and lots of CEOs in very different companies, but most think of themselves as coaches and this is their team and they want to win.
items.zh: 有很多来自不同公司的CEO，但大多数人把自己看作教练，认为这是他们的团队，他们想要赢。

items.en: These terms are also intended to infuse work with meaning – and, as Rakesh Khurana, another professor, points out, increase allegiance to the firm.
items.zh: 这些术语也旨在赋予工作以意义——正如另一位教授拉凯什·库拉纳所指出的，还能增强员工对公司的忠诚度。

items.en: So it’s not surprising that people are more stressed at home.
items.zh: 因此，人们在家中的压力更大也就不足为奇了。

items.en: Not only are the tasks apparently infinite, the co-workers are much harder to motivate.
items.zh: 不仅任务看起来是无限的，而且同事也更难激励。

items.en: For years, studies have found that first-generation college students – those who do not have a parent with a college degree – lag other students on a range of education achievement factors.
items.zh: 多年来，研究发现，第一代大学生——即父母中没有大学学历的学生——在一系列教育成就因素上都落后于其他学生。

items.en: Their grades are lower and their dropout rates are higher.
items.zh: 他们的成绩较低，退学率也更高。

items.en: But since such students are most likely to advance economically if they succeed in higher education, colleges and universities have pushed for decades to recruit more of them.
items.zh: 但由于这类学生如果在高等教育中取得成功，最有可能在经济上取得进步，因此大学和学院几十年来一直致力于招收更多这样的学生。

items.en: This has created “a paradox” in that recruiting first-generation students, but then watching many of them fail, means that higher education has “continued to reproduce and widen, rather than close” an achievement gap based on social class, according to the depressing beginning of a paper forthcoming in the journal Psychological Science.
items.zh: 根据即将发表在《心理科学》期刊上的一篇论文令人沮丧的开头，这种做法创造了一个‘悖论’：招收第一代大学生，但随后却看到其中许多人失败，这意味着高等教育‘继续复制并扩大，而非缩小’了基于社会阶层的成就差距。

items.en: But the article is actually quite optimistic, as it outlines a potential solution to this problem, suggesting that an approach (which involves a one-hour, next-to-no-cost program) can close 63 percent of the achievement gap (measured by such factors as grades) between first-generation and other students.
items.zh: 但这篇文章实际上相当乐观，因为它概述了解决这一问题的潜在方案，提出一种方法（涉及一个几乎不花成本的一小时项目）可以缩小第一代大学生与其他学生之间63%的成就差距（以成绩等因素衡量）。

items.en: The authors of the paper are from different universities, and their findings are based on a study involving 147 students (who completed the project) at an unnamed private university.
items.zh: 这篇论文的作者来自不同的大学，他们的研究结果基于一项涉及一所未具名的私立大学中147名完成该项目的学生的研究。

items.en: First generation was defined as not having a parent with a four-year college degree.
items.zh: 第一代学生被定义为父母中没有人拥有四年制大学学位的学生。

items.en: Most of the first-generation students (59.1 percent) were recipients of Pell Grants, a federal grant for undergraduates with financial need, while this was true only for 8.6 percent of the students with at least one parent with a four-year degree.
items.zh: 大多数第一代学生（占59.1%）是佩尔助学金的获得者，这是一种针对经济上有需要的本科生的联邦助学金，而至少有一位父母拥有四年制大学学位的学生中，只有8.6%的人获得了这种助学金。

items.en: Their thesis – that a relatively modest intervention could have a big impact – was based on the view that first-generation students may be most lacking not in potential but in practical knowledge about how to deal with the issues that face most college students.
items.zh: 他们的论文认为，相对适度的干预措施可能会产生重大影响，这一观点基于这样的看法：第一代学生最缺乏的可能不是潜力，而是应对大多数大学生所面临问题的实用知识。

items.en: They cite past research by several authors to show that this is the gap that must be narrowed to close the achievement gap.
items.zh: 他们引用多位作者过去的研究，指出必须缩小这一差距，才能弥合成就差距。

items.en: Many first-generation students “struggle to navigate the middle-class culture of higher education, learn the ‘rules of the game,’ and take advantage of college resources,” they write.
items.zh: 他们写道，许多第一代学生‘难以适应高等教育中的中产阶级文化，学习‘游戏规则’，并充分利用大学资源’。

items.en: And this becomes more of a problem when colleges don’t talk about the class advantages and disadvantages of different groups of students.
items.zh: 当大学不谈论不同学生群体在阶级上的优势和劣势时，这个问题会变得更加严重。

items.en: Because US colleges and universities seldom acknowledge how social class can affect students’ educational experiences, many first-generation students lack insight about why they are struggling and do not understand how students ‘like them’ can improve.
items.zh: 由于美国的大学和学院很少承认社会阶级如何影响学生的教育经历，许多第一代学生缺乏对自己为何挣扎的洞察力，也不了解‘像他们这样’的学生该如何提高。

items.en: Even in traditional offices, “the lingua franca of corporate America has gotten much more emotional and much more right-brained than it was 20 years ago,” said Harvard Business School professor Nancy Koehn.
items.zh: 甚至在传统办公室中，哈佛商学院教授南希·科恩也表示：‘美国企业界的通用语言在20年前已经变得更加情感化和更加依赖右脑思维了。’

items.en: And they were right.
items.zh: 他们是对的。

items.en: For now it appears the economy is creating jobs at a decent pace.
items.zh: 目前看来，经济正在以相当不错的速度创造就业机会。

items.en: We still have a long way to go to get back to full employment, but at least we are now finally moving forward at a faster pace.
items.zh: 我们距离实现充分就业还有很长的路要走，但至少我们现在终于开始以更快的速度向前推进了。

items.en: However, there is another important part of the jobs picture that was largely overlooked.
items.zh: 然而，就业图景中还有另一个重要方面被很大程度地忽视了。

items.en: There was a big jump in the number of people who report voluntarily working part-time.
items.zh: 自愿从事兼职工作的人数出现了大幅增长。

items.en: This figure is now 830,000（4.4 percent）above its year ago level.
items.zh: 这一数字目前比去年同期高出83万人（4.4%）。

items.en: Before explaining the connection to the Obamacare, it is worth making an important distinction.
items.zh: 在解释与奥巴马医改的联系之前，有必要先做出一个重要区分。

items.en: Many people who work part-time jobs actually want full-time jobs.
items.zh: 许多从事兼职工作的人实际上希望获得全职工作。

items.en: You have the importation of terminology that historically used to be associated with non-profit organizations and religious organizations: terms like vision, values, passion, and purpose,” said Khurana.
items.zh: 库尔纳纳说："你们引入了那些历史上与非营利组织和宗教组织相关的术语，比如愿景、价值观、激情和使命。"

items.en: This new focus on personal fulfillment can help keep employees motivated amid increasingly loud debates over work-life balance.
items.zh: 这种对个人实现的新关注可以帮助员工在工作与生活平衡的激烈争论中保持积极性。

items.en: The “mommy wars” of the 1990s are still going on today, prompting arguments about why women still can’t have it all and books like Sheryl Sandberg’s Lean In, whose title has become a buzzword in its own right.
items.zh: 20世纪90年代的"妈妈之战"至今仍在继续，引发了关于为什么女性仍然无法兼顾一切的争论，也催生了像谢丽尔·桑德伯格的《向前一步》这样的书籍，其书名本身已成为一个流行语。

items.en: Terms like unplug, offline, life-hack, bandwidth, and capacity are all about setting boundaries between the office and the home.
items.zh: 像"断开连接"、"离线"、"生活技巧"、"带宽"和"容量"这样的术语，都是在办公室与家庭之间设定界限的表现。

items.en: But if your work is your “passion,” you’ll be more likely to devote yourself to it, even if that means going home for dinner and then working long after the kids are in bed.
items.zh: 但如果你的工作是你所热爱的"激情"，你更有可能全身心投入其中，即使这意味着吃完晚饭回家后，孩子睡觉后你还要继续工作很长时间。

items.en: But this seems to be the irony of office speak: Everyone makes fun of it, but managers love it, companies depend on it, and regular people willingly absorb it.
items.zh: 但办公室术语似乎存在一种讽刺：每个人都嘲笑它，但管理者却喜欢它，公司依赖它，普通人也自愿接受它。

items.en: As a linguist once said, “You can get people to think it’s nonsense at the same time that you buy into it.” In a workplace that’s fundamentally indifferent to your life and its meaning, office speak can help you figure out how you relate to your work – and how your work defines who you are.
items.zh: 正如一位语言学家曾说的："你可以让人们觉得这是胡言乱语，同时你自己却深信不疑。"在一个本质上对你生活及其意义漠不关心的工作环境中，办公室术语可以帮助你弄清楚自己如何与工作相关联，以及你的工作如何定义你是谁。

items.en: Many people talked of the 288,000 new jobs the Labor Department reported for June, along with the drop in the unemployment rate to 6.1 percent, as good news.
items.zh: 许多人谈到劳工部报告的6月份新增288,000个就业岗位，以及失业率降至6.1%的这一数据，认为这是好消息。

items.en: They take part-time work because this is all they can get.
items.zh: 他们从事兼职工作，因为这就是他们能获得的全部工作机会。

items.en: An increase in involuntary part-time work is evidence of weakness in the labor market and it means
items.zh: 非自愿兼职工作的增加是劳动力市场疲软的证据，这意味着

items.en: that many people will be having a very hard time making ends meet.
items.zh: 许多人将面临非常困难的处境，难以维持生计。

items.en: There was an increase in involuntary part-time in June, but the general direction has been down.
items.zh: 六月份非自愿兼职工作有所增加，但总体趋势是下降的。

items.en: Involuntary part-time employment is still far higher than before the recession, but it is down by 640,000 (7.9 percent) from its year ago level.
items.zh: 非自愿兼职就业人数仍远高于经济衰退前的水平，但与去年同期相比减少了64万人（7.9%）。

items.en: We know the difference between voluntary and involuntary part-time employment because people tell us.
items.zh: 我们知道自愿兼职和非自愿兼职之间的区别，因为人们会告诉我们。

items.en: The survey used by the Labor Department asks people if they worked less than 35 hours in the reference week.
items.zh: 劳工部使用的调查会询问人们在参考周内是否工作了少于35个小时。

items.en: If the answer is “yes,” they are classified as working part-time.
items.zh: 如果回答是“是”，那么他们就被归类为兼职工作。

items.en: The survey then asks whether they worked less than 35 hours in that week because they wanted to work less than full time or because they had no choice.
items.zh: 随后，调查询问他们是否在那周工作少于35小时，是因为他们想做兼职工作，还是因为别无选择。

items.en: They are only classified as voluntary part-time workers if they tell the survey taker they chose to work less than 35 hours a week.
items.zh: 只有当他们告诉调查员自己是出于自愿而每周工作少于35小时时，才会被归类为自愿兼职工人。

items.en: The issue of voluntary part-time relates to Obamacare because one of the main purposes was to allow people to get insurance outside of employment.
items.zh: 自愿兼职的问题与奥巴马医改相关，因为奥巴马医改的主要目的之一就是让人们能够通过非就业途径获得医疗保险。

items.en: For many people, especially those with serious health conditions or family members with serious health conditions, before Obamacare the only way to get insurance was through a job that provided health insurance.
items.zh: 对许多人来说，尤其是那些自己或家人有严重健康问题的人，在奥巴马医改之前，获得保险的唯一途径就是通过提供医疗保险的工作。

items.en: However, Obamacare has allowed more than 12 million people to either get insurance through Medicaid or the exchanges.
items.zh: 然而，奥巴马医改已经使超过1200万人能够通过医疗补助计划或医保交易所获得保险。

items.en: These are people who may previously have felt the need to get a full-time job that provided insurance in order to cover themselves and their families.
items.zh: 这些人以前可能觉得有必要找一份提供保险的全职工作，以保障自己和家人的医疗需求。

items.en: With Obamacare there is no longer a link between employment and insurance.
items.zh: 有了奥巴马医改之后，就业与保险之间不再存在必然联系。

items.en: France, which prides itself as the global innovator of fashion, has decided its fashion industry has lost an absolute right to define physical beauty for women.
items.zh: 法国以全球时尚创新者自居，但如今它已决定，其时尚产业不再拥有绝对权利来定义女性的物理美。

items.en: Relying on ethical persuasion rather than law to address the misuse of body ideals may be the best step.
items.zh: 依靠道德劝说而非法律来应对身体理想被滥用的问题可能是最好的一步。

items.en: Even better would be to help elevate notions of beauty beyond the material standards of a particular industry.
items.zh: 更好的做法是帮助提升人们对美的观念，使其超越特定行业的物质标准。

items.en: For the first time in history more people live in towns than in the country.
items.zh: 历史上首次有更多人居住在城镇而非乡村。

items.en: In Britain this has had a curious result.
items.zh: 在英国，这导致了一个奇特的结果。

items.en: While polls show Britons rate "the countryside" alongside the royal family, Shakespeare and the National Health Service (NHS) as what makes them proudest of their country, this has limited political support.
items.zh: 尽管民调显示，英国人将"乡村"与王室、莎士比亚和国家医疗服务体系（NHS）并列，视为让他们最引以为豪的国家象征，但这种观念在政治上却缺乏广泛支持。

items.en: A century ago Octavia Hill launched the National Trust not to rescue stylish houses but to save "the beauty of natural places for everyone forever.
items.zh: 一个世纪前，奥克塔维娅·希尔发起成立国家信托基金，并非为了拯救时尚的房屋，而是为了"永远为所有人保存自然景观的美丽"。

items.en: It was specifically to provide city dwellers with spaces for leisure where they could experience "a refreshing air.
items.zh: 这特别旨在为城市居民提供休闲空间，让他们能够体验到"清新的空气"。

items.en: Hill's pressure later led to the creation of national parks and green belts.
items.zh: 希尔的推动后来促成了国家公园和绿色地带的建立。

items.en: Its lawmakers gave preliminary approval last week to a law that would make it a crime to employ ultra-thin models on runways.
items.zh: 其立法机构上周已对该法律进行了初步批准，该法律将规定在时装秀上雇佣超瘦模特属于犯罪行为。

items.en: The parliament also agreed to ban websites that "incite excessive thinness" by promoting extreme dieting.
items.zh: 议会还同意禁止那些通过宣传极端节食来"煽动过度瘦身"的网站。

items.en: Such measures have a couple of uplifting motives.
items.zh: 此类措施背后有几个积极的动机。

items.en: They suggest beauty should not be defined by looks that end up impinging on health.
items.zh: 它们表明，美不应该被那些最终损害健康的外貌所定义。

items.en: And the ban on ultra-thin models seems to go beyond protecting models from starving themselves to death - as some have done.
items.zh: 而对超瘦模特的禁令似乎不仅仅是为了保护模特免于因节食致死——一些模特确实这样做过。

items.en: It tells the fashion industry that it must take responsibility for the signal it sends women, especially teenage girls, about the social tape-measure they must use to determine their individual worth.
items.zh: 它还向时尚行业传达了一个信息，即它必须为向女性，尤其是青少年女孩传递的关于她们必须用来衡量自身价值的社会标准负责。

items.en: The bans, if fully enforced, would suggest to women (and many men) that they should not let others be arbiters of their beauty.
items.zh: 如果这些禁令得到全面执行，将向女性（以及许多男性）表明，他们不应让他人成为评判自己美貌的标准。

items.en: And perhaps faintly, they hint that people should look to intangible qualities like character and intellect rather than dieting their way to size zero or wasp-waist physiques.
items.zh: 或许还隐含着一个微弱的暗示，即人们应该关注诸如品格和智慧等无形的特质，而不是通过节食来达到零号身材或蜂腰细臀的体型。

items.en: The French measures, however, rely too much on severe punishment to change a culture that still regards beauty as skin-deep - and bone-showing.
items.zh: 然而，法国的措施过于依赖严厉的惩罚，以改变一种仍将美貌视为肤浅、并以显露骨骼为美的文化。

items.en: Under the law, using a fashion model that does not meet a government-defined index of body mass could result in a $85,000 fine and six months in prison.
items.zh: 根据法律，使用不符合政府定义的体重指数的时装模特，可能导致85000美元的罚款和六个月的监禁。

items.en: The fashion industry knows it has an inherent problem in focusing on material adornment and idealized body types.
items.zh: 时装行业知道，它本身存在一个固有问题，即过于关注物质装饰和理想化的身体类型。

items.en: In Denmark, the United States, and a few other countries, it is trying to set voluntary standards for models and fashion images that rely more on peer pressure for enforcement.
items.zh: 在丹麦、美国和其他少数国家，它正在尝试为模特和时装形象制定自愿标准，这些标准更多地依赖同行压力来执行。

items.en: In contrast to France's actions, Denmark's fashion industry agreed last month on rules and sanctions regarding the age, health, and other characteristics of models.
items.zh: 与法国的做法相反，上个月丹麦的时装行业就有关模特年龄、健康状况和其他特征的规则和惩罚措施达成了一致。

items.en: The newly revised Danish Fashion Ethical Charter clearly states: "We are aware of and take responsibility for the impact the fashion industry has on body ideals, especially on young people.
items.zh: 新修订的丹麦时装道德宪章明确指出："我们意识到并承担时装行业对身体理想，尤其是对年轻人所产生的影响。"

items.en: The charter's main tool of enforcement is to deny access for designers and modeling agencies to Copenhagen Fashion Week (CFW), which is run by the Danish Fashion Institute.
items.zh: 宪章的主要执行工具是拒绝设计师和模特经纪公司参加由丹麦时装协会主办的哥本哈根时装周（CFW）。

items.en: But in general it relies on a name-and-shame method of compliance.
items.zh: 但总体而言，它依赖于一种通过曝光和谴责来实现合规的方法。

items.en: They don't make countryside any more, and every year concrete consumes more of it.
items.zh: 他们不再建造乡村了，而且每年混凝土都在吞噬更多的乡村地区。

items.en: It needs constant guardianship.
items.zh: 它需要持续的保护。

items.en: At the next election none of the big parties seem likely to endorse this sentiment.
items.zh: 在下次选举中，似乎没有任何大党会支持这种观点。

items.en: The Conservatives' planning reform explicitly gives rural development priority over conservation, even authorising "off-plan" building where local people might object.
items.zh: 保守党的规划改革明确将农村发展置于环境保护之上，甚至授权在当地人可能反对的地方进行"非规划区"建设。

items.en: The concept of sustainable development has been defined as profitable.
items.zh: 可持续发展的概念已被定义为盈利性。

items.en: Labour likewise wants to discontinue local planning where councils oppose development.
items.zh: 工党同样希望在地方议会反对开发的情况下终止地方规划。

items.en: The Liberal Democrats are silent.
items.zh: 自由民主党则保持沉默。

items.en: Only Ukip, sensing its chance, has sided with those pleading for a more considered approach to using green land.
items.zh: 只有英国独立党（Ukip）察觉到机会，站在那些呼吁更谨慎使用绿地的人一边。

items.en: This is not a free market but a biased one.
items.zh: 这不是一个自由市场，而是一个有偏见的市场。

items.en: Rural towns and villages have grown and will always grow.
items.zh: 乡村城镇和村庄已经发展，并且将一直持续发展。

items.en: They do so best where building sticks to their edges and respects their character.
items.zh: 它们在建筑紧贴边缘并尊重其特色的地方发展得最好。

items.en: We do not ruin urban conservation areas.
items.zh: 我们不会破坏城市保护区域。

items.en: Why ruin rural ones?
items.zh: 为什么要去破坏乡村区域呢？

items.en: Development should be planned, not let rip.
items.zh: 发展应当是有计划的，而不是放任自流。

items.en: After the Netherlands, Britain is Europe's most crowded country.
items.zh: 继荷兰之后，英国是欧洲人口最稠密的国家。

items.en: Half a century of town and country planning has enabled it to retain an enviable rural coherence, while still permitting low-density urban living.
items.zh: 半个世纪的城乡规划使英国得以保持令人羡慕的乡村整体性，同时仍然允许低密度的城市生活。

items.en: Its Campaign to Protect Rural England struck terror into many local Conservative parties.
items.zh: 其保护英格兰乡村的运动使许多地方保守党派感到恐慌。

items.en: The sensible place to build new houses, factories and offices is where people are, in cities and towns where infrastructure is in place.
items.zh: 新建住宅、工厂和办公楼的合理地点应该是有人居住的地方，即基础设施已经完备的城市和城镇。

items.en: The London agents Stirling Ackroyd recently identified enough sites for half a million houses in the London area alone, with no intrusion on green belt.
items.zh: 伦敦的斯特林·阿克罗伊德代理公司最近仅在伦敦地区就确定了足够建设五十万套房屋的地点，且不侵占绿带区域。

items.en: What is true of London is even truer of the provinces.
items.zh: 伦敦的情况在省区更为明显。

items.en: The idea that "housing crisis" equals "concreted meadows" is pure lobby talk.
items.zh: 将"住房危机"等同于"水泥化的草地"的说法纯粹是游说团体的言论。

items.en: The issue is not the need for more houses but, as always, where to put them.
items.zh: 问题不是需要更多的房屋，而是，一如既往的，要把它们建在哪里。

items.en: Under lobby pressure, George Osborne favours rural new-build against urban renovation and renewal.
items.zh: 在游说团体的压力下，乔治·奥斯本倾向于在乡村建设新房，而不是在城市进行翻新和更新。

items.en: He favours out-of-town shopping sites against high streets.
items.zh: 他更倾向于建设城外购物中心，而不是市中心的商业街。

items.en: There is no doubt of the alternative - the corrupted landscapes of southern Portugal, Spain or Ireland.
items.zh: 毫无疑问，这种替代方案就是葡萄牙、西班牙或爱尔兰被破坏的自然景观。

items.en: Avoiding this rather than promoting it should unite the left and right of the political spectrum.
items.zh: 避免这种情况而不是推动它，应该能团结政治光谱的左翼和右翼。

items.en: There is one and only one social responsibility of business," wrote Milton Friedman, a Nobel prize-winning economist, "That is, to use its resources and engage in activities designed to increase its profits.
items.zh: 诺贝尔奖获得者经济学家米尔顿·弗里德曼写道："企业唯一且绝对的社会责任，就是利用其资源并从事旨在增加其利润的活动。"

items.en: But even if you accept Friedman's premise and regard corporate social responsibility (CSR) policies as a waste of shareholders' money, things may not be absolutely clear-cut.
items.zh: 但即使你接受了弗里德曼的前提，并认为企业社会责任（CSR）政策是股东资金的浪费，事情可能也并非绝对明确。

items.en: New research suggests that CSR may create monetary value for companies - at least when they are prosecuted for corruption.
items.zh: 新的研究表明，当企业因腐败行为被起诉时，CSR可能会为公司创造货币价值。

items.en: The largest firms in America and Britain together spend more than $15 billion a year on CSR, according to an estimate by EPG, a consulting firm.
items.zh: 据咨询公司EPG的估计，美国和英国最大的公司每年在CSR上合计支出超过150亿美元。

items.en: This could add value to their businesses in three ways.
items.zh: 这可能通过三种方式为其业务增加价值。

items.en: First, consumers may take CSR spending as a "signal" that a company's products are of high quality.
items.zh: 首先，消费者可能会将CSR支出视为一种"信号"，表明公司的产品具有高质量。

items.en: We estimate that either eliminating a substantial labour-rights concern, such as child labour, or increasing corporate giving by about 20% results in fines that generally are 40% lower than the typical punishment for bribing foreign officials," says one researcher.
items.zh: 一位研究者表示："我们估计，无论是消除一个重大的劳工权利问题（如童工），还是将企业捐赠增加约20%，通常都会导致罚款比贿赂外国官员的典型惩罚低40%。"

items.en: Researchers admit that their study does not answer the question of how much businesses ought to spend on CSR.
items.zh: 研究人员承认，他们的研究并未回答企业应在企业社会责任（CSR）上花费多少的问题。

items.en: Nor does it reveal how much companies are banking on the halo effect, rather than the other possible benefits, when they decide their do-gooding policies.
items.zh: 它也没有揭示当企业决定其行善政策时，究竟有多少公司是依赖光环效应，而不是其他可能的好处。

items.en: But at least they have demonstrated that when companies get into trouble with the law, evidence of good character can win them a less costly punishment.
items.zh: 但至少他们已经证明，当企业陷入法律麻烦时，良好的品行证据可以使他们获得成本更低的惩罚。

items.en: There will eventually come a day when The New York Times ceases to publish stories on newsprint.
items.zh: 最终总会有一天，《纽约时报》将不再用新闻纸印刷新闻故事。

items.en: Exactly when that day will be is a matter of debate.
items.zh: 这一天究竟何时到来，仍存在争议。

items.en: Sometime in the future," the paper's publisher said back in 2010.
items.zh: "总有一天，"该报纸的出版商在2010年时表示，"会在未来某个时候。"

items.en: Nostalgia for ink on paper and the rustle of pages aside, there's plenty of incentive to ditch print.
items.zh: 除了对纸张上的油墨和翻阅纸页时的沙沙声怀有怀旧之情外，放弃印刷版还有很多激励因素。

items.en: Second, customers may be willing to buy a company's products as an indirect way to donate to the good causes it helps.
items.zh: 其次，顾客可能愿意购买一家公司的产品，以此作为一种间接方式，向该公司支持的公益事业捐款。

items.en: And third, through a more diffuse "halo effect," whereby its good deeds earn it greater consideration from consumers and others.
items.zh: 第三，通过更为分散的"光环效应"，即该公司所做的善举使其获得更多消费者和其他人的关注。

items.en: Previous studies on CSR have had trouble differentiating these effects because consumers can be affected by all three.
items.zh: 以往关于企业社会责任（CSR）的研究难以区分这些效应，因为消费者可能同时受到这三种因素的影响。

items.en: A recent study attempts to separate them by looking at bribery prosecutions under America's Foreign Corrupt Practices Act (FCPA).
items.zh: 最近的一项研究试图将它们区分开来，方法是考察美国《反海外腐败法》（FCPA）下的贿赂调查案件。

items.en: It argues that since prosecutors do not consume a company's products as part of their investigations, they could be influenced only by the halo effect.
items.zh: 该研究认为，由于检察官在调查过程中并不消费公司的产品，因此他们可能只受到光环效应的影响。

items.en: The study found that, among prosecuted firms, those with the most comprehensive CSR programmes tended to get more lenient penalties.
items.zh: 研究发现，在被起诉的公司中，那些拥有最全面的企业社会责任项目的公司往往获得更轻的处罚。

items.en: Their analysis ruled out the possibility that it was firms' political influence, rather than their CSR stand, that accounted for the leniency: Companies that contributed more to political campaigns did not receive lower fines.
items.zh: 他们的分析排除了这种可能性：即公司获得宽大处理是因为其政治影响力，而非其企业社会责任立场：在政治竞选中捐款更多的公司并未获得更低的罚款。

items.en: In all, the study concludes that whereas prosecutors should only evaluate a case based on its merits, they do seem to be influenced by a company's record in CSR.
items.zh: 总的来说，该研究得出结论认为，尽管检察官应该仅根据案件本身的实际情况进行评估，但他们似乎确实受到了公司在企业社会责任方面的记录的影响。

items.en: It was seen as a blunder," he said.
items.zh: 他说道："这被视为一个失误。"

items.en: The move turned out to be foresighted.
items.zh: 这一举措最终被证明是远见卓识。

items.en: And if Peretti were in charge at the Times?
items.zh: 如果佩雷蒂负责《时代周刊》呢？

items.en: I wouldn't pick a year to end print," he said.
items.zh: 他说："我不会选择一个年份来终止纸质版。"

items.en: I would raise prices and make it into more of a legacy product.
items.zh: 我会提高价格，把它打造成更具传承价值的产品。

items.en: The most loyal customers would still get the product they favor, the idea goes, and they'd feel like they were helping sustain the quality of something they believe in.
items.zh: 这个想法认为，最忠实的客户仍然会得到他们偏好的产品，并且他们会觉得自己在帮助维持他们所相信的事物的质量。

items.en: So if you're overpaying for print, you could feel like you were helping," Peretti said.
items.zh: 佩雷蒂说："如果你为纸质版支付了过高的价格，你就会觉得自己在帮助支持它。"

items.en: Then increase it at a higher rate each year and essentially try to generate additional revenue.
items.zh: 然后每年以更高的幅度提高价格，从而尝试产生额外的收入。

items.en: The infrastructure required to make a physical newspaper - printing presses, delivery trucks - isn't just expensive; it's excessive at a time when online-only competitors don't have the same set of financial constraints.
items.zh: 制作一份纸质报纸所需的基础设施——印刷机、投递卡车——不仅昂贵；在如今仅在线竞争者没有相同财务约束的情况下，这种投入更是过于庞大了。

items.en: Readers are migrating away from print anyway.
items.zh: 无论如何，读者正在远离纸质版报纸。

items.en: And though print ad sales still dwarf their online and mobile counterparts, revenue from print is still declining.
items.zh: 尽管纸质广告销售仍远超其在线和移动广告销售，但纸质广告的收入仍在下降。

items.en: Overhead may be high and circulation lower, but rushing to eliminate its print edition would be a mistake, says BuzzFeed CEO Jonah Peretti.
items.zh: 尽管运营成本可能很高，发行量也可能较低，但BuzzFeed首席执行官乔纳森·佩雷蒂（Jonah Peretti）表示，匆忙取消纸质版将是错误的决定。

items.en: Peretti says the Times shouldn't waste time getting out of the print business, but only if they go about doing it the right way.
items.zh: 佩雷蒂表示，《纽约时报》不应该浪费时间退出纸质业务，但前提是他们必须以正确的方式来进行。

items.en: Figuring out a way to accelerate that transition would make sense for them," he said, "but if you discontinue it, you're going to have your most loyal customers really upset with you.
items.zh: 他说："找到一种方法来加快这一转型对他们来说是有意义的，但如果你直接取消纸质版，你的最忠实客户会非常不满。"

items.en: Sometimes that's worth making a change anyway.
items.zh: 有时候，即使这样，做出改变也是值得的。

items.en: Peretti gives the example of Netflix discontinuing its DVD-mailing service to focus on streaming.
items.zh: 佩雷蒂举了Netflix取消其DVD邮寄服务以专注于流媒体服务的例子。

items.en: In other words, if you're going to make a print product, make it for the people who are already obsessed with it.
items.zh: 换句话说，如果你要制作印刷品，就为那些已经痴迷于它的受众制作。

items.en: Which may be what the Times is doing already.
items.zh: 这或许就是《纽约时报》已经在做的事情。

items.en: Getting the print edition seven days a week costs nearly $500 a year - more than twice as much as a digital-only subscription.
items.zh: 每周七天获取印刷版的费用每年将近500美元——是仅购买数字版订阅的两倍多。

items.en: It's a really hard thing to do and it's a tremendous luxury that BuzzFeed doesn't have a legacy business," Peretti remarked.
items.zh: Peretti评论道："这真的很难做到，而BuzzFeed没有传统业务这一巨大优势，是一种极大的奢侈。"

items.en: But we're going to have questions like that where we have things we're doing that don't make sense when the market changes and the world changes.
items.zh: 但我们会遇到这样的问题，当市场和世界发生变化时，我们正在做的事情可能就变得没有意义了。

items.en: In those situations, it's better to be more aggressive than less aggressive.
items.zh: 在这些情况下，采取更积极的策略比消极的策略更好。

items.en: It’s true that high-school coding classes aren’t essential for learning computer science in college.
items.zh: 确实，高中阶段的编程课程对于在大学学习计算机科学并不是必不可少的。

items.en: Students without experience can catch up after a few introductory courses, said Tom Cortina, the assistant dean at Carnegie Mellon’s School of Computer Science.
items.zh: 卡内基梅隆大学计算机科学学院的副院长Tom Cortina表示，没有经验的学生在完成几门入门课程后也能赶上。

items.en: For instance, one of the apps the students are developing suggests movies based on your mood.
items.zh: 例如，学生们正在开发的一款应用程序可以根据你的心情推荐电影。

items.en: The students in the Flatiron class probably won’t drop out of high school and build the next Facebook.
items.zh: Flatiron 班的学生很可能不会退学并创建下一个 Facebook。

items.en: Programming languages have a quick turnover, so the “Ruby on Rails” language they learned may not even be relevant by the time they enter the job market.
items.zh: 编程语言更新换代很快，因此他们现在学习的“Ruby on Rails”语言到他们进入职场时可能已经不再相关了。

items.en: But the skills they learn – how to think logically through a problem and organize the results – apply to any coding language, said Deborah Seehorn, an education consultant for the state of North Carolina.
items.zh: 教育顾问 Deborah Seehorn 表示，他们学到的技能——如何通过逻辑思考解决问题并组织结果——适用于任何编程语言。

items.en: Indeed, the Flatiron students might not go into IT at all.
items.zh: 事实上，Flatiron 的学生可能根本不会进入 IT 领域。

items.en: But creating a future army of coders is not the sole purpose of the classes.
items.zh: 但这些课程的唯一目的并不是培养未来的程序员大军。

items.en: These kids are going to be surrounded by computers – in their pockets, in their offices, in their homes – for the rest of their lives.
items.zh: 这些孩子的一生都将被计算机包围——在他们的口袋里、办公室里和家中。

items.en: The younger they learn how computers think, how to coax the machine into producing what they want – the earlier they learn that they have the power to do that – the better.
items.zh: 他们越早学习计算机是如何思考的，如何引导机器生成他们想要的结果——越早意识到他们拥有这种能力——就越有好处。

items.en: However, Cortina said, early exposure is beneficial.
items.zh: 然而，科特纳表示，早期接触计算机科学是有益的。

items.en: When younger kids learn computer science, they learn that it’s not just a confusing, endless string of letters and numbers – but a tool to build apps, or create artwork, or test hypotheses.
items.zh: 当小孩子学习计算机科学时，他们会明白这不仅仅是一串令人困惑、无休止的字母和数字，而是一种用来开发应用程序、创作艺术品或验证假设的工具。

items.en: It’s not as hard for them to transform their thought processes as it is for older students.
items.zh: 对他们来说，转变思维方式并没有 older students 那么困难。

items.en: Breaking down problems into bite-sized chunks and using code to solve them becomes normal.
items.zh: 将问题分解成小块并用代码来解决变得习以为常。

items.en: Giving more children this training could increase the number of people interested in the field and help fill the jobs gap, Cortina said.
items.zh: 科特纳表示，给更多孩子这样的培训可能会增加对该领域感兴趣的人数，并有助于填补就业缺口。

items.en: Students also benefit from learning something about coding before they get to college, where introductory computer-science classes are packed to the brim, which can drive the less-experienced or -determined students away.
items.zh: 学生在进入大学之前如果能先学习一些编程知识，也会受益，因为大学的计算机科学入门课程内容非常密集，可能会让那些经验不足或缺乏决心的学生望而却步。

items.en: The Flatiron School, where people pay to learn programming, started as one of the many coding bootcamps that’s become popular for adults looking for a career change.
items.zh: Flatiron School 是一所人们付费学习编程的学校，它最初是众多为寻求职业转变的成年人而开设的编程速成班之一。

items.en: The high-schoolers get the same curriculum, but “we try to gear lessons toward things they’re interested in,” said Victoria Friedman, an instructor.
items.zh: 高中生接受同样的课程，但‘我们尽量将课程内容与他们的兴趣结合起来’，讲师维多利亚·弗里德曼说道。

items.en: Biologists estimate that as many as 2 million lesser prairie chickens – a kind of bird living on stretching grasslands – once lent red to the often grey landscape of the midwestern and southwestern United States.
items.zh: 生物学家估计，曾经多达200万只的小 prairie 鸡——一种栖息在广阔草原上的鸟类——使美国中西部和西南部地区常常灰暗的景观增添了红色。

items.en: But just some 22,000 birds remain today, occupying about 16% of the species’ historic range.
items.zh: 但如今仅剩下约2.2万只鸟类，占据了该物种历史分布范围的约16%。

items.en: The crash was a major reason the u.s. Fish and Wildlife Service (USFWS) decided to formally list the bird as threatened.
items.zh: 这一数量锐减是美国鱼类和野生动物管理局（USFWS）决定正式将该鸟类列为‘受威胁物种’的主要原因之一。

items.en: The lesser prairie chicken is in a desperate situation,” said USFWS Director Daniel Ashe.
items.zh: ‘小 prairie 鸡正处于绝望的境地，’美国鱼类和野生动物管理局局长丹尼尔·阿什说道。

items.en: Some environmentalists, however, were disappointed.
items.zh: 然而，一些环保人士对此感到失望。

items.en: They had pushed the agency to designate the bird as “endangered,” a status that gives federal officials greater regulatory power to crack down on threats.
items.zh: 他们曾敦促该机构将该鸟类列为‘濒危物种’，这一地位赋予联邦官员更大的监管权力，以打击威胁。

items.en: But Ashe and others argued that the “threatened” tag gave the federal government flexibility to try out new, potentially less confrontational conservation approaches.
items.zh: 但阿什和其他人认为，‘受威胁物种’的标签使联邦政府能够尝试新的、可能更具建设性的保护方法。

items.en: In particular, they called for forging closer collaborations with western state governments, which are often uneasy with federal action, and with the private landowners who control an estimated 95% of the prairie chicken’s habitat.
items.zh: 特别是，他们呼吁与西部州政府建立更紧密的合作关系，这些州政府通常对联邦行动持谨慎态度，并与控制着约95%小 prairie 鸡栖息地的私人土地所有者进行合作。

items.en: Not surprisingly, industry groups and states generally argue it goes too far; environmentalists say it doesn’t go far enough.
items.zh: 毫不意外，行业团体和各州通常认为该措施过于极端；环保主义者则表示该措施还不够彻底。

items.en: The federal government is giving responsibility for managing the bird to the same industries that are pushing it to extinction,” says biologist Jay Lininger.
items.zh: 生物学家杰伊·林杰说：‘联邦政府将管理这种鸟类的责任交给了那些正在将其推向灭绝的行业。’

items.en: That everyone’s too busy these days is a cliché.
items.zh: ‘如今每个人都太忙了’这句话已经成了老生常谈。

items.en: But one specific complaint is made especially mournfully: There’s never any time to read.
items.zh: 但有一个具体的抱怨尤其令人感到悲哀：‘根本没有时间阅读。’

items.en: What makes the problem thornier is that the usual time-management techniques don’t seem sufficient.
items.zh: 使问题更加棘手的是，通常的时间管理技巧似乎并不足够。

items.en: The web’s full of articles offering tips on making time to read: “Give up TV” or “Carry a book with you at all times.” But in my experience, using such methods to free up the odd 30 minutes doesn’t work.
items.zh: 网络上充斥着各种文章，提供如何腾出时间阅读的建议，比如‘放弃看电视’或‘随身携带一本书’。但根据我的经验，用这些方法挤出零星的30分钟并不奏效。

items.en: Sit down to read and the flywheel of work-related thoughts keeps spinning – or else you’re so exhausted that a challenging book’s the last thing you need.
items.zh: 坐下来看书时，与工作相关的想法飞轮仍在不停地转动——或者你实在太疲惫了，这时候读一本有挑战性的书恰恰是你最不需要的。

items.en: The modern mind, Tim Parks, a novelist and critic, writes, “is overwhelmingly inclined toward communication...
items.zh: 小说家兼评论家蒂姆·帕克斯写道：‘现代人的思维 overwhelmingly 倾向于交流……’

items.en: Under the plan, for example, the agency said it would not prosecute landowners or businesses that unintentionally kill, harm, or disturb the bird, as long as they had signed a range-wide management plan to restore prairie chicken habitat.
items.zh: 例如，根据该计划，该机构表示，只要土地所有者或企业签署了覆盖整个栖息地范围的管理计划以恢复草原鸡的栖息地，就不会起诉那些无意中杀死、伤害或干扰该鸟类的人或企业。

items.en: Negotiated by USFWS and the states, the plan requires individuals and businesses that damage habitat as part of their operations to pay into a fund to replace every acre destroyed with 2 new acres of suitable habitat.
items.zh: 该计划由美国鱼类和野生动物管理局（USFWS）与各州协商制定，要求那些在经营过程中损害栖息地的个人和企业，将其纳入一个基金，用以每破坏一英亩土地就恢复两英亩适宜的栖息地。

items.en: The fund will also be used to compensate landowners who set aside habitat.
items.zh: 该基金还将用于补偿那些保留栖息地的土地所有者。

items.en: USFWS also set an interim goal of restoring prairie chicken populations to an annual average of 67,000 birds over the next 10 years.
items.zh: 美国鱼类和野生动物管理局还设定了一个中期目标，即在未来10年内将草原鸡种群数量恢复到每年平均67,000只的水平。

items.en: And it gives the Western Association of Fish and Wildlife Agencies (WAFWA), a coalition of state agencies, the job of monitoring progress.
items.zh: 同时，它还赋予西部鱼类和野生动物管理机构协会（WAFWA），这是一个由各州机构组成的联盟，负责监督进展的职责。

items.en: Overall, the idea is to let “states remain in the driver’s seat for managing the species,” Ashe said.
items.zh: 总体而言，这个想法是让‘各州在管理该物种方面继续掌握主导权’，阿什表示。

items.en: Not everyone buys the win-win rhetoric.
items.zh: 并非所有人都认同这种双赢的说法。

items.en: Some Congress members are trying to block the plan, and at least a dozen industry groups, four states, and three environmental groups are challenging it in federal court.
items.zh: 一些国会议员正试图阻止该计划，至少有十几个行业团体、四个州和三个环保组织正在联邦法院对该计划提出挑战。

items.en: It is not simply that one is interrupted; it is that one is actually inclined to interruption.” Deep reading requires not just time, but a special kind of time which can’t be obtained merely by becoming more efficient.
items.zh: 问题不仅仅在于被打断；而在于人们实际上倾向于被打断。" 深度阅读不仅需要时间，还需要一种特殊的时间，这种时间仅靠提高效率是无法获得的。

items.en: In fact, “becoming more efficient” is part of the problem.
items.zh: 事实上，"提高效率"正是问题的一部分。

items.en: Thinking of time as a resource to be maximised means you approach it instrumentally, judging any given moment as well spent only in so far as it advances progress toward some goal.
items.zh: 将时间视为一种需要最大化的资源，意味着你以工具性的方式对待时间，只有在某个时刻有助于实现某个目标时，才会认为这个时刻是被充分利用的。

items.en: Immersive reading, by contrast, depends on being willing to risk inefficiency, goallessness, even time-wasting.
items.zh: 相比之下，沉浸式阅读则取决于你是否愿意承担效率低下、没有目标，甚至浪费时间的风险。

items.en: Try to slot it in as a to-do list item and you’ll manage only goal-focused reading – useful, sometimes, but not the most fulfilling kind.
items.zh: 试图把它当作待办事项清单中的一项来安排，你只会进行以目标为导向的阅读——这有时是有用的，但并不是最有满足感的那种阅读。

items.en: The future comes at us like empty bottles along an unstoppable and nearly infinite conveyor belt,” writes Gary Eberle in his book Sacred Time, and “we feel a pressure to fill these different-sized bottles (days, hours, minutes) as they pass, for if they get by without being filled, we will have wasted them.” No mind-set could be worse for losing yourself in a book.
items.zh: 加里·埃伯勒在他的著作《神圣的时间》中写道："未来像空瓶子一样朝我们涌来，沿着一条不可阻挡且几乎无限的传送带。" 我们感到有压力，要随着它们经过时将它们填满，因为如果它们经过而未被填满，我们就会觉得浪费了它们。" 没有什么思维模式比这更不利于沉浸在书中。

items.en: So what does work?
items.zh: 那么，什么方法是有效的呢？

items.en: Perhaps surprisingly, scheduling regular times for reading.
items.zh: 或许令人惊讶的是，安排固定的阅读时间。

items.en: You’d think this might fuel the efficiency mind-set, but in fact, Eberle notes, such ritualistic behaviour helps us “step outside time’s flow” into “soul time.” You could limit distractions by reading only physical books, or on single-purpose e-readers.
items.zh: 你可能会认为这会助长效率至上的思维模式，但事实上，埃伯勒指出，这种仪式化的行为能帮助我们‘跳出时间的洪流’，进入‘灵魂时间’。你可以通过只阅读纸质书或使用单一功能的电子阅读器来减少干扰。

items.en: Carry a book with you at all times” can actually work, too – providing you dip in often enough, so that reading becomes the default state from which you temporarily surface to take care of business, before dropping back down.
items.zh: ‘随身携带一本书’其实也有效——只要你经常翻阅，使阅读成为一种默认状态，暂时离开它去处理事务，然后再回到阅读中。

items.en: On a really good day, it no longer feels as if you’re “making time to read,” but just reading, and making time for everything else.
items.zh: 在真正的好日子里，你不再觉得是在‘挤出时间来阅读’，而只是在阅读，同时为其他一切事情腾出时间。

items.en: Against a backdrop of drastic changes in economy and population structure, younger Americans are drawing a new 21st-century road map to success, a latest poll has found.
items.zh: 在经济和人口结构发生剧烈变化的背景下，一项最新调查显示，美国人正在绘制一幅新的21世纪成功之路图。

items.en: Across generational lines, Americans continue to prize many of the same traditional milestones of a successful life, including getting married, having children, owning a home, and retiring in their sixties.
items.zh: 跨越代际，美国人依然重视许多传统意义上的成功人生里程碑，包括结婚、生育子女、拥有自己的住房以及六十岁左右退休。

items.en: But while young and old mostly agree on what constitutes the finish line of a fulfilling life, they offer strikingly different paths for reaching it.
items.zh: 但尽管年轻人和老人都基本认同构成充实人生终点线的要素，他们却提供了截然不同的实现路径。

items.en: Young people who are still getting started in life were more likely than older adults to prioritize personal fulfillment in their work, to believe they will advance their careers most by regularly changing jobs, to favor communities with more public services and a faster pace of life, to agree that couples should be financially secure before getting married or having children, and to maintain that children are best served by two parents working outside the home, the survey found.
items.zh: 调查显示，那些刚开始步入人生的人更倾向于在工作中优先考虑个人成就感，相信通过频繁更换工作最能推动职业发展，更喜欢拥有更多公共服务和快节奏生活的社区，认为夫妻在结婚或生育子女前应实现财务稳定，并且认为孩子在家有两个工作的父母照顾下会受益最大。

items.en: From career to community and family, these contrasts suggest that in the aftermath of the searing Great Recession, those just starting out in life are defining priorities and expectations that will increasingly spread through virtually all aspects of American life, from consumer preferences to housing patterns to politics.
items.zh: 从职业到社区和家庭，这些对比表明，在2008年严重经济衰退的冲击之后，刚刚起步的年轻人正在重新定义优先事项和期望，这些观念将日益渗透到美国生活的方方面面，从消费偏好到住房模式再到政治领域。

items.en: Part of the issue is that airports have only so much room for screening lanes.
items.zh: 问题的一部分在于，机场的安检通道只有有限的空间。

items.en: Another factor may be that more people are trying to overpack their carry-on bags to avoid checked-baggage fees, though the airlines strongly dispute this.
items.zh: 另一个因素可能是，越来越多的人试图在随身行李中装入过多物品，以避免托运行李费用，尽管航空公司对此表示强烈反对。

items.en: There is one step the TSA could take that would not require remodeling airports or rushing to hire: Enroll more people in the PreCheck program.
items.zh: TSA 可以采取的一项措施，无需对机场进行翻新或匆忙招聘人员，就是让更多人加入 PreCheck 项目。

items.en: PreCheck is supposed to be a win-win for travelers and the TSA.
items.zh: PreCheck 本应是旅客和 TSA 的双赢之举。

items.en: Passengers who pass a background check are eligible to use expedited screening lanes.
items.zh: 通过背景审查的乘客有资格使用快速安检通道。

items.en: This allows the TSA to focus on travelers who are higher risk, saving time for everyone involved.
items.zh: 这使得 TSA 能够将注意力集中在风险更高的旅客身上，为所有相关人员节省时间。

items.en: The TSA wants to enroll 25 million people in PreCheck.
items.zh: TSA 希望将 2500 万人纳入 PreCheck 项目。

items.en: It has not gotten anywhere close to that, and one big reason is sticker shock: Passengers must pay $85 every five years to process their background checks.
items.zh: 它离这个目标还差得很远，其中一个主要原因就是价格冲击：乘客必须每五年支付 85 美元来处理他们的背景审查。

items.en: Americans are willing to tolerate time-consuming security procedures in return for increased safety.
items.zh: 美国人愿意忍受耗时的安全检查程序，以换取更高的安全性。

items.en: The crash of EgyptAir Flight 804, which terrorists may have downed over the Mediterranean Sea, provides another tragic reminder of why.
items.zh: 埃及航空804号航班在地中海上空可能被恐怖分子击落的坠机事件，再次提醒人们为何需要这样做。

items.en: But demanding too much of air travelers or providing too little security in return undermines public support for the process.
items.zh: 但是，如果对空中旅客的要求过高，或者提供的安全保障不足，就会削弱公众对这一过程的支持。

items.en: And it should: Wasted time is a drag on Americans' economic and private lives, not to mention infuriating.
items.zh: 这确实应该如此：浪费的时间会拖累美国人的经济和私人生活，更不用说让人恼火了。

items.en: Last year, the Transportation Security Administration (TSA) found in a secret check that undercover investigators were able to sneak weapons - both fake and real - past airport security nearly every time they tried.
items.zh: 去年，美国运输安全管理局（TSA）在一次秘密检查中发现，卧底调查人员几乎每次都能将武器——包括假的和真的——带过机场安检。

items.en: Enhanced security measures since then, combined with a rise in airline travel due to the improving economy and low oil prices, have resulted in long waits at major airports such as Chicago's O'Hare International.
items.zh: 自那以后实施的加强安全措施，加上由于经济改善和油价低迷导致的航空旅行增加，使得像芝加哥奥黑尔国际机场这样的主要机场出现了长时间的排队现象。

items.en: It is not yet clear how much more effective airline security has become - but the lines are obvious.
items.zh: 目前尚不清楚航空安全措施究竟变得更加有效了多少——但排队的长龙是显而易见的。

items.en: Part of the issue is that the government did not anticipate the steep increase in airline travel, so the TSA is now rushing to get new screeners on the line.
items.zh: 其中一部分问题是政府没有预料到航空旅行的大幅增长，因此运输安全管理局现在正仓促地将新的安检人员部署到一线。

items.en: Young and old converge on one key point: Overwhelming majorities of both groups said they believe it is harder for young people today to get started in life than it was for earlier generations.
items.zh: 年轻人和老人都聚焦于一个关键点：这两个群体中绝大多数人都认为，如今的年轻人比早期几代人更难开始自己的生活。

items.en: While younger people are somewhat more optimistic than their elders about the prospects for those starting out today, big majorities in both groups believe those “just getting started in life” face a tougher climb than earlier generations in reaching such signpost achievements as securing a good-paying job, starting a family, managing debt, and finding affordable housing.
items.zh: 虽然年轻人比他们的长辈对当前刚开始生活的人的前景稍微乐观一些，但两个群体中的大多数人认为，如今刚开始生活的人要达到诸如找到高薪工作、组建家庭、管理债务和找到负担得起的住房等标志性成就，所面临的挑战比早期几代人更大。

items.en: Pete Schneider considers the climb tougher today.
items.zh: 皮特·施耐德认为如今的起步更加艰难。

items.en: Schneider, a 27-year-old auto technician from the Chicago suburbs, says he struggled to find a job after graduating from college.
items.zh: 施耐德是一名27岁的汽车技师，来自芝加哥郊区。他说自己大学毕业后很难找到工作。

items.en: Even now that he is working steadily, he said, “I can’t afford to pay my monthly mortgage payments on my own, so I have to rent rooms out to people to make that happen.” Looking back, he is struck that his parents could provide a comfortable life for their children even though neither had completed college when he was young.
items.zh: 即使现在他稳定地工作了，他也表示：'我靠自己无法负担每月的房贷，所以我必须把房间租给别人来实现这一点。' 回顾过去，他感到惊讶的是，他的父母在他年幼时虽然都没有完成大学学业，却仍能为子女提供舒适的生活。

items.en: I still grew up in an upper middle-class home with parents who didn’t have college degrees,” Schneider said.
items.zh: 施耐德说：'我仍然在一个中上阶层的家庭中长大，我的父母都没有大学学位。'

items.en: I don’t think people are capable of that anymore.
items.zh: 我不认为人们现在还能做到这一点。

items.en: First two hours, now three hours - this is how far in advance authorities are recommending people show up to catch a domestic flight, at least at some major u.s. airports with increasingly massive security lines.
items.zh: 最初建议提前两小时到达，现在则建议提前三小时——这是美国一些主要机场的安检队伍越来越长的情况下，当局推荐人们搭乘国内航班时提前到达的时间。

items.en: Since the beginning, this price tag has been PreCheck's fatal flaw.
items.zh: 从一开始，这个价格标签就是PreCheck计划致命的缺陷。

items.en: Upcoming reforms might bring the price to a more reasonable level.
items.zh: 即将进行的改革可能会将价格降至更合理的水平。

items.en: But Congress should look into doing so directly, by helping to finance PreCheck enrollment or to cut costs in other ways.
items.zh: 但国会应该直接介入，通过资助PreCheck报名或以其他方式降低成本来实现。

items.en: The TSA cannot continue diverting resources into underused PreCheck lanes while most of the traveling public suffers in unnecessary lines.
items.zh: TSA不能继续将资源转移到使用率低的PreCheck通道，而让大多数旅客在不必要的队伍中受苦。

items.en: It is long past time to make the program work.
items.zh: 现在早已是时候让这个项目正常运作了。

items.en: The ancient Hawaiians were astronomers," wrote Queen Liliuokalani, Hawaii's last reigning monarch, in 1897.
items.zh: “古代夏威夷人都是天文学家，”夏威夷最后一位在位君主利留卡拉尼女王在1897年写道。

items.en: Star watchers were among the most esteemed members of Hawaiian society.
items.zh: 观星者曾是夏威夷社会最受尊敬的成员之一。

items.en: Sadly, all is not well with astronomy in Hawaii today.
items.zh: 令人遗憾的是，如今夏威夷的天文学发展并不理想。

items.en: Protests have erupted over construction of the Thirty Meter Telescope (TMT), a giant observatory that promises to revolutionize humanity's view of the cosmos.
items.zh: 关于建造三十米望远镜（TMT）的抗议活动已经爆发，这是一座有望彻底改变人类对宇宙视野的巨型天文台。

items.en: At issue is the TMT's planned location on Mauna Kea, a dormant volcano worshiped by some Hawaiians as the piko, that connects the Hawaiian Islands to the heavens.
items.zh: 争议的焦点是TMT计划建在毛纳基山，这座休眠火山被一些夏威夷人视为连接夏威夷群岛与天空的‘piko’（中心点）。

items.en: But Mauna Kea is also home to some of the world's most powerful telescopes.
items.zh: 但毛纳基山也是世界上一些最强大望远镜的所在地。

items.en: Rested in the Pacific Ocean, Mauna Kea's peak rises above the bulk of our planet's dense atmosphere, where conditions allow telescopes to obtain images of unsurpassed clarity.
items.zh: 毛纳基山位于太平洋之上，其山顶耸立在地球稠密大气层的大部分之上，这里的条件使望远镜能够获得无与伦比的清晰图像。

items.en: Opposition to telescopes on Mauna Kea is nothing new.
items.zh: 反对在毛纳基山建造望远镜并非新鲜事。

items.en: A small but vocal group of Hawaiians and environmentalists have long viewed their presence as disrespect for sacred land and a painful reminder of the occupation of what was once a sovereign nation.
items.zh: 一小群但声音响亮的夏威夷人和环保主义者长期以来认为，这些望远镜的存在是对神圣土地的不敬，也是对曾经是一个主权国家的痛苦提醒。

items.en: Some blame for the current controversy belongs to astronomers.
items.zh: 当前争议的部分责任应归咎于天文学家。

items.en: In their eagerness to build bigger telescopes, they forgot that science is not the only way of understanding the world.
items.zh: 他们在急于建造更大望远镜的过程中，忘记了科学并不是理解世界的唯一方式。

items.en: They did not always prioritize the protection of Mauna Kea's fragile ecosystems or its holiness to the island's inhabitants.
items.zh: 他们并不总是优先考虑保护冒纳凯阿的脆弱生态系统，或其对岛上居民的神圣意义。

items.en: Hawaiian culture is not a relic of the past; it is a living culture undergoing a renaissance today.
items.zh: 夏威夷文化并不是过去的遗物；它是一种今天正在经历复兴的活文化。

items.en: Yet science has a cultural history, too, with roots going back to the dawn of civilization.
items.zh: 然而，科学也有自己的文化历史，其根源可以追溯到文明的黎明时期。

items.en: The same curiosity to find what lies beyond the horizon that first brought early Polynesians to Hawaii's shores inspires astronomers today to explore the heavens.
items.zh: 最初促使早期波利尼西亚人来到夏威夷海岸的那种探索地平线彼岸的好奇心，今天依然激励着天文学家探索浩瀚的星空。

items.en: Calls to disassemble all telescopes on Mauna Kea or to ban future development there ignore the reality that astronomy and Hawaiian culture both seek to answer big questions about who we are, where we come from and where we are going.
items.zh: 要求拆除冒纳凯阿山上所有望远镜或禁止在那里进行未来开发的呼声，忽视了一个现实：天文学与夏威夷文化都在试图回答关于我们是谁、从哪里来以及将去往何处这些重大问题。

items.en: Perhaps that is why we explore the starry skies, as if answering a primal calling to know ourselves and our true ancestral homes.
items.zh: 也许这正是我们探索星空的原因，仿佛在回应一种原始的召唤，以了解我们自己和真正的祖先家园。

items.en: The astronomy community is making compromises to change its use of Mauna Kea.
items.zh: 天文学界正在做出妥协，以改变其对冒纳凯阿的使用方式。

items.en: The TMT site was chosen to minimize the telescope's visibility around the island and to avoid archaeological and environmental impact.
items.zh: TMT（三十米望远镜）的选址是为了尽量减少望远镜在岛上的可见性，并避免对考古和环境造成影响。

items.en: To limit the number of telescopes on Mauna Kea, old ones will be removed at the end of their lifetimes and their sites returned to a natural state.
items.zh: 为了限制毛纳基山上的望远镜数量，旧的望远镜在其使用寿命结束时将被拆除，并将其位置恢复为自然状态。

items.en: There is no reason why everyone cannot be welcomed on Mauna Kea to embrace their cultural heritage and to study the stars.
items.zh: 没有理由不让所有人都能登上毛纳基山，去拥抱他们的文化传统，去研究繁星。

items.en: Kennedy once said that a country's GDP measures "everything except that which makes life worthwhile.
items.zh: 肯尼迪曾说过，一个国家的国内生产总值（GDP）衡量的是"一切除了使生活有价值的东西"。

items.en: With Britain voting to leave the European Union, and GDP already predicted to slow as a result, it is now a timely moment to assess what he was referring to.
items.zh: 随着英国投票决定脱离欧洲联盟，且国内生产总值（GDP）已经预测会因此放缓，现在正是评估他所指内容的恰当时机。

items.en: The question of GDP and its usefulness has annoyed policymakers for over half a century.
items.zh: 关于GDP及其效用的问题，已经让政策制定者困扰了半个世纪以上。

items.en: Many argue that it is a flawed concept.
items.zh: 许多人认为，GDP是一个存在缺陷的概念。

items.en: It measures things that do not matter and misses things that do.
items.zh: 它衡量了不重要的东西，却忽略了真正重要的东西。

items.en: By most recent measures, the UK's GDP has been the envy of the Western world, with record low unemployment and high growth figures.
items.zh: 根据最新的数据，英国的GDP一直是西方世界的羡慕对象，失业率创历史新低，经济增长数据也十分亮眼。

items.en: If everything was going so well, then why did over 17 million people vote for Brexit, despite the warnings about what it could do to their country's economic prospects?
items.zh: 如果一切发展得如此顺利，那么为什么仍有超过1700万人投票支持脱欧，尽管有警告称这可能会对他们的国家经济前景造成影响？

items.en: A recent annual study of countries and their ability to convert growth into well-being sheds some light on that question.
items.zh: 最近一项对各国将其经济增长转化为福祉能力的年度研究，为这个问题提供了一些启示。

items.en: Across the 163 countries measured, the UK is one of the poorest performers in ensuring that economic growth is translated into meaningful improvements for its citizens.
items.zh: 在被评估的163个国家中，英国在确保经济增长转化为对公民有意义的改善方面，是表现最差的国家之一。

items.en: Rather than just focusing on GDP, over 40 different sets of criteria from health, education and civil society engagement have been measured to get a more rounded assessment of how countries are performing.
items.zh: 除了关注GDP之外，还测量了包括健康、教育和公民社会参与在内的40多个不同指标集，以更全面地评估各国的表现。

items.en: While all of these countries face their own challenges, there are a number of consistent themes.
items.zh: 尽管所有这些国家都面临各自的问题，但有一些共同的主题值得关注。

items.en: Yes, there has been a budding economic recovery since the 2008 global crash, but in key indicators in areas such as health and education, major economies have continued to decline.
items.zh: 是的，自2008年全球金融危机以来，确实出现了经济复苏的迹象，但在健康和教育等关键领域的指标上，主要经济体却持续下滑。

items.en: Yet this isn't the case with all countries.
items.zh: 然而，并非所有国家都是这种情况。

items.en: Some relatively poor European countries have seen huge improvements across measures including civil society, income equality and the environment.
items.zh: 一些相对贫穷的欧洲国家在包括公民社会、收入平等和环境在内的多个指标上都取得了显著改善。

items.en: Officials must not be allowed to play favorites in providing information or in arranging meetings simply because an individual or group provides a campaign donation or a personal gift.
items.zh: 官员在提供信息或安排会议时，不得因某个人或团体提供了竞选捐款或个人礼物而偏袒 favorites。

items.en: This type of integrity requires well-enforced laws in government transparency, such as records of official meetings, rules on lobbying, and information about each elected leader's source of wealth.
items.zh: 这种 integrity 需要严格执行的政府 transparency 法律，例如官方会议记录、游说规则，以及每位当选领导人财富来源的信息。

items.en: Favoritism in official access can fan public perceptions of corruption.
items.zh: 在官方 access 中的偏袒可能助长公众对腐败的 perception。

items.en: But it is not always corruption.
items.zh: 但这并不总是腐败。

items.en: Rather officials must avoid double standards, or different types of access for average people and the wealthy.
items.zh: 相反，官员必须避免双重标准，即对普通人和富人提供不同类型的 access。

items.en: If connections can be bought, a basic premise of democratic society - that all are equal in treatment by government - is undermined.
items.zh: 如果关系可以被购买，那么民主社会的基本前提——政府在对待所有人时应平等——就会被削弱。

items.en: Good governance rests on an understanding of the inherent worth of each individual.
items.zh: 良好的 governance 建立在对每个人内在价值的理解之上。

items.en: The court's ruling is a step forward in the struggle against both corruption and official favoritism.
items.zh: 法院的裁决是在反对腐败和官方偏袒的斗争中迈出的一步。

items.en: Merely helping a gift-giver gain access to other officials, unless done with clear intent to pressure those officials, is not corruption, the justices found.
items.zh: 法官们发现，仅仅帮助赠礼者接触到其他官员，除非明显意图对这些官员施加压力，否则不构成腐败。

items.en: The court did suggest that accepting favors in return for opening doors is "distasteful" and "nasty.
items.zh: 法院还指出，以换取接触机会而接受好处是"令人不快"且"肮脏"的行为。

items.en: But under anti-bribery laws, proof must be made of concrete benefits, such as approval of a contract or regulation.
items.zh: 但在反贿赂法律下，必须证明存在具体利益，例如批准合同或规章。

items.en: Simply arranging a meeting, making a phone call, or hosting an event is not an "official act".
items.zh: 仅仅安排会议、打个电话或举办活动，并不构成"官方行为"。

items.en: The court's ruling is legally sound in defining a kind of favoritism that is not criminal.
items.zh: 法院在界定一种不构成刑事犯罪的偏袒行为时，其裁决在法律上是站得住脚的。

items.en: Elected leaders must be allowed to help supporters deal with bureaucratic problems without fear of prosecution for bribery.
items.zh: 当选领导人必须被允许帮助支持者处理官僚问题，而无需担心因贿赂而被起诉。

items.en: The basic compact underlying representative government," wrote Chief Justice John Roberts for the court, "assumes that public officials will hear from their constituents and act on their concerns.
items.zh: 最高法院首席大法官约翰·罗伯茨在裁定书中写道："代议制政府的基本契约假定，公职人员会听取选民的意见，并根据他们的关切采取行动。"

items.en: But the ruling reinforces the need for citizens and their elected representatives, not the courts, to ensure equality of access to government.
items.zh: 但这一裁决强调了公民及其当选代表，而非法院，需要确保公众平等接触政府的机会。

items.en: This is a lesson that rich countries can learn: When GDP is no longer regarded as the sole measure of a country's success, the world looks very different.
items.zh: 这是一个富裕国家可以学习的教训：当国内生产总值（GDP）不再被视为衡量一个国家成功与否的唯一标准时，世界将显得截然不同。

items.en: So, what Kennedy was referring to was that while GDP has been the most common method for measuring the economic activity of nations, as a measure, it is no longer enough.
items.zh: 因此，肯尼迪所指的是，尽管GDP一直是衡量国家经济活动最常用的方法，但作为衡量标准，它已经不再足够了。

items.en: It does not include important factors such as environmental quality or education outcomes - all things that contribute to a person's sense of well-being.
items.zh: 它没有包括诸如环境质量或教育成果等重要因素——所有这些因素都关系到一个人的幸福感。

items.en: The sharp hit to growth predicted around the world and in the UK could lead to a decline in the everyday services we depend on for our well-being and for growth.
items.zh: 全球范围内以及英国预计将遭受的经济增长锐减，可能导致我们日常依赖以维持幸福感和促进增长的服务出现下滑。

items.en: But policymakers who refocus efforts on improving well-being rather than simply worrying about GDP figures could avoid the forecasted doom and may even see progress.
items.zh: 但如果政策制定者将努力重点重新放在改善幸福感上，而不是仅仅关注GDP数据，他们或许可以避免预测中的灾难，甚至可能看到进步。

items.en: In a rare unanimous ruling, the US Supreme Court has overturned the corruption conviction of a former Virginia governor, Robert McDonnell.
items.zh: 在罕见的一致裁决中，美国最高法院推翻了前弗吉尼亚州州长罗伯特·麦克唐奈（Robert McDonnell）的腐败定罪。

items.en: But it did so while holding its nose at the ethics of his conduct, which included accepting gifts such as a Rolex watch and a Ferrari automobile from a company seeking access to government.
items.zh: 但法院在做出这一决定时，对他的行为道德表示了不满，其中包括接受一家寻求政府接触机会的公司赠送的劳力士手表和法拉利汽车等礼物。

items.en: The high court's decision said the judge in mr. McDonnell's trial failed to tell a jury that it must look only at his "official acts," or the former governor's decisions on "specific" and "unsettled" issues related to his duties.
items.zh: 最高法院的裁决指出，麦克唐奈先生审判中的法官未能告知陪审团，他们只能关注他的"官方行为"，即前州长在与其职责相关的"具体"和"未决"问题上的决策。

items.en: Every Saturday morning, at 9 am, more than 50,000 runners set off to run 5km around their local park.
items.zh: 每个星期六上午9点，超过5万名跑者都会出发，在他们当地的公园周围跑5公里。

items.en: The Parkrun phenomenon began with a dozen friends and has inspired 400 events in the UK and more abroad.
items.zh: Parkrun现象始于一群朋友，并已激励了英国400场活动，海外也有更多类似的活动。

items.en: Events are free, staffed by thousands of volunteers.
items.zh: 这些活动是免费的，由数千名志愿者负责组织。

items.en: Runners range from four years old to grandparents; their times range from Andrew Baddeley’s world record 13 minutes 48 seconds up to an hour.
items.zh: 跑者年龄从四岁到祖父母辈不等；他们的用时从安德鲁·巴德利的世界纪录13分48秒到一个小时不等。

items.en: Parkrun is succeeding where London’s Olympic “legacy” is failing.
items.zh: Parkrun正在成功之处，正是伦敦奥运会‘遗产’失败的地方。

items.en: Ten years ago on Monday, it was announced that the Games of the 30th Olympiad would be in London.
items.zh: 十年前的周一，宣布第30届奥运会将在伦敦举行。

items.en: Planning documents pledged that the great legacy of the Games would be to lever a nation of sport lovers away from their couches.
items.zh: 规划文件承诺，奥运会留下的伟大遗产是激发全国体育爱好者远离沙发，积极参与运动。

items.en: The population would be fitter, healthier and produce more winners.
items.zh: 人们将变得更健康、更健壮，并产生更多的冠军。

items.en: It has not happened.
items.zh: 这并没有发生。

items.en: The number of adults doing weekly sport did rise, by nearly 2 million in the run-up to 2012 – but the general population was growing faster.
items.zh: 在2012年之前，每周进行体育运动的成年人数量确实有所上升，增加了近200万人——但总体人口增长得更快。

items.en: Worse, the numbers are now falling at an accelerating rate.
items.zh: 更糟糕的是，这一数字现在正以越来越快的速度下降。

items.en: The opposition claims primary school pupils doing at least two hours of sport a week have nearly halved.
items.zh: 反对派声称，每周进行至少两小时体育运动的小学生人数几乎减少了一半。

items.en: Obesity has risen among adults and children.
items.zh: 成年人和儿童的肥胖率都上升了。

items.en: Official retrospections continue as to why London 2012 failed to “inspire a generation.” The success of Parkrun offers answers.
items.zh: 官方仍在回顾伦敦2012为何未能实现“激励一代人”的目标。Parkrun的成功提供了答案。

items.en: Parkun is not a race but a time trial: Your only competitor is the clock.
items.zh: Parkrun不是一个比赛，而是一个计时赛：你唯一的对手就是时钟。

items.en: The ethos welcomes anybody.
items.zh: 这种理念欢迎任何人。

items.en: There is as much joy over a puffed-out first-timer being clapped over the line as there is about top talent shining.
items.zh: 对于首次参赛者气喘吁吁地冲过终点线而受到掌声欢呼，与顶尖人才大放异彩所带来的喜悦一样多。

items.en: The Olympic bidders, by contrast, wanted to get more people doing sport and to produce more elite athletes.
items.zh: 相比之下，申办奥运会的各方则希望让更多人参与体育运动，并培养出更多优秀的运动员。

items.en: The dual aim was mixed up: The stress on success over taking part was intimidating for newcomers.
items.zh: 这一双重目标被混淆了：过分强调成功而非参与，让新手感到望而生畏。

items.en: Indeed, there is something a little absurd in the state getting involved in the planning of such a fundamentally “grassroots” concept as community sports associations.
items.zh: 事实上，政府介入社区体育协会这样本质上属于‘基层’的概念的规划，多少有些荒谬。

items.en: If there is a role for government, it should really be getting involved in providing common goods – making sure there is space for playing fields and the money to pave tennis and netball courts, and encouraging the provision of all these activities in schools.
items.zh: 如果政府有其角色，那它真正应该做的是提供公共产品——确保有场地用于运动，有资金铺设网球和篮网球场，并鼓励在学校中开展所有这些活动。

items.en: But successive governments have presided over selling green spaces, squeezing money from local authorities and declining attention on sport in education.
items.zh: 然而，历届政府却一直在任期内推动出售绿地、从地方政府榨取资金，并且在教育中对体育的关注度不断下降。

items.en: Instead of wordy, worthy strategies, future governments need to do more to provide the conditions for sport to thrive.
items.zh: 未来的政府不应再制定冗长而空洞的战略，而应更多地为体育的发展创造有利条件。

items.en: Or at least not make them worse.
items.zh: 至少，不要让情况变得更糟。

items.en: With so much focus on children’s use of screens, it’s easy for parents to forget about their own screen use.
items.zh: 在如此关注儿童使用屏幕的情况下，父母很容易忘记自己也在使用屏幕。

items.en: Tech is designed to really suck you in,” says Jenny Radesky in her study of digital play, “and digital products are there to promote maximal engagement.
items.zh: 在她关于数字游戏的研究中，Jenny Radesky说："科技的设计就是要真正吸引你，数字产品旨在促进最大程度的参与。"

items.en: It makes it hard to disengage, and leads to a lot of bleed-over into the family routine.
items.zh: 这使得人们难以脱离科技产品，导致大量时间渗透到家庭日常生活中。

items.en: Radesky has studied the use of mobile phones and tablets at mealtimes by giving mother-child pairs a food-testing exercise.
items.zh: Radesky通过给母子配对进行食物测试练习，研究了用餐时间使用手机和平板电脑的情况。

items.en: She found that mothers who used devices during the exercise started 20 per cent fewer verbal and 39 per cent fewer nonverbal interactions with their children.
items.zh: 她发现，在练习过程中使用设备的母亲与孩子进行的口头交流减少了20%，非语言交流减少了39%。

items.en: During a separate observation, she saw that phones became a source of tension in the family.
items.zh: 在另一次观察中，她看到手机成为了家庭中紧张的来源。

items.en: Parents would be looking at their emails while the children would be making excited bids for their attention.
items.zh: 父母在查看电子邮件时，孩子们则兴奋地试图吸引他们的注意。

items.en: Infants are wired to look at parents’ faces to try to understand their world, and if those faces are blank and unresponsive – as they often are when absorbed in a device – it can be extremely disconcerting for the children.
items.zh: 婴儿天生就会注视父母的脸，以试图理解他们的世界，而如果这些脸是空白且无反应的——就像他们专注于设备时常常那样——对孩子来说会非常令人困惑。

items.en: Radesky cites the “still face experiment” devised by developmental psychologist Ed Tronick in the 1970s.
items.zh: 拉德斯基引用了发展心理学家埃德·特罗尼克在20世纪70年代设计的“静止面孔实验”。

items.en: In it, a mother is asked to interact with her child in a normal way before putting on a blank expression and not giving them any visual social feedback: The child becomes increasingly distressed as she tries to capture her mother’s attention.
items.zh: 在这个实验中，母亲首先被要求以正常的方式与孩子互动，然后戴上一副空白的表情，不再给予任何视觉上的社交反馈：孩子会越来越焦虑，因为她试图吸引母亲的注意。

items.en: Parents don’t have to be exquisitely present at all times, but there needs to be a balance and parents need to be responsive and sensitive to a child’s verbal or nonverbal expressions of an emotional need,” says Radesky.
items.zh: 拉德斯基说：‘父母并不需要时时刻刻都极度专注，但需要保持一种平衡，同时要对孩子表达情绪需求时的言语或非言语信号做出回应和敏感的反应。’

items.en: On the other hand, Tronick himself is concerned that the worries about kids’ use of screens are born out of an “oppressive ideology that demands that parents should always be interacting” with their children: “It’s based on a somewhat fantasised, very white, very upper-middle-class ideology that says if you’re failing to expose your child to 30,000 words you are neglecting them.” Tronick believes that just because a child isn’t learning from the screen doesn’t mean there’s no value to it – particularly if it gives parents time to have a shower, do housework or simply have a break from their child.
items.zh: 另一方面，特罗尼克本人则担心，对孩子使用屏幕的担忧源于一种‘压迫性的意识形态，要求父母必须始终与孩子互动’：‘这种观念基于一种相当幻想化的、非常白人化、非常中上层阶级的意识形态，认为如果你没有让你的孩子接触到30,000个单词，就等于忽视了他们。’ 特罗尼克认为，仅仅因为孩子没有从屏幕上学到东西，并不意味着屏幕就没有价值——特别是如果它能给父母一些时间去洗澡、做家务或只是暂时从孩子身边解脱一下。

items.en: Parents, he says, can get a lot out of using their devices to speak to a friend or get some work out of the way.
items.zh: 他说，父母可以通过使用自己的设备与朋友交谈或处理一些工作，获得很多好处。

items.en: This can make them feel happier, which lets them be more available to their child the rest of the time.
items.zh: 这会让他们感觉更快乐，从而在其余时间里更愿意陪伴孩子。

items.en: Today, widespread social pressure to immediately go to college in conjunction with increasingly high expectations in a fast-moving world often causes students to completely overlook the possibility of taking a gap year.
items.zh: 如今，广泛的社会压力要求学生必须立刻上大学，再加上快节奏世界中日益提高的期望，常常使学生完全忽视了休学一年的可能性。

items.en: After all, if everyone you know is going to college in the fall, it seems silly to stay back a year, doesn’t it?
items.zh: 毕竟，如果你认识的人都要在秋季上大学，那么待一年再入学似乎很傻，不是吗？

items.en: In 2015, the US Forest Service for the first time spent more than half of its $5.5 billion annual budget fighting fires – nearly double the percentage it spent on such efforts 20 years ago.
items.zh: 2015年，美国林业局首次将其每年55亿美元的预算中超过一半用于扑灭山火——这一比例几乎是20年前的两倍。

items.en: In effect, fewer federal funds today are going towards the agency’s other work – such as forest conservation, watershed and cultural resources management, and infrastructure upkeep – that affect the lives of all Americans.
items.zh: 实际上，如今更少的联邦资金被用于该机构的其他工作——例如森林保护、水源地和文化资源管理以及基础设施维护——这些工作影响着所有美国人的生活。

items.en: Another nationwide concern is whether public funds from other agencies are going into construction in fire-prone districts.
items.zh: 另一个全国性关注的问题是，其他机构的公共资金是否被用于在易发生火灾的地区进行建设。

items.en: As Moritz puts it, how often are federal dollars building homes that are likely to be lost to a wildfire?
items.zh: 正如莫里茨所说，联邦资金有多少次是用于建造那些很可能在野火中被毁掉的房屋？

items.en: It’s already a huge problem from a public expenditure perspective for the whole country,” he says.
items.zh: 他说，从全国公共支出的角度来看，这已经是一个巨大的问题。

items.en: We need to take a magnifying glass to that.
items.zh: 我们需要用放大镜仔细审视这一点。

items.en: Like, ‘Wait a minute, is this OK?’ Do we want instead to redirect those funds to concentrate on lower-hazard parts of the landscape?
items.zh: 比如，‘等一下，这样真的没问题吗？’我们是否应该将这些资金重新导向，集中用于那些火灾风险较低的地区？

items.en: Such a view would require a corresponding shift in the way US society today views fire, researchers say.
items.zh: 研究人员表示，这种观点将需要美国社会在看待火灾方式上相应的转变。

items.en: If you’re not convinced of the inherent value in taking a year off to explore interests, then consider its financial impact on future academic choices.
items.zh: 如果你还没有认识到休学一年去探索兴趣的内在价值，那么请考虑它对未来学术选择的经济影响。

items.en: According to the National Center for Education Statistics, nearly 80 percent of college students end up changing their majors at least once.
items.zh: 根据美国国家教育统计中心的数据，近80%的大学生至少换过一次专业。

items.en: This isn’t surprising, considering the basic mandatory high school curriculum leaves students with a poor understanding of the vast academic possibilities that await them in college.
items.zh: 这并不令人意外，考虑到基础必修的高中课程让学生对大学中等待他们的广阔学术可能性缺乏了解。

items.en: Many students find themselves listing one major on their college applications, but switching to another after taking college classes.
items.zh: 许多学生在大学申请时列出一个专业，但在上过大学课程后又转到另一个专业。

items.en: It’s not necessarily a bad thing, but depending on the school, it can be costly to make up credits after switching too late in the game.
items.zh: 这并不一定是坏事，但根据学校的不同，如果在太晚的时候才换专业，补足学分可能会产生高昂的费用。

items.en: At Boston College, for example, you would have to complete an extra year were you to switch to the nursing school from another department.
items.zh: 例如，在波士顿学院，如果你从其他院系转到护理学院，就需要多完成一年的学习。

items.en: Taking a gap year to figure things out initially can help prevent stress and save money later on.
items.zh: 最初休学一年来理清思路，可以帮助学生避免压力并节省以后的开支。

items.en: Though often viewed as a problem for western states, the growing frequency of wildfires is a national concern because of its impact on federal tax dollars, says Professor Max Moritz, a specialist in fire ecology and management.
items.zh: 火生态学与管理专家、教授Max Moritz表示，尽管野火频发常被视为西部州的问题，但由于其对联邦税收资金的影响，这一现象正在成为全国性的关注问题。

items.en: For one thing, conversations about wildfires need to be more inclusive.
items.zh: 首先，关于野火的讨论需要更加包容。

items.en: Over the past decade, the focus has been on climate change – how the warming of the Earth from greenhouse gases is leading to conditions that worsen fires.
items.zh: 在过去十年中，关注的焦点一直是气候变化——地球因温室气体变暖所导致的条件如何加剧火灾。
