items.en: While climate is a key element, Moritz says, it shouldn’t come at the expense of the rest of the equation.
items.zh: 虽然气候是一个关键因素，莫里茨表示，但它不应以牺牲方程中的其他要素为代价。

items.en: The human systems and the landscapes we live on are linked, and the interactions go both ways,” he says.
items.zh: 他说：‘我们所处的人类系统与景观是相互关联的，这种互动是双向的。’

items.en: Failing to recognize that, he notes, leads to “an overly simplified view of what the solutions might be.
items.zh: 他指出，未能认识到这一点，会导致‘对可能解决方案的过于简化的看法’。

items.en: Our perception of the problem and of what the solution is becomes very limited.
items.zh: 我们的对问题和解决方案的认识将变得非常有限。

items.en: At the same time, people continue to treat fire as an event that needs to be wholly controlled and unleashed only out of necessity, says Professor Balch at the University of Colorado.
items.zh: 同时，科罗拉多大学的巴奇教授指出，人们仍然将野火视为一种需要完全控制、只有在必要时才释放的事件。

items.en: But acknowledging fire’s inevitable presence in human life is an attitude crucial to developing the laws, policies, and practices that make it as safe as possible, she says.
items.zh: 她说：‘承认野火在人类生活中不可避免的存在，是制定使其尽可能安全的法律、政策和实践的关键态度。’

items.en: We’ve disconnected ourselves from living with fire,” Balch says.
items.zh: 巴尔奇说："我们已经与火共处的生活方式断开了联系。"

items.en: It is really important to understand and try and tease out what is the human connection with fire today.
items.zh: 今天，理解并试图厘清人类与火之间的关系真的非常重要。

items.en: Among the annoying challenges facing the middle class is one that will probably go unmentioned in the next presidential campaign: What happens when the robots come for their jobs?
items.zh: 中产阶级面临的一个令人烦恼的挑战，很可能在下一次总统竞选中被忽视：当机器人抢走他们的工作时会发生什么？

items.en: Don't dismiss that possibility entirely.
items.zh: 不要完全忽视这种可能性。

items.en: About half of u.s. jobs are at high risk of being automated, according to a University of Oxford study, with the middle class disproportionately squeezed.
items.zh: 根据牛津大学的一项研究，大约一半的美国工作都有可能被自动化取代，而中产阶级则会受到不成比例的影响。

items.en: Lower-income jobs like gardening or day care don't appeal to robots.
items.zh: 像园艺或托儿这样的低收入工作对机器人来说并不具有吸引力。

items.en: But many middle-class occupations - trucking, financial advice, software engineering - have aroused their interest, or soon will.
items.zh: 但许多中产阶级的职业——如货运、财务建议、软件工程——已经引起了机器人的兴趣，或者很快就会引起它们的兴趣。

items.en: The rich own the robots, so they will be fine.
items.zh: 富人拥有机器人，所以他们不会有事。

items.en: This isn't to be alarmist.
items.zh: 这并不是危言耸听。

items.en: Optimists point out that technological upheaval has benefited workers in the past.
items.zh: 乐观主义者指出，过去的技术变革曾使工人受益。

items.en: The Industrial Revolution didn't go so well for Luddites whose jobs were displaced by mechanized looms, but it eventually raised living standards and created more jobs than it destroyed.
items.zh: 工业革命对卢德派分子来说并不顺利，因为他们的工作被机械化织布机取代了，但最终它提高了生活水平，并创造了比摧毁更多的工作。

items.en: Likewise, automation should eventually boost productivity, stimulate demand by driving down prices, and free workers from hard, boring work.
items.zh: 同样，自动化最终应该会提高生产率，通过压低价格刺激需求，并使工人摆脱繁重而无聊的工作。

items.en: But in the medium term, middle-class workers may need a lot of help adjusting.
items.zh: 但在中期内，中产阶级工人可能需要大量的帮助来适应变化。

items.en: The first step, as Erik Brynjolfsson and Andrew McAfee argue in The Second Machine Age, should be rethinking education and job training.
items.zh: 正如埃里克·布林约尔松和安德鲁·麦卡菲在《第二次机器时代》中所主张的，第一步应该是重新思考教育和职业培训。

items.en: Curriculums - from grammar school to college - should evolve to focus less on memorizing facts and more on creativity and complex communication.
items.zh: 课程设置——从语法学校到大学——应该演变，减少对记忆事实的重视，而更加注重创造力和复杂沟通能力。

items.en: Vocational schools should do a better job of fostering problem-solving skills and helping students work alongside robots.
items.zh: 职业学校应该更好地培养解决问题的技能，并帮助学生与机器人协同工作。

items.en: Online education can supplement the traditional kind.
items.zh: 在线教育可以补充传统的教育形式。

items.en: It could make extra training and instruction affordable.
items.zh: 它可以让额外的培训和教学变得负担得起。

items.en: Professionals trying to acquire new skills will be able to do so without going into debt.
items.zh: 那些试图获取新技能的专业人士将能够在不陷入债务的情况下实现这一点。

items.en: The challenge of coping with automation underlines the need for the u.s. to revive its fading business dynamism: Starting new companies must be made easier.
items.zh: 应对自动化带来的挑战凸显了美国需要重振其逐渐衰退的商业活力：必须让创办新公司变得更加容易。

items.en: In previous eras of drastic technological change, entrepreneurs smoothed the transition by dreaming up ways to combine labor and machines.
items.zh: 在以前技术发生剧烈变革的时代，企业家通过设想将劳动力和机器结合的方法，缓解了转型过程中的冲击。

items.en: The best uses of 3D printers and virtual reality haven't been invented yet.
items.zh: 3D打印机和虚拟现实的最佳用途尚未被发明出来。

items.en: The u.s. needs the new companies that will invent them.
items.zh: 美国需要那些能够发明这些用途的新公司。

items.en: Finally, because automation threatens to widen the gap between capital income and labor income, taxes and the safety net will have to be rethought.
items.zh: 最后，由于自动化可能加剧资本收入与劳动收入之间的差距，税收和社会保障体系将不得不重新考虑。

items.en: Taxes on low-wage labor need to be cut, and wage subsidies such as the earned income tax credit should be expanded: This would boost incomes, encourage work, reward companies for job creation, and reduce inequality.
items.zh: 对低工资劳动力的税收需要削减，同时应扩大诸如已赚收入税抵免之类的工资补贴：这将提高收入，鼓励就业，奖励企业创造就业岗位，并减少不平等现象。

items.en: Technology will improve society in ways big and small over the next few years, yet this will be little comfort to those who find their lives and careers upended by automation.
items.zh: 在未来几年里，技术将以大大小小的方式改善社会，但对那些因自动化而生活和事业被颠覆的人来说，这几乎无法带来安慰。

items.en: Destroying the machines that are coming for our jobs would be nuts.
items.zh: 摧毁即将取代我们工作的机器是愚蠢的。

items.en: But policies to help workers adapt will be indispensable.
items.zh: 但帮助工人适应的政策将是不可或缺的。

items.en: A new survey by Harvard University finds more than two-thirds of young Americans disapprove of President Trump's use of Twitter.
items.zh: 哈佛大学的一项新调查显示，超过三分之二的美国年轻人不赞成特朗普总统使用推特的方式。

items.en: The implication is that Millennials prefer news from the White House to be filtered through other sources, not a president's social media platform.
items.zh: 这意味着千禧一代更倾向于通过其他渠道获取白宫的新闻，而不是总统的社交媒体平台。

items.en: Most Americans rely on social media to check daily headlines.
items.zh: 大多数美国人依靠社交媒体来查看每日新闻标题。

items.en: Yet as distrust has risen toward all media, people may be starting to beef up their media literacy skills.
items.zh: 然而，随着对所有媒体的不信任感上升，人们可能开始加强自身的媒体素养技能。

items.en: Such a trend is badly needed.
items.zh: 这种趋势非常必要。

items.en: During the 2016 presidential campaign, nearly a quarter of web content shared by Twitter users in the politically critical state of Michigan was fake news, according to the University of Oxford.
items.zh: 根据牛津大学的研究，在2016年总统竞选期间，密歇根州这一政治关键州的推特用户分享的网络内容中，近四分之一是假新闻。

items.en: And a survey conducted for BuzzFeed News found 44 percent of Facebook users rarely or never trust news from the media giant.
items.zh: 而一项为BuzzFeed新闻进行的调查显示，44%的Facebook用户很少或从不信任这家媒体巨头发布的新闻。

items.en: Young people who are digital natives are indeed becoming more skillful at separating fact from fiction in cyberspace.
items.zh: 作为数字原住民的年轻一代，确实在网络空间中越来越擅长区分事实与虚构。

items.en: A Knight Foundation focus-group survey of young people between ages 14 and 24 found they use "distributed trust" to verify stories.
items.zh: 骑士基金会对14至24岁年轻人进行的小组访谈调查显示，他们使用"分散信任"的方式来验证新闻的真实性。

items.en: They cross-check sources and prefer news from different perspectives - especially those that are open about any bias.
items.zh: 他们会交叉核对消息来源，并倾向于从不同角度获取新闻，尤其是那些坦率承认自身偏见的新闻来源。

items.en: Many young people assume a great deal of personal responsibility for educating themselves and actively seeking out opposing viewpoints," the survey concluded.
items.zh: 该调查得出结论称，许多年轻人认为自己在教育自己方面承担了很大的个人责任，并积极寻找对立的观点。

items.en: Such active research can have another effect.
items.zh: 这种主动的调查行为还可能产生另一种影响。

items.en: A 2014 survey conducted in Australia, Britain, and the United States by the University of Wisconsin-Madison found that young people's reliance on social media led to greater political engagement.
items.zh: 2014年，威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校在澳大利亚、英国和美国进行的一项调查显示，年轻人对社交媒体的依赖导致了更大的政治参与度。

items.en: Social media allows users to experience news events more intimately and immediately while also permitting them to re-share news as a projection of their values and interests.
items.zh: 社交媒体让用户能够更亲密、更即时地体验新闻事件，同时也允许他们重新分享新闻，以展示自己的价值观和兴趣。

items.en: This forces users to be more conscious of their role in passing along information.
items.zh: 这迫使用户更加意识到自己在传播信息中的角色。

items.en: A survey by Barna research group found the top reason given by Americans for the fake news phenomenon is "reader error," more so than made-up stories or factual mistakes in reporting.
items.zh: 巴纳研究小组的一项调查显示，美国人对假新闻现象的首要原因是"读者错误"，比编造的故事或报道中的事实错误更为普遍。

items.en: About a third say the problem of fake news lies in "misinterpretation or exaggeration of actual news" via social media.
items.zh: 大约三分之一的人表示，假新闻的问题在于通过社交媒体对真实新闻的"误解或夸大"。

items.en: In other words, the choice to share news on social media may be the heart of the issue.
items.zh: 换句话说，是否在社交媒体上分享新闻可能是问题的核心。

items.en: This indicates there is a real personal responsibility in counteracting this problem," says Roxanne Stone, editor in chief at Barna Group.
items.zh: "这表明在应对这一问题上，确实存在真正的个人责任，"巴纳集团的主编罗克珊·斯通说。

items.en: So when young people are critical of an over-tweeting president, they reveal a mental discipline in thinking skills - and in their choices on when to share on social media.
items.zh: 因此，当年轻人对频繁推文的总统提出批评时，他们展示了在思维能力方面的一种心理自律——以及在何时通过社交媒体分享上的选择能力。

items.en: Any fair-minded assessment of the dangers of the deal between Britain's National Health Service (NHS) and DeepMind must start by acknowledging that both sides mean well.
items.zh: 任何对英国国家医疗服务体系（NHS）与DeepMind之间协议潜在风险的公正评估，都必须首先承认双方都是出于好意。

items.en: DeepMind is one of the leading artificial intelligence (AI) companies in the world.
items.zh: DeepMind 是全球领先的人工智能（AI）公司之一。

items.en: The potential of this work applied to healthcare is very great, but it could also lead to further concentration of power in the tech giants.
items.zh: 将这项工作应用于医疗保健领域具有巨大潜力，但也可能导致科技巨头进一步集中权力。

items.en: It is against that background that the information commissioner, Elizabeth Denham, has issued her damning verdict against the Royal Free hospital trust under the NHS, which handed over to DeepMind the records of 1.6 million patients in 2015 on the basis of a vague agreement which took far too little account of the patients' rights and their expectations of privacy.
items.zh: 正是在这样的背景下，信息专员伊丽莎白·登纳姆（Elizabeth Denham）对 NHS 下属的皇家自由医院信托机构发布了严厉的裁决，该机构于 2015 年基于一份过于笼统的协议，将 160 万患者的记录交给了 DeepMind，而该协议对患者的权益及其隐私预期考虑得远远不够。

items.en: DeepMind has almost apologized.
items.zh: DeepMind 已经几乎道歉了。

items.en: The NHS trust has mended its ways.
items.zh: NHS 信托机构也已改正了错误做法。

items.en: Further arrangements - and there may be many - between the NHS and DeepMind will be carefully scrutinised to ensure that all necessary permissions have been asked of patients and all unnecessary data has been cleaned.
items.zh: NHS 与 DeepMind 之间的进一步协议——可能还有许多——将受到仔细审查，以确保已向患者征求了所有必要的许可，并清理了所有不必要的数据。

items.en: There are lessons about informed patient consent to learn.
items.zh: 关于知情患者同意方面还有许多需要学习的教训。

items.en: But privacy is not the only angle in this case and not even the most important.
items.zh: 但在这个案例中，隐私并不是唯一的角度，甚至也不是最重要的角度。

items.en: Ms Denham chose to concentrate the blame on the NHS trust, since under existing law it "controlled" the data and DeepMind merely "processed" it.
items.zh: Denham女士选择将责任集中于NHS信托机构，因为根据现行法律，它是数据的"控制者"，而DeepMind仅仅是数据的"处理者"。

items.en: But this distinction misses the point that it is processing and aggregation, not the mere possession of bits, that gives the data value.
items.zh: 但这种区分忽略了关键点，即数据的价值来自于处理和汇总，而非仅仅是拥有这些数据片段。

items.en: The great question is who should benefit from the analysis of all the data that our lives now generate.
items.zh: 最大的问题是，现在我们生活中产生的所有数据的分析，应该让谁受益。

items.en: Privacy law builds on the concept of damage to an individual from identifiable knowledge about them.
items.zh: 隐私法建立在个人因可被识别的信息而受到损害这一概念之上。

items.en: That misses the way the surveillance economy works.
items.zh: 但这忽略了监控经济的运作方式。

items.en: The data of an individual there gains its value only when it is compared with the data of countless millions more.
items.zh: 在监控经济中，个人数据的价值只有在与数以亿计的其他人的数据进行比较时才能体现出来。

items.en: The use of privacy law to curb the tech giants in this instance feels slightly maladapted.
items.zh: 在这种情况下，用隐私法来制约科技巨头似乎有些不太恰当。

items.en: And after going to school for 12 years, it doesn’t feel natural to spend a year doing something that isn’t academic.
items.zh: 在经历了12年的学校教育之后，花一年时间去做一些非学术的事情感觉不太自然。

items.en: But while this may be true, it’s not a good enough reason to condemn gap years.
items.zh: 但尽管这可能是真的，却不足以成为谴责间隔年的原因。

items.en: There’s always a constant fear of falling behind everyone else on the socially perpetuated “race to the finish line,” whether that be toward graduate school, medical school or a lucrative career.
items.zh: 在社会不断推动的‘冲刺终点线’竞赛中，人们始终存在着落后于他人的恐惧，无论这个终点是研究生院、医学院还是高薪职业。

items.en: But despite common misconceptions, a gap year does not hinder the success of academic pursuits – in fact, it probably enhances it.
items.zh: 但尽管存在一些常见的误解，间隔年并不会阻碍学术追求的成功——事实上，它可能还会增强这种成功。

items.en: Studies from the United States and Australia show that students who take a gap year are generally better prepared for and perform better in college than those who do not.
items.zh: 来自美国和澳大利亚的研究表明，休学一年的学生通常比没有休学的学生在大学里准备得更充分，表现也更好。

items.en: Rather than pulling students back, a gap year pushes them ahead by preparing them for independence, new responsibilities and environmental changes
items.zh: 间隔年并不是让学生退步，而是通过让他们为独立、新的责任和环境变化做好准备，从而推动他们前进。

items.en: – all things that first-year students often struggle with the most.
items.zh: – 一年级学生最初常常最难以应对的各种问题。

items.en: Gap year experiences can lessen the blow when it comes to adjusting to college and being thrown into a brand new environment, making it easier to focus on academics and activities rather than acclimation blunders.
items.zh: 间隔年经历有助于减轻适应大学和进入全新环境时的冲击，使人更容易专注于学业和活动，而不是适应过程中的失误。

items.en: This practice does not address the real worry.
items.zh: 这种做法并没有解决真正的担忧。

items.en: It is not enough to say that the algorithms DeepMind develops will benefit patients and save lives.
items.zh: 仅仅说DeepMind开发的算法将造福患者并挽救生命是不够的。

items.en: What matters is that they will belong to a private monopoly which developed them using public resources.
items.zh: 重要的是，这些算法将属于一个私人垄断企业，而该企业正是利用公共资源开发了它们。

items.en: If software promises to save lives on the scale that drugs now can, big data may be expected to behave as a big pharma has done.
items.zh: 如果软件能够像现在的药物一样大规模挽救生命，那么大数据可能会被期待像大型制药公司那样行事。

items.en: We are still at the beginning of this revolution and small choices now may turn out to have gigantic consequences later.
items.zh: 我们仍处于这场革命的初期，现在做出的小选择将来可能会产生巨大的影响。

items.en: A long struggle will be needed to avoid a future of digital feudalism.
items.zh: 为了避免未来出现数字封建主义，需要进行一场长期的斗争。

items.en: Ms Denham's report is a welcome start.
items.zh: Denham女士的报告是一个受欢迎的开端。

items.en: The u.s. Postal Service (USPS) continues to bleed red ink.
items.zh: 美国邮政服务（USPS）继续亏损。

items.en: It is not, however, a sign that they're getting serious about transforming the postal system for the 21st century.
items.zh: 然而，这并不是一个迹象，表明他们正认真致力于为21世纪改造邮政系统。

items.en: It is curious that Stephen Koziatek feels almost as though he has to justify his efforts to give his students a better future.
items.zh: 奇怪的是，史蒂芬·科扎泰克几乎感觉他必须为努力给学生更好的未来进行辩解。

items.en: mr. Koziatek is part of something pioneering.
items.zh: 科扎泰克先生是某个开创性项目的一部分。

items.en: He is a teacher at a New Hampshire high school where learning is not something of books and tests and mechanical memorization, but practical.
items.zh: 他是新罕布什尔州一所高中的教师，那里的学习不是书本、考试和机械记忆的事情，而是实践性的。

items.en: When did it become accepted wisdom that students should be able to name the 13th president of the United States but be utterly overwhelmed by a broken bike chain?
items.zh: 什么时候起，让学生能够说出美国第13任总统的名字，却对一个断裂的自行车链条感到完全不知所措，成了被普遍接受的智慧？

items.en: As Koziatek knows, there is learning in just about everything.
items.zh: 正如科扎泰克所知，在几乎所有事情中都有学习的内容。

items.en: Nothing is necessarily gained by forcing students to learn geometry at a graffitied desk stuck with generations of discarded chewing gum.
items.zh: 强迫学生在满是涂鸦和几代人丢弃的口香糖的课桌上学习几何，未必能带来任何好处。

items.en: They can also learn geometry by assembling a bicycle.
items.zh: 他们也可以通过组装自行车来学习几何。

items.en: But he’s also found a kind of insidious prejudice.
items.zh: 但他也发现了一种隐秘的偏见。

items.en: Working with your hands is seen as almost a mark of inferiority.
items.zh: 动手工作被视为几乎是一种低人一等的标志。

items.en: Schools in the family of vocational education “have that stereotype...that it’s for kids who can’t make it academically,” he says.
items.zh: 他说，职业教育体系中的学校‘有那种刻板印象……认为这是为那些在学术上无法成功的孩子准备的’。

items.en: On one hand, that viewpoint is a logical product of America’s evolution.
items.zh: 一方面，这种观点是美国发展历程中的一种合乎逻辑的产物。

items.en: Manufacturing is not the economic engine that it once was.
items.zh: 制造业已不再是曾经的经济引擎。

items.en: The job security that the US economy once offered to high school graduates has largely evaporated.
items.zh: 美国经济曾经为高中毕业生提供的就业保障已基本消失。

items.en: More education is the new principle.
items.zh: 更多的教育成为新的信条。

items.en: We want more for our kids, and rightfully so.
items.zh: 我们希望孩子们能拥有更多，这无可厚非。

items.en: Most of the money would come from a penny-per-letter permanent rate increase and from shifting postal retirees into Medicare.
items.zh: 大部分资金将来自每封信件增加一美分的永久性费率上调，以及将邮政退休人员纳入医疗保险体系。

items.en: The latter step would largely offset the financial burden of annually pre-funding retiree health care, thus addressing a long-standing complaint by the USPS and its unions.
items.zh: 后一步措施将在很大程度上抵消每年提前为退休人员医疗保健筹资所带来的财政负担，从而解决美国邮政服务（USPS）及其工会长期以来的抱怨。

items.en: If it clears the House, this measure would still have to get through the Senate - where someone is bound to point out that it amounts to the bare, bare minimum necessary to keep the Postal Service afloat, not comprehensive reform.
items.zh: 如果该法案在众议院通过，仍需在参议院获得批准——在那里，肯定有人会指出，这仅仅是为了维持邮政服务正常运转所必需的最低限度措施，而非全面改革。

items.en: There's no change to collective bargaining at the USPS, a major omission considering that personnel accounts for 80 percent of the agency's costs.
items.zh: 该法案没有涉及美国邮政服务的集体谈判，这在很大程度上是一个遗漏，因为人员成本占该机构总成本的80%。

items.en: Also missing is any discussion of eliminating Saturday letter delivery.
items.zh: 此外，法案中也没有讨论取消周六信件投递的问题。

items.en: That common-sense change enjoys wide public support and would save the USPS $2 billion per year.
items.zh: 这一常识性的改变得到了公众的广泛支持，每年可为美国邮政服务节省20亿美元。

items.en: But postal special-interest groups seem to have killed it, at least in the House.
items.zh: 但邮政特殊利益集团似乎已经将其扼杀，至少在众议院是这样。

items.en: The emerging consensus around the bill is a sign that legislators are getting frightened about a politically embarrassing short-term collapse at the USPS.
items.zh: 该法案逐渐形成的共识表明，立法者们对美国邮政服务短期内出现政治上尴尬的崩溃感到担忧。

items.en: It reported a net loss of $5.6 billion for fiscal 2016, the 10th straight year its expenses have exceeded revenue.
items.zh: 它报告称2016财年净亏损56亿美元，这是其费用连续第十年超过收入的年份。

items.en: Meanwhile, it has more than $120 billion in unfunded liabilities, mostly for employee health and retirement costs.
items.zh: 同时，它还有超过1200亿美元的未偿负债务，主要来自员工的医疗和退休成本。

items.en: There are many reasons this formerly stable federal institution finds itself at the brink of bankruptcy.
items.zh: 有许多原因导致这个曾经稳定的联邦机构如今濒临破产边缘。

items.en: Fundamentally, the USPS is in a historic squeeze between technological change that has permanently decreased demand for its bread-and-butter product, first-class mail, and a regulatory structure that denies management the flexibility to adjust its operations to the new reality.
items.zh: 从根本上说，美国邮政服务局正处于历史性的困境之中，一方面是技术变革永久性地减少了其核心产品——一等邮件的需求，另一方面是监管结构剥夺了管理层根据新现实调整运营的灵活性。

items.en: And interest groups ranging from postal unions to greeting-card makers exert self-interested pressure on the USPS's ultimate overseer - Congress - insisting that whatever else happens to the Postal Service, aspects of the status quo they depend on get protected.
items.zh: 从邮政工会到贺卡制造商的各种利益集团，都对美国邮政服务局的最终监管者——国会——施加着出于自身利益的压力，坚持要求无论邮政服务发生什么变化，他们所依赖的现状某些方面必须得到保护。

items.en: This is why repeated attempts at reform legislation have failed in recent years, leaving the Postal Service unable to pay its bills except by deferring vital modernization.
items.zh: 这就是为什么近年来多次改革立法尝试都失败了，导致邮政服务只能通过推迟关键的现代化进程来支付账单。

items.en: Now comes word that everyone involved - Democrats, Republicans, the Postal Service, the unions and the system's heaviest users - has finally agreed on a plan to fix the system.
items.zh: 现在有消息称，所有相关方——民主党人、共和党人、邮政服务局、工会以及该系统的最大用户——终于达成了一项修复该系统的计划。

items.en: Legislation is moving through the House that would save USPS an estimated $28.6 billion over five years, which could help pay for new vehicles, among other survival measures.
items.zh: 一项正在众议院推进的立法预计将在五年内为美国邮政服务局节省286亿美元，这有助于支付新车辆等其他生存措施的费用。

items.en: When education becomes one-size-fits-all, it risks overlooking a nation’s diversity of gifts.
items.zh: 当教育变成一刀切的模式时，它可能会忽视一个国家在天赋上的多样性。

items.en: While fossil fuels – coal, oil, gas – still generate roughly 85 percent of the world’s energy supply, it’s clearer than ever that the future belongs to renewable sources such as wind and solar.
items.zh: 尽管化石燃料——煤炭、石油、天然气——仍然为全球约85%的能源供应提供动力，但越来越明显的是，未来属于可再生能源，如风能和太阳能。

items.en: The move to renewables is picking up momentum around the world: They now account for more than half of new power sources going on line.
items.zh: 向可再生能源的转型正在全球范围内加速：目前它们已占新投入使用的电力来源的一半以上。

items.en: Some growth stems from a commitment by governments and farsighted businesses to fund cleaner energy sources.
items.zh: 一些增长来自于政府和有远见的企业承诺资助更清洁的能源来源。

items.en: But increasingly the story is about the plummeting prices of renewables, especially wind and solar.
items.zh: 但越来越多的情况是关于可再生能源价格的大幅下降，尤其是风能和太阳能。

items.en: The cost of solar panels has dropped by 80 percent and the cost of wind turbines by close to one-third in the past eight years.
items.zh: 在过去八年中，太阳能板的成本下降了80%，风力涡轮机的成本下降了近三分之一。

items.en: In many parts of the world renewable energy is already a principal energy source.
items.zh: 在世界许多地方，可再生能源已经成为主要的能源来源。

items.en: In Scotland, for example, wind turbines provide enough electricity to power 95 percent of homes.
items.zh: 例如在苏格兰，风力涡轮机提供的电力已经足以供应95%的家庭用电。

items.en: But the headlong push into bachelor’s degrees for all – and the subtle devaluing of anything less – misses an important point: That’s not the only thing the American economy needs.
items.zh: 但盲目地让所有人都攻读学士学位，并微妙地贬低任何低于这一层次的教育，却忽略了一个重要的问题：这并不是美国经济唯一需要的东西。

items.en: Yes, a bachelor’s degree opens more doors.
items.zh: 是的，学士学位能打开更多的大门。

items.en: But even now, 54 percent of the jobs in the country are middle-skill jobs, such as construction and high-skill manufacturing.
items.zh: 但即使现在，全国54%的工作属于中等技能工作，例如建筑和高技能制造业。

items.en: But only 44 percent of workers are adequately trained.
items.zh: 但只有44%的工人接受了足够的培训。

items.en: In other words, at a time when the working class has turned the country on its political head, frustrated that the opportunity that once defined America is vanishing, one obvious solution is staring us in the face.
items.zh: 换句话说，在工人阶级已经让国家政治局面发生翻天覆地变化的当下，他们感到沮丧，因为曾经定义美国的机会正在消失，一个显而易见的解决方案正摆在我们面前。

items.en: There is a gap in working-class jobs, but the workers who need those jobs most aren’t equipped to do them.
items.zh: 在工人阶级的工作岗位上存在缺口，但最需要这些工作的人却没有接受相应的培训。

items.en: Koziatek’s Manchester School of Technology High School is trying to fill that gap.
items.zh: 科扎特克（Koziatek）在曼彻斯特科技高中（Manchester School of Technology High School）所做的正是试图填补这一缺口。

items.en: Koziatek’s school is a wake-up call.
items.zh: 科扎特克的学校是一个警钟。

items.en: Although electric cars are still a rarity on roads now, this massive investment could change the picture rapidly in coming years.
items.zh: 尽管目前电动汽车在道路上仍属罕见，但这种大规模投资可能在未来几年迅速改变这一局面。

items.en: While there’s a long way to go, the trend lines for renewables are spiking.
items.zh: 虽然还有很长的路要走，但可再生能源的趋势线正在急剧上升。

items.en: The pace of change in energy sources appears to be speeding up – perhaps just in time to have a meaningful effect in slowing climate change.
items.zh: 能源来源的变化速度似乎正在加快——或许正是时候，对减缓气候变化产生有意义的影响。

items.en: What Washington does – or doesn’t do – to promote alternative energy may mean less and less at a time of a global shift in thought.
items.zh: 华盛顿在推动替代能源方面所做或未做的事情，在全球思想转变的时期可能变得越来越不重要。

items.en: The power and ambition of the giants of the digital economy is astonishing-
items.zh: 数字经济巨头所拥有的权力和野心令人惊叹——

items.en: Amazon has just announced the purchase of the upmarket grocery chain Whole Foods for ＄ 13.5bn, but two years ago Facebook paid even more than that to acquire the WhatsApp messaging service, which doesn’t have any physical product at all.
items.zh: 亚马逊刚刚宣布以135亿美元收购高端杂货连锁店Whole Foods，但两年前Facebook为了收购WhatsApp信息服务，支付的金额甚至更多，而WhatsApp本身没有任何实体产品。

items.en: What WhatsApp offered Facebook was an intricate and finely detailed web of its users’ friendships and social lives.
items.zh: WhatsApp为Facebook提供的，是其用户之间复杂而细致的友谊和社会生活网络。

items.en: Facebook promised the European commission then that it would not link phone numbers to Facebook identities, but it broke the promise almost as soon as the deal went through.
items.zh: Facebook当时向欧盟委员会承诺，不会将电话号码与Facebook身份关联，但交易完成后几乎立刻就违背了这一承诺。

items.en: While the rest of the world takes the lead, notably China and Europe, the United States is also seeing a remarkable shift.
items.zh: 当世界其他地区，尤其是中国和欧洲率先行动时，美国也正在经历一场显著的转变。

items.en: In March, for the first time, wind and solar power accounted for more than 10 percent of the power generated in the US, reported the US Energy Information Administration.
items.zh: 美国能源信息署报告称，3月份，风能和太阳能首次占到了美国发电总量的10%以上。

items.en: President Trump has underlined fossil fuels – especially coal – as the path to economic growth.
items.zh: 特朗普总统强调化石燃料——尤其是煤炭——是实现经济增长的途径。

items.en: In a recent speech in Iowa, he dismissed wind power as an unreliable energy source.
items.zh: 在最近一次爱荷华州的演讲中，他将风能驳斥为不可靠的能源来源。

items.en: But that message did not play well with many in Iowa, where wind turbines dot the fields and provide 36 percent of the state’s electricity generation – and where tech giants like Microsoft are being attracted by the availability of clean energy to power their data centers.
items.zh: 但这一信息在爱荷华州并不受欢迎，该州田野中遍布风力涡轮机，为该州36%的电力供应提供了保障——而且科技巨头如微软正因该州清洁电力的充足供应而被吸引来建设数据中心。

items.en: The question “what happens when the wind doesn’t blow or the sun doesn’t shine?” has provided a quick put-down for skeptics.
items.zh: ‘当风不吹或太阳不照时会发生什么？’这个问题为怀疑者提供了一个迅速的反驳理由。

items.en: But a boost in the storage capacity of batteries is making their ability to keep power flowing around the clock more likely.
items.zh: 但电池储能能力的提升，使得它们能够全天候持续供电的可能性正在增加。

items.en: The advance is driven in part by vehicle manufacturers, who are placing big bets on battery-powered electric vehicles.
items.zh: 这一进展部分得益于汽车制造商，他们正在大力押注于电池驱动的电动汽车。

items.en: Even without knowing what was in the messages, the knowledge of who sent them and to whom was enormously revealing and still could be.
items.zh: 即使不知道这些信息的具体内容，仅知道是谁发送的以及发送给了谁，就已经非常具有揭示性，而且仍然可能具有价值。

items.en: What political journalist, what party whip, would not want to know the makeup of the WhatsApp groups in which Theresa May’s enemies are currently plotting?
items.zh: 哪个政治记者，哪个政党督导，不想知道那些目前正在密谋对抗特雷莎·梅的WhatsApp群组的成员构成呢？

items.en: It may be that the value of Whole Foods to Amazon is not so much the 460 shops it owns, but the records of which customers have purchased what.
items.zh: Whole Foods对亚马逊的价值可能不在于它拥有的460家门店，而在于它记录了哪些顾客购买了什么商品。

items.en: Competition law appears to be the only way to address these imbalances of power.
items.zh: 竞争法似乎成了应对这些权力失衡的唯一途径。

items.en: But it is clumsy.
items.zh: 但这种方法显得笨拙。

items.en: For one thing, it is very slow compared to the pace of change within the digital economy.
items.zh: 首先，与数字经济中变化的速度相比，它显得非常缓慢。

items.en: By the time a problem has been addressed and remedied it may have vanished in the marketplace, to be replaced by new abuses of power.
items.zh: 等到一个问题被发现并加以解决时，它可能已经在市场上消失，取而代之的是新的权力滥用行为。

items.en: But there is a deeper conceptual problem, too.
items.zh: 但还有一个更深层次的概念性问题。

items.en: It doesn’t feel like a human or democratic relationship, even if both sides benefit.
items.zh: 即使双方都受益，这也不像是一个人类或民主的关系。

items.en: To combat the trap of putting a premium on being busy, Cal Newport, author of Deep Work: Rules for Focused Success in a Distracted World, recommends building a habit of “deep work” – the ability to focus without distraction.
items.zh: 为了应对将忙碌视为重要价值的陷阱，深工作：在分心世界中专注成功的规则一书的作者卡尔·纽波特建议培养一种'深工作'的习惯——即在没有干扰的情况下专注的能力。

items.en: There are a number of approaches to mastering the art of deep work – be it lengthy retreats dedicated to a specific task; developing a daily ritual; or taking a “journalistic” approach to seizing moments of deep work when you can throughout the day.
items.zh: 掌握深工作这门艺术有多种方法，无论是进行长时间的退修以专注于特定任务；还是建立每日的仪式；或者采取一种'新闻业'的方式，在一天中抓住可以进行深工作的时刻。

items.en: Whichever approach, the key is to determine your length of focus time and stick to it.
items.zh: 无论采用哪种方法，关键是要确定你的专注时长并坚持下去。

items.en: Newport also recommends “deep scheduling” to combat constant interruptions and get more done in less time.
items.zh: 纽波特还建议采用'深度安排'来应对持续的干扰，从而在更短的时间内完成更多的工作。

items.en: At any given point, I should have deep work scheduled for roughly the next month.
items.zh: 在任何时候，我都应该在日历上安排大约接下来一个月的深工作时间。

items.en: Once on the calendar, I protect this time like I would a doctor’s appointment or important meeting”, he writes.
items.zh: 一旦安排在日历上，我就像保护医生预约或重要会议一样保护这段时间。

items.en: Another approach to getting more done in less time is to rethink how you prioritise your day – in particular how we craft our to-do lists.
items.zh: 另一种在更少时间内完成更多工作的方法是重新思考你如何优先安排一天的任务——特别是我们如何制定待办事项清单。

items.en: Tim Harford, author of Messy: The Power of Disorder to Transform Our Lives, points to a study in the early 1980s that divided undergraduates into two groups: some were advised to set out monthly goals and study activities; others were told to plan activities and goals in much more detail, day by day.
items.zh: 《杂乱：无序的力量如何改变我们的生活》一书的作者蒂姆·哈福德引用了20世纪80年代初的一项研究，该研究将大学生分为两组：一组被建议制定每月目标和学习活动；另一组则被要求更详细地按天规划活动和目标。

items.en: While the researchers assumed that the well-structured daily plans would be most effective when it came to the execution of tasks, they were wrong: the detailed daily plans demotivated students.
items.zh: 尽管研究人员假设，当执行任务时，结构严谨的每日计划会最有效，但他们错了：过于详细的每日计划反而削弱了学生的动力。

items.en: Harford argues that inevitable distractions often render the daily to-do list ineffective, while leaving room for improvisation in such a list can reap the best results.
items.zh: 哈福德认为，不可避免的干扰常常使每日待办事项清单变得无效，而在这个清单中留出一定的即兴发挥空间，反而能取得最佳效果。

items.en: In order to make the most of our focus and energy, we also need to embrace downtime, or as Newport suggests, “be lazy”.
items.zh: 为了充分利用我们的注意力和精力，我们也需要接受空闲时间，正如纽波特所建议的那样，要“懒一点”。

items.en: Idleness is not just a vacation, an indulgence or a vice; it is as indispensable to the brain as vitamin D is to the body…[idleness] is, paradoxically, necessary to getting any work done,” he argues.
items.zh: 他指出，空闲不仅仅是一种休息、放纵或恶习；它对大脑的重要性，就如同维生素D对身体一样不可或缺……[空闲]悖论般地，是完成任何工作的必要条件。

items.en: Srini Pillay, an assistant professor of psychiatry at Harvard Medical School, believes this counterintuitive link between downtime and productivity may be due to the way our brains operate.
items.zh: 哈佛医学院精神病学助理教授斯里尼·皮莱认为，这种空闲时间与生产力之间看似矛盾的联系，可能源于我们大脑的工作方式。

items.en: When our brains switch between being focused and unfocused on a task, they tend to be more efficient.
items.zh: 当我们的大脑在专注于任务和不专注于任务之间切换时，它们往往更加高效。

items.en: What people don’t realise is that in order to complete these tasks they need to use both the focus and unfocus circuits in their brain,” says Pillay.
items.zh: 皮莱说，人们没有意识到，为了完成这些任务，他们需要同时使用大脑中的专注和非专注回路。

items.en: Financial regulators in Britain have imposed a rather unusual rule on the bosses of big banks.
items.zh: 英国的金融监管机构对大银行的负责人实施了一项相当不寻常的规定。

items.en: Starting next year, any guaranteed bonus of top executives could be delayed 10 years if their banks are under investigation for wrongdoing.
items.zh: 从明年开始，如果这些银行因不当行为而受到调查，其高管的任何有保证的奖金都可能被延迟十年发放。

items.en: The main purpose of this "clawback" rule is to hold bankers accountable for harmful risk-taking and to restore public trust in financial institutions.
items.zh: 这项"追回"规则的主要目的是让银行家对其有害的风险行为负责，并恢复公众对金融机构的信任。

items.en: Yet officials also hope for a much larger benefit: more long-term decision-making, not only by banks but by all corporations, to build a stronger economy for future generations.
items.zh: 然而，官员们还希望获得更大的好处：不仅银行，所有公司都能做出更长远的决策，为未来几代人建设更强大的经济。

items.en: Short-termism" or the desire for quick profits, has worsened in publicly traded companies, says the Bank of England's top economist, Andrew Haldane.
items.zh: 英国央行首席经济学家安德鲁·哈尔丹表示，"短期主义"或追求快速盈利的欲望，在上市公司中变得更加严重。

items.en: He quotes a giant of classical economics, Alfred Marshall, in describing this financial impatience as acting like "children who pick the plums out of their pudding to eat them at once" rather than putting them aside to be eaten last.
items.zh: 他引用了古典经济学巨擘阿尔弗雷德·马歇尔的话，将这种金融上的急躁比作"孩子们把布丁里的李子挑出来立刻吃掉，而不是留到最后再吃"。

items.en: The average time for holding a stock in both the United States and Britain, he notes, has dropped from seven years to seven months in recent decades.
items.zh: 他指出，近年来在美国和英国，持有股票的平均时间已从七年的下降到七个月。

items.en: Transient investors, who demand high quarterly profits from companies, can hinder a firm's efforts to invest in long-term research or to build up customer loyalty.
items.zh: 要求公司每季度获得高利润的短期投资者，可能会阻碍企业进行长期研究或建立客户忠诚度的努力。

items.en: This has been dubbed "quarterly capitalism.
items.zh: 这被称为"季度资本主义"。

items.en: In addition, new digital technologies have allowed more rapid trading of equities, quicker use of information, and thus shorter attention spans in financial markets.
items.zh: 此外，新的数字技术使得股票交易更加迅速，信息利用更加高效，从而导致金融市场中的注意力持续时间更短。

items.en: There seems to be a predominance of short-term thinking at the expense of long-term investing," said Commissioner Daniel Gallagher of the US Securities and Exchange Commission in a speech this week.
items.zh: 美国证券交易委员会委员丹尼尔·加拉格尔本周在一次演讲中表示："似乎存在一种以牺牲长期投资为代价的短期思维占主导的现象。"

items.en: In the US, the Sarbanes-Oxley Act of 2002 has pushed most public companies to defer performance bonuses for senior executives by about a year, slightly helping reduce "short-termism.
items.zh: 在美国，2002年的《萨班斯-奥克斯利法案》促使大多数上市公司将高级管理人员的业绩奖金推迟约一年发放，这在一定程度上有助于减少"短期主义"。

items.en: In its latest survey of CEO pay, The Wall Street Journal finds that "a substantial part" of executive pay is now tied to performance.
items.zh: 在最新的一项关于首席执行官薪酬的调查中，《华尔街日报》发现："相当大的一部分"高管薪酬现在与业绩挂钩。

items.en: Much more could be done to encourage "long-termism," such as changes in the tax code and quicker disclosure of stock acquisitions.
items.zh: 为了鼓励"长期主义"，还可以采取更多措施，例如修改税法和加快股票收购信息的披露。

items.en: In France, shareholders who hold onto a company investment for at least two years can sometimes earn more voting rights in a company.
items.zh: 在法国，如果股东持有公司投资至少两年，有时可以获得更多的公司投票权。

items.en: Within companies, the right compensation design can provide incentives for executives to think beyond their own time at the company and on behalf of all stakeholders.
items.zh: 在公司内部，合理的薪酬设计可以激励高管超越其在公司任职的时间，为所有利益相关者着想。

items.en: Britain's new rule is a reminder to bankers that society has an interest in their performance, not just for the short term but for the long term.
items.zh: 英国的新规定提醒银行家们，社会不仅关注他们的短期表现，也关注他们的长期表现。

items.en: Grade inflation - the gradual increase in average GPAs (grade-point averages) over the past few decades - is often considered a product of a consumer era in higher education, in which students are treated like customers to be pleased.
items.zh: 成绩膨胀——过去几十年平均绩点（GPA）的逐渐上升——通常被认为是高等教育消费时代的一种产物，在这个时代里，学生被视为需要取悦的客户。

items.en: But another, related force - a policy often buried deep in course catalogs called "grade forgiveness" - is helping raise GPAs.
items.zh: 但另一个相关因素——一种常被深藏在课程目录中的政策，称为"成绩宽恕"——正在帮助提高绩点。

items.en: Grade forgiveness allows students to retake a course in which they received a low grade, and the most recent grade or the highest grade is the only one that counts in calculating a student's overall GPA.
items.zh: 成绩宽恕允许学生重修他们曾获得低分的课程，而在计算学生的总体绩点时，只计算最近一次或最高一次的成绩。

items.en: The use of this little-known practice has accelerated in recent years, as colleges continue to do their utmost to keep students in school (and paying tuition) and improve their graduation rates.
items.zh: 近年来，这种鲜为人知的做法的使用速度加快了，因为高校一直在尽最大努力让学生留在学校（并继续缴纳学费），同时提高毕业率。

items.en: When this practice first started decades ago, it was usually limited to freshmen, to give them a second chance to take a class in their first year if they struggled in their transition to college-level courses.
items.zh: 几十年前，当这种做法刚开始实施时，通常仅限于大一新生，如果他们在适应大学课程的过程中遇到困难，可以给他们一次重新学习第一年课程的机会。

items.en: But now most colleges, save for many selective campuses, allow all undergraduates, and even graduate students, to get their low grades forgiven.
items.zh: 但现在，除了许多精英校园之外，大多数高校都允许所有本科生，甚至研究生，将他们的低分予以宽恕。

items.en: College officials tend to emphasize that the goal of grade forgiveness is less about the grade itself and more about encouraging students to retake courses critical to their degree program and graduation without incurring a big penalty.
items.zh: 大学官员倾向于强调，成绩宽恕的目标与其说是成绩本身，不如说是鼓励学生重修对他们学位课程和毕业至关重要的课程，而不会受到较大的惩罚。

items.en: Even before the invention of the electric light bulb, the author produced a remarkable work of speculative fiction that would foreshadow many ethical questions to be raised by technologies yet to come.
items.zh: 即使在电灯泡发明之前，这位作者也创作了一部非凡的科幻作品，预示了许多由尚未到来的技术引发的伦理问题。

items.en: Today the rapid growth of artificial intelligence (AI) raises fundamental questions: "What is intelligence, identity, or consciousness?
items.zh: 如今，人工智能（AI）的迅猛发展引发了一些根本性的问题："什么是智能、身份或意识？"

items.en: What makes humans humans?
items.zh: "什么使人类成为人类？"

items.en: What is being called artificial general intelligence, machines that would imitate the way humans think, continues to evade scientists.
items.zh: 被称为人工通用智能的机器，即能够模仿人类思维方式的机器，至今仍然让科学家难以捉摸。

items.en: Yet humans remain fascinated by the idea of robots that would look, move, and respond like humans, similar to those recently depicted on popular sci-fi TV series such as "Westworld" and "Humans.
items.zh: 然而，人类依然对那些看起来、行动和反应都像人类的机器人着迷，这些机器人类似于最近在热门科幻电视剧《西部世界》和《人类》中所描绘的形象。

items.en: Just how people think is still far too complex to be understood, let alone reproduced, says David Eagleman, a Stanford University neuroscientist.
items.zh: 斯坦福大学的神经科学家大卫·埃格曼曼说，人类的思维方式仍然过于复杂，难以理解，更不用说复制了。

items.en: We are just in a situation where there are no good theories explaining what consciousness actually is and how you could ever build a machine to get there.
items.zh: 我们目前正处于一个没有良好理论能够解释意识究竟是什么以及如何制造出具有意识的机器的境地。

items.en: But that doesn't mean crucial ethical issues involving AI aren't at hand.
items.zh: 但这并不意味着与人工智能相关的重大伦理问题尚未出现。

items.en: Ultimately," said Jack Miner, Ohio State University's registrar, "we see students achieve more success because they retake a course and do better in subsequent courses or master the content that allows them to graduate on time.
items.zh: 最终，”俄亥俄州立大学的注册官杰克·迈纳说，“我们看到学生因为重修课程而取得更大的成功，他们在后续课程中表现更好，或者掌握了能够让他们按时毕业的内容。

items.en: That said, there is a way in which grade forgiveness satisfies colleges' own needs as well.
items.zh: 话虽如此，成绩宽恕也满足了大学自身的某种需求。

items.en: For public institutions, state funds are sometimes tied partly to their success on metrics such as graduation rates and student retention - so better grades can, by boosting figures like those, mean more money.
items.zh: 对于公立院校来说，州政府的资金有时部分与它们在毕业率和学生保留率等指标上的表现挂钩——因此，更高的成绩可以通过提升这些数据来意味着更多的资金。

items.en: And anything that raises GPAs will likely make students - who, at the end of the day, are paying the bill - feel they've gotten a better value for their tuition dollars, which is another big concern for colleges.
items.zh: 而且，任何能够提高GPA的事情，都可能让学生——毕竟最终是他们在支付费用——觉得他们为学费得到了更好的价值，这也是大学非常关注的一个问题。

items.en: Indeed, grade forgiveness is just another way that universities are responding to consumers' expectations for higher education.
items.zh: 事实上，成绩宽恕只是大学回应消费者对高等教育期望的另一种方式。

items.en: Since students and parents expect a college degree to lead to a job, it is in the best interest of a school to turn out graduates who are as qualified as possible - or at least appear to be.
items.zh: 由于学生和家长期望大学学位能带来工作机会，因此学校最符合自身利益的做法是培养出尽可能合格的毕业生——或者至少看起来是合格的。

items.en: On this, students' and colleges' incentives seem to be aligned.
items.zh: 在这一点上，学生的激励和大学的激励似乎是一致的。

items.en: This year marks exactly two centuries since the publication of "Frankenstein; or, The Modern Prometheus," by Mary Shelley.
items.zh: 今年正好是玛丽·雪莱所著《弗兰肯斯坦；或，现代普罗米修斯》出版200周年。

items.en: The coming use of autonomous vehicles, for example, poses thorny ethical questions.
items.zh: 例如，自动驾驶汽车的即将到来将引发棘手的伦理问题。

items.en: Human drivers sometimes must make split-second decisions.
items.zh: 人类驾驶员有时必须做出千分之一秒的决策。

items.en: Their reactions may be a complex combination of instant reflexes, input from past driving experiences, and what their eyes and ears tell them in that moment.
items.zh: 他们的反应可能是瞬时反射、以往驾驶经验的输入以及当时眼睛和耳朵所传递信息的复杂结合。

items.en: AI "vision" today is not nearly as sophisticated as that of humans.
items.zh: 如今的AI "视觉"远没有人类那么复杂精细。

items.en: And to anticipate every imaginable driving situation is a difficult programming problem.
items.zh: 而要预见每一种可以想象的驾驶情况则是一个困难的编程问题。

items.en: Whenever decisions are based on masses of data, "you quickly get into a lot of ethical questions," notes Tan Kiat How, chief executive of a Singapore-based agency that is helping the government develop a voluntary code for the ethical use of AI.
items.zh: 每当决策基于大量数据时，"你很快就会陷入许多伦理问题中，" 新加坡一家协助政府制定AI伦理使用自愿准则的机构首席执行官Tan Kiat How指出。

items.en: Along with Singapore, other governments and mega-corporations are beginning to establish their own guidelines.
items.zh: 除了新加坡，其他政府和大型跨国公司也开始制定自己的指导方针。

items.en: Britain is setting up a data ethics center.
items.zh: 英国正在设立一个数据伦理中心。

items.en: Competition law as presently interpreted deals with financial disadvantage to consumers and this is not obvious when the users of these services don’t pay for them.
items.zh: 目前对竞争法的解释主要关注消费者所遭受的经济损失，而当这些服务的使用者无需为此付费时，这种损失并不明显。

items.en: The users of their services are not their customers.
items.zh: 他们的服务使用者并不是他们的客户。

items.en: That would be the people who buy advertising
items.zh: 那就是那些购买广告的人

items.en: from them – and Facebook and Google, the two virtual giants, dominate digital
items.zh: 从它们那里——以及脸书和谷歌这两大虚拟巨头，主导着数字领域

items.en: advertising to the disadvantage of all other media and entertainment companies.
items.zh: 对所有其他媒体和娱乐公司不利的广告。

items.en: The product they’re selling is data, and we, the users, convert our lives to data for the benefit of the digital giants.
items.zh: 他们销售的产品是数据，而我们这些用户则将我们的生活转化为数据，以造福这些数字巨头。

items.en: Just as some ants farm the bugs called aphids for the honeydew they produce when they feed, so Google farms us for the data that our digital lives yield.
items.zh: 就像一些蚂蚁会饲养被称为蚜虫的昆虫，以获取它们进食时产生的蜜露一样，谷歌也在饲养我们，以获取我们的数字生活所产生的数据。

items.en: Ants keep predatory insects away from where their aphids feed; Gmail keeps the spammers out of our inboxes.
items.zh: 蚂蚁将捕食性昆虫赶出它们的蚜虫觅食区域；Gmail将垃圾邮件发送者阻挡在我们的收件箱之外。

items.en: India released its AI ethics strategy this spring.
items.zh: 今年春天，印度发布了其人工智能伦理战略。

items.en: On June 7 Google pledged not to "design or deploy AI" that would cause "overall harm," or to develop AI-directed weapons or use AI for surveillance that would violate international norms.
items.zh: 6月7日，谷歌承诺不会设计或部署会造成‘总体伤害’的人工智能，也不会开发人工智能驱动的武器，或使用人工智能进行违反国际规范的监控。

items.en: It also pledged not to deploy AI whose use would violate international laws or human rights.
items.zh: 它还承诺不部署那些使用方式会违反国际法或人权的人工智能系统。

items.en: While the statement is vague, it represents one starting point.
items.zh: 尽管这一声明较为模糊，但它代表了一个起点。

items.en: So does the idea that decisions made by AI systems should be explainable, transparent, and fair.
items.zh: 同样，人工智能系统的决策应当可解释、透明且公平这一理念也代表了一个起点。

items.en: To put it another way: How can we make sure that the thinking of intelligent machines reflects humanity's highest values?
items.zh: 换句话说：我们如何确保智能机器的思维方式体现出人类的最高价值观？

items.en: Only then will they be useful servants and not Frankenstein's out-of-control monster.
items.zh: 只有这样，它们才能成为有用的仆人，而不是像弗兰肯斯坦那样失控的怪物。

items.en: States will be able to force more people to pay sales tax when they make online purchases under a Supreme Court decision Thursday that will leave shoppers with lighter wallets but is a big financial win for states.
items.zh: 周四最高法院的一项裁决决定，各州将能够迫使更多人在进行在线购物时缴纳销售税，这虽然会让购物者的钱包更轻，但却为各州带来了巨大的财政收益。

items.en: Now, rivals will be charging sales tax where they hadn't before.
items.zh: 现在，竞争对手们将在之前未征收销售税的地区开始征收销售税。

items.en: Big chains have been collecting sales tax nationwide because they typically have physical stores in whatever state a purchase is being shipped to.
items.zh: 大型连锁企业一直在全国范围内收取销售税，因为它们通常在发货所到达的各个州都有实体店铺。

items.en: Amazon.com, with its network of warehouses, also collects sales tax in every state that charges it, though third-party sellers who use the site don't have to.
items.zh: 亚马逊.com凭借其遍布各地的仓库网络，也在所有征收销售税的州收取销售税，尽管使用该网站的第三方卖家则无需这样做。

items.en: Until now, many sellers that have a physical presence in only a single state or a few states have been able to avoid charging sales taxes when they ship to addresses outside those states.
items.zh: 迄今为止，许多只在一个或少数几个州拥有实体存在的卖家，在向这些州以外的地址发货时，都能够避免征收销售税。

items.en: Sellers that use eBay and Etsy, which provide platforms for smaller sellers, also haven't been collecting sales tax nationwide.
items.zh: 使用eBay和Etsy的卖家，这两个平台为小型卖家提供服务，也一直没有在全国范围内收取销售税。

items.en: Under the ruling Thursday, states can pass laws requiring out-of-state sellers to collect the state's sales tax from customers and send it to the state.
items.zh: 根据周四的裁决，各州可以制定法律，要求州外卖家从顾客处收取该州的销售税并将其上缴给州政府。

items.en: Retail trade groups praised the ruling, saying it levels the playing field for local and online businesses.
items.zh: 零售行业协会称赞这一裁决，称其为本地和在线企业创造了公平的竞争环境。

items.en: The losers, said retail analyst Neil Saunders, are online-only retailers, especially smaller ones.
items.zh: 零售分析师尼尔·沙普尔斯表示，输家是仅在线上经营的零售商，尤其是那些规模较小的商家。

items.en: The Supreme Court's opinion Thursday overruled a pair of decades-old decisions that states said cost them billions of dollars in lost revenue annually.
items.zh: 周四，最高法院裁定推翻了两项已有数十年历史的裁决，这些裁决据称每年使各州损失数十亿美元的税收收入。

items.en: The decisions made it more difficult for states to collect sales tax on certain online purchases.
items.zh: 这些裁决使得各州更难对某些在线购买行为征收销售税。

items.en: The cases the court overturned said that if a business was shipping a customer's purchase to a state where the business didn't have a physical presence such as a warehouse or office, the business didn't have to collect sales tax for the state.
items.zh: 最高法院推翻的案件中指出，如果一家企业将客户的购买商品寄送到其没有实体存在（如仓库或办公室）的州，那么该企业无需为该州征收销售税。

items.en: Customers were generally responsible for paying the sales tax to the state themselves if they weren't charged it, but most didn't realize they owed it and few paid.
items.zh: 如果客户没有被收取销售税，通常应自行向州政府缴纳，但大多数客户并不知道自己有这个义务，也很少有人实际缴纳。

items.en: Justice Anthony Kennedy wrote that the previous decisions were flawed.
items.zh: 安东尼·肯尼迪大法官写道，之前的裁决存在缺陷。

items.en: Each year the physical presence rule becomes further removed from economic reality and results in significant revenue losses to the States," he wrote in an opinion joined by four other justices.
items.zh: 他在一份与其他四位大法官联合签署的意见中写道："每年，实体存在规则都越来越脱离经济现实，并导致各州出现重大税收损失。"

items.en: Kennedy wrote that the rule "limited states' ability to seek long-term prosperity and has prevented market participants from competing on an even playing field.
items.zh: 肯尼迪还写道，这一规则"限制了各州寻求长期繁荣的能力，并阻碍了市场参与者在公平的竞争环境中竞争。"

items.en: The ruling is a victory for big chains with a presence in many states, since they usually collect sales tax on online purchases already.
items.zh: 这项裁决对在多个州设有实体的大连锁企业来说是一次胜利，因为它们通常已经对在线购买征收销售税。

items.en: Those retailers may face headaches complying with various state sales tax laws.
items.zh: 这些零售商在遵守各种州销售税法时可能会遇到麻烦。

items.en: The Small Business & Entrepreneurship Council advocacy group said in a statement, "Small businesses and internet entrepreneurs are not well served at all by this decision.
items.zh: 小型企业与创业理事会这一倡导组织在一份声明中表示："这一决定对小型企业和网络创业者来说完全不利。"

items.en: Unlike so-called basic emotions such as sadness, fear, and anger, guilt emerges a little later, in conjunction with a child’s growing grasp of social and moral norms.
items.zh: 与所谓的基本情绪如悲伤、恐惧和愤怒不同，内疚感出现得稍晚一些，伴随着孩子对社会和道德规范理解的逐渐加深。

items.en: Children aren’t born knowing how to say “I’m sorry”; rather, they learn over time that such statements appease parents and friends – and their own consciences.
items.zh: 孩子们并不是生来就知道如何说"对不起"；相反，他们随着时间的推移逐渐学会，这样的表达可以安抚父母和朋友，也能安抚他们自己的良心。

items.en: This is why researchers generally regard so-called moral guilt, in the right amount, to be a good thing.
items.zh: 这就是为什么研究人员通常认为，适量的所谓道德内疚感是一件好事。

items.en: In the popular imagination, of course, guilt still gets a bad rap.
items.zh: 当然，在大众的想象中，内疚感仍然带有负面色彩。

items.en: It is deeply uncomfortable – it’s the emotional equivalent of wearing a jacket weighted with stones.
items.zh: 它非常令人不适——就像穿着一件装满石头的外套一样，是一种情绪上的负担。

items.en: Yet this understanding is outdated.
items.zh: 然而，这种看法已经过时了。

items.en: There has been a kind of revival or a rethinking about what guilt is and what role guilt can serve,” says Amrisha Vaish, a psychology researcher at the University of Virginia, adding that this revival is part of a larger recognition that emotions aren’t binary – feelings that may be advantageous in one context may be harmful in another.
items.zh: 弗吉尼亚大学的心理学研究员阿姆里莎·瓦什表示："关于内疚是什么以及内疚能发挥什么作用，出现了一种复兴或重新思考的趋势。" 她补充说，这种复兴是更广泛地认识到情绪并非非黑即白的一种表现——某种在一种情境下可能有益的情绪，在另一种情境下可能有害。

items.en: Jealousy and anger, for example, may have evolved to alert us to important inequalities.
items.zh: 例如，嫉妒和愤怒可能已经进化为提醒我们注意重要不平等的信号。

items.en: Too much happiness can be destructive.
items.zh: 过多的快乐可能是破坏性的。

items.en: And guilt, by prompting us to think more deeply about our goodness, can encourage humans to make up for errors and fix relationships.
items.zh: 而内疚则通过促使我们更深入地思考自己的善良，鼓励人类弥补错误并修复关系。

items.en: Guilt, in other words, can help hold a cooperative species together.
items.zh: 换句话说，内疚有助于维系一个合作的物种。

items.en: It is a kind of social glue.
items.zh: 它是一种社会粘合剂。

items.en: Viewed in this light, guilt is an opportunity.
items.zh: 从这个角度看，内疚是一种机会。

items.en: Work by Tina Malti, a psychology professor at the University of Toronto, suggests that guilt may compensate for an emotional deficiency.
items.zh: 多伦多大学心理学教授蒂娜·马尔蒂的研究表明，内疚可能会弥补某种情绪缺陷。

items.en: That’s good news, ” Malti says.
items.zh: “这是个好消息，”马尔蒂说。

items.en: We can be prosocial because we caused harm and we feel regret.
items.zh: 我们可以表现出亲社会行为，因为我们造成了伤害并感到后悔。

items.en: Forests give us shade, quiet and one of the harder challenges in the fight against climate change.
items.zh: 森林为我们提供荫蔽、宁静以及应对气候变化斗争中的一大挑战。

items.en: Even as we humans count on forests to soak up a good share of the carbon dioxide we produce, we are threatening their ability to do so.
items.zh: 即使我们人类依赖森林吸收我们排放的大量二氧化碳，我们却在威胁它们完成这一任务的能力。

items.en: The climate change we are hastening could one day leave us with forests that emit more carbon than they absorb.
items.zh: 我们加速的气候变化有一天可能会使森林排放的碳多于吸收的碳。

items.en: Thankfully, there is a way out of this trap – but it involves striking a subtle balance.
items.zh: 幸运的是，有一种方法可以摆脱这个困境——但它需要达到一种微妙的平衡。

items.en: Helping forests flourish as valuable “carbon sinks” long into the future may require reducing their capacity to absorb carbon now.
items.zh: 帮助森林在未来长期作为宝贵的‘碳汇’繁茂生长，可能需要现在减少它们吸收碳的能力。

items.en: California is leading the way, as it does on so many climate efforts, in figuring out the details.
items.zh: 加利福尼亚州正在引领这一方向，就像它在许多气候行动中所做的那样，正在努力理清具体细节。

items.en: In a number of studies, Malti and others have shown that guilt and sympathy may represent different pathways to cooperation and sharing.
items.zh: 在多项研究中，Malti 和其他研究者已经表明，内疚感和同情心可能代表通向合作与分享的不同途径。

items.en: Some kids who are low in sympathy may make up for that shortfall by experiencing more guilt, which can rein in their nastier impulses.
items.zh: 一些同情心较低的孩子可能会通过体验更多的内疚感来弥补这一不足，这种内疚感能够抑制他们更恶劣的冲动。

items.en: And vice versa: High sympathy can substitute for low guilt.
items.zh: 反之亦然：较高的同情心可以弥补较低的内疚感。

items.en: In a 2014 study, for example, Malti looked at 244 children.
items.zh: 例如，在2014年的一项研究中，Malti 研究了244名儿童。

items.en: Using caregiver assessments and the children’s self-observations, she rated each child’s overall sympathy level and his or her tendency to feel negative emotions after moral transgressions.
items.zh: 通过照顾者的评估和孩子们的自我观察，她对每个孩子的总体同情水平以及他们在道德越轨后产生负面情绪的倾向进行了评分。

items.en: Then the kids were handed chocolate coins, and given a chance to share them with an anonymous child.
items.zh: 随后，孩子们被分发了巧克力硬币，并有机会与一名匿名儿童分享这些硬币。

items.en: For the low-sympathy kids, how much they shared appeared to turn on how inclined they were to feel guilty.
items.zh: 对于同情心较低的孩子来说，他们分享的数量似乎取决于他们产生内疚感的倾向程度。

items.en: The guilt-prone ones shared more, even though they hadn’t magically become more sympathetic to the other child’s deprivation.
items.zh: 那些容易感到内疚的孩子分享得更多，尽管他们并没有神奇地变得更加同情对方所遭受的剥夺。

items.en: The state’s proposed Forest Carbon Plan aims to double efforts to thin out young trees and clear brush in parts of the forest.
items.zh: 该州提出的森林碳计划旨在加倍努力，在森林的部分区域疏伐幼树并清除灌木丛。

items.en: This temporarily lowers carbon-carrying capacity.
items.zh: 但这会暂时降低森林的碳储存能力。

items.en: But the remaining trees draw a greater share of the available moisture, so they grow and thrive, restoring the forest’s capacity to pull carbon from the air.
items.zh: 然而，剩下的树木会占据更多的可用水分，因此它们生长得更好，恢复森林从空气中吸收碳的能力。

items.en: Healthy trees are also better able to fend off insects.
items.zh: 健康的树木也更能抵御害虫的侵袭。

items.en: The landscape is rendered less easily burnable.
items.zh: 这样的景观更不容易燃烧。

items.en: Even in the event of a fire, fewer trees are consumed.
items.zh: 即使发生火灾，被烧毁的树木也会更少。

items.en: The need for such planning is increasingly urgent.
items.zh: 制定此类计划的必要性日益紧迫。

items.en: Already, since 2010, drought and insects have killed over 100 million trees in California, most of them in 2016 alone, and wildfires have burned hundreds of thousands of acres.
items.zh: 截至目前，自2010年以来，干旱和害虫已导致加利福尼亚州超过一亿棵树死亡，其中大部分发生在2016年，而野火已烧毁了数十万英亩的土地。

items.en: The complaints are unlikely to stop without an overhaul of immigration rules for farm workers.
items.zh: 在没有对农场工人移民规则进行全面改革的情况下，这些投诉不太可能停止。

items.en: Congress has obstructed efforts to create a more straightforward visa for agricultural workers that would let foreign workers stay longer in the u.s. and change jobs within the industry.
items.zh: 国会阻碍了为农业工人创建更简单签证的努力，这种签证将允许外国工人在美国停留更长时间，并在该行业内更换工作。

items.en: If this doesn’t change, American businesses, communities, and consumers will be the losers.
items.zh: 如果这种情况不改变，美国的企业、社区和消费者将成为输家。

items.en: Perhaps half of u.s. farm laborers are undocumented immigrants.
items.zh: 或许有一半的美国农场工人是无证移民。

items.en: As fewer such workers enter the country, the characteristics of the agricultural workforce are changing.
items.zh: 随着越来越少这样的工人进入该国，农业劳动力的特征正在发生变化。

items.en: Today’s farm laborers, while still predominantly born in Mexico, are more likely to be settled rather than migrating and more likely to be married than single.
items.zh: 如今的农场工人虽然仍主要出生在墨西哥，但更可能已经定居而非迁徙，更可能已婚而非单身。

items.en: They’re also aging.
items.zh: 他们也在逐渐变老。

items.en: At the start of this century, about one-third of crop workers were over the age of 35.
items.zh: 本世纪初，大约三分之一的作物工人年龄超过35岁。

items.en: California plans to treat 35, 000 acres of forest a year by 2020, and 60,000 by 2030 – financed from the proceeds of the state’s emissions-permit auctions.
items.zh: 到2020年，加利福尼亚州计划每年治理35,000英亩的森林，到2030年增加到60,000英亩——资金将来自该州排放许可拍卖所得的收入。

items.en: That’s only a small share of the total acreage that could benefit, about half a million acres in all, so it will be vital to prioritize areas at greatest risk of fire or drought.
items.zh: 这仅仅是可能受益的总面积的一小部分，总计约有50万英亩，因此必须优先治理那些最易发生火灾或干旱的区域。

items.en: The strategy also aims to ensure that carbon in woody material removed from the forests is locked away in the form of solid lumber or burned as biofuel in vehicles that would otherwise run on fossil fuels.
items.zh: 该策略还旨在确保从森林中移除的木质材料中的碳被封存在实体木材中，或用作生物燃料在原本依赖化石燃料的车辆中燃烧。

items.en: New research on transportation biofuels is already under way.
items.zh: 关于交通运输用生物燃料的新研究已经在进行中。

items.en: State governments are well accustomed to managing forests, but traditionally they’ve focused on wildlife, watersheds and opportunities for recreation.
items.zh: 州政府早已习惯于管理森林，但传统上他们关注的重点是野生动物、集水区以及休闲娱乐的机会。

items.en: Only recently have they come to see the vital part forests will have to play in storing carbon.
items.zh: 他们只是最近才意识到森林在储存碳方面将发挥的关键作用。

items.en: California’s plan, which is expected to be finalized by the governor next year, should serve as a model.
items.zh: 预计该计划将在明年由州长最终确定，应成为其他地区的典范。

items.en: American farmers have been complaining of labor shortages for several years.
items.zh: 美国农民已经抱怨劳动力短缺好几年了。

items.en: Now more than half are.
items.zh: 现在超过一半的人都这样了。

items.en: And picking crops is hard on older bodies.
items.zh: 而采摘庄稼对年长的身体来说是很吃力的。

items.en: One oft-debated cure for this labor shortage remains as implausible as it’s been all along: Native u.s. workers won’t be returning to the farm.
items.zh: 一个经常被讨论的解决劳动力短缺的方法一直以来都同样不切实际：美国本土工人不会重返农场。

items.en: Mechanization isn’t the answer, either – not yet, at least.
items.zh: 机械化也不是答案——至少目前还不是。

items.en: Production of corn, cotton, rice, soybeans, and wheat has been largely mechanized, but many high-value, labor-intensive crops, such as strawberries, need labor.
items.zh: 玉米、棉花、大米、大豆和小麦的生产已经基本实现了机械化，但许多高价值且劳动密集型的作物，如草莓，仍然需要人工劳动。

items.en: Even dairy farms, where robots do a small share of milking, have a long way to go before they’re automated.
items.zh: 即使是在乳制品农场，机器人只承担了一小部分挤奶工作，离完全自动化还有很长的路要走。

items.en: As a result, farms have grown increasingly reliant on temporary guest workers using the H-2A visa to fill the gaps in the workforce.
items.zh: 因此，农场越来越依赖使用H-2A签证的临时访客工人来填补劳动力缺口。

items.en: Starting around 2012, requests for the visas rose sharply; from 2011 to 2016 the number of visas issued more than doubled.
items.zh: 从2012年左右开始，这类签证的申请数量急剧上升；从2011年到2016年，签发的H-2A签证数量翻了一番多。

items.en: From 1998 to 2000, 14.5 percent of the fruit Americans consumed was imported.
items.zh: 从1998年到2000年，美国人消费的水果中有14.5%是进口的。

items.en: Little more than a decade later, the share of imports was 25.8 percent.
items.zh: 短短十多年后，进口份额上升到了25.8%。

items.en: In effect, the u.s. can import food or it can import the workers who pick it.
items.zh: 实际上，美国可以进口食品，或者进口采摘这些食品的工人。

items.en: Arnold Schwarzenegger, Dia Mirza and Adrian Grenier have a message for you: It’s easy to beat plastic.
items.zh: 阿诺德·施瓦辛格、迪亚·米尔扎和亚当·格林杰向你传递一个信息：打败塑料很容易。

items.en: They’re part of a bunch of celebrities starring in a new video for World Environment Day – encouraging you, the consumer, to swap out your single-use plastic staples like straws and cutlery to combat the plastics crisis.
items.zh: 他们是一群参与世界环境日新视频拍摄的明星，旨在鼓励你——消费者——将一次性塑料用品如吸管和餐具替换掉，以应对塑料危机。

items.en: The key messages that have been put together for World Environment Day do include a call for governments to enact legislation to curb single-use plastics.
items.zh: 世界环境日提出的关键信息中确实包括呼吁各国政府制定法规以减少一次性塑料的使用。

items.en: But the overarching message is directed at individuals.
items.zh: 但总体信息是针对个人的。

items.en: My concern with leaving it up to the individual, however, is our limited sense of what needs to be achieved.
items.zh: 然而，让我担忧的是，将责任留给个人，我们对需要实现的目标有着有限的认识。

items.en: India has just announced it will “eliminate all single-use plastic in the country by 2022.” There are also incentive-based ways of making better environmental choices easier, such as ensuring recycling is at least as easy as trash disposal.
items.zh: 印度刚刚宣布，它将在2022年前在国内消除所有一次性塑料制品。此外，还有基于激励措施的方法，使更好的环保选择变得更简单，例如确保回收至少和垃圾处理一样方便。

items.en: DeSombre isn’t saying people should stop caring about the environment.
items.zh: 德斯蒙布（DeSombre）并不是说人们应该停止关心环境。

items.en: It’s just that individual actions are too slow, she says, for that to be the only, or even primary, approach to changing widespread behavior.
items.zh: 她说，仅仅依靠个人行为，或者甚至将其作为主要手段，都无法有效改变普遍的行为方式，因为个人行动太慢了。

items.en: None of this is about writing off the individual.
items.zh: 所有这些都不是要否定个人的作用。

items.en: It’s just about putting things into perspective.
items.zh: 只是要让人们从更全面的视角来看待问题。

items.en: We don’t have time to wait.
items.zh: 我们没有时间可以等待。

items.en: We need progressive policies that shape collective action (and rein in polluting businesses), alongside engaged citizens pushing for change.
items.zh: 我们需要推进政策来塑造集体行动（并限制污染企业），同时也要有积极参与的公民推动变革。

items.en: A group of Labour MPs, among them Yvette Cooper, are bringing in the new year with a call to institute a UK "town of culture" award.
items.zh: 一群工党议员，其中包括伊薇特·库珀（Yvette Cooper），正在以设立英国"文化之城"奖项的呼吁，迎接新的一年。

items.en: On their own, taking our own bags to the grocery store or quitting plastic straws, for example, will accomplish little and require very little of us.
items.zh: 仅凭我们自己，比如自带购物袋去杂货店或停止使用塑料吸管，这些行为几乎不会带来什么成效，也几乎不需要我们付出什么。

items.en: They could even be detrimental, satisfying a need to have “done our bit” without ever progressing onto bigger, bolder, more effective actions – a kind of “moral licensing” that allays our concerns and stops us doing more and asking more of those in charge.
items.zh: 它们甚至可能适得其反，满足了我们‘已经尽了一份力’的心理需求，却从未推动我们采取更大胆、更有效的行动——这类似于一种‘道德授权’，减轻了我们的担忧，阻止我们做更多事或对掌权者提出更高要求。

items.en: While the conversation around our environment and our responsibility toward it remains centered on shopping bags and straws, we’re ignoring the balance of power that implies that as “consumers” we must shop sustainably, rather than as “citizens” hold our governments and industries to account to push for real systemic change.
items.zh: 当关于环境和我们对它责任的讨论仍然集中在购物袋和吸管上时，我们却忽视了这种权力平衡所暗示的含义，即作为‘消费者’，我们必须可持续地购物，而不是作为‘公民’去要求政府和企业负责，推动真正的系统性变革。

items.en: It’s important to acknowledge that the environment isn’t everyone’s priority – or even most people’s.
items.zh: 重要的是要承认，环境并不是每个人优先考虑的事情——甚至对大多数人来说也不是。

items.en: We shouldn’t expect it to be.
items.zh: 我们不应该指望它成为每个人的优先事项。

items.en: In her latest book, Why Good People Do Bad Environmental Things, Wellesley College professor Elizabeth R.
items.zh: 在她最新出版的《为什么好人会做坏事：环境行为解析》一书中，韦尔斯利学院教授伊丽莎白·R.

items.en: DeSombre argues that the best way to collectively change the behavior of large numbers of people is for the change to be structural.
items.zh: 德索姆布认为，要集体改变大量人群的行为，最好的方式是进行结构性的改变。

items.en: This might mean implementing policy such as a plastic tax that adds a cost to environmentally problematic action, or banning single-use plastics altogether.
items.zh: 这可能意味着实施诸如对塑料制品征税的政策，使对环境有害的行为付出代价，或者全面禁止一次性塑料制品。

items.en: The H-2A visa has no numerical cap, unlike the H-2B visa for nonagricultural work, which is limited to 66,000 a year.
items.zh: H-2A签证没有人数上限，不像用于非农业工作的H-2B签证每年限定为66,000人。

items.en: Even so, employers complain they aren’t given all the workers they need.
items.zh: 即便如此，雇主们抱怨他们并没有获得所需的所有工人。

items.en: The process is cumbersome, expensive, and unreliable.
items.zh: 这个过程繁琐、昂贵且不可靠。

items.en: One survey found that bureaucratic delays led the average H-2A worker to arrive on the job 22 days late.
items.zh: 一项调查显示，官僚主义的延误导致平均每位H-2A工人晚22天才能上岗。

items.en: The shortage is compounded by federal immigration
items.zh: 劳动力短缺还因联邦移民

items.en: raids, which remove some workers and drive others underground.
items.zh: 突袭行动而加剧，这些行动会驱逐一些工人，迫使其他工人转入地下。

items.en: In a 2012 survey, 71 percent of tree-fruit growers and almost 80 percent of raisin and berry growers said they were short of labor.
items.zh: 在2012年的一项调查中，71%的果树种植者以及近80%的葡萄干和浆果种植者表示他们面临劳动力短缺。

items.en: Some western farmers have responded by moving operations to Mexico.
items.zh: 一些西部的农民对此的回应是将业务转移到墨西哥。

items.en: The proposal is that it should sit alongside the existing city of culture title, which was held by Hull in 2017, and has been awarded to Coventry for 2021.
items.zh: 该提议是让这一称号与现有的“文化之城”头衔并列，后者由胡尔在2017年获得，并已授予考文垂在2021年获得。

items.en: Cooper and her colleagues argue that the success of the crown for Hull, where it brought in £20m of investment and an avalanche of arts, ought not to be confined to cities.
items.zh: 库珀及其同事认为，胡尔获得这一称号的成功，带来了2000万英镑的投资和一场艺术热潮，不应仅限于大城市。

items.en: Britain's towns, it is true, are not prevented from applying, but they generally lack the resources to put together a bid to beat their bigger competitors.
items.zh: 确实，英国的城镇并不被禁止申请，但它们通常缺乏足够的资源来组织一个能击败更大竞争对手的申办方案。

items.en: A town of culture award could, it is argued, become an annual event, attracting funding and creating jobs.
items.zh: 有人认为，文化之城的奖项可以成为一年一度的活动，吸引资金并创造就业机会。

items.en: Some might see the proposal as a booby prize for the fact that Britain is no longer able to apply for the much more prestigious title of European capital of culture, a sought-after award bagged by Glasgow in 1990 and Liverpool in 2008.
items.zh: 一些人可能认为这一提议是英国无法再申请更具声望的“欧洲文化之都”称号的安慰奖，这一奖项曾于1990年由格拉斯哥和2008年由利物浦获得。

items.en: A cynic might speculate that the UK is on the verge of disappearing into an endless fever of self-celebration in its desperation to reinvent itself for the post-Brexit world: after town of culture, who knows what will follow - village of culture?
items.zh: 一个愤世嫉俗者可能会猜测，英国正濒临在脱欧后的世界中不断自我庆祝的狂热边缘：在文化之城之后，谁知道还会有什么接踵而至——文化之村？

items.en: Suburb of culture?
items.zh: 文化之郊区？

items.en: Hamlet of culture?
items.zh: 文化之小村庄？

items.en: It is also wise to recall that such titles are not a cure-all.
items.zh: 也明智的是要记住，这类头衔并不是万能的解决方案。

items.en: A badly run "year of culture" washes in and washes out of a place like the tide, bringing prominence for a spell but leaving no lasting benefits to the community.
items.zh: 管理不善的"文化年"就像潮水一样涌入又退去，一时带来声望，但不会给社区留下持久的益处。

items.en: The really successful holders of such titles are those that do a great deal more than fill hotel bedrooms and bring in high-profile arts events and good press for a year.
items.zh: 真正成功的这类头衔持有者，所做的远不止是填满酒店客房、举办高调的艺术活动和获得良好的媒体报道。

items.en: They transform the aspirations of the people who live there; they nudge the self-image of the city into a bolder and more optimistic light.
items.zh: 它们改变了当地居民的抱负，也促使城市自我形象更加大胆和乐观。

items.en: It is hard to get right, and requires a remarkable degree of vision, as well as cooperation between city authorities, the private sector, community groups and cultural organisations.
items.zh: 要做到这一点很难，需要非凡的远见，以及市政府、私营部门、社区团体和文化组织之间的密切合作。

items.en: But it can be done: Glasgow's year as European capital of culture can certainly be seen as one of a complex series of factors that have turned the city into the powerhouse of art, music and theatre that it remains today.
items.zh: 但这是可以实现的：格拉斯哥作为欧洲文化之都的那一年，无疑可以被视为一系列复杂因素之一，这些因素使这座城市至今仍是艺术、音乐和戏剧的强大力量中心。

items.en: A "town of culture" could be not just about the arts but about honouring a town's peculiarities - helping sustain its high street, supporting local facilities and above all celebrating its people.
items.zh: "文化城镇"不仅仅关乎艺术，还关乎彰显城镇的独特之处——帮助维持其主街商业，支持本地设施，最重要的是庆祝当地居民。

items.en: Jeremy Wright, the culture secretary, should welcome this positive, hope-filled proposal, and turn it into action.
items.zh: 文化大臣杰里米·赖特应该欢迎这一积极、充满希望的提议，并将其付诸行动。

items.en: Scientific publishing has long been a licence to print money.
items.zh: 科学出版长期以来一直是一块印钞机。

items.en: Scientists need journals in which to publish their research, so they will supply the articles without monetary reward.
items.zh: 科学家需要期刊来发表他们的研究成果，因此他们通常会无偿提供文章。

items.en: Other scientists perform the specialised work of peer review also for free, because it is a central element in the acquisition of status and the production of scientific knowledge.
items.zh: 其他科学家也会无偿地进行同行评审这项专业工作，因为这是获取地位和生产科学知识的核心环节。

items.en: With the content of papers secured for free, the publisher needs only find a market for its journal.
items.zh: 在内容已经无偿获得的情况下，出版商只需为其期刊找到一个市场即可。

items.en: Until this century, university libraries were not very price sensitive.
items.zh: 直到本世纪之前，大学图书馆对价格并不十分敏感。

items.en: Scientific publishers routinely report profit margins approaching 40% on their operations at a time when the rest of the publishing industry is in an existential crisis.
items.zh: 在出版行业其他领域正面临生存危机的时期，科学出版商却经常报告其运营利润率接近40%。

items.en: The Dutch giant Elsevier, which claims to publish 25% of the scientific papers produced in the world, made profits of more than £900m last year, while UK universities alone spent more than £210m in 2016 to enable researchers to access their own publicly funded research; both figures seem to rise unstoppably despite increasingly desperate efforts to change them.
items.zh: 荷兰巨头爱思唯尔声称出版了全球25%的科学论文，去年盈利超过9亿英镑，而仅英国大学在2016年就花费了超过2.1亿英镑，以使研究人员能够获取他们自己用公共资金资助的研究成果；尽管人们不断努力改变这一现状，但这两个数字似乎仍在不断攀升。

items.en: The most drastic, and thoroughly illegal, reaction has been the emergence of Sci-Hub, a kind of global photocopier for scientific papers, set up in 2012, which now claims to offer access to every paywalled article published since 2015.
items.zh: 最激烈且完全非法的反应是Sci-Hub的出现，它就像一台全球性的科学论文复印机，成立于2012年，如今声称可以提供自2015年以来所有付费墙后的论文访问权限。

items.en: The success of Sci-Hub, which relies on researchers passing on copies they have themselves legally accessed, shows the legal ecosystem has lost legitimacy among its users and must be transformed so that it works for all participants.
items.zh: Sci-Hub 的成功依赖于研究人员传递他们自己合法获取的副本，这表明现行的法律生态系统在用户眼中已失去合法性，必须进行改革，使其对所有参与者都有效。

items.en: In Britain the move towards open access publishing has been driven by funding bodies.
items.zh: 在英国，向开放获取出版的转变是由资助机构推动的。

items.en: In some ways it has been very successful.
items.zh: 在某些方面，这已经非常成功了。

items.en: More than half of all British scientific research is now published under open access terms: either freely available from the moment of publication, or paywalled for a year or more so that the publishers can make a profit before being placed on general release.
items.zh: 目前，英国超过一半的科学研究都是以开放获取的形式发表的：要么从发表之初就免费提供，要么在一年或更长时间内付费访问，以便出版商在全面开放前获得利润。

items.en: Yet the new system has not yet worked out any cheaper for the universities.
items.zh: 然而，新系统尚未让大学的成本降低。

items.en: Publishers have responded to the demand that they make their product free to readers by charging their writers fees to cover the costs of preparing an article.
items.zh: 出版商为了满足让他们的产品对读者免费的需求，转而向作者收取费用以覆盖文章准备的成本。

items.en: These range from around £500 to $5,000, and apparently the work gets more expensive the more that publishers do it.
items.zh: 这些费用从大约 500 英镑到 5000 美元不等，显然，出版商做得越多，这项工作就越昂贵。

items.en: A report last year pointed out that the costs both of subscriptions and of these "article preparation costs" had been steadily rising at a rate above inflation.
items.zh: 去年的一份报告指出，订阅费用以及这些所谓的 "文章准备成本" 的费用一直在以高于通货膨胀的速度稳步上升。

items.en: In some ways the scientific publishing model resembles the economy of the social internet: labour is provided free in exchange for the hope of status, while huge profits are made by a few big firms who run the market places.
items.zh: 在某些方面，科学出版模式类似于社交互联网的经济模式：人们无偿提供劳动，以换取获得地位的希望，而市场由少数几家大公司掌控，它们却获得了巨大的利润。

items.en: In both cases, we need a rebalancing of power.
items.zh: 在这两种情况下，我们都需要重新平衡权力。

items.en: Progressives often support diversity mandates as a path to equality and a way to level the playing field.
items.zh: 进步派人士通常支持多样性强制规定，将其视为实现平等和平衡竞争环境的途径。

items.en: But all too often such policies are an insincere form of virtue-signaling that benefits only the most privileged and does little to help average people.
items.zh: 但很多时候，这类政策只是虚伪的道德示范形式，只对最 privileged 的群体有利，对普通人帮助甚微。

items.en: A pair of bills sponsored by Massachusetts state Senator Jason Lewis and House Speaker Pro Tempore Patricia Haddad, to ensure "gender parity" on boards and commissions, provide a case in point.
items.zh: 由马萨诸塞州参议员杰森·刘易斯和众议院临时议长帕特里夏·哈达德共同发起的两项法案，旨在确保委员会和董事会的"性别平等"，就是一个典型的例子。

items.en: Haddad and Lewis are concerned that more than half the state-government boards are less than 40 percent female.
items.zh: 哈达德和刘易斯担心，目前超过一半的州政府委员会中女性比例不足40%。

items.en: In order to ensure that elite women have more such opportunities, they have proposed imposing government quotas.
items.zh: 为了确保精英女性拥有更多这样的机会，他们提议实施政府配额。

items.en: If the bills become law, state boards and commissions will be required to set aside 50 percent of board seats for women by 2022.
items.zh: 如果这些法案成为法律，到2022年，州委员会和董事会将被要求将50%的席位保留给女性。

items.en: The bills are similar to a measure recently adopted in California, which last year became the first state to require gender quotas for private companies.
items.zh: 这些法案类似于加利福尼亚州最近通过的一项措施，该州去年成为第一个要求私营公司实行性别配额的州。

items.en: In signing the measure, California Governor Jerry Brown admitted that the law, which expressly classifies people on the basis of sex, is probably unconstitutional.
items.zh: 在签署该措施时，加利福尼亚州州长杰里·布朗承认，这项明确以性别为标准对人进行分类的法律，可能违宪。

items.en: The US Supreme Court frowns on sex-based classifications unless they are designed to address an "important" policy interest.
items.zh: 美国最高法院除非这些性别分类是为了应对一个"重要"的政策利益，否则会反对基于性别的分类。

items.en: Because the California law applies to all boards, even where there is no history of prior discrimination, courts are likely to rule that the law violates the constitutional guarantee of "equal protection".
items.zh: 由于加利福尼亚州的法律适用于所有董事会，即使在没有先前歧视历史的情况下，法院也可能裁定该法律违反宪法中的"平等保护"保证。

items.en: But are such government mandates even necessary?
items.zh: 但这样的政府强制规定是否真的必要呢？

items.en: Female participation on corporate boards may not currently mirror the percentage of women in the general population, but so what?
items.zh: 女性在公司董事会中的参与比例目前可能尚未反映一般人口中女性所占的比例，但这又有什么关系呢？

items.en: The number of women on corporate boards has been steadily increasing without government interference.
items.zh: 在没有政府干预的情况下，女性在公司董事会中的数量一直在稳步增加。

items.en: According to a study by Catalyst, between 2010 and 2015 the share of women on the boards of global corporations increased by 54 percent.
items.zh: 根据Catalyst的一项研究，2010年至2015年间，全球公司董事会中女性所占的比例增加了54%。

items.en: Requiring companies to make gender the primary qualification for board membership will inevitably lead to less experienced private sector boards.
items.zh: 要求公司将性别作为董事会成员资格的主要标准，势必会导致私营部门董事会成员的经验减少。

items.en: That is exactly what happened when Norway adopted a nationwide corporate gender quota.
items.zh: 当挪威全国范围内实施企业性别配额时，这种情况就恰恰发生了。

items.en: Writing in The New Republic, Alice Lee notes that increasing the number of opportunities for board membership without increasing the pool of qualified women to serve on such boards has led to a "golden skirt" phenomenon, where the same elite women scoop up multiple seats on a variety of boards.
items.zh: 《新共和国》杂志的撰稿人艾丽丝·李指出，如果没有增加有资格担任此类董事会成员的女性人数，而只是增加董事会成员的名额，就会导致所谓的"金色裙摆"现象，即同一批精英女性在各种董事会中占据多个席位。

items.en: Next time somebody pushes corporate quotas as a way to promote gender equity, remember that such policies are largely self-serving measures that make their sponsors feel good but do little to help average women.
items.zh: 下次有人推崇企业配额作为促进性别平等的手段时，请记住，这类政策大多是出于自我服务的目的，让政策的推动者感觉良好，但对普通女性的帮助却微乎其微。

items.en: Last Thursday, the French Senate passed a digital services tax, which would impose an entirely new tax on large multinationals that provide digital services to consumers or users in France.
items.zh: 上周四，法国参议院通过了一项数字服务税，该税将对向法国消费者或用户提供数字服务的大型跨国公司征收全新的税款。

items.en: Digital services include everything from providing a platform for selling goods and services online to targeting advertising based on user data, and the tax applies to gross revenue from such services.
items.zh: 数字服务包括从提供在线销售商品和服务的平台到基于用户数据进行定向广告投放的一切内容，而该税适用于此类服务的总收入。

items.en: Many French politicians and media outlets have referred to this as a "GAFA tax," meaning that it is designed to apply primarily to companies such as Google, Apple, Facebook and Amazon - in other words, multinational tech companies based in the United States.
items.zh: 许多法国政界人士和媒体将这项税称为"GAFA税"，这意味着它主要是针对谷歌、苹果、脸书和亚马逊等公司，换句话说，就是美国的跨国科技公司。

items.en: The digital services tax now awaits the signature of President Emmanuel Macron, who has expressed support for the measure, and it could go into effect within the next few weeks.
items.zh: 这项数字服务税现在正等待法国总统埃曼努埃尔·马克龙的签署，他表示支持这一措施，该税可能在接下来的几周内生效。

items.en: But it has already sparked significant controversy, with the United States trade representative opening an investigation into whether the tax discriminates against American companies, which in turn could lead to trade sanctions against France.
items.zh: 但它已经引发了重大争议，美国贸易代表已展开调查，以确定该税收是否对美国公司存在歧视，这反过来可能导致对法国的贸易制裁。

items.en: The French tax is not just a unilateral move by one country in need of revenue.
items.zh: 法国的这项税收不仅仅是某个需要增加收入的国家的单方面举措。

items.en: Instead, the digital services tax is part of a much larger trend, with countries over the past few years proposing or putting in place an alphabet soup of new international tax provisions.
items.zh: 相反，数字服务税是更广泛趋势的一部分，过去几年中，各国提出了或实施了一系列形形色色的新国际税收条款。

items.en: They have included Britain's DPT (diverted profits tax), Australia's MAAL (multinational anti-avoidance law), and India's SEP (significant economic presence) test, to name but a few.
items.zh: 其中包括英国的DPT（转移利润税）、澳大利亚的MAAL（跨国反避税法）和印度的SEP（重大经济存在）测试，仅举几例而已。

items.en: At the same time, the European Union, Spain, Britain and several other countries have all seriously contemplated digital services taxes.
items.zh: 同时，欧盟、西班牙、英国以及多个国家都认真考虑过征收数字服务税。

items.en: These unilateral developments differ in their specifics, but they are all designed to tax multinationals on income and revenue that countries believe they should have a right to tax, even if international tax rules do not grant them that right.
items.zh: 这些单方面举措在具体细节上有所不同，但它们的共同目标是针对跨国公司应税的收入和利润，即使现行国际税收规则并未赋予这些国家相应的征税权利。

items.en: In other words, they all share a view that the international tax system has failed to keep up with the current economy.
items.zh: 换句话说，它们都持有一种观点，即国际税收体系未能跟上当前经济的发展。

items.en: In response to these many unilateral measures, the Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD) is currently working with 131 countries to reach a consensus by the end of 2020 on an international solution.
items.zh: 为应对这些众多的单方面措施，经济合作与发展组织（OECD）目前正在与131个国家合作，力争在2020年底之前就一项国际解决方案达成共识。

items.en: Both France and the United States are involved in the organization's work, but France's digital services tax and the American response raise questions about what the future holds for the international tax system.
items.zh: 法国和美国都参与了该组织的工作，但法国的数字服务税以及美国的应对措施引发了人们对国际税收体系未来走向的疑问。

items.en: France's planned tax is a clear warning: Unless a broad consensus can be reached on reforming the international tax system, other nations are likely to follow suit, and American companies will face a cascade of different taxes from dozens of nations that will prove burdensome and costly.
items.zh: 法国计划征收的这一税种是一个明确的警示：除非在改革国际税收体系方面达成广泛共识，否则其他国家可能会效仿，美国公司将面临来自数十个国家的不同税收，这将带来沉重的负担和高昂的成本。

items.en: Rats and other animals need to be highly attuned to social signals from others so they can identify friends to cooperate with and enemies to avoid.To find out if this extends to non-living beings, Laleh Quinn at the University of California, San Diego, and her colleagues tested whether rats can detect social signals from robotic rats.
items.zh: 老鼠和其他动物需要高度关注来自其他个体的社会信号，这样才能识别出可以合作的朋友和需要避免的敌人。为了弄清楚这种能力是否也适用于非生物，加州大学圣地亚哥分校的拉莱·昆恩（Laleh Quinn）及其同事测试了老鼠是否能够从机器人老鼠身上检测到社会信号。
