items.en: They also looked at genomes from 15 wild equids and 31 earlier donkeys that lived between about 4,000 and 100 years ago.
items.zh: 他们还研究了15种野生马科动物和31种大约生活在4000年前到100年前的早期驴的基因组。

items.en: The team reconstructed the animals' evolutionary tree and used computer models to pinpoint the domestication event, when herders in Kenya and the Horn of Africa tamed wild asses.
items.zh: 该团队重建了这些动物的进化树，并利用计算机模型确定了驯化事件，即大约在肯尼亚和非洲之角的牧民驯服了野驴。

items.en: They then traced how the animals spread across the rest of the continent and into Europe and Asia about 2,500 years later.
items.zh: 随后，他们追踪了这些动物如何在大约2500年后传播到非洲大陆的其他地区，并进入欧洲和亚洲。

items.en: Though it's still unclear why the original domestication happened, Science News' Freda Kreier reports that the event coincided with the Sahara growing larger and drier.
items.zh: 尽管尚不清楚最初的驯化为何发生，但《科学新闻》的弗雷达·克雷尔报道说，这一事件与撒哈拉沙漠变得更大更干燥的时间相吻合。

items.en: Donkeys are champions when it comes to carrying stuff and are good at going through deserts," co-author Ludovic Orlando, an evolutionary biologist at Paul Sabatier University in France, tells the publication.
items.zh: 共同作者、法国图卢兹保罗·萨巴捷大学的进化生物学家卢多维克·奥兰多告诉该出版物："驴在运输货物方面是冠军，而且擅长穿越沙漠。"

items.en: Prehistoric humans may have enlisted donkeys' help in navigating the expanding Sahara.
items.zh: 史前人类可能利用驴的帮助来应对不断扩大的撒哈拉沙漠。

items.en: Researchers say these findings could help put donkeys in the spotlight.
items.zh: 研究人员表示，这些发现可能有助于让驴获得更多关注。

items.en: The animals could benefit from more research: Currently, there are no published genomes from donkeys located south of the equator in Africa.
items.zh: 这些动物需要更多的研究：目前还没有发表来自非洲赤道以南地区的驴的基因组。

items.en: But understanding where the animals were first domesticated could guide archaeologists to a narrower region to search for insights about the original tamed donkeys.
items.zh: 但是了解动物最初在哪里被驯化，可能会引导考古学家在更狭窄的区域内寻找关于最初被驯化的驴的见解。

items.en: Not only does understanding the equines' genetic makeup help reveal their contributions to human history, but it also might improve their management in the future, as climate change alters the planet's environment, write the authors.
items.zh: 作者写道：不仅了解马科动物的基因组成有助于揭示它们对人类历史的贡献，还可能在未来改善它们的管理，因为气候变化正在改变地球的环境。

items.en: There's no business like show business - but in Los Angeles, it feels like there's no business at all.
items.zh: 没有什么生意比演艺业更特别了——但在洛杉矶，感觉好像没有任何生意可做。

items.en: If that sounds melodramatic, consider this: The Art Directors Guild, a labor union representing about 3,000 film workers including set designers, art directors and many other artists, has suspended a training program and issued a statement explaining that "we cannot in good conscience encourage you to pursue our profession while so many of our members remain unemployed.
items.zh: 如果这听起来过于夸张，那么请考虑这一点：艺术指导协会（Art Directors Guild）是一个代表约3000名电影工作者的工会，包括布景设计师、艺术指导和许多其他艺术家，该协会已经暂停了一个培训项目，并发表声明解释说："我们无法本着良知鼓励你们追求这一职业，因为我们的许多成员仍然失业。"

items.en: The guild's pessimism is a reaction to Hollywood's decline, which is reaching a critical point for the industry and Southern California.
items.zh: 该工会的悲观情绪是对好莱坞衰落的反应，而这种衰落对于整个行业和南加州来说，已经达到了关键的转折点。

items.en: Production has been slipping away from Hollywood since the 1950s, but the effects have never been more apparent than at present.
items.zh: 自20世纪50年代以来，影视制作一直在逐渐远离好莱坞，但目前这种影响从未如此明显。

items.en: Other regions in the United States, Canada and Europe have steadily increased incentives to attract TV shows and movies, leaving California in the dust.
items.zh: 美国其他地区、加拿大和欧洲则稳步增加了对电视节目和电影制作的激励措施，使得加州望尘莫及。

items.en: Georgia (which is where many Marvel TV shows and movies are shot) offers up to 30% in transferable tax credits on film and TV production costs, plus an additional 10% increase on the base tax credit if the project includes a Georgia promotional logo.
items.zh: 佐治亚州（许多漫威电视剧和电影都在这里拍摄）为影视和电视制作成本提供高达30%的可转移税收抵免，如果项目包含佐治亚州的宣传标志，还可额外增加10%的基础税收抵免。

items.en: Actors, directors and crew prefer to stay close to their homes in Los Angeles to film, but it's hard for studios to pass up getting a third of their money back if they film outside of California.
items.zh: 演员、导演和剧组成员更倾向于在洛杉矶本地拍摄，但对制片公司来说，如果在加州以外的地方拍摄，他们很难放弃获得三分之一制作成本返还的机会。

items.en: Even as California lost a huge volume of production to other locations, there was still plenty of film production taking place in Los Angeles before this year - sufficient work that many people could make a living in the industry.
items.zh: 即使加州今年失去了大量影视制作业务，转移到了其他拍摄地，在此之前洛杉矶的影视制作量仍然非常充足，足以让许多人在这个行业谋生。

items.en: We were kept afloat by "peak TV", the glut of content that was required by the explosion of streaming services.
items.zh: 我们得以维持下去，是因为有"电视高峰期"，即流媒体服务的爆炸式增长所要求的大量内容供应。

items.en: If productions in Southern California dip below a critical level for too long, the industry's essential talent will drift away along with enormous sums of revenue.
items.zh: 如果南加州的影视制作长时间低于关键水平，这个行业所依赖的核心人才将会流失，同时带来巨额收入的减少。

items.en: Persuading studios to film here would become much more challenging if we couldn't offer a deep bench of local film workers, on-screen talent and local businesses that support the entertainment industry.
items.zh: 如果我们无法提供充足的本地影视工作人员、银幕人才以及支持娱乐产业的本地企业，要说服制片公司在这里拍摄将会变得困难得多。

items.en: That's why the California Film Commission and its Los Angeles counterpart, Film LA, now should act now, before it's too late.
items.zh: 这就是为什么加州电影委员会和其洛杉矶的对应机构Film LA现在必须立即采取行动，否则为时已晚。

items.en: These agencies and other government bodies should dramatically improve incentives to keep our current shows and attract new productions to Los Angeles.
items.zh: 这些机构和其他政府机构应大幅提高激励措施，以留住现有的影视制作项目，并吸引新的制作来到洛杉矶。

items.en: Let's go on with the show... and make sure the show doesn't go on without us.
items.zh: 让我们继续制作节目……并确保节目不会在我们缺席的情况下继续进行。

items.en: The pioneers of wireless saw it as a gift to all the people.
items.zh: 无线技术的先驱们将其视为一份馈赠，献给所有的人。

items.en: The BBC director-general Sir John Reith said that it would dispel "isolation of the spirit" and rejoiced: "It does not matter how many thousands may be listening, there is always enough for others...the genius and the fool, the wealthy and the poor listen simultaneously.
items.zh: 英国广播公司（BBC）总干事约翰·赖斯爵士（Sir John Reith）表示，它能够消除"精神上的孤立"，并欣喜地说："无论有多少人正在收听，总会有足够的内容供其他人享用……天才与愚人、富人与穷人可以同时聆听。"

items.en: Between two great wars this technological innovation built a new kind of national consciousness.
items.zh: 两次世界大战之间，这项技术创新塑造了一种新型的民族意识。

items.en: Opening this week, a book and exhibition curated by Beatty Rubens at the Bodleian in Oxford records how radio changed everyday life from 1922 to 1939, as primitive crystal-and-wire devices evolved into sunburst-grille boxes.
items.zh: 本周开幕的一本书和展览由贝蒂·鲁本斯（Beatty Rubens）在牛津大学博德利图书馆（Bodleian）策划，记录了从1922年到1939年间，无线电如何改变日常生活，当时原始的矿石收音机和线圈装置逐渐演变为带有太阳光芒状格栅的收音机箱。

items.en: She draws on letters, diaries and fiction, and a 1939 field notebook of verbatim audience research by Winifred Gill.
items.zh: 她引用了信件、日记、小说，以及温妮弗雷德·吉尔（Winifred Gill）于1939年撰写的实地听众研究的逐字笔记。

items.en: There's fun in testimonies of people enjoying the sheer newness.
items.zh: 人们享受这种全新事物的证词中充满了趣味。

items.en: A cartoon mocks a group failing to converse because they're all in headphones.
items.zh: 一幅漫画讽刺了一群人因都戴着耳机而无法交谈。

items.en: People report that broadcast music made workmen whistle new tunes.
items.zh: 人们报告说，广播音乐让工人哼起了新的曲调。

items.en: Tipping has always been a vital source of income for workers in historically tipped services, like restaurants, where the tipped minimum wage can be as low as US $2.
items.zh: 小费一直是历史上依赖小费服务行业工人的重要收入来源，比如在餐馆中，小费最低工资可以低至2美元。

items.en: Tip creep and tip flation are now further supplementing the income of many low-wage service workers.
items.zh: 小费上涨和小费膨胀现在进一步补充了众多低薪服务业工人的收入。

items.en: Notably, tipping primarily benefits some of these workers, such as cooks and dishwashers.
items.zh: 值得注意的是，小费主要使其中一些工人受益，例如厨师和洗碗工。

items.en: To ensure that all employees were paid fair wages, some restaurants banned tipping and increased prices, but this movement toward no-tipping services has largely fizzled out.
items.zh: 为了确保所有员工都能获得公平的工资，一些餐厅禁止小费并提高了价格，但这种向无小费服务转型的运动大多已经偃旗息鼓了。

items.en: When it was established, the National Health service (NHS) was visionary: offering high-quality, timely care to meet the dominant needs of the population it served/Nearly 75 years on; with the UK facing very different health challenges, it is clear that model is out of date.
items.zh: 当国家卫生服务（NHS）建立时，它具有前瞻性：提供高质量、及时的医疗服务，以满足其所服务人口的主要需求；将近75年过去了，随着英国面临截然不同的健康挑战，很明显，这一模式已经过时。

items.en: From life expectancy to cancer and infant mortality rates, we are lagging behind many of our peers/With more than 6.8 million on waitlists, healthcare is becoming increasingly inaccessible for those who can not opt to pay for private treatment; and the cost of providing healthcare is increasingly squeezed out investment in other public services/ As demand for healthcare continues to grow, pressures on the workforce-which is already near breaking point-will only become more acute.
items.zh: 从预期寿命到癌症和婴儿死亡率，我们在许多同行国家中都处于落后地位；有超过680万人在候诊名单上，对于那些无法选择自费接受治疗的人来说，医疗保健正变得越来越难以获得；同时，提供医疗保健的成本正日益被挤占，导致对其他公共服务的投资减少。随着对医疗保健的需求持续增长，医疗工作者队伍——目前已接近崩溃边缘——所面临的压力只会变得更加严峻。

items.en: Many of the answers to the crisis in health and care are well rehearsed./We need to be much better at reducing and diverting demand on health services, rather than simply managing it./Much more needs to be
items.zh: 健康和护理危机的许多答案都已经反复讨论过了。/我们需要在减少和转移对医疗服务的需求方面做得更好，而不仅仅是管理需求。/还需要做更多的事情

items.en: invested in communities and primary care to reduce our reliance on hospital's/And capacity in social care needs to be greater, to support the growing number of people living with long-term conditions.
items.zh: 投资于社区和初级护理，以减少我们对医院的依赖。/社会护理的容量需要更大，以支持越来越多患有慢性病的人群。

items.en: By and large the wireless was welcome.
items.zh: 总的来说，无线广播是受欢迎的。

items.en: I loved the chap from the Thirties research who found that wireless suddenly offered "a lot of variety...things I thought I'd never be interested in...ice hockey, perhaps".
items.zh: 我特别喜欢来自三十年代研究的那位先生，他发现无线广播突然提供了"很多多样性……一些我原本认为自己永远不会感兴趣的东西……比如冰球"。

items.en: True: for more than 80 pre-digital years, linear speech broadcasting brought the gift of serendipity, random enlivenings of a car journey or dull manual task.
items.zh: 事实确实如此：在数字时代来临之前的80多年里，线性语音广播带来了偶然发现的礼物，为汽车旅行或单调的手工劳动增添了随机的趣味。

items.en: In my own book about radio I recorded how, on one drive: "I caught up with the news, learnt some 17th-century history, and was startlingly educated by an unpretentious programme on the history of the stethoscope.
items.zh: 在我的关于广播的书中，我记录了一次驾车经历："我及时获取了新闻，了解了一些17世纪的历史，并被一个关于听诊器历史的平实节目惊人地教育了一番。"

items.en: But radio's enriching serendipity is ebbing.
items.zh: 但广播带来的丰富偶然性正在消退。

items.en: With multiple networks, BBC Sounds and countless podcasts, a smartphone user selects what to hear and when.
items.zh: 随着多个网络、BBC Sounds以及无数播客的出现，智能手机用户可以自由选择何时听什么内容。

items.en: And while it is wonderful to take a walk with anything in your headphones, infinite choice encourages us to shrink into niche interests and sympathetic beliefs.
items.zh: 虽然戴着耳机散步时可以听到任何想要的内容，但无限的选择促使我们退缩到狭隘的兴趣和相似的观点中。

items.en: A hundred years on from Marconi and Reith, is the art of mere listening endangered?
items.zh: 自马可尼和赖特（Reith）时代以来的一百年，单纯的倾听艺术是否正面临威胁？

items.en: Navigating beyond the organised pavements and parks of our urban spaces, desire paths are the unofficial footprints of a community, revealing the unspoken preferences, shared shortcuts and collective choices of humans.
items.zh: 在城市空间中，当我们走出有组织的步道和公园时，欲望小径是社区的非正式足迹，揭示了人类未言明的偏好、共享的捷径和集体的选择。

items.en: Often appearing as trodden dirt tracks through otherwise neat green spaces, these routes of collective disobedience cut corners, bisect
items.zh: 这些集体不服从的路线常常以踩踏过的泥地小径的形式出现在原本整洁的绿色空间中，它们绕开角落，穿过中间

items.en: lawns and cross hills, representing the natural capability of people (and animals) to go from point A to point B most effectively.
items.zh: 草坪和交叉的山丘，代表着人们（以及动物）最有效地从A点到达B点的自然能力。

items.en: Ohio State University allowed its students to navigate the Oval, a lawn in the centre of campus, freely, then proceeded to pave the desire paths, creating a web of effective routes students had established.
items.zh: 俄亥俄州立大学允许其学生自由地在校园中心的草坪‘Oval’上行走，随后却将学生自行开辟的有效路线铺设成了柏油路，形成了一张路线网络。

items.en: Yet, reluctance persists among other planners to integrate desire paths into formal plans, citing concerns about safety, environmental impact, or primarily, aesthetics.
items.zh: 然而，其他规划者仍不愿将愿望路径纳入正式规划中，他们引用了对安全、环境影响或主要是美观方面的担忧。

items.en: A Reddit webpage devoted to the phenomenon, boasting nearly 50,000 members, showcases images of local desire paths adorned with signs instructing pedestrians to adhere to designated walkways, underscoring the rebellious nature inherent in these human-made tracks.
items.zh: 一个专门讨论这一现象的Reddit网页，拥有近5万名成员，展示了当地欲望小径的照片，并附有指示行人遵守指定步道的标志，突显了这些人为路径中固有的叛逆性质。

items.en: This clash highlights an ongoing struggle between the organic, user-driven evolution of public spaces and the desire for a visually curated and controlled urban environment.
items.zh: 这次冲突凸显了公共空间有机的、由用户驱动的演变与人们对视觉上精心策划和控制的城市环境的渴望之间的持续斗争。

items.en: The Wickquasgeck Trail is an example of a historical desire path, created by Native Americans to cross the forests of Manhattan and move between settlements quickly.
items.zh: wickquasgeck小径是一个历史上的欲望小径的例子，由美洲原住民创建，用于穿越曼哈顿的森林，并在各定居点之间快速移动。

items.en: The fact that fires happened so often meant they couldn't have been severe enough to kill most trees.
items.zh: 火灾频繁发生这一事实意味着它们并未严重到足以杀死大多数树木的程度。

items.en: Instead, a growing body of research showed that frequent, low-severity fires made many ecosystems healthier.
items.zh: 相反，越来越多的研究表明，频繁但强度较低的火灾实际上使许多生态系统更加健康。

items.en: They rid the forest of dead and sick trees, reducing competition and curbing the spread of disease.
items.zh: 它们清除了森林中的枯死和病弱树木，减少了竞争并遏制了疾病的传播。

items.en: Because flammable material couldn't build up on the landscape, blazes tended to move slowly and peter out when they reached the footprints of previous burns.
items.zh: 由于可燃物无法在地表堆积，火灾往往蔓延缓慢，并在到达之前烧过的区域时逐渐减弱。

items.en: In 2022, Swetnam and other scientists teamed up to compile a database of fire-scarred trees from across the continent.
items.zh: 2022年，Swetnam与其他科学家合作，编制了一个涵盖整个大陆的火疤树木数据库。

items.en: Their North American tree-ring fire-scar network (NAFSN) provided the basis for a study published last month.
items.zh: 他们的北美树木年轮火疤网络（NAFSN）为上个月发表的一项研究提供了基础。

items.en: In the study, the researchers compared the historical fire cadence with the wildfires recorded over the past few decades, and uncovered a striking shortfall.
items.zh: 在这项研究中，研究人员将历史上的火灾频率与过去几十年记录的野火进行了比较，发现了一个显著的不足之处。

items.en: The NAFSN sites experienced less than a quarter of the number of fires that would have been expected without fire suppression.
items.zh: NAFSN的监测点经历的火灾数量不到没有火灾压制情况下预期数量的四分之一。

items.en: Some will say the audiobook boom revives it, though I suppose you can then worry about the decline of reading.
items.zh: 有些人会说，有声书的兴起挽救了阅读，不过我想你也可以因此担心阅读习惯的衰落。

items.en: But inventions shape all of us and it is worth noticing when techno-social habits do change, and asking whether to control them a bit or shield the youngest.
items.zh: 但发明影响着我们所有人，当技术社会习惯发生变化时，值得我们关注，并思考是否应该稍微控制一下，或者保护最年幼的一代。

items.en: Innovation will happen.
items.zh: 创新总会发生。

items.en: Today we fret about the isolating culture of smartphone-staring and selfie-vanity, but already in 1939 there was that lady regretting how, when all her street got wireless, it lost the neighbourly habit of "talking on the brush handle".
items.zh: 如今我们担忧的是智能手机带来的孤立文化以及自拍的虚荣心态，但早在1939年，就有一位女士后悔地说，当她所在的街区都装上了收音机后，人们就失去了在院子里拿着扫帚柄聊天的邻里习惯。

items.en: It's enough to make a person put down the smartphone and go out front with a yard broom.
items.zh: 这足以让人放下智能手机，拿起院子里的扫帚走出去。

items.en: When Tom Swetnam joined the u.s. Forest Service in the 1970s, his mandate was to "put everything out," he recalled.
items.zh: 当汤姆·斯威特纳姆在1970年代加入美国林业局时，他的任务是“把所有东西都扑灭”，他回忆道。

items.en: But when Swetnam enrolled in graduate school at the University of Arizona's Laboratory of Tree-Ring Research, he was surprised to find a record of repeated blazes dating back hundreds of years before European colonists arrived on the continent.
items.zh: 但当斯威特纳姆进入亚利桑那大学的树木年轮研究实验室读研究生时，他惊讶地发现，早在欧洲殖民者到达大陆数百年之前，就有重复的火灾记录。

items.en: Some of the trees he analyzed bore more than 20 fire scars among their rings.
items.zh: 他分析的一些树木，在年轮中留下了超过20处的火灾疤痕。

items.en: This deficit is a testament to the effectiveness of modern firefighting, said Kelly Martin, a past president of the International Association of Wildland Fire.
items.zh: 凯利·马丁表示，国际荒野火灾协会前会长称，这一赤字证明了现代消防的有效性。

items.en: Yet the combined consequences of suppression and climate change have eroded humanity's ability to suppress fires, particularly those that ignite under the most dangerous weather conditions.
items.zh: 然而，压制火灾和气候变化的综合后果已经削弱了人类在最危险天气条件下压制火灾的能力。

items.en: To prevent entire ecosystems from going up in smoke, Martin said, people must bring healthy fire back to places that need it.
items.zh: 马丁说，为了防止整个生态系统被烧毁，人们必须将健康的火灾带回那些需要的地方。

items.en: At Yosemite National Park, Martin oversaw the use of what is known as prescribed burns to make the landscape more resilient.
items.zh: 在约塞米蒂国家公园，马丁负责使用所谓的计划性燃烧，使景观更具韧性。

items.en: These fires were carefully planned and intentionally ignited during periods when weather kept the blazes easy to control, and helped eliminate some of the fuel that had built up around the important park's facilities.
items.zh: 这些火灾是在天气条件使得火势易于控制的时期，经过精心计划并有意点燃的，有助于清除公园重要设施周围的燃料积累。

items.en: Research shows that these prescribed burns make subsequent wildfires less severe, even if later fires happen under the most dangerous weather conditions.
items.zh: 研究表明，即使后来的火灾发生在最危险的天气条件下，这些计划性燃烧也能减轻随后野火的严重程度。

items.en: Yet even as scientists and public officials increasingly agree on the need for more fires in our forests, climate change is making this tactic more challenging, experts said.
items.zh: 然而，专家们指出，尽管科学家和公共官员越来越认同需要在我们的森林中引入更多火灾，但气候变化正在使这一策略变得更加困难。

items.en: It's a double-edged sword because wildfires are getting more severe and larger under climate change and we need this work even more, but then the work gets more challenging," said Susan Prichard, a fire ecologist at the University of Washington.
items.zh: 华盛顿大学的火灾生态学家苏珊·普里查德表示：'这是一种双刃剑，因为气候变化使野火变得更加严重和大规模，我们更需要这项工作，但与此同时，这项工作也变得更加困难。'

items.en: The review recommends a national branding campaign to
items.zh: 该审查建议开展全国性的品牌宣传活动以

items.en: give libraries a stronger physical presence, the reintroduction of a scheme to enable members to use their card in any library in the country, and automatic memberships for children.
items.zh: 增强图书馆的实体存在感，重新推出一项计划使会员能够在本国任何一家图书馆使用他们的借书卡，并为儿童提供自动会员资格。

items.en: If we don’t use them, we will end up losing them.
items.zh: 如果我们不使用它们，最终就会失去它们。

items.en: And for those who haven’t been to a library for some time, they may be surprised by what they find.
items.zh: 而对于那些已经有一段时间没有去过图书馆的人来说，他们可能会对所发现的内容感到惊讶。

items.en: According to our research, around one in five workers in the UK talk to AI like a friend, looking for guidance on personal and professional problems.
items.zh: 根据我们的研究，英国大约五分之一的工人会像对待朋友一样与人工智能交谈，寻求关于个人和职业问题的指导。

items.en: Our data shows that engaging with AI like this can leave us feeling heard and less isolated.
items.zh: 我们的数据显示，以这种方式与人工智能互动，会让我们感到被倾听，减少孤独感。

items.en: But, with this newfound connection, many of us share sensitive, sometimes highly confidential information, even though over a third of people don’t realise that AI
items.zh: 但是，随着这种新建立的联系，我们中许多人会分享敏感信息，有时甚至是高度机密的信息，尽管超过三分之一的人并没有意识到人工智能

items.en: platforms may not be very good at keeping our secrets.
items.zh: 平台可能并不擅长保守我们的秘密。

items.en: Ask people about public libraries and a certain image springs to mind: dusty, old-fashioned, the sort of place you enjoyed as a child but, rather like a British seaside town, would you go there now?
items.zh: 如果问人们关于公共图书馆的看法，脑海中会浮现出某种形象：灰尘满布、古板陈旧，是那种小时候喜欢去但现在却不太愿意再去的地方，就像英国的海滨小镇一样。

items.en: And anyway-aren’t they all closing?
items.zh: 再说，难道不是所有的图书馆都在关闭吗？

items.en: The reality is startlingly different, as I discovered when the culture department commissioned me to conduct an independent review of English public libraries, published yesterday.
items.zh: 现实情况却令人吃惊地不同，当我受文化部门委托，对英格兰的公共图书馆进行独立审查并发表于昨天的报告中所发现的那样。

items.en: As I visited libraries up and down the country, I was surprised to learn there are more than twice the number of libraries (2,892) as there are branches of McDonald’s.
items.zh: 当我走访全国各地的图书馆时，惊讶地发现图书馆的数量（2892家）是麦当劳分店数量的两倍多。

items.en: Enter any one of them and you will find a hive of activity, while books are, and should always be, at the heart of any library, a multitude of other services are offered: employment advice, language classes or digital access and support.
items.zh: 走进其中任何一个图书馆，你会发现那里充满着各种活动，虽然书籍始终应该是图书馆的核心，但还有许多其他服务可供使用：就业咨询、语言课程或数字接入与支持。

items.en: There are libraries with business and intellectual property centres, which can help business owners and entrepreneurs.
items.zh: 有些图书馆设有商业和知识产权中心，可以帮助业主和创业者。

items.en: Many have nurses on site to carry out basic health checks, with a link to the GP’s surgery, there are libraries where young people can borrow a Fifa-standard football free.
items.zh: 许多图书馆还配有护士，可以进行基础健康检查；有些图书馆则与全科医生诊所相连，年轻人还可以免费借到符合国际足联标准的足球。

items.en: In return for all of this, you’ll be asked for precisely nothing.
items.zh: 作为回报，你将被要求什么都不做。

items.en: There will be no charge and you will never be asked to justify or explain yourself, you will simply be welcomed in, offered help if you need it, and left alone if you do not.
items.zh: 不会有任何费用，你也不会被要求为自己辩护或解释，你将被简单地欢迎进入，如果你需要帮助就会被提供帮助，如果你不需要，也会被允许独自安静地待着。

items.en: There is no other institution, public or private, that can say the same.
items.zh: 没有其他任何公共或私人机构能做出这样的承诺。

items.en: Yet still our libraries are often overlooked and underappreciated.
items.zh: 然而，我们的图书馆却常常被忽视和低估。

items.en: There is an overall decline in visits and many are struggling as local authorities come under continued financial pressure.
items.zh: 参观人数总体呈下降趋势，许多图书馆正因地方政府持续面临的财政压力而艰难维持。

items.en: The number of libraries that have closed since 2010 is disputed.
items.zh: 自2010年以来关闭的图书馆数量存在争议。

items.en: An annual survey by the Chartered Institute of Public Finance and Accountancy puts it at nearly 800 across the UK; official statistics held by the Arts Council record 230 in England.
items.zh: 英国特许公共金融与会计协会的一项年度调查显示，全英关闭的图书馆接近800家；而艺术委员会保存的官方统计数据则显示，仅在英格兰就有230家。

items.en: It is, of course, 230 libraries too many.
items.zh: 当然，这230家关闭的图书馆数量也太多了。

items.en: So if we are to protect our libraries for future generations, we must raise awareness of them and the work they do.
items.zh: 因此，如果我们想要为子孙后代保护好我们的图书馆，就必须提高人们对图书馆及其所做工作的认识。

items.en: For business, the implications are worrying.
items.zh: 对企业来说，这些影响令人担忧。

items.en: Consider Microsoft Copilot, for example.
items.zh: 例如，考虑微软的Copilot。

items.en: It gains Microsoft broad rights to the data inputted or outputted by any user – rights to use this data in any way it sees fit; it can even share it with third parties.
items.zh: 它获得了任何用户输入或输出数据的广泛使用权——可以以任何方式使用这些数据；甚至可以将其与第三方共享。

items.en: This means that any sensitive business information could potentially be exposed to the world.
items.zh: 这意味着任何敏感的商业信息都可能被公之于众。

items.en: Employers are taking note and taking action.
items.zh: 雇主们已经注意到这一点并采取了行动。

items.en: According to our research, 25% have decided to either outright ban AI or regulate its use within their organisations.
items.zh: 根据我们的研究，25%的企业已经决定要么完全禁止使用人工智能，要么在其组织内部对其使用进行规范。

items.en: But even with these policies in place, some employees choose to break the rules.
items.zh: 但即使有了这些政策，一些员工仍会选择违反规定。

items.en: They have their reasons – around 63% of them report that using AI increases their productivity, and some even feel AI offers more help than their human colleagues.
items.zh: 他们有自己的理由——大约63%的员工表示使用人工智能能提高他们的工作效率，有些人甚至觉得人工智能比他们的同事提供的帮助更多。

items.en: The situation presents a delicate balance between leveraging AI for its productivity gains and risking confidential data exposure.
items.zh: 这种情况在利用人工智能实现生产力提升与冒着泄露机密数据的风险之间呈现出一种微妙的平衡。

items.en: Employers need to manage AI tools with the same level of care as any other form of data sharing or storage.
items.zh: 雇主需要像对待其他任何形式的数据共享或存储一样，谨慎管理人工智能工具。

items.en: There's also a knowledge gap that needs to be addressed — 40% of individuals surveyed are unsure about
items.zh: 还存在一个需要解决的知识鸿沟——40%的受访者不清楚

items.en: who retains ownership over the content produced by AI.
items.zh: 人工智能生成的内容所有权归谁所有。

items.en: By instilling best practices in AI engagement and creating policies that evolve with the technology, business can positively shift the AI landscape.
items.zh: 通过在人工智能参与中推行最佳实践，并制定与技术发展同步的政策，企业可以积极改变人工智能的发展格局。

items.en: With AI's potential to simplify our professional lives, do the admin and enhance the work experience.
items.zh: 人工智能有潜力简化我们的职业生活，进行管理并提升工作体验。

items.en: It's up to us to navigate its usage cautiously so it supports us without compromising our privacy.
items.zh: 我们必须谨慎地驾驭其使用，使其在不损害我们隐私的前提下支持我们。

items.en: There's no need to back away from progress, as long as we're equipped with the knowledge and tools to make sure AI remains a friend.
items.zh: 只要我们具备相关知识和工具，确保人工智能始终是我们的朋友，就没有必要退缩于进步。

items.en: Head on holiday, which matters for business in a country where tourism accounts for 10 percent of GDP.
items.zh: 人们前往度假，这对一个旅游业占GDP 10%的国家的商业活动至关重要。

items.en: Disruptions have become increasingly frequent with train delays now a fixture in Italian media coverage.
items.zh: 中断情况如今在意大利媒体报道中已成为常态，发生的频率也日益增加。

items.en: Ferrovie dello Stato Italiane, the publicly controlled group that owns train operator Trenitalia and the national train network RFI, said 23 percent of all high-speed trains it operated were late in 2023.
items.zh: 意大利国有铁路集团Ferrovie dello Stato Italiane表示，2023年其运营的高速列车中有23%出现延误。

items.en: The huge investments in Italy's obsolete infrastructure partly explained the disruption, said Ferrovie.
items.zh: Ferrovie表示，对意大利过时基础设施的巨大投资部分解释了这种中断现象。

items.en: RFI, the network operator, is the single largest European recovery fund
items.zh: 网络运营商RFI是欧洲复苏基金的最大受益者。

items.en: beneficiary with planned investments of €24bn by 2026.
items.zh: 计划到2026年投资240亿欧元。

items.en: Ferrovie will invest a total of €124bn in infrastructure over the next 10 years.
items.zh: Ferrovie将在未来10年内对基础设施投资总计1240亿欧元。

items.en: But lack of capacity is another problem.
items.zh: 但运力不足是另一个问题。

items.en: And this is where the challenge lies.
items.zh: 问题就出在这里。

items.en: There are so many products out there, being promoted with huge advertising and marketing budgets, that it's easy to fall victim.
items.zh: 市场上有这么多产品，它们都投入了巨额的广告和营销预算进行推广，很容易让人上当受骗。

items.en: But by building a culture of digital responsibility within our business, we can create a future where AI can help us without spilling the beans.
items.zh: 但如果我们能在企业内部建立起数字责任文化，就能创造一个未来，在这个未来中，人工智能可以为我们提供帮助，而不会泄露秘密。

items.en: Since the 2008 launch of the high-speed rail network between Rome and Milan, trains have become the preferred means of travel across Italy for locals and tourists alike.
items.zh: 自2008年罗马至米兰高速铁路网络开通以来，火车已成为意大利本地居民和游客出行的首选方式。

items.en: Fast trains can cover the 500km between the two cities in three hours.
items.zh: 高速列车可以在三小时内完成两地之间500公里的行程。

items.en: The network also connects Naples, Bologna, Florence and Turin.
items.zh: 该网络还连接了那不勒斯、博洛尼亚、佛罗伦萨和都灵。

items.en: In many cases, it is the best option — in terms of travel time and cost— for both leisure and business travellers.
items.zh: 在许多情况下，它在出行时间和成本方面都是休闲旅客和商务旅客的最佳选择。

items.en: This is why the recent severe delays caused by numerous maintenance works have thrown the rail industry into chaos at a time when most people
items.zh: 这就是为什么最近由于大量维护工作导致的严重延误，在大多数人需要出行的时候，使铁路行业陷入了混乱。

items.en: scale back the footprint of the fest.
items.zh: 缩减节日的规模。

items.en: We are eliminating a stage, booking fewer performers and making additional cuts to reduce our costs, all while striving to keep the festival as vibrant as ever, as supportive of local artists and businesses, and as true to Wicker Park’s unique spirit and reputation as festgoers have come to expect.
items.zh: 我们正在取消一个舞台，预订更少的表演者，并做出额外的削减以降低成本，同时努力保持节日一如既往的活力，一如既往地支持本地艺术家和企业，一如既往地体现威克公园独特的精神和声誉，这是参加节日活动的观众所期待的。

items.en: This summer, as you enjoy your favorite neighborhood street festival, I hope you’ll remember that they exist because of community support.
items.zh: 这个夏天，当你享受你最喜欢的社区街头节日时，我希望你能记住，这些节日之所以存在，是因为有社区的支持。

items.en: A thriving summer festival season doesn’t happen by accident; It happens when we all chip in.
items.zh: 一个繁荣的夏季节日季并非偶然发生；它是在我们所有人共同努力的情况下才实现的。

items.en: Transport economist Andrea Giuricin said the planned investments would bring improvements but disruptions in the meantime were inevitable.
items.zh: 运输经济学家安德里亚·吉乌里钦表示，计划中的投资将带来改进，但在此过程中出现中断是不可避免的。

items.en: We have a mixed system, there is no spare capacity and as soon as there’s a hiccup on the line, the situation becomes highly complex,” he said.
items.zh: 我们有一个混合系统，没有备用容量，一旦线路出现一点小问题，情况就会变得非常复杂，”他说。

items.en: A mixed system means that high-speed trains must travel on the regular tracks on certain routes or when passing through large cities.
items.zh: 混合系统意味着高速列车在某些路线或经过大城市时必须在普通轨道上行驶。

items.en: If there’s congestion or, for example, a local train breaks down, the entire high-speed network is affected.
items.zh: 如果出现拥堵，或者例如一列地方列车发生故障，整个高速网络都会受到影响。

items.en: One of the most important changes the upgrades will bring is the segregation of the high-speed line from the regular one in certain urban centres through the construction of underground rail links.
items.zh: 升级带来的最重要的变化之一是在某些城市中心通过建设地下铁路连接，将高速线路与普通线路分隔开来。

items.en: Improvements will also come from the high-density technology and satellite signalling that RFI has been investing in for years, say experts.
items.zh: 专家表示，改进还将来自于RFI多年来投资的高密度技术和卫星信号系统。

items.en: It will allow for a reduction of the distance between high-speed trains travelling on the same line at any given time, which should mean a significant increase in
items.zh: 这将允许在同一时间线路上运行的高速列车之间的距离减少，这意味着容量和交通流畅度将显著增加

items.en: capacity and traffic fluidity, according to Giuricin.
items.zh: 据吉乌里钦称。

items.en: In 2023, Chicago lost one of its most beloved street festivals.
items.zh: 2023年，芝加哥失去了其最受欢迎的街头节日之一。

items.en: The Silver Room Block Party, staged by Hyde Park community leader Eric Williams, announced it would not return in 2024.
items.zh: 由海德公园社区领袖埃里克·威廉姆斯主办的银室街区派对宣布2024年不会再次举办。

items.en: What began as a small neighborhood gathering blossomed into a massive cultural event welcoming tens of thousands of people each year over nearly two decades before abruptly shutting down.
items.zh: 这个最初只是一个小社区聚会的活动，在近二十年的时间里逐渐发展成为一项吸引数万人参加的大型文化活动，但最终却突然关闭了。

items.en: Williams pointed to rising production costs and declining attendee donations as primary reasons the Silver Room Block Party could not continue, highlighting a reality that all street festival organizers face right now.
items.zh: 威廉姆斯指出，由于制作成本上升和参与者捐款减少，银室街区派对无法继续举办，这凸显了当前所有街头节日组织者所面临的现实问题。

items.en: The cost of producing a street festival in Chicago has skyrocketed.
items.zh: 在芝加哥举办一场街头节日的成本已经急剧上升。

items.en: Security, entertainment, portable restrooms, insurance and even basics
items.zh: 安全、娱乐、移动厕所、保险，甚至一些基本项目

items.en: such as fencing and staffing have all become significantly more expensive.
items.zh: 如围栏和人员配备，都已经变得显著更加昂贵。

items.en: At the same time, donations at festival gates have dropped dramatically.
items.zh: 与此同时，节日现场的捐款也大幅下降。

items.en: Chicago’s summer festivals are about more than just entertainment; they are economic engines that directly benefit the neighborhoods they’re in and the city of Chicago as a whole.
items.zh: 芝加哥的夏季节庆不仅仅是娱乐活动；它们是经济引擎，直接惠及所在社区以及整个芝加哥市。

items.en: Street festivals drive foot traffic to local businesses and foster the kind of cultural vibrancy that makes our city special.
items.zh: 街头节庆能带动本地商家的人流量，并培育出使我们的城市独具特色的一种文化活力。

items.en: We often hear people ask why we solicit donations at our entry points, especially when the city’s largest festivals like the Chicago Jazz Festival do not request donations.
items.zh: 我们经常听到有人问，为什么我们在入口处征集捐款，尤其是在像芝加哥爵士音乐节这样的大型节庆并不请求捐款时。

items.en: The fact is, unlike those large, city-produced music festivals, your neighborhood street festivals receive no city funding and rely on a combination of sponsorships, vendor fees and gate donations to cover their costs.
items.zh: 事实上，与那些由市政府主办的大型音乐节庆不同，你的社区街头节庆并未获得任何市政府资金支持，而是依靠赞助、摊位费用和入场捐款的组合来覆盖成本。

items.en: Wicker Park Fest has long been one of Chicago’s most anticipated summer festivals, drawing upward of 70,000 attendees for a full weekend of live indie music, local art, small business vendors and, most importantly, community connection.
items.zh: 威克帕克节长期以来一直是芝加哥最受期待的夏季节庆之一，周末期间吸引多达70,000名参与者，享受现场独立音乐、本地艺术、小型商家摊位以及最重要的社区联系。

items.en: In 2024, Wicker Park Fest saw record-breaking attendance.
items.zh: 2024年，威克帕克节迎来了创纪录的参与人数。

items.en: Despite the turnout, gate donations reached their lowest point in our history.
items.zh: 尽管参与人数众多，但入场捐款却达到了我们历史上最低的水平。

items.en: This year, we’ve been forced to
items.zh: 今年，我们不得不

items.en: The growth of the food and drink market in Europe is being driven by a shift in consumer habits and the rise of wholesale opportunities.
items.zh: 欧洲食品饮料市场的增长由消费者习惯的转变和批发机会的增加所驱动。

items.en: This development is boosting wholesale demand from the food service segment by 4 to 5 percent a year across Europe, compared with growth in retail demand of 1 to 2 percent.
items.zh: 这一发展正在提升欧洲各地餐饮业的批发需求，每年增长 4 到 5 个百分点，与零售需求每年增长 1 到 2 个百分点相比。

items.en: Meanwhile, as the recession is looming, people are getting anxious about their spending.
items.zh: 同时，随着经济衰退即将来临，人们开始对自己的消费感到焦虑。

items.en: Most leading retailers have already tried e-commerce, with limited success, and expansion abroad.
items.zh: 大多数领先零售商已经尝试过电子商务，但成效有限，以及海外扩张。

items.en: But almost all have ignored the big, profitable opportunity in their own backyard: the wholesale food and drink trade, which appears to be just the kind of market retailers need.
items.zh: 但几乎所有都忽视了自家后院中巨大的、有利可图的机会：批发食品饮料贸易，这似乎正是零售商所需要的市场类型。

items.en: Definitely not.
items.zh: 肯定不是。

items.en: The functioning of the market is still dominated by the logic of retail, with producers and retailers operating in long-established chains.
items.zh: 市场运作仍受零售逻辑主导，生产者和零售商在长期存在的供应链中运营。

items.en: Retailers that master the intricacies of wholesaling in Europe may well expect to reap substantial profits thereby.
items.zh: 掌握欧洲批发业务复杂之处的零售商可能会因此获得可观的利润。

items.en: At least, that is how it looks as a whole.
items.zh: 至少，整体看起来是这样。

items.en: Closer inspection reveals important differences among the biggest national markets, especially in their customer segments and wholesale structures, as well as the competitive dynamics of individual food and drink categories.
items.zh: 更仔细的观察揭示了最大的国内市场之间存在重要差异，尤其是在其客户群体和批发结构方面，以及各个食品和饮料类别的竞争动态。

items.en: Big retailers must understand these differences before they can identify the right segments to target.
items.zh: 大型零售商必须理解这些差异才能确定正确的目标客户群体。

items.en: Demand comes mainly from two sources: independent mom-and-pop grocery stores which, unlike large retail chains, are too small to buy straight from producers, and food service operators that cater to consumers when they don't eat at home.
items.zh: 需求主要来自两个方面：独立的小型杂货店，它们不像大型零售连锁店那样能够直接从生产商采购，以及为在家外用餐的消费者提供服务的餐饮服务运营商。

items.en: Such food service operators range from snack machines to large institutional catering ventures, but most of these businesses are known in the trade as "horeca": hotels, restaurants, and cafes.
items.zh: 此类食品服务运营商从零食自动贩卖机到大型机构餐饮企业不等，但这些企业大多在业内被称为"horeca"：酒店、餐馆和咖啡馆。

items.en: Overall, Europe's wholesale market for food and drink is growing at the same sluggish pace as the retail market, but the figures, when added together, mask two opposing trends.
items.zh: 总体而言，欧洲的食品和饮料批发市场正以与零售市场相同的缓慢速度增长，但这些数据加在一起时却掩盖了两种相反的趋势。

items.en: Moreover, average overall margins are higher in wholesale than in retail; wholesale demand from the food service sector is growing quickly as more Europeans eat out more often; and changes in the competitive dynamics of this fragmented industry are at last making it feasible for wholesalers to consolidate.
items.zh: 此外，批发业务的整体平均利润率高于零售业务；食品服务行业对批发的需求正在快速增长，因为越来越多的欧洲人更频繁地外出就餐；而这一分散行业的竞争格局变化终于使批发商能够进行 1 整合。

items.en: Copying Birds May Save Aircraft Fuel
items.zh: 模仿鸟类可能节省飞机燃料

items.en: Both Boeing and Airbus have trumpeted the efficiency of their newest aircraft, the 787 and A350 respectively.
items.zh: 波音和空客都曾高调宣扬其最新飞机——787和A350——的效率。

items.en: Their clever designs and lightweight composites certainly make a difference.
items.zh: 他们的巧妙设计和轻质复合材料确实产生了显著影响。

items.en: But a group of researchers at Stanford University, led by Ilan Kroo, has suggested that airlines could take a more naturalistic approach to cutting jet-fuel use and it would not require them to buy new aircraft.
items.zh: 但由Ilan Kroo领导的斯坦福大学研究团队建议，航空公司可以采取更自然的方法减少喷气燃料使用，且无需购买新飞机。

items.en: The answer, says Dr. Kroo, lies with birds.
items.zh: 据克鲁博士说，答案在于鸟类。

items.en: Since 1914, scientists have known that birds flying in formation – a V-shape – expend less energy.
items.zh: 自1914年以来，科学家们就知道以V字形编队飞行的鸟类消耗更少的能量。

items.en: The air flowing over a bird’s wings curls upwards behind the wingtips, a phenomenon known as upwash.
items.zh: 流经鸟类翅膀的空气在翼尖后方向上卷曲，这种现象被称为上升气流。

items.en: Other birds flying in the upwash experience reduced drag, and spend less energy propelling themselves.
items.zh: 其他在上升气流中飞行的鸟类会遇到阻力减少，并且花费更少的能量来推动自己。

items.en: Peter Lissaman, an aeronautics expert who was formerly at Caltech and the University of Southern California, has suggested that a formation of 25 birds might enjoy a range increase of 71%.
items.zh: 曾任职于加州理工学院和南加州大学的航空专家Peter Lissaman提出，25只鸟的编队可能使飞行距离增加71%。

items.en: When applied to aircraft, the principles are not substantially different.
items.zh: 当应用于飞机时，这些原理没有实质性差异。

items.en: Dr. Kroo and his team modeled what would happen if three passenger jets departing from Los Angeles, San Francisco and Las Vegas were to assemble over Utah, assume an inverted V-formation, occasionally change places so all could have a turn in the most favourable positions, and proceed to London.
items.zh: Kroo博士和他的团队模拟了如果从洛杉矶、旧金山和拉斯维加斯起飞的三架客机在犹他州上空集结、组成倒V字形队列、偶尔变换位置以使所有飞机都能轮流处于最有利的位置，然后飞往伦敦会发生的情况。

items.en: They found that the aircraft consumed as much as 15% less fuel (coupled with a reduction in carbon-dioxide output).
items.zh: 他们发现这种飞机的燃油消耗量减少了多达15%（并伴随着二氧化碳排放量的减少）。

items.en: Nitrogen-oxide emissions during the cruising portions of the flight fell by around a quarter.
items.zh: 飞行巡航阶段的氮氧化物排放量减少了大约四分之一。

items.en: There are, of course, knots to be worked out.
items.zh: 当然存在需要解决的问题。

items.en: One consideration is safety, or at least the perception of it.
items.zh: 一个考虑因素是安全，或者至少是安全的感知。

items.en: Would passengers feel comfortable travelling in companion?
items.zh: 乘客会感到在同伴陪同下旅行舒适吗？

items.en: Dr. Kroo points out that the aircraft could be separated by several nautical miles, and would not be in the intimate groupings favoured by display teams like the Red Arrows.
items.zh: 克鲁博士指出，这些飞机可以相隔数海里，不会像红箭队这样的表演团队所偏好的那样紧密编队。

items.en: A passenger peering out of the window might not even see the other planes.
items.zh: 从窗户往外张望的乘客可能甚至看不到其他飞机。

items.en: Whether the separation distances involved would satisfy air-traffic-control regulations is another matter, although a working group at the International Civil Aviation Organisation has included the possibility of formation flying in a blueprint for new operational guidelines.
items.zh: 涉及的间隔距离是否符合空中交通管制规定则是另一回事，尽管国际民用航空组织的一个工作组已将编队飞行的可能性纳入新运行指南的蓝图中。

items.en: It remains to be seen how weather conditions affect the air flows that make formation flight more efficient.
items.zh: 仍有待观察天气状况如何影响使编队飞行更高效的气流。

items.en: In zones of increased turbulence, the planes’ wakes will decay more quickly and the effect will diminish.
items.zh: 在湍流增强的区域，飞机的尾流会更快衰减并且影响会减弱。

items.en: Dr. Kroo says this is one of the areas his team will investigate further.
items.zh: 克鲁博士表示，这是他们团队将要进一步调查的领域之一。

items.en: It might also be hard for airlines to co-ordinate the departure times and destinations of passenger aircraft in a way that would allow them to gain from formation flight.
items.zh: 航空公司可能也难以协调客机的起飞时间和目的地，以实现从编队飞行中获益。

items.en: Cargo aircraft, in contrast, might be easier to reschedule, as might routine military flights.
items.zh: 相比之下，货机可能更容易重新安排，常规军事航班也是如此。

items.en: As it happens, America’s armed forces are on the case already.
items.zh: 碰巧，美国武装部队已经在处理此事。

items.en: Earlier this year the country’s Defence Advanced Research Projects Agency announced plans to pay Boeing to investigate formation flight, though the programme has yet to begin.
items.zh: 今年早些时候该国国防高级研究计划局宣布计划向波音公司支付费用以研究编队飞行尽管该项目尚未开始

items.en: There are reports that some military aircraft flew in formation when they were low on fuel during the Second World War, but Dr. Lissaman says they are unsubstantiated.
items.zh: 有报道称第二次世界大战期间一些军用飞机在燃料不足时曾编队飞行，但Lissaman博士表示这些报道未经证实。

items.en: “My father was an RAF pilot and my cousin the skipper of a Lancaster lost over Berlin,” he adds.
items.zh: 他补充道：我父亲是一名皇家空军飞行员，我表兄则是一名兰开斯特轰炸机的飞行员，后来在柏林上空失事。

items.en: So he should know.
items.zh: 因此他应该知道。

items.en: Findings of the Stanford University researchers will promote the sales of new Boeing and Airbus aircraft.
items.zh: 斯坦福大学研究人员的研究结果将促进新型波音和空客飞机的销售。

items.en: The upwash experience may save propelling energy as well as reducing resistance.
items.zh: 上洗体验可能节省推进能量并减少阻力。

items.en: Formation flight is more comfortable because passengers can not see the other planes.
items.zh: 编队飞行更舒适，因为乘客不能看到其他飞机。

items.en: The role that weather plays in formation flight has not yet been clearly defined.
items.zh: 天气在编队飞行中的作用尚未明确界定。

items.en: It has been documented that during World War Ⅱ, America’s armed forces once tried formation flight to save fuel.
items.zh: 有记录显示，在第二次世界大战期间，美国武装部队曾尝试编队飞行以节省燃料。

items.zh: 毫不令人意外的是，多达一半的英语专业博士生在获得学位前退学。

items.en: These are disciplines that are going out of style: 22% of American college graduates now major in business compared with only 2% in history and 4% in English.
items.zh: 这些是正在过时的学科：现在美国大学毕业生主修商科的比例是22%，与仅2%的历史学和4%的英语专业相比。

items.en: However, many leading American universities want their undergraduates to have a grounding in the basic canon of ideas that every educated person should possess.
items.zh: 然而，许多美国顶尖大学希望其本科生具备每个受过教育的人都应掌握的基本思想体系。

items.en: But most find it difficult to agree on what a "general education" should look like.
items.zh: 但大多数人难以就“通识教育”应该是什么样子达成一致。

items.en: At Harvard, Mr. Menand notes, "the great books are read because they have been read" - they form a sort of social glue.
items.zh: 在哈佛，门德先生指出，"伟大的书籍之所以被阅读，是因为它们已经被阅读过"——它们形成了一种社会粘合剂。

items.en: There are simply too few posts.
items.zh: 帖子实在太少。

items.en: This is partly because universities continue to produce ever more PhDs.
items.zh: 部分原因是大学持续培养越来越多的博士生。

items.en: But fewer students want to study humanities subjects: English departments awarded more bachelor's degrees in 1970-71 than they did 20 years later.
items.zh: 但越来越少的学生想学习人文学科：英语系在1970-71年授予的学士学位比20年后授予的更多。

items.en: Fewer students require fewer teachers.
items.zh: 学生人数减少，所需教师人数也随之减少。

items.en: So, at the end of a decade of thesis-writing, many humanities students leave the profession to do something for which they have not been trained.
items.zh: 因此，在完成十年的论文写作后，许多人文专业学生离开学术界去做他们未受过训练的事情。

items.en: Many students experience both varieties.
items.zh: 许多学生都经历了这两种类型。

items.en: Although more than half of Harvard undergraduates end up in law, medicine or business, future doctors and lawyers must study a non-specialist liberal-arts degree before embarking on a professional qualification.
items.zh: 尽管哈佛大学超过半数的本科生最终从事法律、医学或商业领域，未来的医生和律师必须在着手获得专业资格之前先攻读非专业文理通科学位。

items.en: The growth in public money for academic research has speeded the process: federal research grants rose fourfold between 1960 and 1990, but faculty teaching hours fell by half as research took its toll.
items.zh: 公共资金对学术研究的增长加速了这一进程：联邦政府的研究资助在1960年至1990年间增长了四倍，但教师授课时数却因研究带来的负担而减少了一半。

items.en: Professionalism has turned the acquisition of a doctoral degree into a prerequisite for a successful academic career: as late as 1969 a third of American professors did not possess one.
items.zh: 专业化使得获得博士学位成为学术成功生涯的必要条件：直到1969年，三分之一的美国教授尚未拥有博士学位。

items.en: But the key idea behind professionalisation, argues Mr. Menand, is that "the knowledge and skills needed for a particular specialisation are transmissible but not transferable.
items.zh: 但门兰先生认为专业化背后的关键理念是“某一特定专业所需的知识和技能是可传授但不可转移的”。

items.en: So disciplines acquire a monopoly not just over the production of knowledge, but also over the production of the producers of knowledge.
items.zh: 因此，学科不仅垄断了知识的生产，还垄断了知识生产者的培养。

items.en: Otherwise, academics will continue to think dangerously alike, increasingly detached from the societies which they study, investigate and criticise.
items.zh: 否则，学者们将继续危险地想法趋同，日益脱离他们所研究、调查和批评的社会。

items.en: "Academic inquiry, at least in some fields, may need to become less exclusionary and more holistic.
items.zh: 至少在某些领域，学术研究可能需要变得更加包容和整体性。

items.en: Yet quite how that happens, Mr. Menand does not say.
items.zh: 然而，门兰先生并未说明这一过程如何发生。

items.en: They may then decide to go elsewhere.
items.zh: 他们可能会决定去其他地方。

items.en: For something curious has been happening in American universities, and Louis Menand, a professor of English at Harvard University, captured it skillfully.
items.zh: 在……方面，有一件奇特的事情正在发生，哈佛大学英语教授Louis Menand巧妙地捕捉到了这一点。

items.en: With its theme that "Mind is the master weaver," creating our inner character and outer circumstances, the book As a Man Thinketh by James Allen is an in-depth exploration of the central idea of self-help writing.
items.zh: 以“心灵是主宰的编织者”为主题，创造我们的内在性格和外在环境，詹姆斯·艾伦的著作《As a Man Thinketh》深入探讨了自助类写作的核心理念。

items.en: (46) Allen's contribution was to take an assumption we all share - that because we are not robots we therefore control our thoughts - and reveal its erroneous nature.
items.zh: (46) 艾伦的贡献在于将我们共同的一个假设——即因为我们不是机器人，所以能够控制自己的思想——揭示其错误性。

items.en: Because most of us believe that mind is separate from matter, we think that thoughts can be hidden and made powerless; this allows us to think one way and act another.
items.zh: 由于大多数人相信心灵与物质是分离的，我们认为思想可以被隐藏并变得无能为力；这使我们能够以一种方式思考，而以另一种方式行动。

items.en: However, Allen believed that the unconscious mind generates as much action as the conscious mind, and (47) while we may be able to sustain the illusion of control through the conscious mind alone, in reality we are continually faced with a question: "Why cannot I make myself do this or achieve that?
items.zh: 然而，艾伦认为潜意识与意识一样能产生行动，尽管我们可能仅凭意识就能维持对控制的幻觉，但实际上我们不断面临这样的问题："为什么我无法让自己做这件事或达成那个目标？"

items.en: Since desire and will are damaged by the presence of thoughts that do not accord with desire, Allen concluded: "We do not attract what we want, but what we are.
items.zh: 由于与欲望不一致的想法的存在会损害欲望和意志，Allen得出结论：我们吸引的不是我们想要的，而是我们本身。

items.en: Achievement happens because you as a person embody the external achievement; you don't "get" success but become it.
items.zh: 成就之所以发生，是因为你作为一个人体现了外在的成就；你不是“获得”成功，而是成为成功。

items.en: There is no gap between mind and matter.
items.zh: 心灵与物质之间没有鸿沟。

items.en: Part of the fame of Allen's book is its contention that "Circumstances do not make a person, they reveal him.
items.zh: 艾伦的书之所以闻名，部分原因在于其论点"环境不会造就一个人，而是揭示他的真实面目。"

items.en: (48) This seems a justification for neglect of those in need, and a rationalization of exploitation, of the superiority of those at the top and the inferiority of those at the bottom.
items.zh: 这似乎是对忽视需要帮助之人的正当化，以及对剥削、上层人士的优越性和底层人士的劣等性的合理化。

items.en: This, however, would be a knee-jerk reaction to a subtle argument.
items.zh: 然而，这会是对一个微妙论点的本能反应。

items.en: Each set of circumstances, however bad, offers a unique opportunity for growth.
items.zh: 无论处境多么糟糕，都提供一个独特的机会去成长。

items.en: If circumstances always determined the life and prospects of people, then humanity would never have progressed.
items.zh: 如果环境一直决定人们的生活和前途，那么人类就不会进步。

items.en: In fact, (49) circumstances seem to be designed to bring out the best in us, and if we feel that we have been "wronged" then we are unlikely to begin a conscious effort to escape from our situation.
items.zh: 事实上，环境似乎旨在激发我们最好的一面，如果我们感到自己受到了委屈，我们就不大可能开始有意识地努力摆脱我们的处境。

items.en: Nevertheless, as any biographer knows, a person's early life and its conditions are often the greatest gift to an individual.
items.zh: 然而，正如任何传记作家所知，一个人的早年生活及其生活条件往往是他最大的礼物。

items.en: The sobering aspect of Allen's book is that we have no one else to blame for our present condition except ourselves.
items.zh: Allen 一书令人警醒的方面在于，我们无法将当前状况归咎于他人，只能归咎于自己。

items.en: (50) The upside is the possibilities contained in knowing that everything is up to us; where before we were experts in the array of limitations, now we become authorities of what is possible.
items.zh: (50) 积极面在于认识到一切取决于我们自身的可能性；过去我们擅长应对各种限制，现在却成为掌握可能性的权威。

items.en: Directions: Write a letter to a friend of yours to 1) recommend one of your favorite movies and 2) give reasons for your recommendation.
items.zh: 说明：给你的朋友写一封信，推荐你最喜欢的电影之一，并说明推荐的理由。

items.en: Use "Li Ming" instead.
items.zh: 请提供需要翻译的英文句子。

items.en: Do not write the address.
items.zh: 不要写地址。

items.en: The Internet affords anonymity to its users, a blessing to privacy and freedom of speech.
items.zh: 互联网赋予其用户匿名性，这对隐私和言论自由是一种益处。

items.en: But that very anonymity is also behind the explosion of cyber-crime that has 1 across the Web.
items.zh: 但正是这种匿名性也是网络犯罪激增背后的原因，这1在互联网上发生。

items.en: Can privacy be preserved 2 bringing safety and security to a world that seems increasingly 3?
items.zh: 在似乎日益[3]的世界中，隐私能否在[2]带来安全与保障的同时得以保留？

items.en: Last month, Howard Schmidt, the nation’s cyber-czar, offered the federal government a 4 to make the Web a safer place – a “voluntary trusted identity” system that would be the high-tech 5 of a physical key, a fingerprint and a photo ID card, all rolled 6 one.
items.zh: 上个月，国家网络事务协调员霍华德·施密特向联邦政府提出了一个4，以使网络环境更安全——一种自愿可信身份系统，这将是实体钥匙、指纹和照片身份证的高科技5，所有这些功能都整合在6。

items.en: The system might use a smart identity card, or a digital credential 7 to a specific computer, and would authenticate users at a range of online services.
items.zh: 该系统可能使用智能身份卡，或用于特定计算机的数字凭证7，并将在多种在线服务中认证用户。

items.en: The idea is to 8 a federation of private online identity systems.
items.zh: 这个想法是要建立一个 8 私人在线身份系统的联盟。

items.en: Users could 9 which system to join, and only registered users whose identities have been authenticated could navigate those systems.
items.zh: 用户可9选择加入哪个系统，只有已注册且身份已通过验证的用户才能使用这些系统。

items.en: The approach contrasts with one that would require an Internet driver’s license 10 by the government.
items.zh: 这种方法与需要由政府发放的网络驾照10形成对比。

items.en: Google and Microsoft are among companies that already have these “single sign-on” systems that make it possible for users to 11 just once but use many different services.
items.zh: 谷歌和微软是已经拥有这些“单点登录”系统的公司之一，这些系统使用户只需11一次登录即可使用多种不同的服务。

items.en: 12 , the approach would create a “walled garden” in cyberspace, with safe “neighborhoods” and bright “streetlights” to establish a sense of a 13 community.
items.zh: 12 ，这种方法将在网络空间中创建一个“封闭花园”，有安全的“社区”和明亮的“路灯”来建立一种 13共同体的感觉。

items.en: Mr. Schmidt described it as a “voluntary ecosystem” in which “individuals and organizations can complete online transactions with 14, trusting the identities of each other and the identities of the infrastructure 15 which the transaction runs.
items.zh: 施密特先生将其描述为一种“自愿生态系统”，在其中“个人和组织可以完成在线交易14，信任彼此的身份以及交易所运行的基础设施15的身份”。

items.en: Still, the administration’s plan has 16 privacy rights activists.
items.zh: 然而，政府的计划仍遭到 16 位隐私权活动人士的反对。

items.en: Some applaud the approach; others are concerned.
items.zh: 一些人赞扬这种方法；另一些人则表示担忧。

items.en: It seems clear that such a scheme is an initiative push toward what would 17 be a compulsory Internet “driver’s license” mentality.
items.zh: 显然，这样的计划是一个主动推动，朝着会成为强制性互联网“驾照”心态的方向。

items.en: The plan has also been greeted with 18 by some computer security experts, who worry that the “voluntary ecosystem” envisioned by Mr. Schmidt would still leave much of the Internet 19.
items.zh: 该计划也受到了一些计算机安全专家的第 18 个欢迎，他们担心施密特先生设想的“自愿生态系统”仍会留下互联网的第 19 个部分。

items.en: They argue that all Internet users should be 20 to register and identify themselves, in the same way that drivers must be licensed to drive on public roads.
items.zh: 他们认为所有互联网用户都应年满20岁才能注册并实名认证，就像驾驶员必须持有驾照才能在公共道路上驾驶一样。

items.zh: 根据每段文字后的问题，选择A、B、C或D作答。

items.en: Finally, figures close to the Franch government have murmured, euro-zone members should agree to some fiscal and social harmonisation: e.g., curbing competition in corporate-tax rates or labour costs.
items.zh: 最后，法国政府内部人士表示，欧元区成员国应达成财政和社会政策的协调统一，例如限制在公司税率或劳动力成本方面的竞争。

items.en: Leading doctors today weigh in on the debate over the government’s role in promoting public health by demanding that ministers impose “fat taxes” on unhealthy food and introduce cigarette-style warnings to children about the dangers of a poor diet.
items.zh: 当今权威医生就政府在促进公共健康中的作用展开讨论，要求部长们对不健康食品征收“脂肪税”，并向儿童发出类似香烟包装的警告，说明不良饮食的危害。

items.en: The demands follow comments made last week by the health secretary, Andrew Lansley, who insisted the government could not force people to make healthy choices and promised to free businesses from public health regulations.
items.zh: 这些要求是在上周卫生大臣安德鲁·兰斯利发表评论后提出的，他坚持认为政府无法强制人们做出健康选择，并承诺使企业免于公共卫生法规的约束。

items.en: But senior medical figures want to stop fast-food outlets opening near schools, restrict advertising of products high in fat, salt or sugar, and limit sponsorship of sports events by fast-food producers such as McDonald’s.
items.zh: 但资深医疗专家希望阻止快餐店在校园附近开设，限制高脂肪、高盐或高糖产品的广告，并限制麦当劳等快餐企业对体育赛事的赞助。

items.en: They argue that government action is necessary to curb Britain’s addiction to unhealthy food and help halt spiraling rates of obesity, diabetes and heart disease.
items.zh: 他们认为政府行动是必要的，以遏制英国对不健康食品的依赖并帮助遏制肥胖、糖尿病和心脏病的上升趋势。

items.en: Professor Terence Stephenson, president of the Royal College of Paediatrics and Child Health, said that the consumption of unhealthy food should be seen to be just as damaging as somking or excessive drinking.
items.zh: 皇家儿科与儿童健康学院院长特伦斯·斯蒂芬森教授表示，不健康食品的消费应被视为与吸烟或过量饮酒同样有害。

items.en: “Thirty years ago, it would have been inconceivable to have imagined a ban on smoking in the workplace or in pubs, and yet that is what we have now.
items.zh: 三十年前，人们难以想象在工作场所或酒吧里会出台禁止吸烟的规定，然而现在我们却拥有了这样的规定。

items.en: Are we willing to be just as courageous in respect of obesity?
items.zh: 我们在对待肥胖问题上是否同样勇敢？

items.en: I would suggest that we should be,” said the leader of the UK’s children’s doctors.
items.zh: 我建议我们应该这样，英国儿童医生协会的负责人说。

items.en: Lansley has alarmed health campaigners by suggesting he wants industry rather than government to take the lead.
items.zh: Lansley通过提出他希望工业界而非政府牵头，使健康活动人士感到震惊。

items.en: He said that manufacturers of crisps and candies could play a central role in the Change4Life campaign, the centrepiece of government efforts to boost healthy eating and fitness.
items.zh: 他说，薯片和糖果制造商可以在Change4Life运动中发挥核心作用，该运动是政府促进健康饮食和健身努力的核心。

items.en: He has also criticised the celebrity chef Jamie Oliver’s high-profile attempt to improve school lunches in England as an example of how “lecturing” people was not the best way to change their behaviour.
items.zh: 他也批评了名厨Jamie Oliver在英格兰高调改善学校午餐的尝试，认为这是“说教”并非改变人们行为的最佳方式的例证。

items.en: Stephenson suggested potential restrictions could include banning TV advertisements for foods high in fat, salt or sugar before 9 pm and limiting them on billboards or in cinemas.
items.zh: 史蒂芬森建议潜在限制措施包括禁止在晚上9点前播放高脂肪、高盐或高糖食品的电视广告，并限制其在广告牌或电影院的播放。

items.en: “If we were really bold, we might even begin to think of high-calorie fast food in the same way as cigarettes – by setting strict limits on advertising, product placement and sponsorship of sports events,” he said.
items.zh: 如果我们真的有勇气，甚至可能开始像看待香烟一样看待高热量快餐——通过严格限制广告、产品植入和体育赛事赞助，他说。

items.en: Such a move could affect firms such as McDonald’s, which sponsors the youth coaching scheme run by the Football Association.
items.zh: 此举可能影响像麦当劳这样的公司，这些公司资助英格兰足球协会的青年教练计划。

items.en: Fast-food chains should also stop offering “inducements” such as toys, cute animals and mobile phone credit to lure young customers, Stephenson said.
items.zh: 史蒂芬森表示，快餐连锁店也应停止提供玩具、可爱动物和手机话费等诱因以吸引年轻顾客。

items.en: Professor Dinesh Bhugra, president of the Royal College of Psychiatrists, said: “If children are taught about the impact that food has on their growth, and that some things can harm, at least information is available up front.
items.zh: 皇家精神科医师学院院长迪内什·布格拉教授表示：如果儿童被教导食物对其生长的影响，以及某些事物可能造成伤害，至少信息在一开始就能获得。

items.en: He also urged councils to impose “fast-food-free zones” around schools and hospitals – areas within which takeaways cannot open.
items.zh: 他还敦促地方委员会在学校和医院周围设立“无快餐区”——在这些区域内不得开设外卖店。

items.en: A Department of Health spokesperson said: “We need to create a new vision for public health where all of society works together to get healthy and live longer.
items.zh: 卫生部门发言人表示：我们需要为公共卫生制定一个新的愿景，让整个社会共同努力，变得健康并延长寿命。

items.en: This includes creating a new ‘responsibility deal’ with business, built on social responsibility, not state regulation.
items.zh: 这包括与企业建立新的‘责任协议’，以社会责任为基础，而非国家监管。

items.en: Later this year, we will publish a white paper setting out exactly how we will achieve this.
items.zh: 今年晚些时候，我们将发布一份白皮书，阐述我们具体将如何实现这一目标。

items.en: The food industry will be alarmed that such senior doctors back such radical moves, especially the call to use some of the tough tactics that have been deployed against smoking over the last decade.
items.zh: 食品行业将震惊于资深医生支持这些激进举措，尤其是呼吁采用过去十年中针对吸烟所采取的一些严厉措施。

items.en: Andrew Lansley held that the government should ban fast-food outlets in the neighborhood of schools.
items.zh: 安德鲁·兰斯利认为政府应该禁止在学校周边地区开设快餐店。

items.en: Terence Stephenson agreed that “lecturing” was an effective way to improve school lunches in England.
items.zh: 特伦斯·斯蒂芬森同意“讲课”是改善英格兰学校午餐的有效方式。
四十三。

items.en: Jamie Oliver seemed to believe that cigarette-style warnings should be introduced to children about the dangers of a poor diet.
items.zh: 杰米·奥利弗似乎认为应该向儿童介绍类似香烟的警告，以告知不良饮食的危险。

items.en: Dinesh Bhugra suggested that the producers of crisps and candies could contribute significantly to the Change4Life campaign.
items.zh: Dinesh Bhugra建议薯片和糖果的生产商能为Change4Life活动做出重要贡献。
四十五。

items.en: A Department of Health spokesperson proposed that parents should set good examples for their children by keeping a healthy diet at home.
items.zh: 卫生部门发言人提议，家长应通过在家保持健康饮食为孩子树立好榜样。

items.en: Who would have thought that, globally, the IT industry produces about the same volume of greenhouse gases as the world’s airlines do – roughly 2 percent of all CO2 emissions?
items.zh: 谁能想到，全球IT行业产生的温室气体量与全球航空业相当——约占全球二氧化碳排放量的2%？

items.en: Many everyday tasks take a surprising toll on the environment.
items.zh: 许多日常任务对环境造成出人意料的负担。

items.en: A Google search can leak between 0.2 and 7.0 grams of CO2, depending on how many attempts are needed to get the “right” answer.
items.zh: 一次谷歌搜索可能泄漏0.2至7.0克的CO2，取决于获取“正确”答案所需的尝试次数。

items.en: To deliver results to its users quickly, then, Google has to maintain vast data centres around the world, packed with powerful computers.
items.zh: 为了快速向用户交付结果，Google必须在全球维护庞大的数据中心，里面装满强大计算机。

items.en: While producing large quantities of CO2, these computers emit a great deal of heat, so the centres need to be well air-conditioned, which uses even more energy.
items.zh: 这些计算机在产生大量二氧化碳的同时还会排放大量热量，因此数据中心需要配备良好的空调系统，这会消耗更多能源。

items.en: However, Google and other big tech providers monitor their efficiency closely and make improvements.
items.zh: 然而，谷歌和其他大型科技公司密切监控其效率并进行改进。

items.en: Monitoring is the first step on the road to reduction, but there is much more to be done, and not just by big companies.
items.zh: 监测是减少之路的第一步，但还有很多工作要做，不仅仅需要大公司来承担。

items.en: Think of those fleeting moments when you look out of an aeroplane window and realise that you are flying, higher than a bird.
items.zh: 想想那些转瞬即逝的时刻，当你从飞机窗口向外看时，意识到你正在飞行，比鸟还要高。

items.en: Now think of your laptop, thinner than a brown-paper envelope, or your cellphone in the palm of your hand.
items.zh: 现在想想你的笔记本电脑，比信封还薄，或者你掌心的手机。

items.en: Take a moment or two to wonder at those marvels.
items.zh: 花一两分钟惊叹于那些奇迹。

items.en: You are the lucky inheritor of a dream come true.
items.zh: 你是梦想成真的幸运继承者。

items.en: The second half of the 20th century saw a collection of geniuses, warriors, entrepreneurs and visionaries labour to create a fabulous machine that could function as a typewriter and printing press, studio and theatre, paintbrush and gallery, piano and radio, the mail as well as the mail carrier.
items.zh: 20世纪后半叶见证了一群天才、战士、企业家和远见者努力创造一台非凡的机器，它能够同时充当打字机和印刷机、工作室和剧院、画笔和画廊、钢琴和收音机、邮件以及邮递员。

items.en: (41) The networked computer is an amazing device, the first media machine that serves as the mode of production, means of distribution, site of reception, and place of praise and critique.
items.zh: 联网计算机是一种惊人的设备，作为生产方式、传播手段、接收场所和褒贬之地的首个媒体机器。

items.en: The computer is the 21st century's culture machine.
items.zh: 计算机是21世纪的文化机器。

items.en: But for all the reasons there are to celebrate the computer, we must also act with caution.
items.zh: 尽管有诸多理由为计算机欢呼，我们也必须保持谨慎。

items.en: (42) I call it a secret war for two reasons.
items.zh: (42) 我称之为秘密战争，有两个原因。

items.en: First, most people do not realise that there are strong commercial agendas at work to keep them in passive consumption mode.
items.zh: 首先，大多数人并未意识到有强大的商业议程正在运作，以保持他们处于被动消费模式。

items.en: Second, the majority of people who use networked computers to upload are not even aware of the significance of what they are doing.
items.zh: 其次，使用联网电脑上传的大多数人甚至没有意识到他们所做之事的重要性。

items.en: All animals download, but only a few upload.
items.zh: 所有动物都在下载，但只有少数会上传。

items.en: Beavers build dams and birds make nests.
items.zh: 水獭建造水坝，鸟筑巢。

items.en: Yet for the most part, the animal kingdom moves through the world downloading.
items.zh: 然而，大多数情况下，动物界在世界上移动时都在下载。

items.en: Humans are unique in their capacity to not only make tools but then turn around and use them to create superfluous material goods - paintings, sculpture and architecture - and superfluous experiences - music, literature, religion and philosophy.
items.zh: 人类在不仅制造工具，而且反过来利用它们创造非必需的物质商品——绘画、雕塑和建筑，以及非必需的经历——音乐、文学、宗教和哲学方面是独一无二的。

items.en: (43) For all the possibilities of our new culture machines, most people are still stuck in download mode.
items.zh: (43) 尽管我们的新型文化机器拥有各种可能性，但大多数人仍停留在下载模式。

items.en: Even after the advent of widespread social media, a pyramid of production remains, with a small number of people uploading material, a slightly larger group commenting on or modifying that content, and a huge percentage remaining content to just consume.
items.zh: 即使在社交媒体广泛普及之后，内容生产金字塔依然存在，少数人上传内容，稍多一些的人评论或修改这些内容，而绝大多数人则仅限于消费这些内容。

items.en: (44) Television is a one-way tap flowing into our homes.
items.zh: (44)电视是一种单向流入我们家中的信息源。

items.en: The hardest task that television asks of anyone is to turn the power off after he has turned it on.
items.zh: 电视要求任何人完成的最难任务是在打开之后关闭电源。

items.en: (45) What counts as meaningful uploading?
items.zh: （45）什么构成有意义的上传？

items.en: My definition revolves around the concept of "stickiness" - creations and experiences to which others adhere.
items.zh: 我的定义围绕"黏性"这一概念展开——他人会依附的创造和体验。

items.en: Downloading and consuming culture requires great skills, but failing to move beyond downloading is to strip oneself of a defining constituent of humanity.
items.zh: 下载和消费文化需要高超的技能，但未能超越下载则意味着剥夺人性的关键组成部分。

items.en: Your translation should be written clearly on ANSWER SHEET 2.

items.en: Since the days of Aristotle, a search for universal principles has characterized the scientific enterprise.
items.zh: 自亚里士多德时代以来，对普遍原则的探索一直是科学事业的特征。

items.en: In some ways, this quest for commonalities defines science.
items.zh: 在某些方面，对共同点的探索定义了科学。

items.en: Newton's laws of motion and Darwinian evolution each bind a host of different phenomena into a single explicatory framework.
items.zh: 牛顿运动定律和达尔文进化论各自将大量不同的现象整合到一个解释性框架中。

items.en: (46) In physics, one approach takes this impulse for unification to its extreme, and seeks a theory of everything - a single generative equation for all we see.
items.zh: 在物理学中，有一种方法将这种统一的冲动推向极端，并寻求一种万物理论——一个能解释我们所见一切现象的单一生成方程。

items.en: It is becoming less clear, however, that such a theory would be a simplification, given the dimensions and universes that it might entail.
items.zh: 然而，这种理论是否是一种简化变得越来越不明确，鉴于它可能涉及的维度和宇宙。

items.en: Nonetheless, unification of sorts remains a major goal.
items.zh: 尽管如此，某种形式的统一仍然是主要目标。

items.en: This tendency in the natural sciences has long been evident in the social sciences too.
items.zh: 自然科学中的这一趋势在社会科学中也早已显而易见。

items.en: (47) Here, Darwinism seems to offer justification, for if all humans share common origins, it seems reasonable to suppose that cultural diversity could also be traced to more constrained beginnings.
items.zh: （47）在这里，达尔文主义似乎提供了正当理由，因为如果所有人有共同的起源，文化多样性也可能追溯到更受限制的起源。

items.en: Just as the bewildering variety of human courtship rituals might all be considered forms of sexual selection, perhaps the world's languages, music, social and religious customs and even history are governed by universal features.
items.zh: 正如人类求偶仪式的令人眼花缭乱的多样性可能都被视为性选择的形式，也许世界上的语言、音乐、社会和宗教习俗甚至历史都受普遍特征的支配。

items.en: (48) To filter out what is unique from what is shared might enable us to understand how complex cultural behavior arose and what guides it in evolutionary or cognitive terms.
items.zh: 筛选出独特与共享的部分或许能帮助我们理解复杂文化行为是如何产生的，以及从进化或认知角度是什么在引导它。

items.en: That, at least, is the hope.
items.zh: 至少，这是希望。

items.en: But a comparative study of linguistic traits published online today supplies a reality check.
items.zh: 但今天在线发表的一份关于语言特征的比较研究提供了一个现实检验。

items.en: Russell Gray at the University of Auckland and his colleagues consider the evolution of grammars in the light of two previous attempts to find universality in language.
items.zh: 奥克兰大学的Russell Gray及其同事基于两次先前尝试在语言中寻找普遍性，来考虑语法的演变。

items.en: The most famous of these efforts was initiated by Noam Chomsky, who suggested that humans are born with an innate language-acquisition capacity that dictates a universal grammar.
items.zh: 这些努力中最有名的是由诺姆·乔姆斯基发起的，他提出人类天生具有先天的语言习得能力，这种能力决定了普遍语法。

items.en: A few generative rules are then sufficient to unfold the entire fundamental structure of a language, which is why children can learn it so quickly.
items.zh: 一些生成规则足以揭示语言的全部基础结构，这就是为什么儿童能如此快速地掌握它。

items.en: (49) The second, by Joshua Greenberg, takes a more empirical approach to universality, identifying traits (particularly in word order) shared by many languages, which are considered to represent biases that result from cognitive constraints.
items.zh: 第二项由Joshua Greenberg提出，采用更实证的方法研究普遍性，识别出许多语言共有的特征（尤其是词序），这些特征被认为代表了由认知限制导致的偏见。

items.en: Gray and his colleagues have put them to the test by examining four family trees that between them represent more than 2,000 languages.
items.zh: Gray和他的同事通过研究四个语系树，这四个语系树共同代表了超过2000种语言，对他们进行了测试。

items.en: (50) Chomsky's grammar should show patterns of language change that are independent of the family tree or the pathway tracked through it, whereas Greenbergian universality predicts strong co-dependencies between particular types of word-order relations.
items.zh: (50) Chomsky的语法应展示独立于语系树或其内部追踪路径的语言变化模式，而格林伯格的普遍性预测特定类型的语序关系之间存在强烈的相互依赖性。

items.en: Neither of these patterns is borne out by the analysis, suggesting that the structures of the languages are lineage-specific and not governed by universals.
items.zh: 分析结果并未证实这两种模式，这表明语言的结构是谱系特异性的，而非由普遍规律所支配。

items.en: “Universal history, the history of what man has accomplished in this world, is at bottom the History of the Great Men who have worked here,” wrote the Victorian sage Thomas Carlyle.
items.zh: 维多利亚时代的智者托马斯·卡莱尔写道：世界通史，即人类在世界上所成就的历史，归根结底是伟人的历史。

items.en: Well, not any more it is not.

items.en: Suddenly, Britain looks to have fallen out with its favorite historical form.
items.zh: 突然，英国似乎已经与其最喜爱的历史形式决裂。

items.en: This could be no more than a passing literary craze, but it also points to a broader truth about how we now approach the past: less concerned with learning from our forefathers and more interested in feeling their pain.
items.zh: 这可能不过是一时的文学热潮，但它也揭示了一个更普遍的真相：我们如今对待过去的态度，更少关注从祖先那里学习，而更热衷于感受他们的痛苦。

items.en: Today, we want empathy, not inspiration.
items.zh: 今天，我们想要共情，而不是灵感。

items.en: From the earliest days of the Renaissance, the writing of history meant recounting the exemplary lives of great men.
items.zh: 从文艺复兴的最早时期开始，历史写作意味着叙述伟人的典范生平。

items.en: In 1337, Petrarch began work on his rambling writing De Viris Illustribus – On Famous Men, highlighting the virtus (or virtue) of classical heroes.
items.zh: 1337年，彼特拉克开始创作他的随笔《De Viris Illustribus – 《论著名人物》》，强调古典英雄的virtus（或美德）。

items.en: Petrarch celebrated their greatness in conquering fortune and rising to the top.
items.zh: 彼得拉克赞美他们战胜命运并登上顶峰的伟大。

items.en: This was the biographical tradition which Niccolò Machiavelli turned on its head.
items.zh: 这便是尼科洛·马基雅维利所彻底颠覆的传记传统。

items.en: In The Prince, he championed cunning, ruthlessness, and boldness, rather than virtue, mercy and justice, as the skills of successful leaders.
items.zh: 在《The Prince》中，他主张成功领导者应具备权谋、冷酷无情和果敢，而非美德、仁慈和正义。

items.en: Over time, the attributes of greatness shifted.
items.zh: 随着时间的推移，伟大的特质发生了转变。

items.en: The Romantics commemorated the leading painters and authors of their day, stressing the uniqueness of the artist’s personal experience rather than public glory.
items.zh: 浪漫主义者们纪念他们那个时代的杰出画家和作家，强调艺术家个人经历的独特性，而不是公众荣誉。

items.en: By contrast, the Victorian author Samuel Smiles wrote Self -Help as a catalogue of the worthy lives of engineers, industrialists and explorers.
items.zh: 相比之下，维多利亚时代的作家塞缪尔·斯迈尔斯撰写了《Self-Help》一书，作为工程师、工业家和探险家等值得尊敬之人的生平名录。

items.en: “The valuable examples which they furnish of the power of self-help, of patient purpose, resolute working, and steadfast integrity, issuing in the formation of truly noble and manly character, exhibit,” wrote Smiles, “what it is in the power of each to accomplish for himself.
items.zh: 他们提供的关于自助力量、持之以恒的志向、坚决的工作和坚定不移的诚信的宝贵例子，最终形成真正高尚而男子气概的性格，展现了每个人为自己所能实现的事物，Smiles写道。

items.en: His biographies of James Watt, Richard Arkwright and Josiah Wedgwood were held up as beacons to guide the working man through his difficult life.
items.zh: 他撰写的詹姆斯·瓦特、理查德·阿克赖特和约西亚·韦奇伍德的传记被视作榜样，以引导工人度过艰难的生活。

items.en: This was all a bit bourgeois for Thomas Carlyle, who focused his biographies on the truly heroic lives of Martin Luther, Oliver Cromwell and Napoleon Bonaparte.
items.zh: 这对托马斯·卡莱尔来说都显得有点资产阶级气，他专注于马丁·路德、奥利弗·克伦威尔和拿破仑·波拿巴这些真正英雄般的人生。

items.en: These epochal figures represented lives hard to imitate, but to be acknowledged as possessing higher authority than mere mortals.
items.zh: 这些划时代的人物象征着难以模仿的生活，但被承认为拥有比凡人更高的权威。

items.en: Not everyone was convinced by such bombast.
items.zh: 并非每个人都被这种夸张的言辞所说服。

items.en: “The history of all hitherto existing society is the history of class struggles,” wrote Marx and Engels in The
items.zh: 迄今为止所有存在的社会的历史都是阶级斗争的历史，马克思和恩格斯在《中写道

items.en: Communist Manifesto.
items.zh: 共产党宣言

items.en: For them, history did nothing, it possessed no immense wealth nor waged battles: “It is man, real, living man who does all that.
items.zh: 对他们来说，历史并未采取任何行动，也没有拥有巨大的财富或发动战争：正是现实的、活着的人完成了所有这些事。

items.en: And history should be the story of the masses and their record of struggle, As such, it needed to appreciate the economic realities, the social contexts and power relations in which each epoch stood.
items.zh: 历史应当是大众的斗争历程，因此需要理解每个时代所处的经济现实、社会背景和权力关系。

items.en: For: “Men make their own history, but they do not make it just as they please; they do not make it under circumstances chosen by themselves, but under circumstances directly found, given and transmitted from the past.
items.zh: 人们创造自己的历史，但他们并不是随心所欲地创造；他们不是在自己选择的环境中创造，而是在直接从过去继承下来的环境中创造。

items.en: This was the tradition which revolutionised our appreciation of the past.
items.zh: 这正是彻底改变了我们对过去的理解的传统。

items.en: In place of Thomas Carlyle, Britain nurtured Christopher Hill, EP Thompson and Eric Hobsbawm.
items.zh: 代替托马斯·卡莱尔，英国培养了克里斯托弗·希尔、E.P.汤普森和埃里克·霍布斯鲍姆。

items.en: History from below stood alongside biographies of great men.
items.zh: 自下而上的历史与伟人传记并列存在。

items.en: Whole new realms of understanding – from gender to race to cultural studies – were opened up as scholars unpicked the multiplicity of lost societies.
items.zh: 随着学者们揭示了失落社会的多样性，全新的理解领域——从性别到种族再到文化研究——被打开。

items.en: And it transformed public history too: downstairs became just as fascinating as upstairs.
items.zh: 它也改变了公共历史：楼下变得和楼上一样有趣。

items.en: Petrarch highlighted the public glory of the leading artists.
items.zh: 彼特拉克强调了主要艺术家的公众荣耀。

items.en: Niccolò Machiavelli focused on epochal figures whose lives were hard to imitate.
items.zh: 尼科洛·马基雅维利专注于划时代的人物，他们的生活难以模仿。

items.en: Samuel Smiles opened up new realms of understanding the great men in history.
items.zh: Samuel Smiles开辟了理解历史伟人领域的新天地。

items.en: Thomas Carlyle held that history should be the story of the masses and their record of struggle.
items.zh: 托马斯·卡莱尔认为历史应该是大众的故事以及他们的斗争记录。

items.en: Marx and Engels dismissed virtue as unnecessary for successful leaders.
items.zh: 马克思和恩格斯认为美德对成功领导者而言是不必要的。

items.en: When people in developing countries worry about migration, they are usually concerned at the prospect of their best and brightest departure to Silicon Valley or to hospitals and universities in the developed world.
items.zh: 当发展中国家的人们担忧移民时，他们通常担心的是本国最优秀的人才前往硅谷或发达国家的医院和大学的前景。

items.en: These are the kind of workers that countries like Britain, Canada and Australia try to attract by using immigration rules that privilege college graduates.
items.zh: 这些是英国、加拿大和澳大利亚等国家试图通过使用优先考虑大学毕业生的移民规则来吸引的工人类型。

items.en: Lots of studies have found that well-educated people from developing countries are particularly likely to emigrate.
items.zh: 大量研究发现，发展中国家的受过良好教育的人尤其可能移民。

items.en: A big survey of Indian households in 2004 found that nearly 40% of emigrants had more than a high-school education, compared with around 3.3% of all Indians over the age 25.
items.zh: 2004年一项针对印度家庭的大规模调查发现，近40%的移民拥有高中以上教育，与约3.3%的25岁以上印度人相比。

items.en: This “brain drain” has long bothered policymakers in poor countries.
items.zh: 这种“人才流失”现象长期困扰着贫困国家的政策制定者。

items.en: They fear that it hurts their economies, depriving them of much-needed skilled workers who could have taught at their universities, worked in their hospitals and come up with clever new products for their factories to make.
items.zh: 他们担心这会损害他们的经济，剥夺了他们急需的高技能工人，这些工人可能在他们的大学任教、在他们的医院工作，并为他们的工厂研发出聪明的新产品。

items.zh: 假设你前几天从网上商店购买的电子词典存在某些问题。

items.zh: 总体而言，人们在做出个人决策时并不擅长考虑背景信息。

items.en: To 8 this idea, he turned to the university-admissions process.

items.en: He studied the results of 9,323 MBA interviews 12 by 31 admissions officers.
items.zh: 他研究了9,323次MBA面试的结果，这些面试由31名招生官进行。

items.en: The interviewers had 13 applicants on a scale of one to five.
items.zh: 面试官对 13 名申请人进行了 1 到 5 分的评分。

items.en: The scores were 15 used in conjunction with an applicant's score on the Graduate Management Admission Test, or GMAT, a standardised exam which is 16 out of 800 points, to make a decision on whether to accept him or her.

items.en: The social sciences are flourishing.
items.zh: 社会科学正在繁荣发展。

items.en: As of 2005, there were almost half a million professional social scientists from all fields in the world, working both inside and outside academia.
items.zh: 截至2005年，全球各领域的专业社会科学家几乎有五十万名，从事学术界内外的工作。

items.en: According to the World Social Science Report 2010, the number of social-science students worldwide has swollen by about 11% every year since 2000.
items.zh: 根据《世界社会科学研究报告2010》，自2000年以来，全球社会科学学生人数每年增长约11%。

items.en: Yet this enormous resource is not contributing enough to today's global challenges, including climate change, security, sustainable development and health.
items.zh: 然而，这一巨大资源未能充分应对当今全球面临的挑战，包括气候变化、安全、可持续发展和健康。

items.en: (41) Humanity has the necessary agro-technological tools to eradicate hunger, from genetically engineered crops to artificial fertilizers.
items.zh: (41) 人类拥有必要的农业科技工具来消除饥饿，从基因工程作物到人工肥料。

items.en: Here, too, the problems are social: the organization and distribution of food, wealth and prosperity.
items.zh: 此处的问题同样是社会性的：食品、财富和繁荣的组织与分配。

items.en: (42) This is a shame - the community should be grasping the opportunity to raise its influence in the real world.
items.zh: （42）这很遗憾——社群应该抓住这个机会提升其在现实世界中的影响力。

items.en: To paraphrase the great social scientist Joseph Schumpeter: there is no radical innovation without creative destruction.
items.zh: 正如伟大的社会科学家Joseph Schumpeter所言：没有创造性破坏，就没有根本性创新。

items.en: Today, the social sciences are largely focused on disciplinary problems and internal scholarly debates, rather than on topics with external impact.
items.zh: 如今，社会科学主要关注学科内部问题和学术界内部的争论，而非具有外部影响的话题。

items.en: Analyses reveal that the number of papers including the keywords "environmental change" or "climate change" have increased rapidly since 2004.
items.zh: 分析显示，包含关键词环境变化或气候变化的论文数量自2004年以来迅速增加。

items.en: (43) When social scientists do tackle practical issues, their scope is often local: Belgium is interested mainly in the effects of poverty on Belgium, for example.
items.zh: (43) 当社会科学家处理实际问题时，他们的研究范围往往局限于本地：例如，比利时主要关注贫困对本国的影响。

items.en: And whether the community's work contributes much to an overall accumulation of knowledge is doubtful.
items.zh: 社区的工作是否对总体知识积累有重大贡献仍存疑。

items.en: The problem is not necessarily the amount of available funding.
items.zh: 问题不一定是可用资金的数量。

items.en: (44) This is an adequate amount so long as it is aimed in the right direction.
items.zh: （44）只要方向正确，这数量就足够。

items.en: Social scientists who complain about a lack of funding should not expect more in today's economic climate.
items.zh: 抱怨资金不足的社会科学家在当今的经济环境下不应指望获得更多。

items.en: The trick is to direct these funds better.
items.zh: 关键在于更有效地分配这些资金。

items.en: The European Union Framework funding programs have long had a category specifically targeted at social scientists.
items.zh: 欧盟框架资助计划长期以来一直设有专门针对社会科学家的类别。

items.en: This year, it was proposed that the system be changed: Horizon 2020, a new program to be enacted in 2014, would not have such a category.
items.zh: 今年有人提议改变这一制度：2014年将实施的新计划Horizon 2020不会设立此类类别。

items.en: This has resulted in protests from social scientists.
items.zh: 这导致了社会科学家的抗议。

items.en: But the intention is not to neglect social science; rather, the complete opposite.
items.zh: 但意图并非忽视社会科学；相反，是要完全重视它。

items.en: (45) That should create more collaborative endeavors and help to develop projects aimed directly at solving global problems.
items.zh: (45) 这将促成更多协作项目并有助于推动直接针对解决全球性问题的项目。

items.en: Global challenges and social innovation ought to receive much more attention from scientists, especially the young ones.
items.zh: 全球性挑战和社会创新应当获得更多科学家，尤其是年轻一代的关注。

items.en: Stemming climate change, for example, is as much about changing consumption patterns and promoting tax acceptance as it is about developing clean energy.
items.zh: 遏制气候变化，例如，与发展清洁能源同样重要，也在于改变消费模式和促进税收接受。

items.en: And in Europe, some are up in arms over a proposal to drop a specific funding category for social-science research and to integrate it within cross-cutting topics of sustainable development.
items.zh: 在欧洲，一些人强烈反对一项提议，即取消社会科学研究的特定资金类别，并将其纳入可持续发展的跨领域主题中。
